chapters.title: Chapter 551 First Test
paragraphs: *Boom*

"Damn it!" Ximen Yan cursed angrily after he could only light up eight crystals, and he could also hear the jeers from the beast and natural races. 'These bastards! Sooner or later, my father will exterminate their races, and I will laugh at your destruction.' "Your turn."
"Yes, Master." Qian Ying immediately took a deep breath and punched the stone obelisk, lighting up six crystals.

Ximen Yan nodded in satisfaction at Qian Ying's result, and he immediately pulled her into his embrace before giving her a rough kiss on the lips. 'If you manage to bring Ximen Yueliang to me, I will give you a tremendous reward, and it will help your cultivation break through to the 2-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. If you also manage to bring Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue to me, I will give you an additional reward, so you should try your best.'
"Yes, Master." Qian Ying then looked at the three women, and a faint evil smile appeared on her face.
"It's your turn! Don't let me down!" Ximen Yan shouted to his people.
The demons of the Dark Demon Kingdom immediately took turns hitting the stone obelisk. Three-quarters of them successfully lit up five crystals, but a quarter failed to do so.
After they stepped aside, Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang immediately led the demons from the Ximen Demon Kingdom. "Hey, brother, you must not lose to Ximen Yan, or our father will punish you."

"I know." Ximen Hongwu immediately took an attacking stance, clenched his fists tightly, and took a deep breath. After a black aura enveloped his body, he immediately punched the stone obelisk with all his strength, causing a loud bang.
*Boom*
Gradually, the crystals started to light up from the bottom, but Ximen Hongwu let out a disappointed sigh when it stopped at the eighth crystal, only to dimly light up at the ninth.
"Hehe! Not bad!" Ximen Yueliang said as she chuckled. "Even though you failed to light up the ninth crystal, it has already lit up dimly, which means your strength is slightly above Ximen Yan."

"I assume only the eighth crystal is lit up, so our strength is still equal." Ximen Hongfu then pushed his little sister forward. "Your turn, Yueliang. You must be able to light up at least five crystals, or you will fail."
"Humph! It's too easy for me." Ximen Yueliang immediately walked in front of the stone obelisk and touched it gently. "Five crystals, huh?"

Ximen Yueliang immediately closed her eyes and stood in her spot in silence, confusing the spectators. However, their eyes widened as soon as the eighth crystal lit up rapidly, indicating that her strength was superior to her big brother even though their cultivation was three minor levels apart.
Ximen Yueliang immediately turned to her big brother, making a victory gesture with her two fingers. "See? It's easy, right? I can match you even if I don't use all my strength."

Ximen Hongwu shook his head helplessly at his little sister's behavior, and he immediately ordered the demons from the Ximen Demon Kingdoms to start. Unfortunately, only half of them could light five crystals or more, and the rest failed to meet the minimum requirement.

After that, the humans began to take their turns testing their strength, starting with the Bai Kingdom. Bai Chongxi, Bai Renfu, and Bai Shaoyi could light eight, six, and five crystals, respectively. However, only a quarter of the people of their kingdom managed to light five crystals.

On the Zhou Kingdom's side, Zhou Tong succeeded in lighting ten crystals, shocking the strongest people from the beast and natural races' kingdoms. They never expected a human cultivator to match their strength, but they remembered his kingdom's relationship with the two demon kingdoms, and they thought the demons had helped him to increase his strength.

Unfortunately, his siblings' strength was not on par with Zhou Tong's, especially since Zhou Tai could only light six crystals. Meanwhile, Zhou Fang and Zhou Meiling only succeeded in lighting five crystals, highlighting the stark difference in their strength. The other people from their kingdom were clearly stronger than those from the Bai Kingdom, with three-quarters of them managing to light five crystals.

Huangfu Lian then led his brothers, sisters, and people to run the test. The first prince of the Huangfu Kingdom was quite satisfied with his results, having managed to light up eight crystals using a special technique to enhance his raw strength.

Like their eldest brother, Huangfu Xiaofan, Huangfu Xiaoying, and Huangfu Xiaomei use a special technique to light seven crystals. Even though people sneered at their actions, the Huangfu siblings didn't care about them. Of the members of the Huangfu Kingdom, only half managed to light five crystals.

As the weakest of the five human kingdoms, only a few representatives of the Yun Kingdom managed to light up five crystals, and their number was at most thirty. Even so, three of them managed to light up six and seven crystals.

Based on the system scan, Zhang Fei discovered that one of them was Guo Jihai, the nephew of Guo Xuehua, who was cultivated in the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. Judging from his physique, he is also a body cultivator, and his raw strength is the highest. The other two were Li Yao and Su Zhen, who cultivated in the quasi-divine realm.

"Li Yao is Big Brother Aoxian's wife." Zhang Fei turned to Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue in surprise. "Su Zhen is Guo Jihai's fiancée, but their relationship often goes through ups and downs, so they haven't gotten married yet."
"Oh." Zhang Fei nodded slightly in response, but he then turned to Xian Xianqin, who had been paying attention to Qian Ying since earlier. "Are you going to take your test now?"
"No." Xian Xianq shook her head at Zhang Fei. "I'll wait for your turn first."

"Princes! Do you realize that his attitude is similar to that of a lovebird?" Xian Xianqin immediately looked back and glared at Yuan Luo, but she shrugged her shoulders and pointed at their sect sisters. "Ask them; they will definitely agree with me."

Ru Yanyue and Ye Zhiqiu chose not to say anything, but Bai Tian'er was different from them, and she immediately agreed with Yuan Luo. "She's right, Princess. You're a lovebird, so you should confess your feelings to him, or I'll take him away from you."

"Tch!" Xian Xianqin gritted her teeth and turned her gaze at one of the groups from the Xian Imperial Sect, who had begun to line up on the four sides of the stone obelisk. She then pointed to two men and informed Zhang Fei of their identities. 'They are Uncle Xian Hong's sons, Xian Yu and Xian Mu. Both of them hate my family because of the enmity between our fathers, and many members of our sect side with them, especially since their father is the supposed emperor of our kingdom. However, his tendency to align with the demons led my father to overthrow him before he could ascend to the throne. In the end, he joined the dark demon kingdoms and became Ximen Gongfu's right-hand man, repeatedly attempting to kill us with their assistance.'

'As expected, there are indeed complicated issues between them, but I'm not surprised by Xian Feng's decision, especially since humans hate demons most.' Zhang Fei then pointed to the two other people leading the other group. 'Who are these two? Why are they leading the third group?'

Xian Xianqin looked at the two people for a moment before telling Zhang Fei. 'Xian Qifeng is Uncle Luo's son, and the woman next to him is his wife, Luo Qinglin. Although they are still part of our royal family, my second uncle prefers to be neutral, and the people in their entourage also do not want to interfere in our family disputes. Even so, they are very loyal to our kingdom, and they will help us if other kingdoms attack us.'
'I see.' Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. 'What about your aunt? Is she married?'
'Hmm?' Xian Xianqin looked at Zhang Fei with raised eyebrows. 'How did you know about Aunt Changyue? Have you met her before?'

'Look at the sky.' Xian Xianqin looked up immediately and saw Xian Changyue standing there, her arms crossed in front of her chest, her gaze firmly fixed on Zhang Fei. She has been here for some time now, but none of you have noticed her presence. Unlike you, I have been aware of her presence from the very beginning. Based on her gaze, I believe your parents sent her here to keep an eye on me.'

Xian Xianqin let out a soft sigh in her heart before nodding to Zhang Fei. 'Hey, you know that my parents have no ill intentions towards you, right? I hope you don't take their actions to heart, and you can ignore Aunt Changyue.'

'I'm not that petty, okay? I know they have no ill intentions towards me, and they've helped me a lot, but I still don't like it when they keep monitoring me.' Zhang Fei then asked Xian Xianqin again. 'Is your aunt married?'
'Not yet.' Xian Xian shook her head in response. 'Aunt Changyue doesn't like men, and she doesn't feel like she needs them, so she never plans to get married.'

A faint smile immediately appeared on Zhang Fei's face, and he looked up slightly at Xian Changyue, but he right away shifted his gaze to the stone obelisk when the eight crystals lit up twice. 'Xian Yu and Xian Mu are much stronger than you and your big brother; no wonder there are more people on their side.'

'You are right; they are indeed stronger than us, but we will not lose to them once we break through to the Seven Divine Realm.' However, Xian Xianqin's expression turned disappointed. 'Unfortunately, we never managed to break through to that stage. No matter how hard we try to break through that final barrier, we always fail to do so, which makes us feel that something is holding us back.'

Zhang Fei directly pointed at Xian Xianqin's chest. 'Clear your demon heart first; I'm sure you will successfully break through to the seven divine realms after that. If you still have difficulty doing it, I will help you to break through to that stage.'

If Xian Xianqin had not witnessed Zhang Fei's abilities, she would definitely doubt him. However, she already knew quite a lot of his abilities, and he could even defeat Huan Ya, who was much stronger than him. Moreover, he could reach the Earth Realm even though he was only 20 years old, something he could not do in the past.
Xian Xianqin nodded with a smile. 'I will prove to you that I can overcome my demon heart.'

'That's good.' Zhang Fei then looked at the people from both groups again, and he saw that Xian Qifeng had successfully lit up seven crystals. He did not pay much attention to the other people, but he still remembered their respective strengths, especially the people from Xian Yu and Xian Mu's group.
Once the members of the two groups completed their tasks, Chao Yuanfeng immediately ordered his disciples, "It's your turn. You guys must make it into the top 100 rankings."
"Yes, Master."

Ximen Chuixue immediately led them toward the stone obelisk, but those people did not care about him or the other disciples. They also did not care about Xian Xianwu, Xian Xianqin, Yun Qinghao, and Yun Xinyue. Their gazes were only focused on one person, Zhang Fei, who was leisurely walking at the back.
Even Ximen Yan, who had no information about Zhang Fei, paid serious attention, mainly because of his closeness to Xian Xianqin.
Likewise, Ximen Yu and Ximen Mu glared at Zhang Fei with a look full of questions, especially since they had never heard of him before they set off for the Star Tower.
[Master, are you going to show off your power here? If you do that, people from the Huangfu, Bai, and the two demon kingdoms will target you directly.]

'Didn't you pay attention to their expressions, Mei?' Zhang Fei responded with a slight shake of his head. 'Even without me showing my strength, those people from the Huangfu and Bai Kingdoms have already plotted to capture me. The people from the Zhou Kingdom still look down on me now, but they will also target me if I show my strength. I can see that those demons are also targeting me; Ximen Yan appears to be jealous of my close relationship with Xian Xianqin. I don't know Ximen Hongfu and Ximen Yueliang's reasons for targeting me, but they have been glancing at me repeatedly since earlier.
[Does that mean you will show them your power?]

'Yes.' Zhang Fei nodded to Mei. 'Whether I show my power or not, they will definitely target me anyway, so I don't need to hold back my power. If the situation gets complicated, I can hide them in my training space, or I can bring them back to the Sky Jade Realm.'

[Well, that's true. However, it would be best if you still exercise caution, particularly when dealing with people from the three human kingdoms. Regarding the demons, you can utilize your demonic force manipulation ability to weaken them, and you also possess new techniques from the Nine Demon Secret Scripture.]
'Yeah.'
"Brother, you must use all your abilities, and we will prove to them that our group is not weak." As soon as they arrived in front of the stone obelisk, Yuan Luo immediately spoke to Ximen Chuixue.

Ximen Chuixue nodded and took a stance, but he briefly looked at the demons before he unleashed his full strength. With his full strength, he punched the stone obelisk, creating a loud explosion audible from a considerable distance.
*Boom*
In a few seconds, all ten crystals lit up, and the people immediately shifted their gazes from Zhang Fei to Ximen Chuixue.
"Yay!" Yuan Luo jumped up in joy after seeing that. "Congratulations, Brother! Your diligent training over the past few years has paid off!"
"Phew!" Ximen Chuixue breathed a sigh of relief and withdrew his strength, but he then turned to Bai Tian'er. "Your turn."

Bai Tian'er nodded to Ximen Chuixue before standing in front of the stone obelisk. She thought for a while as she looked at the three Bai siblings. 'Your family ostracized my family even though we are part of the Bai royal family, but I will show you that I am much better than you.'
*Swoosh*

Bai Tian'er's aura exploded, and a shockwave swept toward the people. She used her full power to punch the stone obelisk, causing the spectators' eyes to widen in shock as she ignited nine crystals. However, the other two groups from the Xian Imperial Sect were particularly shocked after witnessing that, as they never expected her raw strength to be that high.
"Nine crystals, huh?" Bai Tian'er muttered to herself as she looked towards the top of the stone obelisk. "My raw strength is still inferior to yours, Brother Chui."
Ximen Chuixue shook his head at Bai Tian'er. "I have been a body cultivator since I was small, and my body cultivation level is quite high, so my raw strength is also higher than yours."
"Yeah." Bai Tian'er then spoke to Yuan Luo. "If you can't light up a minimum of six crystals, I will ask our master to punish you."

"Hey! I'm Brother Chui's lover, and I won't disappoint him." Unlike Ximen Chuixue or Bai Tian'er, Yuan Luo did not take any stance and directly punched the stone obelisk, igniting the seven crystals. "Hehe! Yay! Seven crystals!"

Following them were Ying Shanhu, Huang Chi, Xuan Wuji, Yu Chongming, Xi Shen, Ru Yanyue, and Ye Zhiqiu. All of them managed to light up six and seven crystals, satisfying Chao Yuanfeng, who was watching them from a distance.

"Brother." Xian Xianwu nodded to his sister and struck the stone obelisk, immediately lighting eight crystals. "Sigh! At first, I thought I could ignite the ninth crystal, but my power could only ignite the eighth.'

"Haha." Yun Qinghao laughed and patted Xian Xianwu's shoulder. "Brother, your strength has improved a lot compared to before, so you should be quite satisfied. Anyway, I will do it now, but I think our strengths are no different now."
Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue immediately tested their raw strength through the stone obelisk, and both of them succeeded in lighting eight and seven crystals.
Zhang Fei then pushed Xian Xianqin forward. "Show them you are stronger than many of them, even though your cultivation is still in the quasi-divine realm."
"Yeah."

chapters.title: Chapter 552 Demon Heart Challange
paragraphs: *Swoosh*

As a shockwave left Xian Xianqin's body, the crystals on the stone obelisk began to light up one by one, but it finally stopped at the eighth crystal. Even so, she was satisfied with the result because her strength had increased by two crystals compared to the last time, which made her confident that she could pass those challenges on the first floor.
"Are you satisfied with the results?"

Xian Xianqin immediately turned to Zhang Fei, who was standing beside her. "Yes, I am satisfied with the result. Next, I will defeat my demon heart challenge, and I am optimistic that we will be able to pass all the tests on the first floor. Now, it's your turn, and you must use your best strength to achieve the best results."

"Honestly, I still don't want to show my strength to the public, but they're targeting me now, so it won't make a difference whether I hide it or not." Xian Xianqin immediately looked at the few people who were watching Zhang Fei seriously, and most of them obviously had malicious intentions towards him, except for people from the beast and natural races. "You must go back, or my attack will impact you."

After Zhang Fei said that, many people started to mock him from afar because his cultivation was the weakest among them. They didn't believe that he could light up five crystals, and they believed that he would be lucky if he could light up one.
Unlike them, Xian Xianqin completely believed in Zhang Fei's strength, especially after she witnessed his battle with Huan Ya a week ago.
Bai Tian'er and the others also believed in Zhang Fei's strength, especially since he could knock a body cultivator with high cultivation like Ximen Chuixue backward.
Even though their parents highly praised Zhang Fei, Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue were still skeptical of his strength. They tried to ask Xian Xianwu about it, but he didn't say anything.

'I would definitely fail this test of strength if I weren't a body cultivator, and both of my body techniques have already broken through, so I'm confident I can pass it.' Zhang Fei then took an attacking stance and pulled his right hand back. He then looked at the crystal above and smiled faintly before punching the stone obelisk.
*Boom*
*Rumble... Rumble... Rumble..*

The powerful explosion shocked all the spectators, and they also lost their balance as the ground beneath them shook violently as a result of Zhang Fei's attack. However, they quickly stabilized themselves and focused their gazes on the crystals that began to light up one by one. Zhang Fei's result swiftly passed the fifth crystal without showing any signs of stopping.
"What the hell?"
"How is that possible?"
"Impossible! He must be cheating!"
Almost everyone present around the stone obelisk began to scream in disbelief, and they began to accuse Zhang Fei of cheating after his previous attack lit up the tenth crystal.

Xian Changyue, who was watching Zhang Fei from up in the sky, fell dumbstruck after she witnessed that. She didn't expect that his raw strength was already so great, and he even achieved perfect results, surpassing so many cultivators who were much stronger than him. 'This kid! How can a dual cultivator like him have such a powerful attack? If he punched me with his current strength without any protection, I would probably die on the spot.'

Meanwhile, Long Chen and Long Tian, who were standing in the distance, were grinning widely after witnessing that. Their fists were tightly clenched, and they really couldn't wait to spar with him, just like their father.

Although the members of the natural races were also shocked by Zhang Fei's results, none of them doubted his strength. They were sensitive to Qi's movements and knew he wasn't cheating, so they considered having him join them.

'Have you two understood the reason Uncle Yun and Aunt Guo asked you to join us?' Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue nodded to Xian Xianwu as their eyes continued to stare at Zhang Fei's back. 'He is a genius among geniuses, but he still has to improve his strength to be able to compete with these people openly.'

Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue glanced at their potential opponents, but they instantly scowled when they saw their murderous gazes directed toward Zhang Fei. 'He is indeed a genius, but he made a big mistake by showing off his strength. Look at them! All of them are eager to kill him, so we must protect him during the maze and survival challenges.'

'No need.' Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue raised their eyebrows at Xian Xianwu. 'You two don't know him yet, but we have trained with him for a week, so I can tell you both that he does not need our protection. Instead, we need his protection, and we will be as safe as long as we are by his side.'
Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue seemed doubtful about that, so they paid attention to Ximen Chuixue and the others' expressions, but all of them looked at Zhang Fei with confidence.

"Fei!" Xian Xianqin suddenly shouted, ran forward, and hugged Zhang Fei from behind, a behavior that amused Yuan Luo and the others. "Hehehe! I believed you would succeed in lighting the tenth crystal, and you've already proven it."
Zhang Fei immediately turned to Xian Xianqin and hugged her waist. "Since my darling believes in my abilities, I certainly can't let you down, right?"
Xian Xianqin was momentarily stunned, but her cheeks flushed as she remembered their situation, so she pushed Zhang Fei away and ran back to their group.

'This shy princess!' Zhang Fei then looked at those people, especially those who were openly showing their killing intent. As he expected, people from the Zhao Kingdom also started targeting him, and Zhou Tong was one of those who showed his killing intent towards him. However, he responded to them with a relaxed smile before looking toward the demons from both demon kingdoms, and he used his demonic force manipulation to make many of them shiver, including their seniors. 'Heh! If you guys dare to attack me, I will let the demon extermination sword quench its thirst by drinking your blood.'

Zhang Fei suddenly raised his eyebrows and looked up, especially since Xian Changyue decided to land in front of him. Without uttering a word, she stepped in front of the stone obelisk and delivered a light punch.

Although she did not use his full strength, Xian Changyue easily lit the ninth crystal, and her name immediately entered the top 100 rankings. "What are you waiting for? Don't you want to enter the tower?"

'This woman! She originally just wanted to monitor me, but now she wants to protect me from them.' Zhang Fei then turned to Xian Xianqin and the others. "Let's go in; we will definitely pass the first floor."
"Go!" Chao Yuanfeng immediately led his disciples to follow behind Zhang Fei and Xian Changyue.
The rest of the group, particularly those who had ranked in the top 100, also rushed into the tower. Most of them continued to stare at Zhang Fei, contemplating various ways to harm him.

Even though the people who escorted them didn't participate in those challenges, they could still enter the tower using their tokens, but they were teleported to a waiting area. Meanwhile, those who did not make it into the ranking immediately left the location with their returning jade.

After they entered the star tower, a portal immediately opened in front of the stone obelisk. Zhang Fei [1] led his wives, partners, family, and friends out of the training space. "All right, you guys can test your strength on this stone obelisk so we will know your progress."

They quickly followed Zhang Fei [1]'s order by striking the stone obelisk in turns, but most of them could only light up three to four crystals, especially the people from Earth. Even the young cultivators of the Sky Jade Realm could only light up five crystals at maximum, but they were not disappointed by their results, and it actually spurred their spirits to become even stronger.

As for the senior cultivators, most of them could light up six crystals, and only Boitata could light up seven crystals. Even so, none of them wanted to challenge the tower because there were so many evil cultivators inside, and they would only bring trouble to Zhang Fei, especially since many of them were targeting him.

Since they didn't intend to challenge the tower, Zhang Fei [1] immediately brought them back into the training space. He sent some of them into the beast space, such as Boitata, Shen Yu, and Shen Xueyi. That way, his real body can take them out to see the situation in the survival and maze challenges, but he will only take them out if the situation is really safe.

Inside the tower, Zhang Fei looked around in confusion because there was nothing inside, so Xian Xianqin immediately explained to him. "The challenges will start soon, but we don't know which one we will face first, so we can't prepare ourselves."
"It's okay. We've been preparing ourselves for a week, so I'm sure everything will be fine." Zhang Fei replied as he read each participant's data on the blue screen before his eyes.

"Aren't you too confident in yourself?" Zang Fei turned to Xian Changyue directly. "Your raw strength is indeed high, but you will face the battle challenge, and there is a possibility that you will face cultivators in the seven divine realms. With your current cultivation, you won't be able to defeat them, and they might even kill you due to your previous display of strength."

Although her words were cold and dismissive, Zhang Fei did not feel offended by Xian Changyue's words. "You are right, Senior Changyue. My current cultivation is indeed not as high as theirs, and they can kill me like an ant. However, none of you, including Princess Xianqin, are aware of my true abilities. You may think I am arrogant and overconfident, but I am confident in my abilities, and I am confident that I can pass the battle challenge."

Xian Changyue wanted to scold Zhang Fei, but Xian Xianqin immediately pulled her aside. She then informed her aunt about his battle with Huan Ya, which elicited a look of disbelief from her. My brother and I witnessed their battle firsthand, and he managed to defeat her within a matter of minutes. Even after she used her domain, she still didn't match it. That's why I believe that he will be able to pass the battle challenge, even if his opponent is a cultivator in the seven divine realms.'

Xian Changyue looked at Zhang Fei with a frown, but he responded with a confident smile. 'Sigh! I hope you are right, Xianqin. His talents were too high and rare, and it would be a shame if he died in their hands.'

'Don't worry, everything will be fine, and he won't die in their hands.' Xian Xianqin suddenly looked up, and her body trembled slightly as a black portal descended from the ceiling along with a huge screen. "Fei! The Demon Heart Challenge!"

Upon hearing that, everyone in the room became tense. They didn't expect that the first test would be the demon heart challenge, especially since it had always been the most difficult test for them. They had already failed the test multiple times, and failing the first test directly would prevent them from proceeding to the other tests.
"The demon heart challenge, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered as he looked at the black portal.
Since the demon heart challenge was a personal test, the black portal suddenly lit up and sucked in everyone present, sending them to various locations.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh as he appeared in front of his old house on Earth. "Why did the test bring me here? I drove my father crazy and killed my big brother, but I never regretted my actions. If I had to go through both once again, I would definitely do it again."
"Is that true, Zhang Fei?" A little girl's voice startled Zhang Fei, prompting him to turn towards her, but he was unable to recognize her face. "Hehe! Do you still remember me?"
"Who are you? How did you appear here?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows and inquired.

"I've always wanted to meet you, but you can't remember me, and it makes me sad." The little girl said this as she put on a pitiful look, but then she pointed to the house. "Our first meeting was when we were five years old, and we met in this house. Back then, you were a cheerful and friendly kid, and I really liked you, but you liked Zhang Lin more."

Zhang Fei shook his head, summoned the demon extermination sword, and pointed it at the girl. "You may be able to confuse other people's minds with your lies, but you won't be able to do it to me. I remember all my old memories, even my childhood memories, and you are not part of them, so you should show your true form right now."
"Hehehe." The little girl let out an eerie laugh. "You are indeed different from them, Zhang Fei. Usually, they will believe me right away, and they will try hard to find me in their memories."

However, the little girl quickly transformed into Chen Xin. "What about this woman? Despite your love for Zhang Lin, this woman was your first lover. Unfortunately, she betrayed you with Zhang He, and they conspired to frame you. In the end, you were abandoned by your family, which led to your death."
"Haish!" Zhang Fei exhaled softly. "Somehow, I feel that the person who created you to test us is too stupid."
"What do you mean by that?" The little girl asked with a frown.

"You can read all my memories while I was in this place, right?" The little girl nodded to Zhang Fei. "Since you can read my memories, you should already know that I don't care about their deaths. Even if they come back to life and appear in front of me again, I will kill them once again. That's why I said that your creator is a fool, and you are no different from a defective AI."

The little girl didn't say anything and turned to Zhang Hai. "What about your father? Don't you regret it? You would never have existed in this world without him, but you snatched your mother away from him, and your actions caused him to go crazy."

"Hey! If you want to test me with all this, you should let me pass right now." The little girl raised her eyebrows again, but Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "You're right that I wouldn't exist in this world without him, but I'm a demon now. Moreover, my mother always harbored sadness when she was with him, but she's happy with me now, so I'll never regret making him go crazy."

The little girl fell into deep thought for a while, but then she smiled faintly and turned into Chu Hong, causing Zhang Fei to frown. "This guy is a good man, and he really loves Liu Qingyu. He was willing to accept you into his family and marry two of his three daughters to you, but you repaid his kindness by snatching his wife."

"You're right. I repaid Chu Hong's kindness with evil, so I've wronged him." The little girl smiled after Zhang Fei said that, but his next words annoyed her. "He is dead now, and Qingyu is happy with me, so I no longer hold any regrets in my heart about him. Anyway, you can transform into every person I've hurt or killed in the past, but your efforts will ultimately be in vain. Like I said, I am a demon, and a demon is an evil creature."
"Ugh! You're so annoying!" The little girl shouted in annoyance as she stomped her feet repeatedly on the floor. "My master will definitely scold me when I get back!"
"Your master? Don't tell me that you are a living being." The little girl immediately covered her mouth, which convinced Zhang Fei.

"Tch! I'll let you pass this test!" Before Zhang Fei could say anything, the little girl had already sent him out of the place. "Ugh! I shouldn't have said that to him! Master will definitely punish me after this! Sigh! Whatever, it's already too late, and he already knows about me, so I should go back and report to my master."

chapters.title: Chapter 553 Results
paragraphs: "That damn little girl! I will definitely spank her ass if we meet again in the future." Zhang Fei then fell into deep thought regarding the identity of the little girl, her master, and the Star Tower. 'Hey, Mei! Do you think the founder of this tower was a person in the upper realms?'

[I'm not sure about it, Master. However, I detected an unusual Qi emanating from the stone obelisk, which differs from the Qi of the cultivators from the upper realms you have previously encountered. Moreover, Xian Xianqin said that this tower suddenly appeared by itself, and Feng Yao had no information about it. Hong Xinxin never mentioned it, leading me to believe that the founder of this tower was a person from a realm beyond the upper realms.]

'That may be true, but why would someone from that realm send this tower to this realm? What is the purpose of that person giving us so many challenges?' Zhang Fei then looked up. 'This tower still has nine more floors, but the challenges on the first floor are already numerous and challenging. The challenges from the second to the tenth floor will be even harder, so it's natural that they can't go up to the tenth floor.'

[I can't give you a definite answer about that, and you need to try to challenge up to the 10th floor to get the answer, Master. The people from this realm may not be able to reach the 10th floor, but you are different from them. Since you are the only living being with three identities and possess numerous cheats, I am confident that you will surpass them and reach that floor in the future.]

'Forget it! I don't want to think about it now.' Zhang Fei then looked at the screen above him, and he saw several names appear there. Within a few seconds, members of the beast and natural races reappeared in the room.

All of them were shocked when they saw Zhang Fei, so they immediately looked at the screen to see the results. They found his name at the top of the list, which meant he was the first person to complete the demon heart challenge.

Zhang Fei himself was surprised by their success in completing the challenge so quickly. He did not doubt that the members of the natural races could pass it easily, but he did not expect that some people from the beast races could also pass it so easily.

The Long siblings exchanged glances for a moment before approaching Zhang Fei, and Long Chen immediately spoke to him. "It seems that our father's assessment of you was correct, and you are indeed not an ordinary cultivator, Brother."
"At first, we were doubtful about his praise of you, but your strength test results opened our eyes, and we believe in his assessment now." Long Tian added.

The Long siblings' words caused some of the natural races to raise their eyebrows, but Zhang Fei's next words made them realize that they had misunderstood his relationship with the beast races. "Emperor Long Huang and Empress Long Baiyun only saw me from a distance, and we have never known each other, so his praise of me is too much."

"Hahaha!" Long Chen laughed upon hearing that. "You are not wrong about that, but we are the dragon race, and we have very sensitive best instincts. In fact, our father never praised us, but he praised you instead, so his praise of you is not excessive."

Long Tian then spoke to Zhang Fei as well. "To be honest, our father is eager to spar with you, but your current strength is still significantly inferior to his. That's why our father has asked us to test your strength, and we hope you are willing to spare some time to spar with us during the survival challenge."

"Sure." Zhang Fei immediately agreed to their request. "Since your cultivation surpasses mine, we must spar without our cultivation, and we will fight solely based on our physical strength and abilities."

"All right, we will fight without our cultivation." The Long siblings immediately agreed with this, particularly because their self-esteem was as high as their father's, and they had no intention of bullying a cultivator with a lower cultivation level.

"Can you show us your beast form, Brother?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows in response to Long Tian's question. "Our father told us that you are actually a beast, and your beast identity is not an ordinary beast but a mythical beast like us dragons, so we were curious about it."
Zhang Fei did not immediately answer Long Tian, but he first looked at the members of the natural races, who were looking at him in shock and curiosity.

Zhang Fei then transformed into his fox form, which shocked the members of the natural race. After all, his fox form was already very large, and he also had five tails. Unlike them, the Long siblings were not surprised to see this, especially since Long Huang had already informed them that he was a heavenly fox.

One of the members of the natural races, the young woman with wavy brown hair, rides a brown wolf, dashing toward them. Three people from the natural races immediately moved to follow her, and they observed Zhang Fei seriously.
Xin Xianzi, a petite woman with long pink hair and four wings behind her back, nodded repeatedly. "You are a heavenly fox, right?"

Zhang Fei had already guessed that people from the natural races would recognize his fox identity, and he wanted to use it to establish a relationship with them, so he immediately agreed to the Long Sibling's request to show his fox form.
"That's right, I am a heavenly fox." Zhang Fei immediately returned to his human form. "Only a few of them know the identity of my beast, so I hope you guys don't talk about it when they return."

The people of both races immediately nodded in agreement, and the young woman with wavy brown hair right away introduced herself. "My name is Xian Jinglan, and I am an elf. Meanwhile, this wolf is my friend, Lang."

"As for me, I belong to the fairy race." Xin Xianzi then pointed at their two friends. "Even though his body is not very big, Zheng Ru is a descendant of the giant race. The short guy is Jin Dabao, and he is a member of the dwarf race."
"Hey, Xianzi! I'm short, but you are much smaller than me!" Jin Dabao protested the fairy girl in an annoyed tone.

"Hehehe." Xin Xianzi giggled at that, but then she questioned Zhang Fei. "Why did you join the humans? Since you are a beast, wouldn't it be better if you joined us or the two princes of the beast race?"

Zhang Fei shook his head at Xin Xianzi. "Many of you think that humans are evil, but I am different from you. Not all of them are evil, and many of them are much better than beasts or natural races, so it doesn't matter to me if I join them."
"You are right." Xian Jinglan replied as she nodded. "Not all humans are evil, but most are very evil, so we never want to be friends with them."

"You have your own choices, and I have my own choices, so you don't need to force yours on me." Zhang Fei then turned to the group of people who had just appeared. "Let's talk again after we've gone through all the tests."
All of them immediately agreed with that, especially since the people who had just appeared were evils from the three kingdoms.
'They also succeeded in passing the demon heart challenge, huh?' Zhang Fei murmured to himself as he observed the members of the royal families of the Huangfu, Zhou, and Bai Kingdoms.

Those people also glanced at Zhang Fei, but they frowned upon seeing him surrounded by people from both the beast and natural races, causing various questions about their relationship to arise in their minds.
Once they saw the results on the screen and saw Zhang Fei's name first, the people from the Huangfu and Bai Kingdoms directly spoke with each other, though they did so via voice transmission.

Even though he couldn't hear their conversation, Zhang Fei could tell from their gazes that they were plotting something against him. He also noticed Zhou Tong frequently glancing at him while he was giving instructions to his three family members. 'I love peace, but crazy people keep coming and looking for trouble with me. Since you're all plotting something against me, I'll play along with your game, and you guys must be prepared to suffer.'
Two hours later, some people from the Yun and Xian Kingdoms also reappeared in that room, such as Guo Jihai, Li Yao, Shu Zhen, Xian Mu, Xian Yu, and Xian Qifeng.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's group still hasn't returned from their test, which worries him. He isn't worried about the other members, but he is worried that Xian Xianqin will fail her test.

'When did he become acquainted with the people from the beast and natural races' kingdoms? Do they intend to bring him to their side?' Xian Changyue, who had just appeared, immediately muttered in her heart. She then approached them and asked Zhang Fei. "When did you complete your challenge?"
"Why don't you see it yourself?" Zhang Fei gestured to the screen above them.
"Hmm?" The sight of Zhang Fei's name momentarily stunned Ximen Changyue. "I didn't expect you to complete the demon heart challenge so quickly. Does this mean you have no regrets in your heart?"

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Xian Changyue. "Regrets will only hinder our development, and I don't want my development to be hindered. I have long since thrown away all the regrets in my heart, so the demon heart challenge is too easy for me."

"You're right about that, brother." Long Chen suddenly spoke. "Unfortunately, not everyone can throw away the regrets in their hearts as easily as you, so the demon heart challenge is really troublesome for them."
"It took us some time to overcome our demon hearts." Long Tian added with a soft sigh.
Xin Xianzi, the fairy, suddenly asked. "Have you ever killed anyone, Zhang Fei?"

"Is that even a question, Senior Xianxi? We are cultivators, and the world of cultivation is too cruel, so killing or being killed is inevitable." Xin Xianzi and the others nodded in agreement to Zhang Fei. "Honestly, I have lost count of the number of living beings I have killed, especially since there were too many of them. Although I have killed so many, I have never regretted my decision to kill them because they are my enemies, and I will continue to kill everyone who chooses to be my enemy."

They didn't say anything and looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief, but they were aware that they couldn't be weak-hearted as cultivators, and they had to be prepared to dirty their hands with blood, especially the blood of their enemies.

Xian Changyue also looked at Zhang Fei and thought to herself. 'He's so young, but his resolution is much firmer than that of many senior cultivators, including me. Unlike him, I have spared my enemies too many times, but my decisions only add to my troubles.'
Meanwhile, the people from the other three kingdoms continued to glare at Zhang Fei, and their eyes showed that they were mocking him for his words just now.

Sometime later, many challengers, including humans, beast races, natural races, and demons, failed the demon heart challenge. Once they reappeared from the room, they were automatically sent out of the tower, especially since they had lost their qualifications to challenge the other tests.

Not long after them, half of Zhang Fei's group, including Yuan Luo and two women, successfully passed their demon heart challenge. They reappeared at the same time as the two royal families of the two demon kingdoms. However, half of them, such as Xian Xianwu, Xian Xianqin, Yun Qinghai, and Yun Xinyue, have yet to return.

"Wow! You're ranked first, Zhang Fei!" Yuan Luo immediately shouted as soon as she saw the results on the board, but then she looked around for Xian Xianqin. "It seems that our princess is still having trouble getting rid of her demon heart, and she will probably fail again this time."
"No." Zhang Fei immediately refuted Yuan Luo. "Princes Xianqin will definitely succeed in passing her demon challenge."

Yuan Luo immediately asked with a playful smile. "Why do you still address her as a princess? Isn't your relationship more intimate now? Although she still doesn't want to admit it, we can see that she has fallen in love with you."

"I—" Zhang Fei did not have time to answer Yan Luo's question when six other people suddenly appeared in front of them. He immediately smiled and said to Xian Xianqin, "Congratulations; you finally passed your demon heart challenge, and we will undergo the other tests together."
Xian Xianqin smiled sweetly and took Zhang Fei's hand. "Thanks to you, I finally got through my demon heart."
"You are wrong." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "You were able to pass it because you managed to let go of the regret in your heart, so you should be proud of yourself."

Xian Xianqin nodded in response. "Actually, I nearly failed again due to her relentless attacks, and I hesitated to counterattack. However, I remembered your words that we could still save her from their hands, so I steeled my heart and defeated her."

"Get a room, you two." They immediately turned to Bai Tian'er, who looked annoyed. "Why are you guys looking at me like that? I was annoyed because my demon heart was stronger than last time, but in the end, I got through it."
"That's good." Zhang Fei then turned to the other four. "What about you guys?"
"I'm the same as Tian'er." Ximen Chuixue replied with a soft sigh. "My demon heart is getting heavier and stronger, so I'm having a hard time getting through it."

Xian Xianwu also told Zhang Fei. "My demon heart has not only grown stronger, but it has also become easier than it was before. However, I had a hard time solving the puzzle that it gave me, and I spent a lot of time solving it."
"A puzzle?"
Xian Xianwu shook his head at them. "I don't want to talk about that anymore."

"All our members managed to pass the demon heart challenge, so I think this is a good sign for us, and I hope we will succeed in passing all the remaining challenges." All of them nodded to Ximen Chuixue, but then they looked at the numbers on the screen. There were only seventy participants left, indicating that more than a quarter had failed. "The number of our enemies is still large, so we must remain vigilant against them."

Suddenly, another portal descended from the room's ceiling, but it was red, and Xian Xianqin immediately asked Zhang Fei via voice transmission. 'Are you ready to take the test? The next test is the battle challenge, and we will be sent randomly before meeting our enemies.'
'I'm ready anytime.' Zhang Fei then turned to the people who were so eager to kill him. 'I hope I'll meet one of them so I can reduce the number of our enemies.'
'Which of them will be your toughest opponent?' Xian Xianqin asked as she glanced at those people.

'Zhou Tong is my toughest opponent, but I dare not underestimate Huangfu Lian and the others, especially since most of their cultivation has reached the seven divine realms.' Zhang Fei then looked at the demons from the two demon kingdoms. 'As for those demons, I'm not too worried about them because my demon abilities are better than theirs, so I'm confident in defeating them.'
Xian Xianqin was about to speak to Zhang Fei once more, but the red portal suddenly glowed, sucking them into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 Battle Challange
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

Ignoring the two notifications, Zhang Fei turned his attention to his surroundings, particularly since the portal had transported him into a forest. He grinned slightly after he successfully opened the system map so he could easily monitor the movements of his potential enemy.

On the map, Zhang Fei found that the forest was not very large, but he saw many red dots gathered in its heart. He also discovered numerous lines that had never appeared on his map before, all of which were trap locations created by the tower to intensify the battle challenge's difficulty.

Not long after, another dot appeared at the other end of the forest. Zhang Fei smiled broadly after learning that his opponent was Zhou Fang, the third prince of the Zhou Kingdom. 'Heh! As Xian Feng guessed, the people of that kingdom did have a connection with those demons, and they gave them demon bloodlines. Moreover, this guy can increase his demon rank, so I'm sure the demon energy should exist in those demon kingdoms, but it can't be sensed from the outside because of the barrier on their island.'

Seeing Zhou Fang flying towards him, Zhang Fei immediately used his invisibility and summoned the demon extermination sword. He then rubbed his sword and spoke to the souls of the two girls inside. 'Honestly, I want to give him to you two, but I still need him. I hope you don't kill him, and you can kill him after my plan succeeds.'
*Zing...Zing...Zing...*

Zhang Fei smiled as soon as the demon extermination sword responded to him with a strong vibration, and he flew high into the sky to monitor Zhou Fang directly. His opponent appeared to have trouble avoiding the obstacles, and the beasts that had gathered in the center had spread out, some toward him.

'Hahaha! It will be difficult if I have to fight him directly, so I'll use these beasts to trouble him first.' Zhang Fei immediately released his heavenly fox aura to scare away the beasts, forcing them to move toward Zhou Fang instead.
*Slash... Slash... Slash...*

While evading the traps, Zhou Fang wielded the two green swords in his hands and slashed them at the beasts that were rushing toward him. He could see that they were frightened by something, but he could not detect the presence of any powerful beasts in the forest.
"What the hell happened to them? What caused them to be so scared like this?" Zhou Fang didn't want to bother with that and used some of his techniques to slaughter every beast that came his way.
*Slash... Slash... Slash...*

Zhou Fang sensed a sudden attack coming straight at him from the sky, so he immediately looked there and simultaneously swung his two swords. A dark and green Qi quickly shot into the sky, forming a cross, and the two immediately collided with a crescent-shaped white Qi.
*Boom*

Zhou Fang immediately jumped to the highest tree and spread his senses to search for his opponent, but it was impossible for him to detect Zhang Fei, who was in an invisible state. Instead, two huge flying beasts flew towards him to attack him, but he immediately disappeared from his spot, and the two beasts suddenly split into two.
Zhang Fei was quite surprised by Zhou Fang's movement speed, and he was sure that he would not be able to follow his movements if he had not practiced using the level-four gravity feature.

Wasting no time, Zhang Fei teleported behind Zhou Fang, who was looking for him in a confused manner. He channeled his light element into the demon extermination sword and slashed it against his back, but a transparent shield suddenly appeared and blocked his attack.
*Clang*

"Damn it!" Zhou Fan immediately spun around as he slashed his sword horizontally, but his attack only hit empty air, which confused him. He immediately activated his wind and darkness elements at the same time, creating a wind vortex around him. "Who exactly is my enemy? How can that person hide his or her presence from my senses? Could it be one of those demons who attacked me? My father has sworn allegiance to them, so there's no way they will attack me."

Zhou Fang suddenly sensed his demon bloodline tremble because of something, but he didn't realize that Zhang Fei was using his demonic force manipulation to weaken him. An ethereal giant claw that suddenly manifested above him shocked him, and he thought that one of the demons was trying to kill him.
"Damn it! Whoever you are, I will fight you back with all my strength." Zhou Fang immediately unleashed his full power, making the dark green vortex around him strengthen.

Zhou Fang then assumed an attacking stance, positioning both of his swords on his right side. He channeled his two elements into them, causing dark green auras to envelop them. He then swung them toward the ethereal giant claw, and two dark green swords Qi shot out from his two swords before clashing with the claw.
*Boom*

Their collision generated a huge shockwave that pushed Zhou Fang backward while the beasts below scattered around to avoid the impact. He immediately stabilized himself and monitored the surrounding area, but his expression was filled with rage due to his inability to sense Zhang Fei's presence.

Zhang Fei, hiding in the distance, was also annoyed by Zhou Fang's ability to easily break all his attacks. 'Tch! A cultivator in the seven divine realms like him is indeed extraordinary! I have weakened his demon bloodline, but his abilities are still far above mine. Moreover, his swords are not ordinary swords but sword artifacts, and both of them enhance the power of his wind attacks.'

Zhang Fei then glanced at the beast corpse that Zhou Fang had previously killed, and he immediately landed in the crowd of corpses. He then released his darkness element and used his necromancy, creating a dark circle to summon their souls.

Sensing this, Zhou Fang immediately turned towards it and saw the black circle, filled with the souls of the beasts he had previously killed. "Who exactly is this demon? How can he or she summon the souls of dead beasts?"

Zhang Fei smiled at Zhou Fang's expression, and he ordered the beasts' souls to attack him directly. Additionally, he released his demon aura and used one of the techniques in the Nine Demon Secret Scripture, causing the sky above them to turn dark.

Zhao Fang's expression became more serious as he observed numerous black lightning flashes above him, but he had no time to ponder as the souls of the beasts rushed toward him. He immediately grabbed the necklace around his neck, channeled his qi into it, and flew to attack those beast souls afterward. (A/N: It was a demon technique, not an elemental technique.)
*Slash... Slash... Slash...*
Zhao Fang's attack instantly split the beasts' souls apart, but their souls quickly reconnected and attacked him again.
*Slash... Slash... Slash...*

No matter how many times Zhao Fang split them, their souls kept reconnecting, and he could feel their strength increasing every time he split them. He was really furious about it, especially since the black lightning above him kept rumbling as if it were brewing their maximum attack. 'Shit! The black lightning seems powerful! I don't know if my protective artifact is enough to ward them off, so I will immediately give up on this challenge if it can't stop them.'

'This attack is much stronger than I expected, but I wonder if it will be enough to destroy his protective artifact.' Zhang Fei, who was hiding among the corpses of the beasts, muttered inwardly as he looked up at the sky. 'Abyssal Lightning Tribulation! Descend!'
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

In that instant, countless black lightnings rained down on Zhou Fang. He immediately ignored these beast souls and used his strongest area attack to target the black lightning. However, the beast souls immediately attacked him, but their attacks could not penetrate his protection. He swiftly directed his dark green vortex toward them, propelling them into the sky. "Damn! Break for me!"

Zhang Fei naturally would not allow Zhou Fang to break his attack, so he immediately threw the demon extermination sword at him. Additionally, he pulled out the hongxi dagger and hellfire chains, throwing them both at his enemy simultaneously.
*Swoosh... Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Zhou Fang, who was trying to break Zhang Fei's abyssal lightning tribulation, was shocked when his three weapons collided with his protection. The demon extermination sword and the hongxi dagger tried to penetrate his protection, and the hellfire chains encircled his protection without being affected by his dark green vortex.

However, Zhou Fang felt a sense of relief upon recognizing their respective grades, which led him to concentrate his efforts on countering Zhang Fei's lightning attack. Although the demon extermination sword is a soul weapon, its grade is only a spirit grade. The hellfire chains grade is only an earth grade, and the hongxi dagger is a heaven grade. "Heh! Such weak artifacts won't be able to destroy my protection artifact!"
Zhou Fang finally managed to break the lightning attack. He immediately tried to destroy Zhang Fei's three weapons, but he pulled them back, causing him to frown. "Hey, Coward! Come out now!"

Seeing that his attack and three weapons were useless against Zhou Fang, Zhang Fei immediately racked his brains to find another way to defeat him. He suddenly remembered one of his demon artifacts, the abyssal mirror.

Zhang Fei realized that Zhou Fang was not a soul cultivator but rather a sword cultivator, leading him to believe that his soul power was inferior to his own. He immediately took the abyssal mirror out, teleported a little way ahead of his enemy, and showed it to him.

The abyssal mirror is only an earth grade, but it is not an attack artifact; it is a trap artifact instead. Zhao Fang's body trembled in fear as soon as he stared at the mirror, and his pupils shrank from the effect, trapping his soul within the mirror's depth.

Despite this, Zhang Fei refrained from hastily approaching Zhou Fang due to the strength of his dark green vortex and his inability to destroy his protection artifact. 'This guy! His soul is trapped in my mirror, but his two protections still haven't disappeared. Hey, Mei! Do you have any ideas for destroying both of them?'

[Master, Zhao Fang's protection artifact is of a celestial grade, and your current strength is insufficient to destroy it. If you use your enhanced ability and the blood essence pill to boost your strength, you might be able to destroy it. Additionally, you can use Soul Connect II to borrow the power of the beasts in the Beast Space. However, I don't know if you will be considered cheating if you use all three, and you will fail if you are considered cheating.]

Zhang Fei was in a dilemma after hearing that, especially since he was eager to complete all the challenges. Moreover, he still had one pending quest, which he could only complete by passing through the first floor of the Star Tower.

'Should I use the Bloodmoon Devouring Array? I can kill him if I use it, but I can only use it once, and it will disappear after that, so I will be at a loss if I use it on him now.' After carefully considering it, Zhang Fei decided to take out the demon extermination sword once again. He then used his enhanced condition ability to increase his raw strength, and he also activated Soul Connect II to borrow the power of all the beasts within the Beast Space. When he combined these abilities with his two body cultivation techniques, his strength increased severalfold.
Zhang Fei refrained from attacking Zhao Fang immediately and instead waited for some time, feeling relieved that the tower had not expelled him from the challenge. 'Phew! I thought it would fail!'
[You are lucky that the tower considers both of them to be your abilities, Master. However, I am sure you will fail if you use the blood essence pill to boost your strength.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei then held the hilt of the demon extermination sword with both hands and pointed its blade upwards. He then closed his eyes and focused all his power on his sword while channeling his light element into it. 'I don't know if this will work, but I have to try it.'

The blade of the demon extermination seemed to lengthen as Zhang Fei's light element formed a new blade. He then opened his eyes and swung his sword toward Zhou Fang, but he did not aim at his body directly. He swung his sword slightly to the side, primarily because he needed to keep him alive.
*Slash*
Zhang Fei's light sword Qi directly collided with Zhou Fang's protective barrier, yet he persisted in pressing his sword down due to its strength.
*Crack... Crack...*

Zhang Fei's eyes lit up when he saw the cracks in Zhou Fang's protective barrier; he channeled more of his strength into his sword and pressed it down even harder, causing the cracks to spread rapidly.
Sometimes later, Zhao Fang's protective barrier shattered into pieces, and his dark green vortex also disappeared at the same time, making Zhang Fei feel relieved.

"Phew! The cultivators in the seven divine realms are indeed terrifying, and I will never win against them with my current strength." Zhang Fei immediately canceled his enhanced body condition and the Soul Link II, then approached Zhou Fang and used his demon abilities, including his demon slave mark, memory manipulation, and several others.
After he had done all that, Zhang Fei immediately pulled the abyssal mirror back into his hand and released Zhou Fang's soul from within.
Zhou Fang looked dizzy for a few moments after that, but then he kneeled on one knee in front of Zhang Fei. "What can I do for you, Master?"

Even though Zhou Fang had become his slave, Zhang Fei still did not want to deal directly with Zhou Xiaochuan and his Zhou Kingdom, especially since they were too strong. Instead, he gave him some other instructions for his new slave, especially regarding the demons affiliated with his family. "Can you do that?"

"No." Zhou Fang answered with a shake of his head. "The demons have never met me and the others, and they only communicate with my father, so I can't do anything about them. However, I have information about Ximen Hongwu. He plans to capture you and turn you into a puppet for his sister, Ximen Yueliang."

Zhang Fei had already guessed that there was something wrong with the two men, so he was not surprised to hear that they wanted to do such a thing to him. Although he was worried that they would gang up on him in the maze or survival challenge, he did not think much of either of them, especially since he was not alone when challenging both challenges.

Zhang Fei then gave Zhou Fang some other orders, which he immediately agreed to. "All right, you can forfeit this challenge and return to your kingdom immediately, but you must inform me immediately after you have successfully carried out my orders."
Zhou Fang nodded and raised his hands. "I give up this challenge."
As soon as he said that, both of them immediately disappeared from the battle scene. The two of them were immediately sent back to the first floor, but Zhou Fang was sent out of the tower afterward.

However, an old man with long white hair suddenly appeared at that place, and he was accompanied by the little girl Zhang Fei had met during the demon heart challenge. "Master, that hateful guy is really annoying! If you let me, I will definitely beat him up!"

"Are you proud of being able to beat up a cultivator who is much weaker than you, Hua Mei'er?" The little girl immediately covered her mouth without daring to argue with the old man. "Our sect sent several towers to the middle realms to look for the best talents, but none of them could reach the tenth floor for the past thousands of years. However, our wait appears to be coming to an end soon, as that kid possesses the ability to reach the tenth floor."
"Huh?" Hua Mei'er looked at the old man with repeated blinks. "Are you sure he has that qualification, Master?"
"Yes." The old man gave a brief response before escorting Hua Mei'er leave the place.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 The Alchemy Union
paragraphs: In the waiting room, Chao Yuanfeng nodded in satisfaction after Zhang Fei's name appeared on the screen. Despite not ranking first as he had in the Demon Heart Challenge, he managed to secure a spot in the top 10. 'At first, I thought he would lose to Zhou Fang, but he actually managed to defeat him. I don't know how he managed to do it, but the people of the Zhou Kingdom will definitely set their eyes on him, especially Zhou Xiaochuan. Furthermore, Zhou Tong has qualified for the next challenge, and they will undoubtedly face off against each other in the survival or maze challenges.'

'Hey, Old Yuanfeng! I didn't expect that kid to pass the first two challenges so easily. It's no surprise that both of our emperors held him in high regard, and Emperor Yun even ordered his children to join your group simply because of his presence.' The envoy from the Yun Kingdom spoke to Chao Yuanfeng via voice transmission.

Chao Yuanfeng turned to him with a smile. 'Old Yang Shao, you haven't seen all of Zhang Fei's abilities, and he is even more terrifying than you can imagine, so I believe he will successfully lead them to pass the first floor.'

'If our prince and princess manage to pass the first floor, it will be a huge improvement for them, especially since they have failed many times before.' Yang Shao suddenly remembered some things. 'The Sin Challenge is not easy to pass, and they still have to pass the Enlightenment Challenge. It seems easy because they only need to learn the technique they choose; it won't be easy either, and they will fail if they can't learn it.'
'You're right.' Chao Yuanfang replied with a nod of agreement. 'However, our princes and princesses are intelligent, so I'm sure they will succeed in the enlightenment challenge.'

Unlike them, the male envoy from the Zhou Kingdom looked upset at Zhou Fang's defeat, and he immediately reported the matter to Zhou Xiaochuan. 'Where exactly did that brat come from? He has close ties with the Xian and Yun Kingdoms, and his progress is more amazing than some of the powerful cultivators above him.'

The envoys from the other four kingdoms also wondered about Zhang Fei's true identity, and they immediately reported his whereabouts to their emperors directly, especially about his results in the first three challenges.
Huangfu Shou, Bai Yaowei, Ximen Changtian, and Ximen Gongfu immediately ordered them to capture Zhang Fei as soon as he left the Star Tower.

Zhang Fei stood with a satisfied smile as he looked at the screen. Despite not ranking first and only ranking tenth, Zhang Fei was genuinely satisfied, particularly considering that the nine people above him were cultivators in the seven divine realms. He did not expect Xian Jinglan to be powerful and manage to defeat her opponent so quickly, even though her opponent's cultivation was two minor levels above hers.
Meanwhile, Xian Changyue, Long Chen, Zhou Tong, Zheng Ru, Long Tian, Xi Xianzi, Jin Dabao, Ximen Yan, and Qian Ying occupy ranks two to nine.
'How did you manage to defeat Zhao Fang?' Xian Changyue asked Zhang Fei via voice transmission.

Zhang Fei first glanced at Zhou Tong, who continued to glare at him with a murderous look. 'I couldn't fight Zhou Fang head-on, so I had to use some methods to weaken him first, and I attacked him after he was sufficiently exhausted.'

'How did you exhaust Zhou Fang?' Zhang Fei replied to Xian Changyue with a wink, irritating her. 'Despite their opponents' cultivation being on par with theirs, Xianwu and Xianxin would likely have a difficult time defeating them, especially since both of them are demons from the dark demon kingdom.'

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. 'Prince Xianwu and Princess Xianqin have prepared very well in the past week, so I am sure they will be able to defeat the two demons. Instead, Yun Qinghai will lose to his opponent, and Yun Xinyue will not necessarily be able to pass her test.'

'Qinghai's opponent is Zhou Tai, and he is different from you. His opponent's cultivation is at the 2-Moon Divine Transcend, so he will never win against him with his cultivation still at the quasi-divine realm.' Xian Changyue then turned her gaze to Yun Xinyue's name. 'Xinyue's opponent is Bai Shouyi, and their cultivation is equivalent in the quasi-divine realm. However, the Bai Princess's character is similar to her father, and they will not hesitate to use any means to achieve their goals.'
Zhang Fei had already realized that the Bai siblings had used something to boost their strengths during the strength test. 'What will happen if their fight ends in a draw?'

'No one knows the origin of this tower, and the rules in this tower are really weird.' Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly. 'If their fight ends in a draw, they both pass the battle challenge and can take on the next.'

'I see.' Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. 'After this, there will be no more elimination battles, so it doesn't matter if the two of them advance to the next challenge. However, there will be too many participants in the survival and maze challenges, and fierce battles will definitely be unavoidable. Fortunately, we have you by our side, and I want you to focus on protecting them when we undergo both challenges.'

Xian Changyue immediately turned to Zhang Fei. 'What about you? Are you thinking about separating from us? All of them have their sights set on you, and they will undoubtedly attack you together. The Huangfu and Bai Kingdoms form a single alliance, while the Zhou Kingdom aligns itself with the two demon kingdoms, putting you in danger if you separate from us.'

'I knew that, so I decided to wander alone during the survival challenge.' Xian Changyue frowned at Zhang Fei's answer. 'If I stay with you guys, they will also target all of you, and the situation will become more complicated.'

Just as Xian Changyue was about to refute Zhang Fei, two lights suddenly appeared in the room. Yun Xinyue and Bai Shouyi immediately appeared and fell to the ground. Their condition was quite worrying, especially the princess of the Yun Kingdom, whose body was partly purplish black, indicating that she was poisoned.

Without thinking twice, they rushed to Yun Xinyue's side, and Zhang Fei immediately squatted beside the princess of the Yun Kingdom to check her condition. He then took out an antidote and forced her to swallow it, as the poison had already spread throughout her body. He also forced her to swallow a recovery pill so her condition could recover faster. After that, he sat her down and used his light element to heal her other injuries.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei had mastered the light law; even though it was only at the initial level, it was already very helpful to Yun Xinyue.

Meanwhile, Xian Changyue gazed at Bao Shouyi with a serious expression, but she did not take any action against her, particularly given the restrictions on fighting within the tower. If she attacks the Bai princess, the tower will immediately expel her.

Bai Shouyi's condition was also quite serious, with many wounds on her body, but her wounds were not life-threatening. Although their fight ended in a draw, the Bai princess smiled evilly when she saw Yun Xinyue's condition, but she did not say anything and swallowed some pills to restore her condition.
Zhou Tong suddenly moved behind Bai Shouyi, sat cross-legged behind her, and pressed his palms against her back. 'I will help you restore your condition.'

Two lights suddenly appeared in the room, but one of them was immediately sent out of the tower, and Zhou Tai stood in his spot with a broad smile. However, he frowned after he saw the rank, especially since Zhang Fei managed to defeat his little brother. 'This bastard! I will kill him if we meet in survival or maze challenges later!'

Xian Changyue immediately checked outside the tower, but she couldn't find Yun Qinghai there. She suddenly received a voice transmission from Chao Yuanfeng, who informed her that the Yun prince had already returned to the Yun Kingdom using a returning jade and that his condition was fine because he surrendered early. 'Phew! Fortunately, Qinghai didn't force himself and knew when to give up, or he would die at Zhou Tai's hands.'

Shortly after that, Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin appeared in the room with exhausted looks. However, Xian Changyue felt relieved because her nephew and niece did not suffer any significant injuries, and they only suffered some external injuries. She wanted to give them healing and recovery pills, but Zhang Fei had already thrown two pills at each of them, and they immediately swallowed them.
Xian Xianqin then approached Zhang Fei and asked. "What about Yinyue's condition? Will she be okay?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then withdrew his light element back and laid Yun Xinyue on the floor with her head in his lap. "I have removed the poison from her body, and her life is no longer in danger, but she needs to rest for some time to recover."

With a sense of relief, Xian Xianqin sat beside Zhang Fei, resting her head on his shoulder. "That demon was always running and hiding like a rat, and I was too tired to chase him. Luckily, I managed to corner him and kill him before he gave up the match."

"Good job." Zhang Fei replied as he put his arm around Xian Xianqin's shoulders. "Like us humans, many demons are very good. However, many demons, like that guy over there, are evil and deserve to die."

Ximen Yan, who was resting a little away from them, immediately put on a gloomy look after Zhang Fei said that. The two demons, who were Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin's opponents, were his subordinates, and they killed both of them. 'He can have fun with the Xian princess now, but I will kill her and Xian Xianwu in the survival or maze challenges later, and I will turn her into my slave.'
"Hehe." Xian Xianqin laughed as she closed her eyes. "I'll take a rest first, Zhang Fei."

Zhang Fei nodded, observing the ranking on the screen as numerous names began to appear, many of which were members of his group. Regrettably, some of them, like Huang Chi and Xuan Wuji, encountered formidable opponents and were unable to continue their challenge. 'Sigh! Our numbers have been reduced by two with their defeat, but it should be no problem for us since we still have Xian Changyue. Moreover, Ximen Chuixue and Bai Tian'er are not weak, so I'm confident we still have a chance to pass the survival or maze challenges.'

From the side of the two demon kingdoms, their royal members also managed to win their respective fights, but many of their members died in their fights.

"Senior Gong Ren."
"Hmm?" Gong Ren immediately turned to the two. "Why are you two here? What do you need from me?"

"Senior, I need that portal again." Shang Huaqiang's answer made Gong Ren frown. "One of the portals was destroyed by Princess Feng Yao, and I can't enter that realm because of our rules, so I need a new one."
Gong Ren was surprised to hear the name. "Do you have a problem with her? Why did she destroy the portal?"
"Honestly, I never had any problems with her, but she claimed to be the protector of this realm, so she helped them to destroy it."

"I see." Gong Ren nodded in understanding, but he immediately rejected Shang Huaqiang's request. "Since Princess Feng Yao has already said that she is the protector of that realm, I will not sell another portal to you."
"Why is that, Senior Gong?" Fei Qinyuan asked.

"Shouldn't you two already know the answer?" asked Gong Ren. "I do need a lot of jewels for my experiments, but I have a good relationship with the phoenix races. However, he is not in this realm now, so you have to wait sometime to meet him."
Fei Qinyuan immediately turned to her husband, but Shang Huaqiang could only sigh helplessly. "In that case, we will go back now, and we will come to this realm again after Senior Cheng returns."
Gong Ren just nodded and focused his gaze on the experiment in front of him, but his mind was filled with several questions.

"Why do they keep targeting a planet in the lower realms? What exactly is hidden on that planet? Why did Princess Feng Yao decide to become the planet's protector?" In the end, Gong Ren decides to stop his experiment, takes his outer robe, and leaves his room. "I have to go to the phoenix realm to confirm the truth."

Everyone who saw him immediately paid respect to him, especially after they saw the phoenix embroidered on the back of his robe.

On the first floor, many alchemists traded pills, and so many cultivators tried to buy them, but he didn't pay any attention to them. He swiftly approached the female receptionist at the room's center, presenting his token, which bore an engraved phoenix. "Take me to see Huoyun Zhiyan."

After they arrived on the third floor, the female receptionist immediately returned to her place, and the young man casually smashed the door in front of her, shocking several people inside.
However, they immediately recognized the young man's identity, so they said nothing and hurriedly lined up in front of him. "What can we do for you, Sir Feng Xishui?"

Feng Xishui didn't answer him immediately. Instead, he went to the chair behind the main table and sat there, raising both of his legs on it. "Huoyun Zhiyan, I have never liked your alchemy union, but Princess Feng Yao ordered me to come here."
"What does Princess Feng Yao want from us, sir?" Huoyun Zhiyan asked nervously.
Feng Xishui narrowed his eyes at Huoyun Zhiyan before delivering the message. "One of your men targeted my princess's sister."

Huoyun Zhiyan and the few people with him became tense, and a cold sweat began to drip from their foreheads. "Sir, how could my men dare to target Princess Feng's sister? I think it must be just a misunderstanding, or that person might not know her identity."

"I don't care whether that person knows her identity or not, and I also don't care whether it's a misunderstanding or not." Feng Xishui replied in a cold voice. "My princess said that someone sent one of your alchemy union's guards to capture her sister, so she sent me here to ask you to take responsibility."
