chapters.title: Chapter 556 Alchemy Union's Decision
paragraphs: Huoyun Zhiyan wiped away his sweat and inquired. "Sir, who... who exactly is that person? Which realm is he from?"

"Lian Jinshu from the Nine Stars Realm." Huoyun Zhiyan and the others froze as soon as Feng Xishui mentioned the name. "My princess doesn't care about your shops in other kingdoms, but she ordered you to close your shop in the Xian Kingdom because her sister wants to open an alchemy shop there. You don't need to punish that foolish old man, as she already has her own plans for him. If you or the people from your alchemy union dare to protect him, I will lead some people from my phoenix race to destroy all your shops in these middle realms, including this organization. My princess never jokes with her words, so you should immediately carry out her order, or you guys will suffer the consequences."
"Sir, we-"

"I didn't come here to negotiate with you." Immediately, Feng Xishui flicked his finger, causing several small flames to enter their bodies and turning their faces pale. "All of you have indeed reached the Divine Manifestation Realm, but your strengths are nothing in my eyes. If any of you dare to disobey my princess's order, I will immediately activate my flame inside your bodies, and you guys will turn to ashes in a matter of seconds."

After Feng Xishui disappeared from the room, Huoyun Zhiyan and his colleagues immediately took a deep breath. An old man dressed in a brown alchemist robe immediately questioned their leader. "What should we do, Zhiyan? Are we really going to sacrifice Lian Jinshu? Moreover, the alchemy market in the Xian Kingdom is the second largest after the Zhou Kingdom, and we will suffer a substantial loss if we close our shop there."

"Are you an idiot, Sun Jianming?" An old woman, also dressed in an alchemist's robe, inquired in a high voice. "Do you think we can fight the Phoenix race? Have you forgotten what they did to us when we tried to dominate the alchemy market in the upper realms? Do you think Lian Jinshu's life and the alchemy market in the Xian Kingdom are more important than our lives? Princess Feng Yao is the beloved daughter of the Phoenix Emperor and Empress, and they are two of the strongest cultivators there, so they will not hesitate to destroy us if we dare to defy her order."

The old woman's mention darkened Sun Jianming's face, but he couldn't refute her as he still remembered the incident vividly, and they were forced to return to the middle realms without being able to fight back in the slightest.

"Xiu Hanyu is right, Old Jianming." Huoyun Zhiyan expressed this sentiment with a heavy sigh. "I don't want to lose the alchemy market in the Xian Kingdom, but our lives are more important. It doesn't matter if we lose one of the markets, especially since Princess Feng Yao has no intention of interfering with our other affairs, and we still have full control over the entire alchemy market in these middle realms.

Sun Jianming could only sigh deeply and concur. "In that case, we should inform Cheng Feng and the other two about this issue to prevent them from aiding Lian Jinshu. If Princess Feng Yao drives us out of the Nine Stars Realm, we will suffer a greater loss, especially since the alchemy market in that realm ranks among the top five in these middle realms."

"Yeah." Huoyun Zhiyan immediately pulled out a communication device and ordered someone to contact his representatives in the Nine Stars Realm. "You two can tell the others not to go to that realm for the time being, especially since I'm sure Sir Feng Xishui is still watching us, or we'll face even bigger trouble than this."
Sun Jianming and Xiu Hanyu immediately left the room to meet the other elders of the Alchemy Union, and Huoyun Zhiyan sat down in his chair and let out a heavy sigh.

Lian Jinshu, who was checking some herbs in his shop, immediately collapsed after he heard the message from one of the Alchemy Union's higher-ups. "What happened? Why did they suddenly decide to let go of the market in this kingdom? Furthermore, they terminated my membership in the organization without providing a detailed explanation for their decision."

Four of Lian Jinshu's five guards suddenly entered the shop, and Dugu Yun immediately told him the order from their higher-ups. "Old Lian, you are no longer a representative of our organization, so we will no longer protect you, and you can take care of your own matters."
"Where is Huan Ya?" Lian Jishu asked.

"I haven't seen her since a week ago, so I don't know about her whereabouts. She is completely loyal to the organization, and they must have told her about their decision, so there is no point in you looking for her." Lian Jishu's face darkened, but he knew that all the guards had always been loyal to their organization. "They have ordered you to leave this shop immediately, and you must leave all the items here as they belong to the organization."
Lian Jinshu didn't say anything and went to his private room to tidy up his personal belongings, especially since he was still shocked by the sudden decision of the Alchemy Union's higher-ups.
"Hey, Dugu Yun. What do you think really happened? Why did they suddenly expel Old Lian from our organization?" One of the guards, Li Sanxi, asked the question.
"We are just low-rank guards, so we don't need to question the orders of our higher-ups; we only need to carry out their orders." Dugu Yun's answer caused Li Sanxi and the other two to sigh.
Unlike them, Situ Yi smiled faintly and immediately contacted Zhang Fei to inform him about their organization's decision regarding Lian Jinshu.

Shortly afterward, they escorted Lian Jinshu out of the shop. However, the old man gazed at the shop for some time before departing, while his former four guards merely observed him from afar. 'Sigh! Since I have no place to stay in this kingdom anymore, I should go to Hexie City in the Bai Kingdom to see my family.'

Huan Ya, who was resting in a village, looked confused after she received the order from the Alchemy Union higher-ups. Moreover, their decision regarding Lian Jinshu was too sudden, so she felt strange about it. "Could this matter have something to do with Zhang Fei? How did he know them? Could it be that he has stronger backers than them?"
Just as she was thinking, Huan Ya suddenly received a voice transmission from one of Zhang Fei's clones; he asked her to hurry to Hexie City, as Lian Jinshu was on his way there.

"Tch! That guy treats me like his slave." Despite this, Huan Ya immediately left the village to carry out Zhang Fei's order because she had already experienced the benefits of his pills and was eager to obtain better ones in order to advance to the Seven Divine Realms.

In the alchemy shop in the Bai Kingdom, the representative of the Alchemy Union for the kingdom was sitting together with the leader of his five guards. However, their expressions were puzzled after receiving orders about Lian Jinshu from their higher-ups.

Cheng Feng directly spoke to the leader of his guards. "Yong Zhengjun, I know that Old Jian is your brother-in-law, but he is not more important than your status in our organization. They have already given strict orders, and you will definitely lose your status if you insist on helping him, so you must think carefully about your decision."

"You are right, Old Cheng." Yong Zhengjun replied with a heavy sigh. "I will not protect Old Lian, but I will still protect my sister and her children. I do not know about his real problem, but I am sure some people or groups are pressuring our higher-ups to make such a decision, and those people must be much stronger than them. I was worried that those people would target them, so I thought about moving them to another city, especially since I couldn't possibly protect them from those strong cultivators."

Cheng Feng himself also had the same thought, or else their higher-ups would not hand over the alchemy market in the Xian Kingdom just like that, and he believed there was a thorny issue behind their decision. chapters.title: Chapter 557 Meet Tie Xuan
paragraphs: Zhang Fei suddenly felt something coming from his sword, so he summoned the demon extermination sword and spoke to Xian Changyue. 'Anyway, I have something to do, so I hope you can keep an eye on them.'

'Do whatever you want, and I'll keep an eye on them.' Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes and entered his sword's soul space while Xian Changyue observed his sword. 'A soul weapon, huh? Unfortunately, it's only a spirit grade, and it won't be of much use to him in the future.'

Unfortunately, Ximen Changyue was not a blacksmith, and she did not know the history of the demon extermination sword. If she knew about it, she wouldn't possibly take it lightly, especially since it's upgradeable.
"Why did you two call me?" Zhang Fei immediately asked the two sword souls.
Jian Guang'an was the first to answer him. "Master, you have indeed become the master of the demon extermination sword, but your bond with it is still not that deep."
"To deepen your bond with it, you must merge your soul with us, especially since we are its souls." Jian Hei'an added to her sister's words.
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly. "If our souls merge, you guys will be bound to me. If I die, you two will die too, and the demon extermination sword will become an ordinary sword."

"We know." Both women nodded to Zhang Fei. "However, you will never be able to unleash the demon extermination sword's full power if you don't merge your soul with us, and it is the only way to unleash its true potential. Moreover, your enemy demons are getting stronger, and the sword will be useless against them later. Additionally, you should begin searching for suitable materials to upgrade the sword, which will further increase its power against those demons."

"Naturally, I also want to upgrade it, but Old Gang can't recognize the materials, so I don't know where to find them." However, Zhang Fei immediately realized his mistake, especially since he knew a blacksmith who was more skilled than Gang Zhishou. "I thought I could ask Tie Xuan about them, but I have to do it carefully, or he will snatch it from me.'

Both women immediately spoke. "Master, you don't need to think about it anymore. You can use your soul manipulation to merge your soul with ours, and you will definitely be able to feel the changes in the demon extermination sword afterward."

"All right." Zhang Fei finally agreed to that and used the soul manipulation ability immediately. Within a few minutes, his soul had merged with the souls of the two women, allowing them to feel each other's emotions. Moreover, he could feel a deep bond with his sword, but he also felt that something was missing. "Now that our souls have united, I will assist you both in nurturing your souls to enhance them."
"Yes, Master."
They immediately sat opposite each other while holding hands, and Zhang Fei shared his two soul cultivation techniques with them before using his soul power to increase their soul power.

Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivated in the room, immediately opened his eyes. However, he couldn't find Shang Yaolin by his side, especially since she had already started carrying out her punishment duties. Instead, he found Murong Qianying sitting in a chair, staring at him with a hesitant gaze. Despite having used his enhanced demon charm on her for the past two weeks, she had not succumbed to its effects, so he used it against her again to enhance its effects further.

Murong Qianying immediately raised her eyebrows when she sensed that, but she immediately moved onto the bed and cupped Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face with both hands. "Why did you use your abilities on me? I actually didn't want to discuss this matter, but you keep using it on me, and I'm finding it increasingly difficult to control myself."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed softly and held Murong Qianying's hands. "Aunt Qianying, I am a beast, and my sense of hearing is very sharp. I can hear your conversations with the others, so I know that all of you want to use me to fulfill your ambition of overthrowing Shang Huaqiang. You even sent Big Sis Yumei to me because she has some abilities to control others, but her abilities are useless to me, so I used my abilities to subdue her."
Murong Qianying was stunned in disbelief, as she never expected that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had long known about their plans, and she felt that he was deliberately toying with them all.

"My parents and I were on the hunt for a long time, and many people were eager to take advantage of us. That's why they taught me a lot of things, especially the negative traits of humans, to protect myself." Murong Qianying would not have remembered about it if Zhang Xiaolong [3] had not mentioned it. "My mother comes from the same race as Big Sis Yumei's fox bloodline, and she is much more cunning than all the women I've ever met. She always taught me that if women want to take advantage of me, then I have to take advantage of them back. Since you want to take advantage of me, I deliberately used my abilities on you."

"Your mother is right. The cultivation worlds are filled with countless people who will try to take advantage of us, so we must also take advantage of them in return." Murong Qianying then asked. "Are my two daughters not enough for you? How do you feel about my second daughter? I know you subdued Yumei because she wanted to subdue you first, but Yaolin has never done anything to you, and she wholeheartedly loves you."

"They are not enough for me because there are so many cultivators much stronger than me out there, and my parents' enemies are even more powerful. The dual cultivation path is the fastest way for me to gain strength and take revenge on them, but I need more women to assist me. Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer made Murong Qianying feel that he was much more cunning than her. "Considering that you have been living with us for two weeks, you should already be aware of my feelings for Big Sis Yaolin. She is completely different from you or Big Sis Yumei, and she never wanted to take advantage of me, so I would never hurt her feelings."

"You are really cunning, do you know that?" Murong Qianying then pulled both of her hands and Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s grasp. "You're still a child, but your innocent appearance fooled us, and we were unaware of your plans."

'Innocent my ass!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to his adult form and pressed Murong Qianying down on the bed, causing her to frown. "Aunt Qianying, I know you want me, especially after watching me and Big Sis Yaolin over and over again. You know for sure that I can give you sexual satisfaction that you have never experienced before, so you don't need to lie to yourself. Moreover, your husband is far away in the Red Sun Realm, so he would never find out if you cheated on him. So what do you think about it?"

"Can you stop your abilities first?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately rejected Murong Qianying with a shake of his head. "You are right; your activities with my second daughter are indeed tempting me, and the effects of your abilities are driving me almost crazy. Although my mental strength is very strong, I have difficulty resisting the effects, and your adult figure keeps appearing in my mind, so I'm afraid to return to my realm because my husband might find out that I'm thinking about another man."

"Did you satisfy yourself for the last two weeks?" Murong Qianying shamelessly admitted this by nodding her head to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Instead of satisfying yourself, why not let me satisfy your lust? I understand that you don't want Big Sis Yaolin to know about it; we can do it somewhere else in secret, and it will be our secret."

Murong Qianying was actually hesitant about cheating on her husband, especially since he was still a kid in her eyes. However, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s enhanced demon charm had a big impact on her, and his sexual activity with her second daughter tempted her tremendously. "Let's go; I'll take you somewhere else."

"Before that, I want to go to the Tie Clan to see Senior Brother Tie Xuan, so we'll go there first, and you can take me somewhere else afterward." After Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned the clan, Murong Qianying appeared annoyed, but she didn't say anything and allowed him to carry her off the bed. "I won't be staying there for long, and we will go to another place after I meet him."
Before long, they arrived at the Tie Clan, but Murong Qianying didn't want to enter the clan, so she asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] to go in by herself and wait for him outside.

"Luo 'er, let's meet Zhang Fei and Princess Xian; I have something to discuss with him."
"Let's go meet them." Yuan Luo immediately broke free from Ximen Chuixue's embrace and pulled him toward the location of Zhang Fei and Princess Xian.
"Princess! Zhang Fei!"
Hearing Yuan Luo's scream, Xian Xianqin immediately pulled her hand out of Zhang Fei's grasp, causing him to shake his head. "What happened? Why are you in such a hurry?"
"Brother Chui wants to speak to Zhang Fei."

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows when he saw Ximen Chuixue's expression, but he then observed the surrounding area through the map. After he discovered something, he immediately threw a device to the ground and a blurry barrier right away enveloped them, surprising the three people. "Do you want to talk about those demons? "Demons?" Xian Xianqin looked at Zhang Fei in confusion.

Ximen Chuixue turned to Yuan Luo, who immediately nodded at her. After that, Ximen Chuixue returned to his demon form, shocking Xian Xianqin and causing her to stammer. "You... you... are... a demon..."

"What is the order of the demon ranks?" Xian Xianqin posed this question because she was unfamiliar with demons.

"Those envoys from both demon kingdoms seem to have noticed your identity, and they clearly intend to capture you, so you should be more careful of them. As for Senior Sister Yuan, Senior Changyue will definitely protect her, so you don't have to worry too much about her."
"Can you help me fight them, Zhang Fei?"

"Ximen Yan, Ximen Hongwu, and Ximen Yueliang demon ranks are only at the marquis and marchioness ranks. Meanwhile, the demon participants' demon rank is lower than theirs, and their cultivation is mostly in the quasi-divine realm. That's why I'm not too worried about them, and I will help you fight them if they attack us in the maze or survival challenges." Zhang Fei paused to consider his next move before proceeding. "However, their four guards' demon rank is at the duke rank, like mine, and their cultivation is in the divine expansion realm. They will be formidable opponents for us, but fortunately, they cannot attack us while we are in the tower, allowing us to avoid them once we have completed the last challenge."

"You're right. We don't have to face their guards, and we can directly return to the sect using our returning jade." Ximen Chuixue then turned to his lover. "Luo'er, you must stay by Senior Changyue's side when we go through the two challenges, okay? Zhang Fei and I will take care of those demons so they won't attack you guys."
"All right." Yuan Luo immediately agreed, fully aware of her own strength, knowing that forcing herself to go along with them would only make her a burden.

sentences.text: "Zhang Fei."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei turned to Xian Xianqin.
"What's the matter?
Xian Xianqin let out a soft sigh.
"I wanted to apologize to you for my words when I first brought you to the sect, and I really didn't mean it that way."
"Forget it, okay?" Zhang Fei then raised their hands.
"If I were still thinking about your words back then, I wouldn't be holding your hand now.
Before I met my wife and partners, I was pretty much inexperienced when it came to feelings.
My first lover betrayed me with my own big brother, and they even conspired to frame me.
When I first met Chu Ying and Liu Qingyu, I thought of getting them because they could help me improve my cultivation, so I used my abilities to influence them.
Chu Qing fell for me immediately when she saw my little fox form, and her feelings deepened when she saw my half-fox form, making it easy for me to win her over, even without the use of my abilities.
However, I started to change after I saved Liu Hua and met Hu Yue, and I learned more about feelings after I met Shen Yu."
"I see." Zhang Fei then led Xian Xianqin to walk again.
"Who exactly is your first love?"
"Lin'er." Xian Xianqin was surprised at Zhang Fei's answer.
"At first, I didn't know that my feelings for her were those between a man and a woman, and we spent time like ordinary siblings.
I realized my feelings for her after I met Chen Xin, and I loved her not as a little sister but as a woman.
She also loved me as a man, but our blood hindered our relationship.
Even so, we often took a bath together and kissed too many times, but we did it when no one was at home, so no one was aware of our relationship."
Xian Xianqin simply nodded in understanding, making no comments about their relationship.
"Then what about your mother and elder sister?
Why did you choose to take them as your wives?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed as he rubbed the back of his head.
"Actually, I never considered taking my mother as my wife, but my anger took over me when I met her again.
I was already a demon at that time, so I used my abilities on her to make her understand my anger and hatred.
As for my big sister, I never knew about her feelings for me, and I only found out about it when we reunited after two years of separation.
Since I already have such a relationship with my mother and Lin'er, I decided to take her as my wife.
Even so, it took several months for her to accept her own feelings, and she officially became my wife on my 20th birthday."
"You're absolutely insane; do you know that?" Xian Xianqin expressed this by shaking her head.
"You're probably the only person in this universe who takes all the women in your family as your wives, and you also have relationships with several mothers and daughters."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed in response.
"Having several mothers and daughters as my wives is highly enjoyable, especially when we engage in dual cultivation together."
A red hue graced Xian Xianqin's cheeks as she imagined him engaging in dual cultivation with so many women, rendering her speechless.
"Are you still thinking about increasing your number of wives?"
"Don't you already know the answer, princess darling?" Zhang Fei responded in a playful tone.
'Ugh!
This shameless guy!' Xian Xianqin hurriedly changed the topic of their conversation.
"Anyway, I heard from Lin'er that you have five female slaves, but I've never seen them in your residence."
"You already know why I enslaved them, right?" Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Since the five of them are my slaves, I will not place them with my wives or partners; instead, I send them to a special place to take care of the place."
"Are you going to throw them away once you no longer need them?"
"No." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head.
"I took them as my slaves for a reason, and they will continue to help me even after I become truly powerful.
Apart from them, I have some female prisoners, but I have no interest in them.
I only need their Qi, and I will release them once I no longer need them, but I will do something about them first before releasing them.
I had numerous female enemies in the past, but they were too weak to assist me, so I killed some of them and sent some others to a demon realm."
"What happens to those you send to a demon realm?"
"They had turned into demons, but two of them were lucky because they fell into the hands of a good demon.
The other two were not as lucky as them, and they became slaves to the demons." Xian Xianqin let out a heavy sigh after Zhang Fei said that.
"I think that's enough about me for now, and I want to know a few things about you."
"What do you want to know about me?"
Zhang Fei stopped walking and grabbed Xian Xianqin's shoulder.
"Have you ever been in love?
Have you ever had someone you loved before?"
Zhang Fei's question caused Xian Xianqin to become embarrassed, but she quickly nodded and shared her story with him.
"Honestly, I have loved two people in the past; one of them was a man, and the other was a woman."
"Let me guess, the woman is Qian Ying, right?"
"Yes." Xian Xianqin immediately admitted it.
"Qian Ying is not only my best friend; she has been my everything in the past.
That's why I regretted it when she fell into the hands of the demons, and I would never have been able to overcome it if it weren't for you.
The man is Big Brother Aoxian, but he only regards me as a little sister, and he only loves Big Sis Yao."
Zhang Fei was not surprised by this because the Xian and Yun Kingdoms had such a close relationship, so it was not surprising that their children were attracted to each other.
"Have you never loved a man other than Yun Aoxian?"
"No." Xian Xianqin answered with a shake of her head.
"His rejection broke my heart, and I was no longer interested in other men after that.
Qian Ying always accompanied me at that time, and I was happy to have her by my side.
All the time we spent together involuntarily led me to fall in love with her, but I never expressed my feelings to her because I believed such a relationship was wrong."
"Then, what about now?
Have you started to like me?"
"Humph!" Instead, Xian Xianqin snorted and walked away, but her red face caused Zhang Fei to laugh in amusement. 'This guy!
He should have known the answer, but he still asked that!'
Zhang Fei immediately chased after Xian Xianqin and held her hand again.
"I understand that your feelings for me are still in the early stages, but I am confident that I can win your heart completely, and you will become my wife in the future."
'Sigh!
His skin is thicker than the palace walls!' After that, they walked around other areas of the tower and talked about other things to deepen their relationship.
In another area, a couple strolled hand in hand, engaging in a conversation.
"Are you serious about that, Brother?
Is Zhang Fei really a demon like you?"
"It's my guess, but I've been thinking about it since we met." Yuan Luo fell into contemplation after hearing that.
"All these years, no one knows my true identity, including our sect master and Emperor Xian.
However, Zhang Fei was able to recognize my identity right away, even though we only met for the first time.
Moreover, I felt some pressure from him during the strength test, and I noticed that the other demons also felt the same pressure.
This led me to believe that he was indeed a demon, and his demon race was likely superior to ours, enabling him to suppress us."
Yuan Luo asked him again.
"Do you think our princess and her family already know Zhang Fei's true identity?
She is close to him, and she has clearly fallen in love with him.
She is a good woman, and I don't want her to be controlled by him."
"No." Ximen Chuixue denied her guess with a shake of her head.
"Based on Princess Xian's expression and attitude, I am sure that she is not controlled by anything.
She is in a relationship with him of her own free will, so you don't need to worry about her."
"I see." Yuan Luo then stopped and moved in front of Ximen Chuixue.
"Brother, we've been together for several years, and I think it's time for us to formalize our relationship, so I hope you can meet my parents in our Yuan Clan."
Yuan Luo's request caused Ximen Chuixue to freeze in place.
However, he himself realized that he had delayed their relationship for too long, mainly because he was afraid that his parents would not be able to accept his identity as a demon.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 People Plans
paragraphs: In one corner, people from the beast and natural races' kingdom seemed to be discussing something, but no one could eavesdrop on their conversation because a soundproof barrier enveloped them.
"Do you really think that Zhang Fei needs our protection?"
Long Chen's question made the others raise their eyebrows, but Xian Jinglan then asked. "What do you mean by that, First Prince Long?"
Xi Xianzi immediately joined in. "Zhang Fei may be strong, and he can also defeat Zhou Fang. However, his enemies are not just one person; all of them are targeting him, including the demons."

"I think they are right, Big Brother." Long Tian spoke as he nodded. "Some people from the two kingdoms are indeed strong, but they are not stronger than us. Xian Kingdom people are divided into three groups, so they cannot protect him if they band together to attack him. Moreover, we have agreed to spar with him, so I think it would be better if our group stays close to their group, and we can protect him if the situation in the survival or maze challenges gets worse."

Long Chen first observed the people from the Xian and Yun Kingdoms, and then he looked at the people from the other kingdoms, especially the demons from the two demon kingdoms. "All right, we will stay around their group, but we shouldn't stay too close to them, and we will only act if Zhang Fei is in danger."
Zheng Ru and the others immediately agreed with that, and they then discussed their plans to face both challenges, especially since one of them could be their next challenge.
Within the Zhou Kingdom's entourage, the three Zhou siblings also rethought their plans, especially after Zhang Fei defeated Zhou Fang.
Zhou Tai then spoke to his big brother. "Fang'er has failed, and I won't be able to fight Bai Renfu and Bai Shouyi alone, but I might be able to do it if Meiling helps me."

"You're right." Zhou Tong then turned to their sister. "Meiling, once we enter one of those challenges, you must go with Tai'er to look for Bai Renfu and Bai Shouyi. The two of you must immediately return to my side once you have successfully captured them."
Zhou Meiling immediately agreed before asking. "What about Zhang Fei? He has already defeated Brother Fang, so we can't let him off, and he must pay for his actions."

"We have to focus on the three Bai siblings first, and we will immediately go look for Zhang Fei after we take care of them." Zhou Tong then pondered for a while before telling them something else. "However, young master Hongwu wants to give that brat to his little sister, so we can't kill him, and we have to capture him alive."

Zhou Meiling and Zhou Tai looked surprised to hear that, but their father had already told them to fully support the plan of the demons from the Ximen Kingdom. "Then what about young master Yan? Does he also want Zhang Fei?"

"No." Zhou Tong replied with a shake of his head. "Young master Yan doesn't care about Zhang Fei, and he only wants young Miss Yueliang and Xian Xianqin. However, he didn't ask for my help, and he has already ordered Qian Ying to capture them."

"It would be a shame if Zhang Fei had to die, especially since he was handsome and his talent was also high." Zhou Tong and Zhou Tai immediately turned to Zhou Meiling. "Why are you two looking at me like that? I had no interest in him, and I only wanted him as my servant. Unfortunately, young master Hongwu wanted him, so I was forced to forget my wish, and I will shift my target to Xian Xianwu instead."

Zhou Tong responded by nodding. "I heard that Huangfu Lian and the others are only targeting Yun Qinghai and Yun Xinyue, so it doesn't matter if you want Xian Xianwu. As for Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying, they seem to have already set their target on Zhang Fei, so we have to get ahead of them to capture him. Once we complete our task, I will assist you in capturing the Xian prince. However, we must exercise caution as Xian Changyue, who is stronger than me, will likely protect him."

Zhou Meiling smiled as she observed Xian Xianwu engaged in a discussion with his group members. "The Xian Kingdom will face doom if he falls into my hands and Xian Xianqin ends up in the hands of young master Yan. Our father can move to subdue Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, and their kingdom will become our subsidiary."
"That's true." Zhou Tong nodded in agreement with his little sister. "However, we don't need to think about things that are still far away, and we should focus on the task at hand."

"Big brother, Zhang Fei is stronger than we think, but I don't think he can defeat Zhou Fang just like that." Huangfu Lian immediately turned to his third brother, Huangfu Xiaofan. "I believe he used some underhanded means to defeat him, and I'm worried that something might happen to Xiaomei and Xiaoying if they fight him with just the two of them. We must send our other members to help them."
Huangfu Lian then turned to her two sisters. "What do you two think about that?"

"I think Brother Xiaofan is right, Big Brother." Huangfu Xiaoying responded by nodding. "Zhang Fei's cultivation is at 1-Moon Earth Realm, and he managed to light up ten crystals on the strength test, but it is still impossible for him to defeat Xiao Fang without using underhanded means."

Huangfu Xiaomei then expressed her idea. "Since Yun Qinghai has failed, our only target left is Yun Xinyue. We will find a way to capture her first, and we will lead some of our members to capture Zhang Fei after that. Additionally, we will ask Bai Chongxi and his two siblings to help us, and I am confident that we will succeed in capturing him."

"All right, you two can do that." Huangfu Lian then looked at Xian Xianqin, who had just returned with Zhang Fei and the other two. "Xiaofan, we must move quickly to capture Xianqin and her brother, but we must distract Xian Changyue from them, or else we will be the ones to die by her hands. After that, we will help our sisters to capture that brat, or else the others will get ahead of us to capture him."
"Okay."

Unlike them, the three people from the Bai Kingdom looked gloomy because they were people of high status, but the people from the Huangfu Kingdom treated them like slaves. Unfortunately, they were unable to resist their orders and were forced to comply with them.

Bai Chongxi immediately spoke to his two siblings. "Renfu and Shaoyi, we will immediately gather with Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei once we enter one of the survival or maze challenges, and we will help them capture Zhang Fei, but we must be very careful because Xian Changyue is by his side. Furthermore, the people from the kingdoms of the beast and natural races are likely to defend him, making this task extremely challenging. Although we cannot defy their orders, I urge you to prioritize your own safety and surrender immediately if the situation poses a significant threat to us."
"Is it okay if we run away, Big Brother?" Bai Renfu asked with a frown.
Bai Shouyi also seemed hesitant about it. "If we run away, Emperor Huangfu will force our parents to hand us over to him, and our fate will be much worse."

Bai Chongxi himself was fully aware of that, but he really didn't want them to die to help the Huangfu Kingdom. Unfortunately, he had no solution for that, especially since the people of the kingdom were always monitoring their movements. "I think I have an idea, but I don't know if it will work. However, I will not tell you two about my idea, and I will try to do it myself so you guys don't have to bear the consequences if they find out about it."
"Big Brother."

"No." Bai Chongxi shook his head at them. "For me, the safety of both of you is the most important, so I won't involve you in my plans. I hope my plan will succeed so we can be free from their control."
Meanwhile, Xian Yu and Xian Mu continued to gaze at Zhang Fei, pondering his origin and his connection to their cousins. "What do you think if we try to approach him, Big Brother?"
"Do you have any ideas about that?" Xian Yu asked without taking his eyes off Zhang Fei.

Instead, Xian Mu sighed and shook his head. "We don't have any information about him, and he doesn't seem interested in getting to know us, so it's hard for us to approach him. What do you think if we contact our father? We'll have a hard time approaching him, but our father might be able to do something about it, and he might be able to bring him over to our side."

"You're right." Xian Yu nodded in agreement. "I'll contact our father now to tell him about Zhang Fei, and I'll ask our mother to investigate his identity in the capital so we can come up with a plan to approach him."

"Husband, are we going to help our prince and princess?" Xian Qifeng immediately turned to his wife, Luo Qinglin. "Those people seem to be targeting their group, and our kingdom will be in danger if they fall into their hands, especially the demons."

Xian Qifeng immediately looked toward the group from the other kingdoms. "You are right; they are indeed targeting Xianqin and Xianwu. When we enter one of the two challenges, we will immediately lead the others to find their group. However, Aunt Changyue is currently with them, so we don't need to join them; instead, we will protect them from behind."

"I think that's better." Luo Qinglin briefly glanced toward Xian Yu and Xian Mu. "Your two cousins seem to be thinking about pulling Zhang Fei to their side, but I'm sure their efforts won't bear fruit because he's close to Princess Xianqin, and I can see that she's already fallen in love with him even though it's not that deep yet."

Xian Qifeng smiled upon hearing that. "Ever since Aoxian rejected her, Xianqin has always kept her distance from men, and this is the first time I've seen her get close to a man in the past few decades. I don't know anything about Zhang Fei's background, but he seems to really care about her, and I think he's the one who helped her to overcome her demon heart challenge."

"Xianqin failed to pass the demon heart challenge in several participations, but she immediately managed to get through it after meeting him, so I think your guess is correct." sentences.text: In one corner, people from the beast and natural races' kingdom seemed to be discussing something, but no one could eavesdrop on their conversation because a soundproof barrier enveloped them.

Zheng Ru and the others immediately agreed with that, and they then discussed their plans to face both challenges, especially since one of them could be their next challenge.
Within the Zhou Kingdom's entourage, the three Zhou siblings also rethought their plans, especially after Zhang Fei defeated Zhou Fang.
Zhou Tai then spoke to his big brother.
"Fang'er has failed, and I won't be able to fight Bai Renfu and Bai Shouyi alone, but I might be able to do it if Meiling helps me."
"You're right." Zhou Tong then turned to their sister.
"Meiling, once we enter one of those challenges, you must go with Tai'er to look for Bai Renfu and Bai Shouyi.
The two of you must immediately return to my side once you have successfully captured them."
Zhou Meiling immediately agreed before asking.
"What about Zhang Fei?
He has already defeated Brother Fang, so we can't let him off, and he must pay for his actions."
"We have to focus on the three Bai siblings first, and we will immediately go look for Zhang Fei after we take care of them." Zhou Tong then pondered for a while before telling them something else.
"However, young master Hongwu wants to give that brat to his little sister, so we can't kill him, and we have to capture him alive."

Zhou Meiling smiled as she observed Xian Xianwu engaged in a discussion with his group members.

"All right, you two can do that." Huangfu Lian then looked at Xian Xianqin, who had just returned with Zhang Fei and the other two.
"Xiaofan, we must move quickly to capture Xianqin and her brother, but we must distract Xian Changyue from them, or else we will be the ones to die by her hands.
After that, we will help our sisters to capture that brat, or else the others will get ahead of us to capture him."
"Okay."
Unlike them, the three people from the Bai Kingdom looked gloomy because they were people of high status, but the people from the Huangfu Kingdom treated them like slaves.
Unfortunately, they were unable to resist their orders and were forced to comply with them.
Bai Chongxi immediately spoke to his two siblings.

Bai Shouyi also seemed hesitant about it.
"If we run away, Emperor Huangfu will force our parents to hand us over to him, and our fate will be much worse."
Bai Chongxi himself was fully aware of that, but he really didn't want them to die to help the Huangfu Kingdom.
Unfortunately, he had no solution for that, especially since the people of the kingdom were always monitoring their movements.
"I think I have an idea, but I don't know if it will work.

"Big Brother."

"For me, the safety of both of you is the most important, so I won't involve you in my plans.
I hope my plan will succeed so we can be free from their control."

"What do you think if we try to approach him, Big Brother?"
"Do you have any ideas about that?" Xian Yu asked without taking his eyes off Zhang Fei.
Instead, Xian Mu sighed and shook his head.
"We don't have any information about him, and he doesn't seem interested in getting to know us, so it's hard for us to approach him.
What do you think if we contact our father?
We'll have a hard time approaching him, but our father might be able to do something about it, and he might be able to bring him over to our side."
"You're right." Xian Yu nodded in agreement.
"I'll contact our father now to tell him about Zhang Fei, and I'll ask our mother to investigate his identity in the capital so we can come up with a plan to approach him."

"Those people seem to be targeting their group, and our kingdom will be in danger if they fall into their hands, especially the demons."
Xian Qifeng immediately looked toward the group from the other kingdoms.
"You are right; they are indeed targeting Xianqin and Xianwu.
When we enter one of the two challenges, we will immediately lead the others to find their group.
However, Aunt Changyue is currently with them, so we don't need to join them; instead, we will protect them from behind."
"I think that's better." Luo Qinglin briefly glanced toward Xian Yu and Xian Mu.

Xian Qingfei nodded in agreement with his wife.

paragraphs: "Hey, wake up, my sexy succubus."
Orith, who was still sleeping, immediately opened her eyes. "I'm still tired, Elion. After you evolved into a lust demon lord, your strength in bed has surpassed mine."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [4] chuckled and took out a recovery pill before putting it in Orith's mouth. "Swallow it; you'll get fresher faster."
Orith immediately swallowed the pill, but she also felt suspicious about it. "Where did you get it? As far as I know, there is no such pill in this realm."

"We've been together for quite some time now, so I think it's time to tell you the truth." Orith raised her eyebrows, but Zhang Fei [4] immediately carried her off the bed. "Actually, I'm not a demon from this realm, and I came here specifically to increase my demon power."
"Eh?" Orith was stunned for a while. "Are you serious about that? Did you really come from another demon realm?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Orith. "Actually, I came from a demon realm in the lower realms, and Old Arbeola knew about it a long time ago. Unfortunately, the demon aura there was too weak, so I decided to come here, where the demon aura is several times stronger."
"Why didn't Lord Arbeola tell me about that?" Orith asked with a puzzled look.

Zhang Fei [4] rubbed Orith's cheeks. "I asked Old Arbeola to keep it a secret from the other demons, especially since I was still too weak at that time. However, I have evolved and reached the duke rank now, and you have helped me so much, so I decided to tell you the truth."

"I see." Orith nodded in understanding. "Can you take me to that realm? Even though it is a demon realm from the lower realms, I have never been to other realms, so I want to go there to have a look."

"I'm telling you this because I really want to take you there." Orith's expression turned joyful after hearing that, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately contacted Balena to meet them. "Anyway, Zilvora will be arriving soon, so we'll go there after she arrives."

Not long after, Balena arrived at the room, but he sighed heavily because Zhang Fei [4] and Orith were still naked. Even so, he was no longer embarrassed by such a situation, especially since he had repeatedly seen them like that. "Why did you ask me to come here?"

"Are you bored with this realm?" Balena nodded to Zhang Fei [4]. "I want to take you to see other realms so you can refresh your mind. However, we won't stay there for too long, and we will come back here after my subordinates have finished packing."
Hearing that, Orith immediately asked. "Do you have many subordinates there? Do you intend to bring them here?"
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in response. "Their numbers are greater than yours, but I will not bring all of them here; I will only bring a few, perhaps around a hundred people."

"In that case, you should place them in the incubi tower, or the presence of my subordinates will oppress them." Orith immediately turned to Zilvora, who had just arrived, and teased her. "Don't you feel lonely after being away for so long, Queen Zilvora? Moreover, Elion was stronger after he evolved, but you were absent for so long, so you haven't experienced his new strength."

Orith's words were right on target, and Zilvora was indeed lonely without Zhang Fei [4], but she was unwilling to admit it. "Do you think I'm as lustful as you? My subordinates are too many, not to mention the other demon races under my supervision, so I haven't been able to come here for quite a while."
"Hehe." Orith giggled at her response.

As he and Oirth got dressed, Zhang Fei [4] explained the truth to Zilvora, causing the spider queen to frown. He hurriedly asked Mei to open the gate to the Diyu Realm, shocking the three female demons as it appeared out of nowhere. Before they could question him, he had already pushed them through the gate.

"Hmm? The demon aura here is too thin and weak." As soon as they arrived at the Diyu Realm, Zilvora immediately expressed her opinion. "How can the demons in this realm increase their strength with such a weak demon aura?"

"That's why I went to your realm, or I would have had to wait thousands of years to reach the duke rank." The three female demons nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [4]. "Actually, there are several demons with emperor or empress rank in this realm, but they are still less powerful compared to you due to the difference in the quality of demon aura in both realms."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Several demons immediately appeared in front of them, but Zilvora and Orith trembled as soon as they recognized one of them. "Demon... demon emperor! Why... why are you in this realm?"

"This realm is my husband's home realm, and he is the one who sent us here." Zilvora and Orith immediately turned to Zhang Fei [4] because Morgana was pointing her finger at him. "Actually, we didn't know each other before, and we met him in the Netherworld Realm. Since he knows the way back here, he sent us here to ensure those human cultivators cannot find my husband, or else they would continue to control him."
"Does that mean he is free from their control?" Zilvora inquired.
"Not yet." Morgana answered by shaking her head. "You have witnessed their leader's strength, and his slave mark is also strong, so we have not been able to remove it from his soul."
"Are you two going to return to our realm again?" Orith asked.

Oz the First answered her immediately. "Those human cultivators will return to your realm one day, especially considering their previous plan's failure. They might bring another demon to control your realm, so I will never go back there. As for your true demon emperor, I only know he was sent to a realm behind the portal in the dead forest, but I don't know anything about that realm or his condition."

"They already know about it because they have gone there before, and many of the king or queen demons died there." Orith and Zilvora let out heavy sighs after Zhang Fei [4] said that. "Anyway, I will be bringing some of my subordinates from the tower to that realm, so I hope one of you can protect my sub-realm while they are gone."

"Since Oz the First and Morgana protect this realm, I will go there to lead them for the time being." Oz the Second then shared another piece of information with Zhang Fei [4]. "A few days ago, those three winged races came here, and they sent you information that their higher-ups were preparing to move. However, they had no intention of attacking this realm; instead, they wanted to attack the human realm."

Zhang Fei [4] immediately raised his eyebrows, and his face darkened. "I didn't expect them to decide to attack the human realm, but I have already prepared some things there. If they attack first, it will be too late, so I must find another course of action."
Orith, Balena, and Zilvora exchanged confused glances, not understanding their conversation.
"Do you need our help?" Morgana asked.

Zhang Fei [4] thought for a moment before nodding to her. "For now, I will think of another way to stop them without causing a commotion there, or they will suffer if we fight there, and I will inform you two soon."
Morgana and Oz the First immediately agree with that. "All right, we will wait to hear from you, and we will help you stop them."

After that, Zhang Fei [4] led the three female demons from the Netherworld Realm to his tower, and he immediately selected a hundred of them to go to that realm. Since they had previously used demon items from that realm, they were eager to go there in order to gain strength more quickly.
As he waited for his subordinates to get ready, Zhang Fei [4] let the three female demons explore his sub-realm, and he went to Angela's sub-realm to meet Nauvia, the siren.

Upon his arrival there, Zhang Fei [4] immediately summoned Angela out of the training space and explained his plan to bring Nauvia to the Netherworld Realm so she could appoint one of her subordinates to replace the siren.

After Angela left, Zhang Fei [4] immediately went to Nauvia and explained everything. "Do you want to go there? I will send your mother and the others there so you won't be lonely there, and your demon rank can increase faster."

"All right, I will go with you to that realm." Nauvia made her decision without hesitation, realizing that her demon rank had stagnated for too long and staying in the Diyu Realm would hinder her progress. "Where will we live then? Is that place near the waters?"

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at her. "There is a river near my city, but the aquatic demons there are much stronger than in this realm, so you will be in danger if you go there. That's why you should stay in my tower, where no one will bother you, especially now that I am one of the city's leaders."
"I see." Nauvia nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will follow your plan."
Once Angela had selected one of her subordinates, Zhang Fei [4] sent her back to the training space while he took Nauvia to his tower.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to the two female winged races on earth to confirm the news he had received from Oz the Second, and they directly acknowledged it. "When will they attack here?"
"A month."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod of understanding. "In that case, you can tell Gabriel and his people to leave them, or else I will drag them into my battle with them."
"Are you going to kill all of them?" Jiang Yinghua asked with a frown.

Zhang Fei [5] gave a slight smirk. "Do you think I will spare my enemies? I've killed too many people, so it doesn't matter if my hands are soaked in more blood. However, I will only kill those who descend to this realm, especially since I was still not ready to challenge the Throne directly."

Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi were stunned to hear that Zhang Fei [5] wanted to challenge the Throne, but a male winged race suddenly appeared in front of them. However, the two women were not surprised by his presence, especially since they already knew about his relationship with the rebel groups.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked Micah. "What are the rebels' plans? Are they going to make a move?"

"Yes." Micah nodded to confirm that. "My leader has tried to stop them, but the other leaders immediately prepared to move after the Throne announced his decision, and the situation in our realm will be chaotic soon."

"I could not care less about the situation in your realm, and I would be happier if they killed each other in a civil war, so I don't need to step in to kill them." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer made the three winged race frown. "Anyway, I already have some plans against them, so you can tell Dou Haishang to prepare in two months, or the rebels will also die."

After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] instantly disappeared from their sight, leaving them gloomy. Jiang Yinghua spoke directly to Micah. "You should return and inform Dou Haishang about it. Otherwise, the number of our race members who die will be too many."
"Yeah." Micah also left the place afterward.
"Do you think Zhang Fei will really kill them?"
"Yes." Jiang Yinghua nodded to Meng Tianshi. "Anyway, you should return to our realm and tell Lord Gabriel about this matter."
"All right."

Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes as soon as the two notifications appeared, and he rushed to wake up Xian Xianqin and the others, especially since the next challenge would appear soon.
As soon as Zhang Fei's group started moving, all the participants immediately got ready and stared at the ceiling of the room, waiting for the next challenge.

After some time, they were surprised by the appearance of several portals above them, and it had never happened in the past. Zhang Fei immediately realized that something was wrong because their appearance was different from Chao Yuanfeng's explanations, so he right away held the hands of the two women beside him, Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue.
Before they could react, all the portals glowed and sucked them in. Unlike the previous two tests, the people felt dizzy and nauseous as soon as they arrived at the location of the next challenge.
*Bleugh*
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue vomited as soon as they arrived there, so Zhang Fei immediately touched their backs and helped them relieve their nausea with his light element. "Are you guys okay?"

"We're fine." Both women immediately wiped their mouths and answered Zhang Fei, but their expressions changed as soon as they saw the tree walls surrounding them. "I didn't expect us to face the maze challenge so soon, and the rules seem to have changed."
"Yes." Xian Xianqin nodded in response. "Normally, we would enter as a group and arrive at the same spot, but we have now separated from our group."
"This is really troublesome." Yun Xinyue said with a heavy sigh. "We will face danger if we meet those evil people, especially those who have broken through to the seven divine realms."

Zhang Fei immediately opened the map system, but his expression turned ugly because it could not detect the area inside the maze. Only their area was visible, while the other maps were obscured by darkness. 'Can you detect those people's whereabouts, Mei?'

[Unfortunately, there is a powerful barrier that suppresses the system sensor, so I can't do that, master. I'm sure this barrier also blocks your senses, so you should walk carefully because you won't be able to sense what will appear on your way.]
"What happened? Why is your expression like this?" Xian Xianqin inquired after observing his facial expression.

"There is a powerful barrier that suppresses our senses, so we can't detect our surroundings." Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately spread their senses, and the results were exactly as Zhang Fei had described. "We need to move with extreme caution, and you must take out your weapons now so we can be prepared for any unexpected possibilities."
"All right." Both women immediately took out their weapons, one sword, and one long spear.

Zhang Fei himself immediately took out the moonlit whisper sword that Tie Xuan had lent him, and he also did not forget to take out the hongxi dagger. Additionally, he prepared the moon demon wheel and the hell chains in case they faced a group attack.
Zhang Fei carefully led the two women to walk forward as he asked. "How long does it usually take us to complete this challenge?"

"There is no time limit." Zhang Fei was slightly surprised by Xian Xianqin's answer. "The maze challenge is always difficult because each area frequently changes, and we will often encounter various obstacles, such as fighting beasts, puzzles, and so on. Not to mention, our enemies can appear in front of us at any time, so we must always be ready to fight, or we will die at their hands."

Zhang Fei tried to use his warp portal, but it was unsuccessful. Additionally, he was unable to open the portal to either his training space or Yin-Yang space. He then tried to summon Boitata from his beast space as a last resort, but his attempts were also unsuccessful. 'If my guess is correct, the tower is under the control of the little girl's master, who has purposefully altered the rules to make our situation more challenging because of my presence.'

sentences.text: "Hey, wake up, my sexy succubus."
Orith, who was still sleeping, immediately opened her eyes.
"I'm still tired, Elion.
After you evolved into a lust demon lord, your strength in bed has surpassed mine."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [4] chuckled and took out a recovery pill before putting it in Orith's mouth.
"Swallow it; you'll get fresher faster."
Orith immediately swallowed the pill, but she also felt suspicious about it.
"Where did you get it?
As far as I know, there is no such pill in this realm."
"We've been together for quite some time now, so I think it's time to tell you the truth." Orith raised her eyebrows, but Zhang Fei [4] immediately carried her off the bed.
"Actually, I'm not a demon from this realm, and I came here specifically to increase my demon power."
"Eh?" Orith was stunned for a while.
"Are you serious about that?
Did you really come from another demon realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Orith.
"Actually, I came from a demon realm in the lower realms, and Old Arbeola knew about it a long time ago.
Unfortunately, the demon aura there was too weak, so I decided to come here, where the demon aura is several times stronger."
"Why didn't Lord Arbeola tell me about that?" Orith asked with a puzzled look.
Zhang Fei [4] rubbed Orith's cheeks.
"I asked Old Arbeola to keep it a secret from the other demons, especially since I was still too weak at that time.
However, I have evolved and reached the duke rank now, and you have helped me so much, so I decided to tell you the truth."
"I see." Orith nodded in understanding.
"Can you take me to that realm?
Even though it is a demon realm from the lower realms, I have never been to other realms, so I want to go there to have a look."
"I'm telling you this because I really want to take you there." Orith's expression turned joyful after hearing that, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately contacted Balena to meet them.
"Anyway, Zilvora will be arriving soon, so we'll go there after she arrives."
Not long after, Balena arrived at the room, but he sighed heavily because Zhang Fei [4] and Orith were still naked.
Even so, he was no longer embarrassed by such a situation, especially since he had repeatedly seen them like that.
"Why did you ask me to come here?"
"Are you bored with this realm?" Balena nodded to Zhang Fei [4].
"I want to take you to see other realms so you can refresh your mind.
However, we won't stay there for too long, and we will come back here after my subordinates have finished packing."
Hearing that, Orith immediately asked.
"Do you have many subordinates there?
Do you intend to bring them here?"
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in response.
"Their numbers are greater than yours, but I will not bring all of them here; I will only bring a few, perhaps around a hundred people."
"In that case, you should place them in the incubi tower, or the presence of my subordinates will oppress them." Orith immediately turned to Zilvora, who had just arrived, and teased her.
"Don't you feel lonely after being away for so long, Queen Zilvora?
Moreover, Elion was stronger after he evolved, but you were absent for so long, so you haven't experienced his new strength."
Orith's words were right on target, and Zilvora was indeed lonely without Zhang Fei [4], but she was unwilling to admit it.
"Do you think I'm as lustful as you?
My subordinates are too many, not to mention the other demon races under my supervision, so I haven't been able to come here for quite a while."
"Hehe." Orith giggled at her response.
As he and Oirth got dressed, Zhang Fei [4] explained the truth to Zilvora, causing the spider queen to frown.
He hurriedly asked Mei to open the gate to the Diyu Realm, shocking the three female demons as it appeared out of nowhere.
Before they could question him, he had already pushed them through the gate.
"Hmm?
The demon aura here is too thin and weak." As soon as they arrived at the Diyu Realm, Zilvora immediately expressed her opinion.
"How can the demons in this realm increase their strength with such a weak demon aura?"
"That's why I went to your realm, or I would have had to wait thousands of years to reach the duke rank." The three female demons nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [4].
"Actually, there are several demons with emperor or empress rank in this realm, but they are still less powerful compared to you due to the difference in the quality of demon aura in both realms."
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Several demons immediately appeared in front of them, but Zilvora and Orith trembled as soon as they recognized one of them.
"Demon... demon emperor!
Why... why are you in this realm?"
"This realm is my husband's home realm, and he is the one who sent us here." Zilvora and Orith immediately turned to Zhang Fei [4] because Morgana was pointing her finger at him.
"Actually, we didn't know each other before, and we met him in the Netherworld Realm.
Since he knows the way back here, he sent us here to ensure those human cultivators cannot find my husband, or else they would continue to control him."
"Does that mean he is free from their control?" Zilvora inquired.
"Not yet." Morgana answered by shaking her head.
"You have witnessed their leader's strength, and his slave mark is also strong, so we have not been able to remove it from his soul."
"Are you two going to return to our realm again?" Orith asked.
Oz the First answered her immediately.
"Those human cultivators will return to your realm one day, especially considering their previous plan's failure.
They might bring another demon to control your realm, so I will never go back there.
As for your true demon emperor, I only know he was sent to a realm behind the portal in the dead forest, but I don't know anything about that realm or his condition."
"They already know about it because they have gone there before, and many of the king or queen demons died there." Orith and Zilvora let out heavy sighs after Zhang Fei [4] said that.
"Anyway, I will be bringing some of my subordinates from the tower to that realm, so I hope one of you can protect my sub-realm while they are gone."
"Since Oz the First and Morgana protect this realm, I will go there to lead them for the time being." Oz the Second then shared another piece of information with Zhang Fei [4].
"A few days ago, those three winged races came here, and they sent you information that their higher-ups were preparing to move.
However, they had no intention of attacking this realm; instead, they wanted to attack the human realm."
Zhang Fei [4] immediately raised his eyebrows, and his face darkened.
"I didn't expect them to decide to attack the human realm, but I have already prepared some things there.
If they attack first, it will be too late, so I must find another course of action."
Orith, Balena, and Zilvora exchanged confused glances, not understanding their conversation.
"Do you need our help?" Morgana asked.
Zhang Fei [4] thought for a moment before nodding to her.
"For now, I will think of another way to stop them without causing a commotion there, or they will suffer if we fight there, and I will inform you two soon."
Morgana and Oz the First immediately agree with that.
"All right, we will wait to hear from you, and we will help you stop them."
After that, Zhang Fei [4] led the three female demons from the Netherworld Realm to his tower, and he immediately selected a hundred of them to go to that realm.
Since they had previously used demon items from that realm, they were eager to go there in order to gain strength more quickly.
As he waited for his subordinates to get ready, Zhang Fei [4] let the three female demons explore his sub-realm, and he went to Angela's sub-realm to meet Nauvia, the siren.

Upon his arrival there, Zhang Fei [4] immediately summoned Angela out of the training space and explained his plan to bring Nauvia to the Netherworld Realm so she could appoint one of her subordinates to replace the siren.
After Angela left, Zhang Fei [4] immediately went to Nauvia and explained everything.
"Do you want to go there?
I will send your mother and the others there so you won't be lonely there, and your demon rank can increase faster."

"All right, I will go with you to that realm." Nauvia made her decision without hesitation, realizing that her demon rank had stagnated for too long and staying in the Diyu Realm would hinder her progress.
"Where will we live then?
Is that place near the waters?"
Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at her.
"There is a river near my city, but the aquatic demons there are much stronger than in this realm, so you will be in danger if you go there.
That's why you should stay in my tower, where no one will bother you, especially now that I am one of the city's leaders."
"I see." Nauvia nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I will follow your plan."
Once Angela had selected one of her subordinates, Zhang Fei [4] sent her back to the training space while he took Nauvia to his tower.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to the two female winged races on earth to confirm the news he had received from Oz the Second, and they directly acknowledged it.
"When will they attack here?"
"A month."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod of understanding.
"In that case, you can tell Gabriel and his people to leave them, or else I will drag them into my battle with them."
"Are you going to kill all of them?" Jiang Yinghua asked with a frown.
Zhang Fei [5] gave a slight smirk.
"Do you think I will spare my enemies?
I've killed too many people, so it doesn't matter if my hands are soaked in more blood.
However, I will only kill those who descend to this realm, especially since I was still not ready to challenge the Throne directly."
Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi were stunned to hear that Zhang Fei [5] wanted to challenge the Throne, but a male winged race suddenly appeared in front of them.
However, the two women were not surprised by his presence, especially since they already knew about his relationship with the rebel groups.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked Micah.
"What are the rebels' plans?
Are they going to make a move?"
"Yes." Micah nodded to confirm that.
"My leader has tried to stop them, but the other leaders immediately prepared to move after the Throne announced his decision, and the situation in our realm will be chaotic soon."

"I could not care less about the situation in your realm, and I would be happier if they killed each other in a civil war, so I don't need to step in to kill them." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer made the three winged race frown.
"Anyway, I already have some plans against them, so you can tell Dou Haishang to prepare in two months, or the rebels will also die."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] instantly disappeared from their sight, leaving them gloomy.
Jiang Yinghua spoke directly to Micah.
"You should return and inform Dou Haishang about it.
Otherwise, the number of our race members who die will be too many."
"Yeah." Micah also left the place afterward.
"Do you think Zhang Fei will really kill them?"
"Yes." Jiang Yinghua nodded to Meng Tianshi.
"Anyway, you should return to our realm and tell Lord Gabriel about this matter."
"All right."
[Ding]
