chapters.title: Chapter 562 The Maze Change
paragraphs: In another area, four people were walking together. Their expressions were extremely serious, and they were on high alert, as they could barely see the path ahead of them, rendering even their senses useless.

"Fortunately, you immediately grabbed my hand, Brother Chui. Otherwise, the portal would have separated us, and I would have had a difficult time finding you." Yuan Luo then turned to the other two people. "Are you two still feeling nauseous and dizzy, Ru Yanyue and Ying Shanhu?"
"Yes." Ru Yanyue was the first to answer as she massaged his forehead and head.

"I'm fine." Ying Shanhu then looked around them. "What exactly is going on here, Chui? Why is the maze challenge this time different from usual? Moreover, the restrictions this time are much stronger than the last, even suppressing our senses."

"I don't have an answer, so we must move forward to figure it out." Ximen Chuixue immediately took out two black gauntlets and wore them on both hands. "We shouldn't let our guard down, especially since we still don't know if any other changes are coming."
Yuan Luo, Ru Yanyue, and Ying Shanhu also immediately took out their respective weapons.
Two women fought some silver wolf earth-rank beasts, but they were no match for them, and they killed them all quickly.
"Hmm? What is that, Tian'er?"
Bai Tian'er raised her eyebrows, glancing at an item that had appeared on top of a pile of beast corpses. She immediately went over there and took it. "It's an elemental crystal, Zhiqiu."

"An elemental crystal?" Ye Zhiqiu was surprised to hear that. "We've challenged this maze several times in the past, but this is the first time we've gotten an item from these beasts. Moreover, an elemental crystal is quite expensive, and it can strengthen our elements."

"It's an ice elemental crystal, so you can have it." Bai Tian'er handed it to Ye Zhiqiu, who immediately stored it in her storage ring. "I'm curious about what caused this maze challenge to change so much, but we can't do anything but move forward for now, and I hope we can get together with the others soon."
The two women immediately walked away from the area. "Do you think the others will be okay?"

"I noticed earlier that Brother Chui is with Yuan Luo, Ru Yanyue, and Ying Shanhu. Zhang Fei is with Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, and Xian Xianwu is with Aunt Changyue. We are in the beginning stage now, so I'm sure they haven't met those people yet." Bai Tian'er then quickened her pace, so Ye Zhiqiu hurriedly followed behind her. "We don't need to worry about them now; we should focus on ourselves since we could meet those evil people anytime."
"Aunt Changyue, I'm worried about Xianqin."

Xian Changyue then turned to her nephew and saw Xian Xianwu's expression filled with worry. However, she was not too surprised by it because he and Xian Xianqin were twins, and they had never been separated before. "I was worried about her situation myself, but Zhang Fei held her hand before we were sucked into those portals, so I think they should be together now. Furthermore, that kid is not bad, and he has defeated Xiao Fang, so I'm confident he can protect your sister."

"Yeah, you're right." Xian Xianwu replied with a nod. "Zhang Fei is indeed strong, and he seems to be resourceful, so Xianqin should be fine as long as she's with him. Moreover, they are not alone, and Yun Xinyue is with them. What do you think is the cause of the strange things happening in this challenge?"
Xian Changyue shook her head at him. "I don't know the answer, but I think we'll find it through the exit, so we should move faster."
Xian Xianwu nodded and quickly followed his paternal aunt, tightly gripping his iron fan to prepare for any unexpected attacks.

A petite woman sat on a tall man's shoulders while supporting her head with her hands, but she kept sighing in annoyance, making the other men beside them confused by her attitude. "Why do you keep sighing on your own, Xi Xianzi?"
"Aren't you annoyed by the changes that have happened here, Long Tian?"

"Naturally, I am annoyed by these unclear changes, but there is nothing we can do to change them, right?" Long Tian then pointed ahead. "There is only one path ahead of us, so we have no choice but to keep moving forward, and we might be able to meet the members of our races soon."

Xi Xianzi nodded before speaking again. "Actually, I'm not worried about our members because they can protect themselves, and those evil people will not dare to attack them. However, I am worried about Zhang Fei because he is only accompanied by those two human princesses, and their cultivation has not broken through to the seven divine realms, so he will definitely be in danger if they attack him."

"Your worries are too much, Xianzi." Xi Xianzi turned to Zheng Ru, the giant. "Zhang Fei is not as weak as you think, and he has proven it by defeating Zhou Fang, so I am sure he can protect himself. Those evil people are also separated from their group, and this maze is very confusing, so they won't be able to find him that quickly."

"Well, that's true." Xi Xianzi then stretched out her hand forward, and a ball of light immediately floated down the path in front of them, illuminating their path. "We can follow it, and it will guide us through this dark path."
*Roar*

In another area, a powerful and overbearing roar of a dragon caused dozens of beasts in front to cower in fear on the ground. A second later, all of them droop motionlessly due to the effect of the roar, but none of them die.

"Prince Long, your roar frightened my Lang, so I hope you don't use it too often." Xian Jinglan said this as she rubbed the brown wolf's head to calm him down. "Moreover, they are just earth-rank beasts, so you don't need to intimidate them that much, and you only need to use your dragon aura to stop them."

"Haha." Long Chen laughed upon hearing that. "You don't know that some beasts are very stubborn and like to commit suicide by attacking stronger beasts, and I don't want to waste my time with them, so I have to do it. Anyway, can you use your abilities to track the others?"
"No." Xian Jinglan then looked up. "I don't know what happened in this maze challenge, but the restrictions are much stronger than usual, so my abilities are useless here."
"I see." Long Chen nodded in understanding and turned to another person. "What about you, Jin Dabao?"

Jin Dabao replied with a shake of his head. "Not only are there restrictions above us, but there are also restrictions below us, rendering my ability to track through the ground useless. The only way for us is to follow the path ahead of us, and I hope we will meet those demon races so that I can beat them up."
"You despise those demon races so much, huh?"

"Isn't that obvious?" Jin Dabao then raised the hammer in his hand. "Those guys killed my brother last time, so I hate them very much. Unfortunately, we can't fight inside the tower, so I have to hold back my anger toward them. Now that we're here, and there's no prohibition against killing in this place, I will not spare any of them who appear before me."
Long Chen turned to the female elf, but Xian Jinglan shrugged helplessly. "Let's speed up so we can find members of our races as soon as possible."

A woman leaned against the wall, her body trembling violently, particularly as the man in front of her continued to stare at her with a lewd expression. 'Ugh! Why is my fate so unlucky? Why did I have to meet this evil demon?'

"Hey! I didn't expect you to end up here with us, Bai Shouyi." The male demon then grabbed her hands and held them above her head. "I know your parents are under Huangfu Shou's control, and I can help you free them. However, I won't do it for free, and you can give your body to me instead."

"No!" Bai Shouyi shouted as she struggled to free her hands, but the male demon restrained both of them very firmly, and her cultivation was far below him. "Let me go, Ximen Yan! I will never give my body to a demon like you! I would rather die than do so!"
"Haha." Ximen Yan laughed softly. "Do you think you can refuse me?"
Bai Shouyi trembled even more intensely at the thought of himself falling into the hands of a demon. "Kill me!"
"Master, we have to move now, or they will get ahead of us."

Ximen Yan immediately turned to his slave with a raised eyebrow, but he then let go of Bai Shouyi's hands and led them forward. "Qian Ying, you must protect Princess Bai for now, and don't let her commit suicide, or I will punish you."
"Yes, Master." Bai Shouyi shivered due to Qian Ying's cold gaze, prompting her to follow behind them immediately.
*Boom*

A huge explosion was heard in another area, but the expression of the man who unleashed the attack was one of utter rage, especially because the tree wall in front of him did not break even though he attacked it with full force. "Damn it! What actually happened? Why does this maze feel so much more complicated than before?"

A man and a woman behind him could only shake their heads at his attitude. "Big Brother Tong, there's no point in you being angry like this, as the situation won't change, and we need to move faster. Moreover, Zhang Fei is only with Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue now, so this is a good opportunity for us, and we can capture them at once."

"I agree with Brother Tai, Big Brother. If we waste time like this, we will fall behind the others." Zhou Meiling joined in. "The sooner we find them, the better for us, and we can use the two women to force their parents to surrender to us."

Zhou Tong let out a soft sigh before nodding to them, and he immediately led his two siblings down the dark path ahead. However, a hole suddenly appeared beneath Zhou Meiling's feet when she stepped forward, and she immediately fell into it. "Ahh! Help me, brothers!"
"Meiling!" Zhou Tong and Zhou Tai simultaneously screamed as they tried to save their sister, but the hole swiftly vanished. "Damn it! The traps in this maze are also disappearing faster than usual!"
"What should we do now?"

"What else?" Zhou Tong immediately walked forward again. "The trap must have sent Meiling to another area, so we must move quickly to find her. She will be in danger if it sends her to the people of the Huangfu Kingdom, and they will use her to pressure our father."
Zhou Tai followed his elder brother with a gloomy expression. "If they really do that, Meiling will definitely die, as our father doesn't care about us, and we are just tools to him."
Zhou Tong chose not to comment on it, especially since he had long been aware of it. "Move faster!"

Meanwhile, Zhou Meiling fell into a deep hole filled with red water, drenching her body. She looked up, her expression turning serious as she realized the depth of the hole and the flight restrictions in each area of the maze, which prevented her from flying out.

"Since when was there a place like this in the maze? Has this place been here for a long time?" Zhou Meiling immediately stood up and walked toward one of the walls before touching it. "At least I didn't meet those people, so I can rest assured. However, this hole is too deep, and the walls are very slippery."

Zhou Meiling immediately dried her upper body, enveloped it with Qi, and jumped up. She grabbed two small rocks jutting out of the wall, and her feet stepped on the two rocks below. "Sigh! This place is really disgusting, so I must start climbing now."
With worried expressions, two men walked side by side, their sister's condition weighing heavily on their minds. "Do you think something bad will happen to Shouyi, Big Brother?"
"Why do you think like that?" Bai Chongxi asked his little brother with a frown. "You should think more positively and pray that nothing bad will happen to her."

Bai Renfu smiled bitterly in response. "I don't want anything bad to happen to her, but we know that there are many people who are eager to capture us, especially those demon races. If she falls into the hands of Ximen Yan or Ximen Hongwu, I'm sure they will use something to control her."

"I'm worried about that too, but we can't do anything to help her right now because we don't know her current location. We can only try to find her as quickly as possible." Bai Renfu nodded in agreement to his big brother, but several tree branches suddenly appeared from the two walls beside them. They immediately tied their bodies and pulled them into the wall on each side, causing both of them to disappear from that location instantly.

A while later, Bai Chongxi was already in another area, but several large beasts immediately confronted him. He hurriedly took out his sword to fight them, but their skin was too tough for it to penetrate, so he swiftly fled through the only path behind him. "This damn maze! Those beasts usually only appear in the inner area, but they're appearing in the outer area now! Tch! I hope Renfu and Meiling can protect themselves until I find them."

On the other hand, Zhou Tai arrived at a relatively safe place, and he found no signs of other living beings there. However, he didn't see any way out of the place, but he found a random arrangement of crystals on the north wall, so he hurried over to it.
"Haish! I'm not as smart as my big brother Meiling, and now I'm faced with a complicated puzzle." Since he had no other choice, Bai Renfu started trying to solve the puzzle.
"Why do you keep making a gloomy face, Yueliang?"

Ximen Yueliang repeatedly stomped her feet on the ground. "Ugh! This maze is so annoying! I was hoping the next challenge would be the survival challenge so we could move to capture Zhang Fei and Xian Xianwu, but this challenge came first."

"Haha." Ximen Hongwu laughed upon hearing that. "Why are you so impatient? Even if we can capture them as quickly as you want, you still can't do anything to them as long as we're still in the tower, so you should be more patient."
Ximen Yueliang let out a soft sigh before looking at the four roads in front of them. "So which path should we choose?"
"I don't know, and you can choose whichever path you like."

"Hmm?" Ximen Yueliang made a thinking posture while considering between the four roads before heading towards the east path. "Let's take this road; I have a feeling that we will meet one of them if we take this road."
Ximen Hongwu smacked his forehead before following behind his little sister, and he also took out his black scythe to guard against any unfavorable situations.
"Fortunately, you moved quickly to catch us, Big Brother. Otherwise, we would have been separated from each other, and it would not be a favorable situation for us." Huangfu Xiaofan sighed softly.
Huangfu Lian just nodded and turned to his two sisters. "Are your tracking artifacts useful for finding the way out?"

"No." Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei answered with shakes of their heads. "The restrictions are too strong, and our artifacts are useless. Do you think it would be better to split into two groups?"

"Only a fool would split up in a place like this." Huangfu Lian immediately led them through the twin paths in front of them. "Let's go; our main task for now is to find Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, and we will also capture Zhang Fei, who is with them."

sentences.text: In another area, four people were walking together.
Their expressions were extremely serious, and they were on high alert, as they could barely see the path ahead of them, rendering even their senses useless.
"Fortunately, you immediately grabbed my hand, Brother Chui.
Otherwise, the portal would have separated us, and I would have had a difficult time finding you." Yuan Luo then turned to the other two people.
"Are you two still feeling nauseous and dizzy, Ru Yanyue and Ying Shanhu?"
"Yes." Ru Yanyue was the first to answer as she massaged his forehead and head.
"I'm fine." Ying Shanhu then looked around them.
"What exactly is going on here, Chui?
Why is the maze challenge this time different from usual?
Moreover, the restrictions this time are much stronger than the last, even suppressing our senses."
"I don't have an answer, so we must move forward to figure it out." Ximen Chuixue immediately took out two black gauntlets and wore them on both hands.
"We shouldn't let our guard down, especially since we still don't know if any other changes are coming."
Yuan Luo, Ru Yanyue, and Ying Shanhu also immediately took out their respective weapons.
Two women fought some silver wolf earth-rank beasts, but they were no match for them, and they killed them all quickly.
"Hmm?
What is that, Tian'er?"
Bai Tian'er raised her eyebrows, glancing at an item that had appeared on top of a pile of beast corpses.
She immediately went over there and took it.
"It's an elemental crystal, Zhiqiu."
"An elemental crystal?" Ye Zhiqiu was surprised to hear that.
"We've challenged this maze several times in the past, but this is the first time we've gotten an item from these beasts.
Moreover, an elemental crystal is quite expensive, and it can strengthen our elements."
"It's an ice elemental crystal, so you can have it." Bai Tian'er handed it to Ye Zhiqiu, who immediately stored it in her storage ring.
"I'm curious about what caused this maze challenge to change so much, but we can't do anything but move forward for now, and I hope we can get together with the others soon."
The two women immediately walked away from the area.
"Do you think the others will be okay?"
"I noticed earlier that Brother Chui is with Yuan Luo, Ru Yanyue, and Ying Shanhu.
Zhang Fei is with Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, and Xian Xianwu is with Aunt Changyue.
We are in the beginning stage now, so I'm sure they haven't met those people yet." Bai Tian'er then quickened her pace, so Ye Zhiqiu hurriedly followed behind her.
"We don't need to worry about them now; we should focus on ourselves since we could meet those evil people anytime."
"Aunt Changyue, I'm worried about Xianqin."
Xian Changyue then turned to her nephew and saw Xian Xianwu's expression filled with worry.
However, she was not too surprised by it because he and Xian Xianqin were twins, and they had never been separated before.
"I was worried about her situation myself, but Zhang Fei held her hand before we were sucked into those portals, so I think they should be together now.
Furthermore, that kid is not bad, and he has defeated Xiao Fang, so I'm confident he can protect your sister."
"Yeah, you're right." Xian Xianwu replied with a nod.
"Zhang Fei is indeed strong, and he seems to be resourceful, so Xianqin should be fine as long as she's with him.
Moreover, they are not alone, and Yun Xinyue is with them.
What do you think is the cause of the strange things happening in this challenge?"
Xian Changyue shook her head at him.
"I don't know the answer, but I think we'll find it through the exit, so we should move faster."
Xian Xianwu nodded and quickly followed his paternal aunt, tightly gripping his iron fan to prepare for any unexpected attacks.
A petite woman sat on a tall man's shoulders while supporting her head with her hands, but she kept sighing in annoyance, making the other men beside them confused by her attitude.
"Why do you keep sighing on your own, Xi Xianzi?"
"Aren't you annoyed by the changes that have happened here, Long Tian?"
"Naturally, I am annoyed by these unclear changes, but there is nothing we can do to change them, right?" Long Tian then pointed ahead.
"There is only one path ahead of us, so we have no choice but to keep moving forward, and we might be able to meet the members of our races soon."
Xi Xianzi nodded before speaking again.
"Actually, I'm not worried about our members because they can protect themselves, and those evil people will not dare to attack them.

However, I am worried about Zhang Fei because he is only accompanied by those two human princesses, and their cultivation has not broken through to the seven divine realms, so he will definitely be in danger if they attack him."
"Your worries are too much, Xianzi." Xi Xianzi turned to Zheng Ru, the giant.
"Zhang Fei is not as weak as you think, and he has proven it by defeating Zhou Fang, so I am sure he can protect himself.
Those evil people are also separated from their group, and this maze is very confusing, so they won't be able to find him that quickly."
"Well, that's true." Xi Xianzi then stretched out her hand forward, and a ball of light immediately floated down the path in front of them, illuminating their path.
"We can follow it, and it will guide us through this dark path."
*Roar*
In another area, a powerful and overbearing roar of a dragon caused dozens of beasts in front to cower in fear on the ground.
A second later, all of them droop motionlessly due to the effect of the roar, but none of them die.
"Prince Long, your roar frightened my Lang, so I hope you don't use it too often." Xian Jinglan said this as she rubbed the brown wolf's head to calm him down.
"Moreover, they are just earth-rank beasts, so you don't need to intimidate them that much, and you only need to use your dragon aura to stop them."
"Haha." Long Chen laughed upon hearing that.
"You don't know that some beasts are very stubborn and like to commit suicide by attacking stronger beasts, and I don't want to waste my time with them, so I have to do it.
Anyway, can you use your abilities to track the others?"
"No." Xian Jinglan then looked up.
"I don't know what happened in this maze challenge, but the restrictions are much stronger than usual, so my abilities are useless here."
"I see." Long Chen nodded in understanding and turned to another person.
"What about you, Jin Dabao?"
Jin Dabao replied with a shake of his head.
"Not only are there restrictions above us, but there are also restrictions below us, rendering my ability to track through the ground useless.
The only way for us is to follow the path ahead of us, and I hope we will meet those demon races so that I can beat them up."
"You despise those demon races so much, huh?"
"Isn't that obvious?" Jin Dabao then raised the hammer in his hand.
"Those guys killed my brother last time, so I hate them very much.
Unfortunately, we can't fight inside the tower, so I have to hold back my anger toward them.
Now that we're here, and there's no prohibition against killing in this place, I will not spare any of them who appear before me."
Long Chen turned to the female elf, but Xian Jinglan shrugged helplessly.
"Let's speed up so we can find members of our races as soon as possible."
A woman leaned against the wall, her body trembling violently, particularly as the man in front of her continued to stare at her with a lewd expression. 'Ugh!
Why is my fate so unlucky?
Why did I have to meet this evil demon?'
"Hey!
I didn't expect you to end up here with us, Bai Shouyi." The male demon then grabbed her hands and held them above her head.
"I know your parents are under Huangfu Shou's control, and I can help you free them.
However, I won't do it for free, and you can give your body to me instead."
"No!" Bai Shouyi shouted as she struggled to free her hands, but the male demon restrained both of them very firmly, and her cultivation was far below him.
"Let me go, Ximen Yan!
I will never give my body to a demon like you!
I would rather die than do so!"
"Haha." Ximen Yan laughed softly.
"Do you think you can refuse me?"
Bai Shouyi trembled even more intensely at the thought of himself falling into the hands of a demon.
"Kill me!"
"Master, we have to move now, or they will get ahead of us."
Ximen Yan immediately turned to his slave with a raised eyebrow, but he then let go of Bai Shouyi's hands and led them forward.
"Qian Ying, you must protect Princess Bai for now, and don't let her commit suicide, or I will punish you."
"Yes, Master." Bai Shouyi shivered due to Qian Ying's cold gaze, prompting her to follow behind them immediately.
*Boom*

A huge explosion was heard in another area, but the expression of the man who unleashed the attack was one of utter rage, especially because the tree wall in front of him did not break even though he attacked it with full force.
"Damn it!
What actually happened?
Why does this maze feel so much more complicated than before?"
A man and a woman behind him could only shake their heads at his attitude.
"Big Brother Tong, there's no point in you being angry like this, as the situation won't change, and we need to move faster.
Moreover, Zhang Fei is only with Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue now, so this is a good opportunity for us, and we can capture them at once."
"I agree with Brother Tai, Big Brother.
If we waste time like this, we will fall behind the others." Zhou Meiling joined in.
"The sooner we find them, the better for us, and we can use the two women to force their parents to surrender to us."
Zhou Tong let out a soft sigh before nodding to them, and he immediately led his two siblings down the dark path ahead.
However, a hole suddenly appeared beneath Zhou Meiling's feet when she stepped forward, and she immediately fell into it.
"Ahh!
Help me, brothers!"
"Meiling!" Zhou Tong and Zhou Tai simultaneously screamed as they tried to save their sister, but the hole swiftly vanished.
"Damn it!
The traps in this maze are also disappearing faster than usual!"
"What should we do now?"
"What else?" Zhou Tong immediately walked forward again.
"The trap must have sent Meiling to another area, so we must move quickly to find her.
She will be in danger if it sends her to the people of the Huangfu Kingdom, and they will use her to pressure our father."
Zhou Tai followed his elder brother with a gloomy expression.
"If they really do that, Meiling will definitely die, as our father doesn't care about us, and we are just tools to him."
Zhou Tong chose not to comment on it, especially since he had long been aware of it.
"Move faster!"
Meanwhile, Zhou Meiling fell into a deep hole filled with red water, drenching her body.
She looked up, her expression turning serious as she realized the depth of the hole and the flight restrictions in each area of the maze, which prevented her from flying out.
"Since when was there a place like this in the maze?
Has this place been here for a long time?" Zhou Meiling immediately stood up and walked toward one of the walls before touching it.
"At least I didn't meet those people, so I can rest assured.
However, this hole is too deep, and the walls are very slippery."
Zhou Meiling immediately dried her upper body, enveloped it with Qi, and jumped up.
She grabbed two small rocks jutting out of the wall, and her feet stepped on the two rocks below.
"Sigh!
This place is really disgusting, so I must start climbing now."
With worried expressions, two men walked side by side, their sister's condition weighing heavily on their minds.
"Do you think something bad will happen to Shouyi, Big Brother?"
"Why do you think like that?" Bai Chongxi asked his little brother with a frown.
"You should think more positively and pray that nothing bad will happen to her."
Bai Renfu smiled bitterly in response.
"I don't want anything bad to happen to her, but we know that there are many people who are eager to capture us, especially those demon races.
If she falls into the hands of Ximen Yan or Ximen Hongwu, I'm sure they will use something to control her."
"I'm worried about that too, but we can't do anything to help her right now because we don't know her current location.
We can only try to find her as quickly as possible." Bai Renfu nodded in agreement to his big brother, but several tree branches suddenly appeared from the two walls beside them.
They immediately tied their bodies and pulled them into the wall on each side, causing both of them to disappear from that location instantly.
A while later, Bai Chongxi was already in another area, but several large beasts immediately confronted him.
He hurriedly took out his sword to fight them, but their skin was too tough for it to penetrate, so he swiftly fled through the only path behind him.
"This damn maze!
Those beasts usually only appear in the inner area, but they're appearing in the outer area now!
Tch!
I hope Renfu and Meiling can protect themselves until I find them."
On the other hand, Zhou Tai arrived at a relatively safe place, and he found no signs of other living beings there.
However, he didn't see any way out of the place, but he found a random arrangement of crystals on the north wall, so he hurried over to it.
"Haish!
I'm not as smart as my big brother Meiling, and now I'm faced with a complicated puzzle." Since he had no other choice, Bai Renfu started trying to solve the puzzle.
"Why do you keep making a gloomy face, Yueliang?"
Ximen Yueliang repeatedly stomped her feet on the ground.
"Ugh!
This maze is so annoying!
I was hoping the next challenge would be the survival challenge so we could move to capture Zhang Fei and Xian Xianwu, but this challenge came first."
"Haha." Ximen Hongwu laughed upon hearing that.

Even if we can capture them as quickly as you want, you still can't do anything to them as long as we're still in the tower, so you should be more patient."
Ximen Yueliang let out a soft sigh before looking at the four roads in front of them.
"So which path should we choose?"

"Hmm?" Ximen Yueliang made a thinking posture while considering between the four roads before heading towards the east path.
"Let's take this road; I have a feeling that we will meet one of them if we take this road."
Ximen Hongwu smacked his forehead before following behind his little sister, and he also took out his black scythe to guard against any unfavorable situations.
"Fortunately, you moved quickly to catch us, Big Brother.
Otherwise, we would have been separated from each other, and it would not be a favorable situation for us." Huangfu Xiaofan sighed softly.
Huangfu Lian just nodded and turned to his two sisters.
"Are your tracking artifacts useful for finding the way out?"
"No." Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei answered with shakes of their heads.
"The restrictions are too strong, and our artifacts are useless.
Do you think it would be better to split into two groups?"
"Only a fool would split up in a place like this." Huangfu Lian immediately led them through the twin paths in front of them.
"Let's go; our main task for now is to find Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, and we will also capture Zhang Fei, who is with them."

chapters.title: Chapter 563 Vengeful Souls
paragraphs: *Growl... Growl...*
As they were about to arrive at another area, Zhang Fei heard the growls of dozens of beasts through his sharp hearing, so he warned the two women straight away. "There are dozens of beasts ahead."
"Hmm?" Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue looked at him in surprise. "Are you able to hear their voices from this distance, even though the formation suppresses our senses?"
Zhang Fei answered them by transforming into his half-fox form, surprising both women. Yun Xinyue, who saw his form for the first time, was immediately fascinated by it. "Are you a demi-human?"

"Haven't you seen my human form?" Yun Xinyue nodded to Zhang Fei. "We don't have much time to relax, but I can tell you that this is my second identity as a fox beast, and Princess Xianqin has seen it before."

Xian Xianqin immediately nodded to the Princess Yun. "I was also shocked when I first learned about his two identities, but Zhang Fei is indeed a human and a beast fox, and his current form is his half-fox form, so he is similar to a demi-human."

"I see." Yun Xinyue then followed them to the next room, but she repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei's five white fox tails that kept dancing behind his hips, making her itch to hold and caress them. 'Ugh! His demi-human form is really cute, especially his ears and tails.'
Upon entering the dark room, dozens of bloodshot eyes greeted them, and they could hear the beasts' heavy breathing.

"You don't need to waste your energy fighting them." Zhang Fei stopped the two women as they were about to attack the beasts, confusing them. As he released his heavenly fox aura, he shot a light ball toward the room's ceiling, leaving the two women stunned to see the beasts curled up on the ground, their bodies shaking strongly. "The cultivation of these beasts has reached the earth realm, but they are only ordinary beasts, so they are not my opponents."
"Does that mean your beast rank is much higher than theirs?" Yun Xinyue inquired.

"My beast rank is indeed far above them." Zhang Fei then swung the moonlit whisper sword horizontally, and a thick sword qi immediately shot out before splitting all the beasts in front of them in half, causing Yun Xinyue's jaw to drop into a wide O shape.

"Hehe." Xian Xianqin chuckled at her expression. "Zhang Fei could even defeat Zhou Fang, who has cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, so you don't need to be shocked to see him kill these earth-rank beasts."
Yun Xinyue nodded to her, but she then pointed to some items that had appeared on top of the beasts' corpses. "What are those items? Since when did the beasts in this maze drop items?"

"I think this is the first time." Xian Xianqin immediately ran toward those items, and her eyes lit up when she saw two elemental crystals among the other items. "Hey! Zhang Fei! Xinyue! Two of them are elemental crystals!"
"Huh?" Yun Xinyue was momentarily stunned before moving to her side. "A wind elemental crystal and a lightning elemental crystal."

"You two can have both." Zhang Fei spoke as he walked behind them, and Mei promptly informed him about the items. All of them are high-grade, such as useable items, weapons, armor, etc. "I'll keep all these items for now, and we'll share them later."
"No need." Both women immediately refused Zhang Fei. "We are princesses, and we can get them easily, so you can keep them."

Zhang Fei laughed bitterly upon hearing that, but he then turned to Xian Xianqin, who handed him the wind elemental crystal. "My wind element reached peak rank a long time ago, so I don't need it anymore. Although this crystal can't help you upgrade your wind element to advanced rank directly, it can still increase its strength. If you don't need to use it, you can give it to one of your wives who has the wind element."
"Thank you." Xian Xianqin just smiled, and Zhang Fei immediately stored all the items in the system inventory. "So which path are we going to choose next? Front? Left? Or right?"
Yun Xinyue immediately spoke to them. "I have a bad feeling about the right path, so we shouldn't go that way."
Instead, Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin walked towards the path on their right, but did not enter it immediately. Yun Xinyue patted her chest in relief.

Zhang Fei immediately summoned a familiar, sent it inside, and shot a ball of light forward. Instantly, their eyes widened in shock as various types of weapons suddenly appeared and attacked his familiar, and all of those weapons were definitely not ordinary weapons.

Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin immediately turned to Yun Xinyue, who placed her hands on her waist and wore a proud face. "Told you, right? My instincts are never wrong, so you guys should listen to me and not enter that path."

"Your instincts are sharper than a beast, Princess Yun." Xian Xianqin nodded in agreement as she followed Zhang Fei to the center of the room, where they examined the two remaining paths. "So which one?"
"Hmm?" Yun Xinyue thought for a moment before she pointed the path ahead. "That path should be safe, so we should go that way."
"Let's go, then." Zhang Fei immediately led them through the path ahead, but they did not lower their guard in the slightest, and their hands tightly gripped the handles of their weapons.
Shortly after they left, a black shadow peeked out from the left path, but it immediately disappeared again.
"How much time did you two need to complete this maze challenge last time?" Zhang Fei asked the two women.
Xian Xianqin told him directly. "Last time, it took us two weeks to complete it, but we have to wait for the last group to pass before the next challenge appears."
"At that time, my group was the last to pass, and it took us a month to exit this challenge." Yun Xinyue responded with a bitter smile.
"Two to four weeks, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself before asking again. "How do we find the key to open the exit? How many keys do we need?"

"Three." Both women answered in unison. "Actually, if we deliberately search for those keys, we will never find them; instead, they will appear on their own when we are near them. However, powerful beasts guard some keys, and in the past, we had to face a beast with cultivation at 1-Moon Divine Transcend. Some keys require us to solve tricky riddles, while deadly traps surround others."

"Those beasts or traps are not the most difficult thing, especially since we can fight and get through them with many people." Zhang Fei turned to Yun Xinyue directly. "Back then, Big Brother Aotian was transported to a room where one of the keys was located, but he had to fight over it with five other participants, so a fight between them was inevitable. Furthermore, the narrow space made it difficult for them to avoid each other, and he ended up getting pretty badly injured in the process of getting the key."

Zhang Fei nodded understandingly, but he suddenly frowned and used his tree control ability straight away, especially since many tree branches appeared from the two walls beside them. He immediately swung his sword at those three branches and cut them into pieces, leaving the two women dumbfounded by his instant reflex.
"Even these tree walls have traps, huh?" Zhang Fei then turned to the two women. "Why are you two stunned?"

Yun Xinyue immediately put on a serious look. "Tell me, Zhang Fei. How can you move so fast? I know your instincts are sharp because you are a beast, but your reflex speed is much faster than any beast I have ever met. Even my parents, whose cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, couldn't match you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and took out the hammer that Gang Zhishou had lent him. As soon as he dropped it, the ground dipped down, causing the two women's eyes to widen. "Why don't you two try lifting it?"

Yun Xinyue immediately grabbed the handle of the hammer and tried to lift it, but it didn't budge an inch, so she used all her strength. Even after her face became extremely red, she still couldn't move it, let alone lift it.
After Yun Xinyue failed, Xian Xianqin also tried to lift the hammer, but her results were also the same as Princess Yun's. "How heavy is this hammer actually? Why is it so heavy?"

Zhang Fei smiled, raised the hammer, and threw it into the air a few times. The two were left completely speechless upon witnessing this, particularly as they were unable to move the hammer, yet he was able to throw it with such ease. "Old Gang lent this hammer to me to train my body because I am a blacksmith, and its weight is two thousand pounds."
"Two... two thousand pounds." Both women stuttered after hearing that.

"Yeah." Zhang Fei then put the hammer back into storage. "That's why you two don't need to be surprised by my reflex. Most blacksmiths have quick reflexes; many of them have even faster reflexes than me. Actually, you two can also improve your speed and reflexes with the same training, but you must start with a much lighter weight and increase it gradually."
Yun Xinyue shook her head in response. "My physique isn't that strong, so I won't be able to train with such a heavy load."

Unlike her, Xian Xianqin was eager to train using such a rigorous method, especially since she had sparred with several of Zhang Fei's wives, all of whom were much faster than her. Despite the vast difference in their cultivation, she had difficulty defending against their attacks. "After we return from the tower, you have to help me train that way, okay?"

"All right, I'll help you, but I hope you won't give up too quickly." Zhang Fei then led them on their way, and they arrived at another room sometime later. However, there was no path in the room, and they also found no riddles or anything inside. "It seems this is a dead end, so we have no other choice but to return to the previous room before taking the left path."

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue nodded in agreement to him, but the floor beneath them suddenly disappeared before they turned to leave. Zhang Fei immediately hugged their waists and threw the hellfire chains toward one of the tree branches on the previous path, which brought them out of the hole beneath them and landed at the side of the hole.

Zhang Fei released both women from his embrace and crouched down, trying to gauge the depth of the hole, but the formation restricted his senses. "What do you two think? Should we go back, or should we enter this hole?"

"I thought the previous road wasn't good, but I'm also worried about this hole because we can't see inside it, so we don't know whether there is danger in it or not." Yun Xinyue was the first to answer.

On the other hand, Xian Xianqin was more curious about the hole than the previous path. "There are no other paths in this room, and this hole is the only one available. Moreover, the previous path is not necessarily a dead end, so I think we should enter it rather than waste our time turning around."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately stood up and hugged them once again. "Moreover, we are cultivators, and danger is a part of our lives. If we continue to avoid the dangers that come our way, then we will never be able to develop ourselves."
"Wait a minute, I-Ahhh!"
Zhang Fei didn't give Yin Xinyue a chance to finish her words and carried the two women into the hole, so she immediately hugged him while closing her eyes.

Zhang Fei immediately pulled the hellfire chain back before storing it, and he used his body modification ability to transform his five tails into something like a parachute, so they wouldn't fall too hard.

Xian Xianqin looked up at Zhang Fei's five fox tails in a daze, especially since she had never seen such a thing before. 'How many secrets does he actually have? How could he transform his tails into such a strange shape?'

After landing at the bottom of the hole, Zhang Fei released the two women and reverted his tails back to their original form. They then looked around and found a path to the west, but Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately hugged him again when they saw so many skeletons below them.
"Ugh! Told you! This place is too scary! Let's go! We have to get out of this place quickly, or we'll die like them." Yun Xinyue complained as her body trembled violently.

Xian Xianqin, who was typically fearless, experienced fear upon seeing those skeletons. Moreover, she could smell the thick smell of blood, causing her to think that those skeletons were new. "There's something wrong here, so we have to leave this place quickly."
"Have you two never encountered a place like this before?" Zhang Fei posed this question as he led them toward the door to the west.
Yun Xinyue shakes her head vigorously. "No! My group and I have never encountered a place like this before, and it's too scary."
"I've never encountered one either."
*Boom*
Zhang Fei immediately stopped when a huge rock blocked their way out, causing Yun Xinyue to become even more frightened to the point she didn't dare open her eyes.
[Master, the system has detected the presence of a creature in this room, but it is unable to scan it due to its invisible form.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and moved the two women behind him, but Yun Xinyue continued to hug his arm and bury her face in his shoulder.
Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin held her green sword without uttering a word, perceiving Zhang Fei's grave expression, which confirmed her suspicion that there was something sinister within.
Zhang Fei's fox ears kept twitching as he tried to listen to the creature's movements, but it didn't make any sound at all, so he immediately brought the two women into an invisible state.
'What should we do now? Have you detected anything?' Zhang Fei nodded slightly in response to Xian Xianqin's questions, and his eyes continued to move to search for the creature's whereabouts.

'I detected the presence of a creature, but I can't see its form or hear its voice. We shouldn't move, or we'll be in danger if it's stronger than us.' Both women nodded in understanding, but Zhang Fei could feel the trembling from Yun Xinyue's body intensifying, so he used his light qi to calm her down. 'Hey, we are with you now, so you don't need to be scared like this.'

Mei suddenly informed Zhang Fei of something else. [Master, their numbers are increasing, and I think they are the souls of these skeletons. However, they are not ordinary souls but vengeful souls, and they seem to be much stronger than the three of you.]
Mei's information raised many questions in Zhang Fei's mind. 'Why are they in this place? Does this tower's founder kill them and imprison their souls?'

[Unfortunately, I don't have the answer to that, Master. Anyway, you can use your devouring art or demon absorbing ability to absorb their souls, and you can use them for your soul power to break through to the perfection stage of the soul core level.]
*Shriek... Shriek...*

Along with the sound of those high-pitched shriek sounds, the temperature in the room dropped at a rapid pace, causing the room to become completely cold. Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately used their qi to envelop their bodies, preventing the cold from affecting them.

Zhang Fei did nothing and kept looking forward as he began to see the appearance of those souls, but their appearance was much more frightening than the human souls he had encountered in the Sky Jade Realm a few months ago. 'They really are vengeful souls, huh?'

sentences.text: *Growl...
Growl...*
As they were about to arrive at another area, Zhang Fei heard the growls of dozens of beasts through his sharp hearing, so he warned the two women straight away.
"There are dozens of beasts ahead."
"Hmm?" Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue looked at him in surprise.
"Are you able to hear their voices from this distance, even though the formation suppresses our senses?"
Zhang Fei answered them by transforming into his half-fox form, surprising both women.
Yun Xinyue, who saw his form for the first time, was immediately fascinated by it.
"Are you a demi-human?"
"Haven't you seen my human form?" Yun Xinyue nodded to Zhang Fei.
"We don't have much time to relax, but I can tell you that this is my second identity as a fox beast, and Princess Xianqin has seen it before."
Xian Xianqin immediately nodded to the Princess Yun.
"I was also shocked when I first learned about his two identities, but Zhang Fei is indeed a human and a beast fox, and his current form is his half-fox form, so he is similar to a demi-human."

"I see." Yun Xinyue then followed them to the next room, but she repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei's five white fox tails that kept dancing behind his hips, making her itch to hold and caress them. 'Ugh!
His demi-human form is really cute, especially his ears and tails.'
Upon entering the dark room, dozens of bloodshot eyes greeted them, and they could hear the beasts' heavy breathing.
"You don't need to waste your energy fighting them." Zhang Fei stopped the two women as they were about to attack the beasts, confusing them.
As he released his heavenly fox aura, he shot a light ball toward the room's ceiling, leaving the two women stunned to see the beasts curled up on the ground, their bodies shaking strongly.
"The cultivation of these beasts has reached the earth realm, but they are only ordinary beasts, so they are not my opponents."
"Does that mean your beast rank is much higher than theirs?" Yun Xinyue inquired.

"My beast rank is indeed far above them." Zhang Fei then swung the moonlit whisper sword horizontally, and a thick sword qi immediately shot out before splitting all the beasts in front of them in half, causing Yun Xinyue's jaw to drop into a wide O shape.
"Hehe." Xian Xianqin chuckled at her expression.
"Zhang Fei could even defeat Zhou Fang, who has cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, so you don't need to be shocked to see him kill these earth-rank beasts."
Yun Xinyue nodded to her, but she then pointed to some items that had appeared on top of the beasts' corpses.
"What are those items?
Since when did the beasts in this maze drop items?"
"I think this is the first time." Xian Xianqin immediately ran toward those items, and her eyes lit up when she saw two elemental crystals among the other items.
"Hey!
Zhang Fei!
Xinyue!
Two of them are elemental crystals!"
"Huh?" Yun Xinyue was momentarily stunned before moving to her side.
"A wind elemental crystal and a lightning elemental crystal."
"You two can have both." Zhang Fei spoke as he walked behind them, and Mei promptly informed him about the items.
All of them are high-grade, such as useable items, weapons, armor, etc.
"I'll keep all these items for now, and we'll share them later."
"No need." Both women immediately refused Zhang Fei.
"We are princesses, and we can get them easily, so you can keep them."
Zhang Fei laughed bitterly upon hearing that, but he then turned to Xian Xianqin, who handed him the wind elemental crystal.
"My wind element reached peak rank a long time ago, so I don't need it anymore.
Although this crystal can't help you upgrade your wind element to advanced rank directly, it can still increase its strength.
If you don't need to use it, you can give it to one of your wives who has the wind element."
"Thank you." Xian Xianqin just smiled, and Zhang Fei immediately stored all the items in the system inventory.
"So which path are we going to choose next?
Front?
Left?
Or right?"
Yun Xinyue immediately spoke to them.
"I have a bad feeling about the right path, so we shouldn't go that way."
Instead, Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin walked towards the path on their right, but did not enter it immediately.
Yun Xinyue patted her chest in relief.
Zhang Fei immediately summoned a familiar, sent it inside, and shot a ball of light forward.
Instantly, their eyes widened in shock as various types of weapons suddenly appeared and attacked his familiar, and all of those weapons were definitely not ordinary weapons.
Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin immediately turned to Yun Xinyue, who placed her hands on her waist and wore a proud face.
"Told you, right?
My instincts are never wrong, so you guys should listen to me and not enter that path."
"Your instincts are sharper than a beast, Princess Yun." Xian Xianqin nodded in agreement as she followed Zhang Fei to the center of the room, where they examined the two remaining paths.
"So which one?"
"Hmm?" Yun Xinyue thought for a moment before she pointed the path ahead.
"That path should be safe, so we should go that way."
"Let's go, then." Zhang Fei immediately led them through the path ahead, but they did not lower their guard in the slightest, and their hands tightly gripped the handles of their weapons.
Shortly after they left, a black shadow peeked out from the left path, but it immediately disappeared again.
"How much time did you two need to complete this maze challenge last time?" Zhang Fei asked the two women.
Xian Xianqin told him directly.
"Last time, it took us two weeks to complete it, but we have to wait for the last group to pass before the next challenge appears."
"At that time, my group was the last to pass, and it took us a month to exit this challenge." Yun Xinyue responded with a bitter smile.
"Two to four weeks, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself before asking again.
"How do we find the key to open the exit?
How many keys do we need?"
"Three." Both women answered in unison.
"Actually, if we deliberately search for those keys, we will never find them; instead, they will appear on their own when we are near them.
However, powerful beasts guard some keys, and in the past, we had to face a beast with cultivation at 1-Moon Divine Transcend.
Some keys require us to solve tricky riddles, while deadly traps surround others."
"Those beasts or traps are not the most difficult thing, especially since we can fight and get through them with many people." Zhang Fei turned to Yun Xinyue directly.
"Back then, Big Brother Aotian was transported to a room where one of the keys was located, but he had to fight over it with five other participants, so a fight between them was inevitable.
Furthermore, the narrow space made it difficult for them to avoid each other, and he ended up getting pretty badly injured in the process of getting the key."
Zhang Fei nodded understandingly, but he suddenly frowned and used his tree control ability straight away, especially since many tree branches appeared from the two walls beside them.
He immediately swung his sword at those three branches and cut them into pieces, leaving the two women dumbfounded by his instant reflex.
"Even these tree walls have traps, huh?" Zhang Fei then turned to the two women.
"Why are you two stunned?"
Yun Xinyue immediately put on a serious look.
"Tell me, Zhang Fei.
How can you move so fast?
I know your instincts are sharp because you are a beast, but your reflex speed is much faster than any beast I have ever met.
Even my parents, whose cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm, couldn't match you."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and took out the hammer that Gang Zhishou had lent him.
As soon as he dropped it, the ground dipped down, causing the two women's eyes to widen.
"Why don't you two try lifting it?"
Yun Xinyue immediately grabbed the handle of the hammer and tried to lift it, but it didn't budge an inch, so she used all her strength.
Even after her face became extremely red, she still couldn't move it, let alone lift it.
After Yun Xinyue failed, Xian Xianqin also tried to lift the hammer, but her results were also the same as Princess Yun's.
"How heavy is this hammer actually?
Why is it so heavy?"
Zhang Fei smiled, raised the hammer, and threw it into the air a few times.
The two were left completely speechless upon witnessing this, particularly as they were unable to move the hammer, yet he was able to throw it with such ease.
"Old Gang lent this hammer to me to train my body because I am a blacksmith, and its weight is two thousand pounds."
"Two... two thousand pounds." Both women stuttered after hearing that.
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then put the hammer back into storage.
"That's why you two don't need to be surprised by my reflex.
Most blacksmiths have quick reflexes; many of them have even faster reflexes than me.
Actually, you two can also improve your speed and reflexes with the same training, but you must start with a much lighter weight and increase it gradually."
Yun Xinyue shook her head in response.
"My physique isn't that strong, so I won't be able to train with such a heavy load."
Unlike her, Xian Xianqin was eager to train using such a rigorous method, especially since she had sparred with several of Zhang Fei's wives, all of whom were much faster than her.
Despite the vast difference in their cultivation, she had difficulty defending against their attacks.
"After we return from the tower, you have to help me train that way, okay?"
"All right, I'll help you, but I hope you won't give up too quickly." Zhang Fei then led them on their way, and they arrived at another room sometime later.
However, there was no path in the room, and they also found no riddles or anything inside.
"It seems this is a dead end, so we have no other choice but to return to the previous room before taking the left path."
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue nodded in agreement to him, but the floor beneath them suddenly disappeared before they turned to leave.

Zhang Fei immediately hugged their waists and threw the hellfire chains toward one of the tree branches on the previous path, which brought them out of the hole beneath them and landed at the side of the hole.
Zhang Fei released both women from his embrace and crouched down, trying to gauge the depth of the hole, but the formation restricted his senses.
"What do you two think?
Should we go back, or should we enter this hole?"

"I thought the previous road wasn't good, but I'm also worried about this hole because we can't see inside it, so we don't know whether there is danger in it or not." Yun Xinyue was the first to answer.
On the other hand, Xian Xianqin was more curious about the hole than the previous path.
"There are no other paths in this room, and this hole is the only one available.
Moreover, the previous path is not necessarily a dead end, so I think we should enter it rather than waste our time turning around."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately stood up and hugged them once again.
"Moreover, we are cultivators, and danger is a part of our lives.
If we continue to avoid the dangers that come our way, then we will never be able to develop ourselves."
"Wait a minute, I-Ahhh!"
Zhang Fei didn't give Yin Xinyue a chance to finish her words and carried the two women into the hole, so she immediately hugged him while closing her eyes.

Zhang Fei immediately pulled the hellfire chain back before storing it, and he used his body modification ability to transform his five tails into something like a parachute, so they wouldn't fall too hard.
Xian Xianqin looked up at Zhang Fei's five fox tails in a daze, especially since she had never seen such a thing before. 'How many secrets does he actually have?
How could he transform his tails into such a strange shape?'
After landing at the bottom of the hole, Zhang Fei released the two women and reverted his tails back to their original form.
They then looked around and found a path to the west, but Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately hugged him again when they saw so many skeletons below them.
"Ugh!
Told you!
This place is too scary!
Let's go!
We have to get out of this place quickly, or we'll die like them." Yun Xinyue complained as her body trembled violently.
Xian Xianqin, who was typically fearless, experienced fear upon seeing those skeletons.
Moreover, she could smell the thick smell of blood, causing her to think that those skeletons were new.
"There's something wrong here, so we have to leave this place quickly."
"Have you two never encountered a place like this before?" Zhang Fei posed this question as he led them toward the door to the west.
Yun Xinyue shakes her head vigorously.
"No!
My group and I have never encountered a place like this before, and it's too scary."
"I've never encountered one either."
*Boom*
Zhang Fei immediately stopped when a huge rock blocked their way out, causing Yun Xinyue to become even more frightened to the point she didn't dare open her eyes.
[Master, the system has detected the presence of a creature in this room, but it is unable to scan it due to its invisible form.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and moved the two women behind him, but Yun Xinyue continued to hug his arm and bury her face in his shoulder.
Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin held her green sword without uttering a word, perceiving Zhang Fei's grave expression, which confirmed her suspicion that there was something sinister within.
Zhang Fei's fox ears kept twitching as he tried to listen to the creature's movements, but it didn't make any sound at all, so he immediately brought the two women into an invisible state.
'What should we do now?
Have you detected anything?' Zhang Fei nodded slightly in response to Xian Xianqin's questions, and his eyes continued to move to search for the creature's whereabouts.
'I detected the presence of a creature, but I can't see its form or hear its voice.

We shouldn't move, or we'll be in danger if it's stronger than us.' Both women nodded in understanding, but Zhang Fei could feel the trembling from Yun Xinyue's body intensifying, so he used his light qi to calm her down. 'Hey, we are with you now, so you don't need to be scared like this.'
Mei suddenly informed Zhang Fei of something else.
[Master, their numbers are increasing, and I think they are the souls of these skeletons.
However, they are not ordinary souls but vengeful souls, and they seem to be much stronger than the three of you.]
Mei's information raised many questions in Zhang Fei's mind. 'Why are they in this place?
Does this tower's founder kill them and imprison their souls?'
[Unfortunately, I don't have the answer to that, Master.
Anyway, you can use your devouring art or demon absorbing ability to absorb their souls, and you can use them for your soul power to break through to the perfection stage of the soul core level.]
*Shriek...
Shriek...*
Along with the sound of those high-pitched shriek sounds, the temperature in the room dropped at a rapid pace, causing the room to become completely cold.
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately used their qi to envelop their bodies, preventing the cold from affecting them.

Zhang Fei did nothing and kept looking forward as he began to see the appearance of those souls, but their appearance was much more frightening than the human souls he had encountered in the Sky Jade Realm a few months ago. 'They really are vengeful souls, huh?'

chapters.title: Chapter 564 Absorb The Souls
paragraphs: [Master, these people probably died a horrible death, so they turned into vengeful souls. Since they have become like this, you don't need to think about saving them, and it's better if you absorb them all at once to increase your soul power.]

Zhang Fei naturally wanted to increase his soul power, but he was curious about why they were trapped there until they transformed into vengeful souls. 'Mei, how much beast essence do I have now? Is there a technique to purify souls in the beast abilities shop?'

[You have two and a half million beast essences, Master. There are three soul-purifying abilities, but you can only buy low-grade ones now, and the price is one million beast essences. You need five million and ten million beast essences to purchase the intermediate and advanced grades of purifying abilities. Although soul light purification is only at a low level, it should be capable of purifying these souls, and it can also be used to remove impurities from other people's souls.]
'Buy it then.'
[All right.]
{You learned the Soul Light Purification Ability.}
{1,000,000 beast essences have been deducted from your balance.}
'What... what are those creatures?' Yun Xinyue stammered as she peered at the vengeful souls that had already materialized.
Xian Xianqin was equally shocked by their appearance. 'Are they human souls?'

'I don't know how they got trapped here and turned into vengeful souls, but I'm sure they are the souls of the owners of the skeletons in this place.' As both women focused their attention on those souls, Zhang Fei suddenly enveloped them with his light element, bolstered by his light law.
In that instant, those vengeful souls scattered around as they were terrified of Zhang Fei's light element, and none of them dared to approach them.

'Don't leave my light element, or they will attack both of you.' Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately held Zhang Fei back by hugging him tightly. 'It's okay. They won't dare attack me, so you two don't need to worry about me.'
'What exactly are you going to do with them?'

'I want to find out the reason behind their situation before making my next move against them, and I have to purify one of them to find out the answer.' Zhang Fei immediately moved their hands from his body and searched for the weakest vengeful soul. After he found it, he immediately teleported in front of it, leaving Yun Xinyue stunned by his instant movement.
Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin had already seen Zhang Fei teleport when he fought Huan Ya, so she was no longer surprised by it.

Zhang Fei showed up in front of a vengeful soul, but it vanished as he was about to capture it, forcing him to switch targets. However, his next target also disappeared, along with the others, which annoyed him.

The vengeful souls were eager to attack Zhang Fei, but the three light shields circling his body prevented them from attacking him. He then released more of his light qi and pointed his right palm upwards, and a bright white light shot out from it, which immediately spread out and formed a formation, illuminating the place.
The vengeful souls scattered away from Zhang Fei after they saw that, and the two women stood dumbfounded in their spots as their eyes focused on the light formation.
[Do you intend to kill them, master? Wouldn't that be a big loss for you?]

'Hey! Naturally, I won't kill them, and I just want to scare them.' Zhang Fei immediately activated the exorcismus ability, and countless rays of light rained down on the area below him, brightening the whole area.

Zhang Fei could clearly see the vengeful souls, and he immediately moved towards one of them before grabbing its neck, causing it to struggle free. However, he immediately activated the soul light purification ability, causing the evil aura to disappear and gradually transform into its former self, a middle-aged man with a cut on his right eye.
Zhang Fei immediately brought the middle-aged man's soul to the two women's side. "Who exactly are you all? How did you guys get trapped here and turn into vengeful souls?"

"Young master, I don't know how you managed to cleanse my soul, but I hope you kill me now. All of us have lost track of how long we've been trapped in this place, and we eventually died here; even our souls continue to wander here." Zhang Fei and the two women frowned upon hearing that. "Honestly, we are evil people in our realm, and we have committed many heinous crimes there, so the people from the Immortal Soul Palace locked us up in this place."
"The Immortal Soul Palace?" Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue were confused after hearing that name, especially since they had never heard of that sect in the middle realms.
Zhang Fei immediately asked. "Is that sect located in the upper realms?"
"No." The middle-aged man's soul shook his head. "Our realm is in the-"
*Swoosh*
Before the middle-aged man's soul could answer Zhang Fei's question, a light pillar suddenly appeared out of nowhere and obliterated his soul, causing him and the two women to frown.

Unlike Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, Zhang Fei could immediately guess the location of the Immortal Soul Palace, especially since Feng Yao had told him that there was another realm beyond the upper realms.

Zhang Fei then looked up with a serious face. 'So that little girl and her master came from that realm, huh? What is their purpose in sending the Star Tower to the Nine Stars Realm? Are they just trying to test us, or do they have another goal?'
"Zhang Fei! What are you going to do with the other vengeful souls?" Xian Xianqin asked.
Yun Xinyue also spoke to him. "Apparently, we have to get rid of them to open the stone, or else we can't go elsewhere."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he continued watching above with a serious gaze. 'Since you guys don't want us to know information about your background, I will use other means to obtain that information.'

Zhang Fei then floated to the center of the room and locked all those vengeful souls with his aura, leaving the two women wondering about his plans for them. After his senses locked onto them all, he immediately teleported in front of each of them, and he swiftly used the demon-absorbing ability to suck them into his body.

"Zhang Fei! Stop it! Don't absorb them! Their evil nature will affect you!" Yun Xinyue, who was still unaware of his demon identity, immediately yelled at him as soon as he did that to those vengeful souls.
"Don't stop him, Xinyue." Yun Xinyue turned to Xian Xianqin with a frown. "I know you're worried about him, but he'll be fine because he still has another identity."
"Another identity?"
Xian Xianqin nodded to her. "I've known about it for a long time, but I couldn't tell you because I promised him. You can ask him yourself if you want to know about it."

Yun Xinyue said nothing and looked at Zhang Fei, who was still busy absorbing the remaining vengeful souls. She was worried that they would influence him, but she could see that nothing had changed in him, so she could feel relieved.
Sometime later, Zhang Fei had finished absorbing all the vengeful souls in that place, and a notification immediately appeared in his mind.
[The host soul level has increased to the perfection stage of the soul core level.]

"Phew." Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief before checking his soul, and he smiled in satisfaction at the breakthrough in his soul power. He then landed in front of the two women and dispelled the light element that enveloped them, but Yun Xinyue immediately groped around his body and looked at him seriously. "Do you realize that your behavior resembles that of a wife?"
"Huh?" Momentarily stunned, Yun Xinyue blushed and withdrew her hands. "Do you really not feel any change after absorbing so many vengeful souls?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "Instead, my soul power broke through one minor stage after I absorbed them, and I might be able to break through to the next major stage faster."
"Phew." Yun Xinyue expressed her relief by patting her chest. "I'm really afraid that their evil nature will influence you, and you will become evil like them."
Zhang Fei smiled at that. "Why are you so worried? Are you in love with me?"

Upon hearing that, Xian Xianqin immediately massaged her forehead and sighed helplessly at Zhang Fei's playboy attitude. 'This guy is a womanizer! Our relationship is still in the early stages, but he is already trying to seduce Xinyue before my eyes.'

"No!" Yun Xinyue denied it by shaking her head, but the blush on her cheeks made Zhang Fei certain of his guess. "You were my savior after you saved me from Bai Shouyi's poison, so I don't want anything bad to happen to you."
"You've seen that I haven't changed, so you don't need to worry anymore, right?" Zhang Fei then pointed toward the exit. "The exit is open now, so we should go to the next area."
"Let's go." Yun Xinyue immediately ran towards the exit as she pondered in her heart. 'Ugh! Why does my heart race when he asks that? Am I truly in love with him?'
"Are you interested in XInyuye?" Zhang Fei turned to Xian Xianqin, neither confirming nor denying her question, which caused her to sigh. "Let's follow her, or she'll be in danger."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately took Xian Xianqin's hand and led her out of the place to catch up with Yun Xinyue, after which the three of them rushed into the next room.

Not long after they left, the old man and Hua Mei'er appeared in the room, and their expressions looked strange seeing the empty room. "Master, I know that he has a demon form, but his ability to absorb those vengeful souls is truly terrifying. Despite having fought numerous demons myself, I have never witnessed such a technique before, and he wasn't unaffected by them."

The old man nodded in agreement with her. "I don't know where he got that technique from, but it is probably a sub-technique of an ancient demon technique. Those vengeful souls might not affect him, but he should refrain from continuously using that technique to boost his soul power. If he continues to use it, he will sooner or later fall into the heretic path, and he might become the most terrifying demon."
"The most terrifying demon? Do you think he can surpass those ancient demons?" Hua Mei'er doubtfully asked.
The old man shook his head. "I can't say for sure, but it's possible."

Hua Mei'er then turned to her master. "Are you sure this won't be a problem, Master? This route is the most dangerous among the routes in this maze, and our leaders have vehemently warned all the tower watchers not to open this route. They even threatened to punish those who violated it severely, but you insisted on opening it to test that annoying kid. Moreover, the usual challenges are already difficult for people in this realm to overcome, and most of them have failed repeatedly, but you have actually increased the difficulty. Anyway, their next destination would be even more difficult, and the two women by his side would probably go crazy."

"You don't need to think about the punishment, and I will bear it myself if they find out about this. If those people are unable to reach the tenth floor, then they are not worthy of joining us, and I will relocate the tower to another realm." The old man then grabbed Hua Mei'er's shoulder. "Let's go back."

Upon reaching the next room, Zhang Fei and the two women immediately frowned, realizing there was no way out. They saw a statue of a woman in the middle of the room, so they immediately approached it and examined it. "Do you think this woman is part of the Immortal Soul Palace?"
"Maybe." Zhang Fei then felt the statue to find a way out of the room, but he found nothing on the statue of the woman. "Let's check these walls."

They immediately divided the task of inspecting the three walls in the room, carefully checking each side separately. After they searched for some time, Xian Xianqin suddenly found a strange part on the wall, and she immediately pushed it in.
*Click*
*Rumble... Rumble...*
They immediately turned to the statue of a woman in the center of the room, and it quickly shifted back, exposing a spiral staircase leading down to the lower area.

"Let's go." Zhang Fei immediately ran towards the stairs, and the two women right away followed behind him. However, the room was much darker, so he enveloped their bodies in his light elements to illuminate their path.

"Brr." Yun Xinyue shivered as the cold wind passed through them from below, and it gave her a terrible feeling. "Guys, I feel like our next destination will be worse than the previous two rooms, and we might meet even more terrifying creatures."

Xian Xianqin shook her head in response. "Xinyue, we are cultivators, so you must brave yourself to face this kind of situation. Otherwise, you will never be able to be independent, and your family must protect you for the rest of your life."
"I'm not afraid of facing other cultivators or beasts, but creatures like those vengeful souls are really scary." Yun Xinyue protested as she pouted her lips.

Zhang Fei laughed at Yun Xinyue's antics. "All right, you don't have to lecture him, Princess Xianqin. Even though we are cultivators, we have some fear in our hearts about something; even I have my own fears."
"What are you afraid of?" Both women asked in curious manners.
"I won't tell you two about that." Both women looked annoyed by Zhang Fei's answer.
Yun Xinyue then asked him. "Xianqin said that you have another identity. Can you tell me about it?"

"You better not know about it, or you will be afraid of me, especially since my last identity is scary to some people." Zhang Fei's response caused Yun Xinyue to frown and turn towards the Xian princess, but Xian Xianqin shook her head, refusing to divulge the information.

After they had walked down for quite some time, they suddenly saw a faint light from below, so they immediately increased their vigilance. Cautiously, they walked towards the lower area, but once they arrived, they became confused. The room ahead was filled with furniture, leading them to conclude that it was a woman's room due to the red and pink decoration.

Moreover, they had never seen such furniture before, including Zhang Fei, who came from the modern Earth. Without hesitation, Yun Xinyue entered the room and laid down on the bed, causing both him and Xian Xianqin to let out helpless sighs.

As soon as the three of them entered the room, the entrance immediately disappeared by itself, causing Yun Xinyue to panic. The Yun princess immediately jumped down from the bed and moved towards the entrance, but there was only a wall in front of her. "Tch! I knew we would be trapped like this again!"

Although she was also panicking about their situation, Xian Xianqin was much calmer because Zhang Fei was by her side, and she was confident that he would be able to lead them out of the room. "What kind of test do you think we will face now?"

"I don't know." Zhang Fei then proceeded towards the dressing table, carefully examining all the furniture. "If my guess is correct, this room belongs to the woman in the previous statue. However, I am unable to sense her presence here, leading me to believe that she or someone else has purposefully locked us here. Anyway, you guys can rest to recover your stamina if you want, and I will look after you two."

Since she couldn't find a way out of the room, Yun Xinyue immediately lay down on the bed again and closed her eyes. Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin immediately sat down beside Zhang Fei, who was already sitting in front of the dressing table, and rested her head on his shoulder. "Do you know anything about the Immortal Soul Palace?"
