{You learned the Soul Light Purification Ability.}
{1,000,000 beast essences have been deducted from your balance.}
'What... what are those creatures?' Yun Xinyue stammered as she peered at the vengeful souls that had already materialized.
Xian Xianqin was equally shocked by their appearance. 'Are they human souls?'

'I don't know how they got trapped here and turned into vengeful souls, but I'm sure they are the souls of the owners of the skeletons in this place.' As both women focused their attention on those souls, Zhang Fei suddenly enveloped them with his light element, bolstered by his light law.
In that instant, those vengeful souls scattered around as they were terrified of Zhang Fei's light element, and none of them dared to approach them.
'Don't leave my light element, or they will attack both of you.' Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately held Zhang Fei back by hugging him tightly. 'It's okay.
They won't dare attack me, so you two don't need to worry about me.'
'What exactly are you going to do with them?'

'I want to find out the reason behind their situation before making my next move against them, and I have to purify one of them to find out the answer.' Zhang Fei immediately moved their hands from his body and searched for the weakest vengeful soul.
After he found it, he immediately teleported in front of it, leaving Yun Xinyue stunned by his instant movement.
Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin had already seen Zhang Fei teleport when he fought Huan Ya, so she was no longer surprised by it.
Zhang Fei showed up in front of a vengeful soul, but it vanished as he was about to capture it, forcing him to switch targets.
However, his next target also disappeared, along with the others, which annoyed him.
The vengeful souls were eager to attack Zhang Fei, but the three light shields circling his body prevented them from attacking him.
He then released more of his light qi and pointed his right palm upwards, and a bright white light shot out from it, which immediately spread out and formed a formation, illuminating the place.
The vengeful souls scattered away from Zhang Fei after they saw that, and the two women stood dumbfounded in their spots as their eyes focused on the light formation.
[Do you intend to kill them, master?
Wouldn't that be a big loss for you?]
'Hey!

Naturally, I won't kill them, and I just want to scare them.' Zhang Fei immediately activated the exorcismus ability, and countless rays of light rained down on the area below him, brightening the whole area.
Zhang Fei could clearly see the vengeful souls, and he immediately moved towards one of them before grabbing its neck, causing it to struggle free.
However, he immediately activated the soul light purification ability, causing the evil aura to disappear and gradually transform into its former self, a middle-aged man with a cut on his right eye.
Zhang Fei immediately brought the middle-aged man's soul to the two women's side.
"Who exactly are you all?
How did you guys get trapped here and turn into vengeful souls?"
"Young master, I don't know how you managed to cleanse my soul, but I hope you kill me now.
All of us have lost track of how long we've been trapped in this place, and we eventually died here; even our souls continue to wander here." Zhang Fei and the two women frowned upon hearing that.
"Honestly, we are evil people in our realm, and we have committed many heinous crimes there, so the people from the Immortal Soul Palace locked us up in this place."
"The Immortal Soul Palace?" Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue were confused after hearing that name, especially since they had never heard of that sect in the middle realms.
Zhang Fei immediately asked.
"Is that sect located in the upper realms?"
"No." The middle-aged man's soul shook his head.
"Our realm is in the-"
*Swoosh*
Before the middle-aged man's soul could answer Zhang Fei's question, a light pillar suddenly appeared out of nowhere and obliterated his soul, causing him and the two women to frown.

Unlike Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, Zhang Fei could immediately guess the location of the Immortal Soul Palace, especially since Feng Yao had told him that there was another realm beyond the upper realms.
Zhang Fei then looked up with a serious face. 'So that little girl and her master came from that realm, huh?
What is their purpose in sending the Star Tower to the Nine Stars Realm?
Are they just trying to test us, or do they have another goal?'
"Zhang Fei!
What are you going to do with the other vengeful souls?" Xian Xianqin asked.
Yun Xinyue also spoke to him.
"Apparently, we have to get rid of them to open the stone, or else we can't go elsewhere."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he continued watching above with a serious gaze. 'Since you guys don't want us to know information about your background, I will use other means to obtain that information.'
Zhang Fei then floated to the center of the room and locked all those vengeful souls with his aura, leaving the two women wondering about his plans for them.
After his senses locked onto them all, he immediately teleported in front of each of them, and he swiftly used the demon-absorbing ability to suck them into his body.
"Zhang Fei!
Stop it!
Don't absorb them!
Their evil nature will affect you!" Yun Xinyue, who was still unaware of his demon identity, immediately yelled at him as soon as he did that to those vengeful souls.
"Don't stop him, Xinyue." Yun Xinyue turned to Xian Xianqin with a frown.
"I know you're worried about him, but he'll be fine because he still has another identity."
"Another identity?"
Xian Xianqin nodded to her.
"I've known about it for a long time, but I couldn't tell you because I promised him.
You can ask him yourself if you want to know about it."
Yun Xinyue said nothing and looked at Zhang Fei, who was still busy absorbing the remaining vengeful souls.
She was worried that they would influence him, but she could see that nothing had changed in him, so she could feel relieved.
Sometime later, Zhang Fei had finished absorbing all the vengeful souls in that place, and a notification immediately appeared in his mind.
[The host soul level has increased to the perfection stage of the soul core level.]
"Phew." Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief before checking his soul, and he smiled in satisfaction at the breakthrough in his soul power.
He then landed in front of the two women and dispelled the light element that enveloped them, but Yun Xinyue immediately groped around his body and looked at him seriously.
"Do you realize that your behavior resembles that of a wife?"
"Huh?" Momentarily stunned, Yun Xinyue blushed and withdrew her hands.
"Do you really not feel any change after absorbing so many vengeful souls?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at her.
"Instead, my soul power broke through one minor stage after I absorbed them, and I might be able to break through to the next major stage faster."
"Phew." Yun Xinyue expressed her relief by patting her chest.
"I'm really afraid that their evil nature will influence you, and you will become evil like them."
Zhang Fei smiled at that.
"Why are you so worried?
Are you in love with me?"
Upon hearing that, Xian Xianqin immediately massaged her forehead and sighed helplessly at Zhang Fei's playboy attitude. 'This guy is a womanizer!
Our relationship is still in the early stages, but he is already trying to seduce Xinyue before my eyes.'
"No!" Yun Xinyue denied it by shaking her head, but the blush on her cheeks made Zhang Fei certain of his guess.
"You were my savior after you saved me from Bai Shouyi's poison, so I don't want anything bad to happen to you."
"You've seen that I haven't changed, so you don't need to worry anymore, right?" Zhang Fei then pointed toward the exit.
"The exit is open now, so we should go to the next area."
"Let's go." Yun Xinyue immediately ran towards the exit as she pondered in her heart. 'Ugh!
Why does my heart race when he asks that?
Am I truly in love with him?'
"Are you interested in XInyuye?" Zhang Fei turned to Xian Xianqin, neither confirming nor denying her question, which caused her to sigh.
"Let's follow her, or she'll be in danger."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei immediately took Xian Xianqin's hand and led her out of the place to catch up with Yun Xinyue, after which the three of them rushed into the next room.
Not long after they left, the old man and Hua Mei'er appeared in the room, and their expressions looked strange seeing the empty room.
"Master, I know that he has a demon form, but his ability to absorb those vengeful souls is truly terrifying.
Despite having fought numerous demons myself, I have never witnessed such a technique before, and he wasn't unaffected by them."
The old man nodded in agreement with her.
"I don't know where he got that technique from, but it is probably a sub-technique of an ancient demon technique.
Those vengeful souls might not affect him, but he should refrain from continuously using that technique to boost his soul power.
If he continues to use it, he will sooner or later fall into the heretic path, and he might become the most terrifying demon."
"The most terrifying demon?
Do you think he can surpass those ancient demons?" Hua Mei'er doubtfully asked.
The old man shook his head.
"I can't say for sure, but it's possible."
Hua Mei'er then turned to her master.
"Are you sure this won't be a problem, Master?
This route is the most dangerous among the routes in this maze, and our leaders have vehemently warned all the tower watchers not to open this route.
They even threatened to punish those who violated it severely, but you insisted on opening it to test that annoying kid.
Moreover, the usual challenges are already difficult for people in this realm to overcome, and most of them have failed repeatedly, but you have actually increased the difficulty.
Anyway, their next destination would be even more difficult, and the two women by his side would probably go crazy."
"You don't need to think about the punishment, and I will bear it myself if they find out about this.
If those people are unable to reach the tenth floor, then they are not worthy of joining us, and I will relocate the tower to another realm." The old man then grabbed Hua Mei'er's shoulder.
"Let's go back."
Upon reaching the next room, Zhang Fei and the two women immediately frowned, realizing there was no way out.
They saw a statue of a woman in the middle of the room, so they immediately approached it and examined it.
"Do you think this woman is part of the Immortal Soul Palace?"
"Maybe." Zhang Fei then felt the statue to find a way out of the room, but he found nothing on the statue of the woman.
"Let's check these walls."
They immediately divided the task of inspecting the three walls in the room, carefully checking each side separately.
After they searched for some time, Xian Xianqin suddenly found a strange part on the wall, and she immediately pushed it in.
*Click*
*Rumble...
Rumble...*
They immediately turned to the statue of a woman in the center of the room, and it quickly shifted back, exposing a spiral staircase leading down to the lower area.
"Let's go." Zhang Fei immediately ran towards the stairs, and the two women right away followed behind him.
However, the room was much darker, so he enveloped their bodies in his light elements to illuminate their path.
"Brr." Yun Xinyue shivered as the cold wind passed through them from below, and it gave her a terrible feeling.
"Guys, I feel like our next destination will be worse than the previous two rooms, and we might meet even more terrifying creatures."
Xian Xianqin shook her head in response.
"Xinyue, we are cultivators, so you must brave yourself to face this kind of situation.
Otherwise, you will never be able to be independent, and your family must protect you for the rest of your life."
"I'm not afraid of facing other cultivators or beasts, but creatures like those vengeful souls are really scary." Yun Xinyue protested as she pouted her lips.
Zhang Fei laughed at Yun Xinyue's antics.
"All right, you don't have to lecture him, Princess Xianqin.
Even though we are cultivators, we have some fear in our hearts about something; even I have my own fears."
"What are you afraid of?" Both women asked in curious manners.
"I won't tell you two about that." Both women looked annoyed by Zhang Fei's answer.
Yun Xinyue then asked him.
"Xianqin said that you have another identity.
Can you tell me about it?"

"You better not know about it, or you will be afraid of me, especially since my last identity is scary to some people." Zhang Fei's response caused Yun Xinyue to frown and turn towards the Xian princess, but Xian Xianqin shook her head, refusing to divulge the information.
After they had walked down for quite some time, they suddenly saw a faint light from below, so they immediately increased their vigilance.
Cautiously, they walked towards the lower area, but once they arrived, they became confused.
The room ahead was filled with furniture, leading them to conclude that it was a woman's room due to the red and pink decoration.
Moreover, they had never seen such furniture before, including Zhang Fei, who came from the modern Earth.
Without hesitation, Yun Xinyue entered the room and laid down on the bed, causing both him and Xian Xianqin to let out helpless sighs.
As soon as the three of them entered the room, the entrance immediately disappeared by itself, causing Yun Xinyue to panic.
The Yun princess immediately jumped down from the bed and moved towards the entrance, but there was only a wall in front of her.
"Tch!
I knew we would be trapped like this again!"
Although she was also panicking about their situation, Xian Xianqin was much calmer because Zhang Fei was by her side, and she was confident that he would be able to lead them out of the room.
"What kind of test do you think we will face now?"
"I don't know." Zhang Fei then proceeded towards the dressing table, carefully examining all the furniture.
"If my guess is correct, this room belongs to the woman in the previous statue.
However, I am unable to sense her presence here, leading me to believe that she or someone else has purposefully locked us here.
Anyway, you guys can rest to recover your stamina if you want, and I will look after you two."
Since she couldn't find a way out of the room, Yun Xinyue immediately lay down on the bed again and closed her eyes.
Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin immediately sat down beside Zhang Fei, who was already sitting in front of the dressing table, and rested her head on his shoulder.
"Do you know anything about the Immortal Soul Palace?"

chapters.title: Chapter 565 Other Groups Situation
paragraphs: "Honestly, I've never heard of the Immortal Soul Palace, and your reactions earlier showed that you guys don't know about it either." Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei. "According to my guess, this Star Tower and that sect are not from the upper realms, but they come from the realms beyond the upper realms."
"The realms beyond the upper realms?" Zhang Fei then told Xian Xianqin about his previous conversation with Feng Yao. "Do those realms truly exist?"

"That's just Feng Yao's parents' guess, and they still don't have clear information about the existence of those realms, especially since their flying artifacts can't go beyond the upper realms." Zhang Fei then embraced Xian Xianqin. "Since we don't have any information about those realms, we don't need to think too much about it, and we can better focus on completing this maze challenge."

"Yeah, you're right. We don't need to think about things that are out of our reach and focus on the problems in front of us." Xian Xianqin was taken aback when Zhang Fei unexpectedly carried her in a princess carry, prompting her to embrace his neck. "What do you want to do?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei then carried her to the bed and laid her beside Yun Xinyue, who had already fallen asleep. "Get some rest, and I'll cultivate on the chair."

Xian Xianqin smiled in response, and she immediately closed her eyes to rest her mind. Zhang Fei then sat on the sofa and closed his eyes, but he was not really cultivating, and he thought of the little girl who appeared in the previous heart challenge demonstration.

Xian Xianwu was fortunate to have his paternal aunt by his side, which made it easier for him to deal with the beasts that blocked their path, and Xian Changyue handled them with ease. However, his expression was still tense as they still hadn't managed to find Xian Xianqin and Zhang Fei, but they had no choice but to keep moving forward.

Soon, they arrived at the next room, but there was only a portal inside, so they entered it directly. In the next moment, they arrived at a garden brimming with a variety of colorful flowers. However, Xian Changyue immediately sensed something strange and right away covered her nose with qi. She then tried to warn her nephew, but she was a second too late because Xian Xianwu's eyes had gone blank, and he immediately pounced on her as if he was under control.
Xian Changyue released a soft sigh, knocked her nephew unconscious, and shouldered him. She then observed several flowers in the garden, which she immediately recognized.

"This is really bad! Xuanwu is exposed to the effects of the Soulweaver Orchid and Scarlet Peony, and I don't have an antidote to relieve the effects of either of them." Xian Changyue quickly carried her nephew to a large flat rock, where she sat him down. She hurriedly sat behind him, pressing both her palms against his back before channeling her qi. "I don't know if my Qi can relieve the effects, but I have to try."

"Hah... Hah... Hah..." Yuan Luo breathed heavily as she leaned against one of the tree walls, gazing at the numerous beast corpses a short distance away from her. "Brother Chui, this maze is really weird. We have passed four areas, but we have always encountered a lot of beasts. Usually, they only appear in the inner area, and we are still in the outer area now. If this continues, we will not be able to clear it. Even if we manage to pass it, our usable items will not be enough for the survival challenge."

Ximen Chuixue immediately agreed with that. "For decades, every time we challenge this tower, the challenges have always been the same. However, this maze challenge has suddenly changed, leading me to believe that someone intentionally set it up to make things difficult for us."
"Why do you think like that?" Ru Yanyue asked as she circulated her breathing, especially since their previous fights drained her energy.

"That's just my feeling, and I don't know the truth." Ximen Chuixue then glanced at Ying Shanhu, who had fallen asleep on the ground. "You guys can rest first, and I will remain on guard to protect the three of you."
"Yeah." Both women immediately closed their eyes, but they did not dare to sleep completely because their enemies could find them at any time.

In another area, Bai Renfu still hadn't moved from his spot, and his appearance was already that of a frustrated person, especially since he still hadn't managed to solve the puzzle in front of him. "Damn it! If Shouyi were with me now, I definitely wouldn't be in trouble like this. I wouldn't be able to save her if I remained stuck here."

Bai Chongxi also appeared frustrated, as he encountered numerous beasts on every path he chose, forcing him to seek refuge in a gap in one of the tree walls. He couldn't possibly face all of them by himself, so he was forced to run away and hide from them. "Thank goodness they couldn't leave their rooms, or else they would have ganged up on me and killed me. Moreover, I couldn't give up this challenge because I didn't know where Renfu and Shouyi were, so I had to find them as soon as possible."

Unlike her two brothers, Bai Shouyi's situation was much better, even though she fell into the hands of the two demons from the Ximen Demon Kingdom. Despite encountering numerous beasts, Bai Shouyi didn't need to expend her energy fighting them, as Ximen Yan had instructed Qian Ying to fight them alone. 'As I recall, she used to be a close friend of Xian Xianqin, but she has now transformed into a demon, and she is completely obedient to this despicable man. Sigh! I want to give up on this challenge, but I'm concerned about Big Brother and Brother Renfu's condition, so I'm not willing to save myself and leave them here.'
*Boom*

The explosion wakes Bai Shouyi from her thoughts, and she sees that Qian Ying has already killed the last beast. Her eyes lit up when she saw some crystals on top of the beasts' corpses, but the female demon immediately took them and handed them to Ximen Yan.

To Bai Shouyi's surprise, Ximen Yan threw a purple crystal at her, which was a poison elemental crystal. "Hey! What about my previous offer? If you surrender yourself to me, I can make you as strong as Qian Ying, and your family will no longer have to be Huangfu Shou's lapdog."
"Keep dreaming!" Bai Shouyi shouted and threw the crystal back at Ximen Yan. "I will never give myself to a demon like you!"
"Heh!" Ximen Yan immediately put away the crystal and pulled Qian Ying into his lap. "Will you still be able to fight if we meet other beasts?"
"Please forgive me, Master. I have been fighting for too long, and my qi is greatly drained, so please allow me to rest for some time."
"I see." Ximen Yan nodded in understanding and lowered Qian Ying from his lap. "All right, you can rest first, and I'll check the next room."

Not long after, Ximen Yan arrived at the next room, which was not far from their resting place. Since he didn't see any beasts inside, he immediately entered it, but the floor beneath him disappeared as soon as he arrived in the middle. "Fuck! Qian Ying!"
Upon hearing that, Qian Ying and Bai Shouyi immediately rushed towards the room, but it was too late, as Ximen Yan had already fallen inside.
Bai Shouyi wanted to escape from there, but Qian Ying swiftly grabbed her shoulder and pulled her into the hole, causing her to scream hysterically. "Argh! You're going to kill me!"
*Splash... Splash...*

Fortunately, the area below them was a lake, and they fell straight into it, drenching their bodies. Qian Ying immediately swam to the surface to look for Ximen Yan, but she didn't find him there. "Shit! Where did my master go?"
"Puahh!" Bai Shouyi had just surfaced, but Qian Ying had already grabbed her hand and guided her to jump out of the lake. "Where is your master?"
However, two large tongues suddenly shot towards them and wrapped around their bodies, one each. They immediately pulled both women in opposite directions.
Qian Ying immediately reacted by cutting off the tongue, but it right away grew back and coiled around her body again, and the coil was tighter than before.

Bai Shouyi immediately took out her dagger, enveloped it with her poison qi, and stabbed it into the tongue that was wrapping around her body. However, it didn't budge and pulled her until she disappeared into the tree wall, as did Qian Ying, who was pulled into the opposite tree wall by another tongue.
The two tongues pulled them into two different slippery pockets filled with thick fluid, causing their consciousness to fade quickly before finally losing it completely.
Countless ice flowers quickly filled a room, causing the air temperature to drop, and several beasts there swiftly froze. "Shatter!"
*Crack... Crack...*

The ice immediately shattered into pieces along with the beasts inside, but the woman who used the technique fell to one knee. Her face was extremely pale, and her breathing was irregular. "Hah... Hah... I don't want to use this technique, but these beasts are really endless."
"Swallow this pill, Zhiqiu." Bai Tian said this as she handed a pill to Ye Zhiqiu with one hand and then swallowed a similar pill herself.

"Thank you." Ye Zhiqiu immediately accepted the pill, sat cross-legged on the ground, and swallowed it. "The changes in this maze are far beyond our expectations, and I'm not sure if we will make it through."

Bai Tian'er immediately sat next to Ye Zhiqiu, stretched her right hand forward, and sucked the two elemental crystals in front into her hand before storing them away. "Somehow, I feel that the change in this maze challenge has something to do with Zhang Fei, especially since his abilities are too absurd. He was able to light up ten crystals in the strength test, and he managed to defeat Zhou Fang in the battle challenge, which no other cultivator at his level would ever be able to do."

"I have the same thoughts as you, but we can't do anything, and we can only try our best to get through everything." Ye Zhiqiu then looked towards the exit ahead of them. "I think we should take a rest first, or we'll be overwhelmed if we encounter a large group of beasts again."
"Yeah." Bai Tian'er replied with a soft sigh. "All the beasts from before were too many, and there are only two of us here, so we shouldn't overexert ourselves."

The four royal members of the Huangfu Kingdom encountered no major difficulties, as their cultivation had already reached the seven divine realms. Even so, Huangfu Lian continued to put on an annoyed expression because those beasts had wasted a lot of his time, and they had also gotten lost in dead-end rooms several times, forcing them to turn back several times.

"Big Brother, I know you're upset, but we should rest now." Huangfu Lian immediately frowned at Huangfu Xiaofan, who pointed at their two sisters. "The two of us are not tired, but Xiaomei and Xiaoying are too tired now, and we can't possibly fight those beasts while carrying them on our backs. Furthermore, I'm certain that the other participants are facing similar challenges, so there's no need for haste."
Huangfu Lian nodded in agreement. "All right, we will rest first, and we will immediately continue our journey once they recover."

Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang sat relaxing at the edge of the room, and they watched their demon summons kill the beasts that blocked their way. "Brother, I'm growing tired of encountering these beasts in every room we pass, so I want to capture Xian Xianwu and Zhang Fei soon."

"Do you think I don't get tired of seeing them all the time?" Ximen Hongwu asked with a shake of his head. "I don't know what's going on here, but I feel like this maze has grown wider, the number of traps inside has also increased, and even the number of beasts is much greater than last time."
Ximen Yueliang pouted her lips and rested her head on Ximen Hongwu's shoulder. "I think we'll spend a month or more in this maze."
"Yeah." Ximen Hongwu replied with a slight nod. "That's why you should be patient and stop grumbling; I will definitely help you to capture them."

In another area, Zhou Tai had difficulty keeping up with his big brother's movements because Zhou Tong kept moving in a hurry because he was worried about their sister's fate, and his qi was rapidly depleting just to keep up with him.
*Bam*

Zhou Tai finally collapsed on the ground, causing Zhou Tong to frown. He immediately let out a soft sigh, went over to his brother, and helped him swallow the pill. "Sorry, I was too worried about Meiling."
"It's okay, Big Brother. I'm also worried about Meiling, but I really can't keep up with your movements, and I need to rest first." After he said that, Zhou Tai immediately closed his eyes.
Zhou Tong immediately brought him to the side and sat down beside him, but his mind was still occupied with Zhou Meiling. "Sigh! I hope she's okay."

Meanwhile, Zhou Meiling finally managed to leave the hole after struggling for so long, but she felt her whole body stiff. Her qi was severely depleted due to the depth of the hole, and she frequently fell due to the slippery walls. Hence, she immediately swallowed some pills to recover from her condition. "Where am I now? This place is not the place where I was separated from my two brothers, and I'm sure this is another area."

After she had rested for some time and her condition was much better, Zhou Meiling immediately stood up and hurried to another room. However, her head became heavy, and her eyes became blurry, causing her to collapse on the ground again.

As soon as Zhou Meiling lost consciousness, the ground beneath her suddenly split open and sucked her in. In the next second, she was transported to another area, where a woman with long purple hair and a transparent body was waiting for her.

"This little girl's face is not bad, and her physique is also quite strong, so I will possess her and take over her body for the time being." After the woman turned into purple smoke and entered her body, Zhou Meiling immediately opened her eyes and stood up. "This way, I can leave this room, and I might be able to leave this tower to live freely once again. After leaving this tower, I will reform my body, and I will kill her afterward."

Zhou Meiling then proceeded to another area, where she encountered a group of beasts. Immediately, a purple smoke emanated from her body, sucking their life force. "Hahaha! I'm lucky to have found this woman, and I'll use her to absorb the life and soul forces of all living creatures in this tower."

In some other areas, the groups from all the kingdoms were experiencing their own difficulties. The two groups from the Xian Imperial Sect and one group from the Yun Imperial Sect faced not only beasts and traps but also other groups, particularly those from the two demon kingdoms. The battle between them was inevitable, which drained their physical and energy.

The group from the kingdom of beasts and natural races was the luckiest among all the participants; with Long Chen and Long Tian on their side, they didn't need to exert any effort to defeat the beasts, especially since all of them directly cowered in fear before their overbearing dragon auras.

This way, they can make their journey to explore the areas of the maze at a leisurely pace, and they only need to avoid the traps that have been prepared to hinder them. However, some of them ended up separated from their group after they were caught in a trap, but it wasn't a big deal for them, and they continued walking forward.

"I don't know if my Qi can relieve the effects, but I have to try."
"Hah...
Hah...
Hah..." Yuan Luo breathed heavily as she leaned against one of the tree walls, gazing at the numerous beast corpses a short distance away from her.
"Brother Chui, this maze is really weird.
We have passed four areas, but we have always encountered a lot of beasts.
Usually, they only appear in the inner area, and we are still in the outer area now.
If this continues, we will not be able to clear it.
Even if we manage to pass it, our usable items will not be enough for the survival challenge."
Ximen Chuixue immediately agreed with that.
"For decades, every time we challenge this tower, the challenges have always been the same.
However, this maze challenge has suddenly changed, leading me to believe that someone intentionally set it up to make things difficult for us."
"Why do you think like that?" Ru Yanyue asked as she circulated her breathing, especially since their previous fights drained her energy.
"That's just my feeling, and I don't know the truth." Ximen Chuixue then glanced at Ying Shanhu, who had fallen asleep on the ground.
"You guys can rest first, and I will remain on guard to protect the three of you."
"Yeah." Both women immediately closed their eyes, but they did not dare to sleep completely because their enemies could find them at any time.
In another area, Bai Renfu still hadn't moved from his spot, and his appearance was already that of a frustrated person, especially since he still hadn't managed to solve the puzzle in front of him.
"Damn it!
If Shouyi were with me now, I definitely wouldn't be in trouble like this.
I wouldn't be able to save her if I remained stuck here."
Bai Chongxi also appeared frustrated, as he encountered numerous beasts on every path he chose, forcing him to seek refuge in a gap in one of the tree walls.
He couldn't possibly face all of them by himself, so he was forced to run away and hide from them.
"Thank goodness they couldn't leave their rooms, or else they would have ganged up on me and killed me.
Moreover, I couldn't give up this challenge because I didn't know where Renfu and Shouyi were, so I had to find them as soon as possible."
Unlike her two brothers, Bai Shouyi's situation was much better, even though she fell into the hands of the two demons from the Ximen Demon Kingdom.

Despite encountering numerous beasts, Bai Shouyi didn't need to expend her energy fighting them, as Ximen Yan had instructed Qian Ying to fight them alone. 'As I recall, she used to be a close friend of Xian Xianqin, but she has now transformed into a demon, and she is completely obedient to this despicable man.
Sigh!
I want to give up on this challenge, but I'm concerned about Big Brother and Brother Renfu's condition, so I'm not willing to save myself and leave them here.'
*Boom*
The explosion wakes Bai Shouyi from her thoughts, and she sees that Qian Ying has already killed the last beast.
Her eyes lit up when she saw some crystals on top of the beasts' corpses, but the female demon immediately took them and handed them to Ximen Yan.
To Bai Shouyi's surprise, Ximen Yan threw a purple crystal at her, which was a poison elemental crystal.
"Hey!
What about my previous offer?
If you surrender yourself to me, I can make you as strong as Qian Ying, and your family will no longer have to be Huangfu Shou's lapdog."
"Keep dreaming!" Bai Shouyi shouted and threw the crystal back at Ximen Yan.
"I will never give myself to a demon like you!"
"Heh!" Ximen Yan immediately put away the crystal and pulled Qian Ying into his lap.
"Will you still be able to fight if we meet other beasts?"
"Please forgive me, Master.
I have been fighting for too long, and my qi is greatly drained, so please allow me to rest for some time."
"I see." Ximen Yan nodded in understanding and lowered Qian Ying from his lap.
"All right, you can rest first, and I'll check the next room."
Not long after, Ximen Yan arrived at the next room, which was not far from their resting place.
Since he didn't see any beasts inside, he immediately entered it, but the floor beneath him disappeared as soon as he arrived in the middle.
"Fuck!
Qian Ying!"
Upon hearing that, Qian Ying and Bai Shouyi immediately rushed towards the room, but it was too late, as Ximen Yan had already fallen inside.
Bai Shouyi wanted to escape from there, but Qian Ying swiftly grabbed her shoulder and pulled her into the hole, causing her to scream hysterically.
"Argh!
You're going to kill me!"
*Splash...
Splash...*
Fortunately, the area below them was a lake, and they fell straight into it, drenching their bodies.
Qian Ying immediately swam to the surface to look for Ximen Yan, but she didn't find him there.
"Shit!
Where did my master go?"
"Puahh!" Bai Shouyi had just surfaced, but Qian Ying had already grabbed her hand and guided her to jump out of the lake.
"Where is your master?"
However, two large tongues suddenly shot towards them and wrapped around their bodies, one each.
They immediately pulled both women in opposite directions.
Qian Ying immediately reacted by cutting off the tongue, but it right away grew back and coiled around her body again, and the coil was tighter than before.
Bai Shouyi immediately took out her dagger, enveloped it with her poison qi, and stabbed it into the tongue that was wrapping around her body.
However, it didn't budge and pulled her until she disappeared into the tree wall, as did Qian Ying, who was pulled into the opposite tree wall by another tongue.
The two tongues pulled them into two different slippery pockets filled with thick fluid, causing their consciousness to fade quickly before finally losing it completely.
Countless ice flowers quickly filled a room, causing the air temperature to drop, and several beasts there swiftly froze.
"Shatter!"
*Crack...
Crack...*
The ice immediately shattered into pieces along with the beasts inside, but the woman who used the technique fell to one knee.
Her face was extremely pale, and her breathing was irregular.
"Hah...
Hah...
I don't want to use this technique, but these beasts are really endless."
"Swallow this pill, Zhiqiu." Bai Tian said this as she handed a pill to Ye Zhiqiu with one hand and then swallowed a similar pill herself.
"Thank you." Ye Zhiqiu immediately accepted the pill, sat cross-legged on the ground, and swallowed it.
"The changes in this maze are far beyond our expectations, and I'm not sure if we will make it through."
Bai Tian'er immediately sat next to Ye Zhiqiu, stretched her right hand forward, and sucked the two elemental crystals in front into her hand before storing them away.
"Somehow, I feel that the change in this maze challenge has something to do with Zhang Fei, especially since his abilities are too absurd.
He was able to light up ten crystals in the strength test, and he managed to defeat Zhou Fang in the battle challenge, which no other cultivator at his level would ever be able to do."
"I have the same thoughts as you, but we can't do anything, and we can only try our best to get through everything." Ye Zhiqiu then looked towards the exit ahead of them.
"I think we should take a rest first, or we'll be overwhelmed if we encounter a large group of beasts again."
"Yeah." Bai Tian'er replied with a soft sigh.
"All the beasts from before were too many, and there are only two of us here, so we shouldn't overexert ourselves."
The four royal members of the Huangfu Kingdom encountered no major difficulties, as their cultivation had already reached the seven divine realms.

Even so, Huangfu Lian continued to put on an annoyed expression because those beasts had wasted a lot of his time, and they had also gotten lost in dead-end rooms several times, forcing them to turn back several times.
"Big Brother, I know you're upset, but we should rest now." Huangfu Lian immediately frowned at Huangfu Xiaofan, who pointed at their two sisters.
"The two of us are not tired, but Xiaomei and Xiaoying are too tired now, and we can't possibly fight those beasts while carrying them on our backs.
Furthermore, I'm certain that the other participants are facing similar challenges, so there's no need for haste."
Huangfu Lian nodded in agreement.
"All right, we will rest first, and we will immediately continue our journey once they recover."
Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang sat relaxing at the edge of the room, and they watched their demon summons kill the beasts that blocked their way.
"Brother, I'm growing tired of encountering these beasts in every room we pass, so I want to capture Xian Xianwu and Zhang Fei soon."
"Do you think I don't get tired of seeing them all the time?" Ximen Hongwu asked with a shake of his head.
"I don't know what's going on here, but I feel like this maze has grown wider, the number of traps inside has also increased, and even the number of beasts is much greater than last time."
Ximen Yueliang pouted her lips and rested her head on Ximen Hongwu's shoulder.
"I think we'll spend a month or more in this maze."
"Yeah." Ximen Hongwu replied with a slight nod.
"That's why you should be patient and stop grumbling; I will definitely help you to capture them."

In another area, Zhou Tai had difficulty keeping up with his big brother's movements because Zhou Tong kept moving in a hurry because he was worried about their sister's fate, and his qi was rapidly depleting just to keep up with him.
*Bam*
Zhou Tai finally collapsed on the ground, causing Zhou Tong to frown.
He immediately let out a soft sigh, went over to his brother, and helped him swallow the pill.
"Sorry, I was too worried about Meiling."
"It's okay, Big Brother.
I'm also worried about Meiling, but I really can't keep up with your movements, and I need to rest first." After he said that, Zhou Tai immediately closed his eyes.
Zhou Tong immediately brought him to the side and sat down beside him, but his mind was still occupied with Zhou Meiling.
"Sigh!
I hope she's okay."
Meanwhile, Zhou Meiling finally managed to leave the hole after struggling for so long, but she felt her whole body stiff.
Her qi was severely depleted due to the depth of the hole, and she frequently fell due to the slippery walls.
Hence, she immediately swallowed some pills to recover from her condition.
"Where am I now?
This place is not the place where I was separated from my two brothers, and I'm sure this is another area."
After she had rested for some time and her condition was much better, Zhou Meiling immediately stood up and hurried to another room.
However, her head became heavy, and her eyes became blurry, causing her to collapse on the ground again.
As soon as Zhou Meiling lost consciousness, the ground beneath her suddenly split open and sucked her in.
In the next second, she was transported to another area, where a woman with long purple hair and a transparent body was waiting for her.

"This little girl's face is not bad, and her physique is also quite strong, so I will possess her and take over her body for the time being." After the woman turned into purple smoke and entered her body, Zhou Meiling immediately opened her eyes and stood up.
"This way, I can leave this room, and I might be able to leave this tower to live freely once again.
After leaving this tower, I will reform my body, and I will kill her afterward."
Zhou Meiling then proceeded to another area, where she encountered a group of beasts.
Immediately, a purple smoke emanated from her body, sucking their life force.
"Hahaha!
I'm lucky to have found this woman, and I'll use her to absorb the life and soul forces of all living creatures in this tower."
In some other areas, the groups from all the kingdoms were experiencing their own difficulties.
The two groups from the Xian Imperial Sect and one group from the Yun Imperial Sect faced not only beasts and traps but also other groups, particularly those from the two demon kingdoms.
The battle between them was inevitable, which drained their physical and energy.

The group from the kingdom of beasts and natural races was the luckiest among all the participants; with Long Chen and Long Tian on their side, they didn't need to exert any effort to defeat the beasts, especially since all of them directly cowered in fear before their overbearing dragon auras.
This way, they can make their journey to explore the areas of the maze at a leisurely pace, and they only need to avoid the traps that have been prepared to hinder them.
However, some of them ended up separated from their group after they were caught in a trap, but it wasn't a big deal for them, and they continued walking forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 A Mysterious Figure
paragraphs: Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, who were talking in their garden, were surprised by the appearance of two people. "Is she one of your wives, Zhang Fei? Does the Alchemy Union's decision to withdraw from our kingdom have anything to do with you?"

"The woman next to me is one of my wives, Zhang Lingxue. I didn't ask my friend to take care of that matter, and I only told her about my problems with them. The two of them have been good friends for a long time, so she sent people from her clan to pressure them because of their relationship." Zhang Fei [1]'s revelation shocked Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, as the Alchemy Union was powerful and influential, and no one had ever dared to pressure them before. However, his friend was able to pressure them until they retreated, which meant his status was higher than theirs. "Since they have decided to withdraw from this kingdom and their shop is now vacant, I plan to use it as my new shop. However, I will not only sell alchemy items; I will also sell a variety of other items, some of which may attract the attention of many people."
"Is one of those items the mattress you gave our daughter before?" Shi Qingzhuang inquired.

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in response. "The mattress is just one of them; there will be many more items later. Once I open my shop, I expect this capital to become even more bustling, drawing people from various kingdoms. Therefore, I'm here to inform you so you can take precautions."

Both of them nodded in understanding. "You can begin setting up your shop in Old Lian's former shop, and I will dispatch some personnel to assist you there. As for the prospective buyers, my people will handle them, so you don't have to worry about them."

"In that case, I will go to buy some materials, especially since I have to renovate the building before opening my shop." Zhang Fei [1] immediately took Zhang Lingxue away from the Xian royal palace, and they rushed toward the market district to buy materials.

Xian Feng immediately contacted Yang Caojing and asked him to wait for Zhang Fei [1] at the shop. "I think our kingdom will undergo a major change soon, and I'm sure his items will sell well in this realm."

"That's true." Shi Qingzhuang replied with a nod of approval. "I've tried the mattress in our daughter's room, and it's really comfortable for sleeping. Since he's going to sell it here, I'll buy some for us."

"Haha." Xian Feng laughed before rising to his feet. "Do you want to join me? Yao Yin will break through to the quasi-divine realm today, so I want to meet Brother Yao and Sister Mu to discuss our son's relationship with her."
"Xuanwu and Yin'er have loved each other for a long time, so it's time for us to formalize their relationship." Shi Qingzhuang immediately followed her husband.

When Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang arrived at the Yao Clan residence, the butler immediately guided them to the backmost building, where a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman were eagerly anticipating their daughter's breakthrough.

"Hahaha." The two people turned their heads back after hearing the laughter, and they wanted to pay their respects to their guests, but Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang stopped them. "Brother Yao Qihu and Sister Mu Hongyin, we will be in-laws soon, so you two don't need to be so formal with us."

Shi Qingzhuang immediately spoke to them. "Yin'er and Xianwu have been in a relationship for a long time, and they love each other very much. Unfortunately, their relationship has always been delayed because she wants to break through to the quasi-divine realm first, and she will break through today, so we came here to propose to her."

"I myself have been looking forward to their wedding for a long time, but Yin'er is too stubborn." Mu Hongyin expressed this sentiment with a heavy sigh. "Fortunately, our wait will end today, and we will discuss their marriage with her once she has finished breaking through."
Yao Qihu then asked. "What about Xianwu and Xianqin?"

"They are currently facing the maze challenge, but there has been a significant change in it." Yao Qihu and Mu Hongyin looked confused by that, so Xian Feng explained the changes to them. "I don't know what happened there, but I think the challenges there will be more difficult than usual, so they won't be able to come back anytime soon, and we'll have to wait a little longer for our children's wedding."

They suddenly looked up at the sky after a phenomenon appeared above, and a pillar of light immediately descended upon the building in front of them, indicating that Yao Yin was about to begin his breakthrough. "Yin'er is a kind-hearted and gentle girl, and she has accumulated a lot of good karma, so her breakthrough is not as difficult as other cultivators."
After waiting for an hour, they could sense that Yao Yin's aura was becoming stronger, surpassing that of other cultivators who had reached the quasi-divine realm.
*Swoosh*
Immediately, a Qi shockwave swept through the surrounding area of the building, and the light pillar vanished into the sky, causing the four people waiting outside to exhale in relief.

A while later, the door of the building finally opened, and a woman with light brown hair that flowed down to her buttocks walked out from inside. Her face was not beautiful when compared to the princesses of the kingdoms, but her calm expression gave peace to those who looked at her, especially her light brown pupils. Her appearance is very simple in a white inner dress combined with a light green outer dress, but her figure is quite attractive with beautiful curves, proportional breasts, and long legs.
Yao Yin immediately looked at her parents with a smile. "Father and mother, Yin'er finally broke through to this stage."

"Your years of hard work have finally paid off, Yin'er." Yao Qihu then took out a sword and handed it to his daughter. "This seven star sword is a heaven-grade sword, and your grandfather prepared it especially for you."
Yao Yin immediately received the sword and drew it from its sheath, but the blade was extremely thin, making it very flexible. "I will go to my grandparents to thank them."

"Before you meet them, we would like to discuss something with you, Yin'er." Mu Hongyin said this as she walked to her daughter's side. "Your relationship with Xianwu has been delayed for too long, so Brother Xian and Sister Shi came here to propose to you. Since you've broken through, you should have no more objections to marrying him, right?"
"Yes, Mother." Yao Yin then looked at Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang. "Uncle Xian and Aunt Shi, Yin'er accepts Brother Xianwu's proposal, and we can be married whenever you want."
Hearing that, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang felt a sense of relief. "All right, you can go meet your grandparents first, and we will start preparing for your wedding with our son today."
"Yes."

After purchasing numerous materials, Zhang Fei [1] promptly led Zhang Lingxue to the former Lian Jinshu shop, where Yang Caojing and several workers were already waiting for them. "Emperor Xian asked me to bring them here, and you can direct them as you wish to renovate this shop."

"Thank you, Senior Yang." After Yang Chaojing left, Zhang Fei [1] immediately led the workers into the building and directed them to start renovating the interior. The four guards from the Alchemy Union had already moved their goods to their branch in the Yun Kingdom, making their work simple. "After the renovation is complete, we will immediately open our first shop in this realm. However, you must teach me more alchemy recipes, and the two of us will perform alchemy together to meet the market demand."

Zhang Lingxue immediately agreed. "Since you are used to concocting rank one pills, I will start teaching you to concoct rank two pills, and your alchemist rank will rise to master alchemist after you successfully concoct one. Anyway, how is the situation inside the maze?"

"Troublesome." Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained the situation to Zhang Lingxue, causing her to frown. "For now, it is still just my guess, but I am certain that it is not wrong, and they really do come from the realms beyond the upper realms."
"Are you going to discuss this matter with Big Sis Yao?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "Someone from the Phoenix clan will arrive in our realm in less than two weeks, so I will bring Big Sis Yue back there at that time, and I will discuss it with Feng Yao later."

Zhang Lingxue agreed with that. "I'm sure Big Sis Yao will be very interested in it, and she might want to go to this realm. It would benefit us if she moved here, and you could learn alchemy from her."

In the Wasteland Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women were preparing to leave for the western island, but Shang Yaolin was puzzled because her mother still hadn't woken up from her sleep. "Aunt Qiangyin is probably tired, so she decided to sleep a little longer, but you don't have to worry about her, and we can leave a message for her."

After Shang Yaolin left a message for her mother, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately released Murong Qianying's subconscious from his dream imprisonment, and he was sure that it was more than enough to make her fall for him completely.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then led the two women to leave the Shang Clan residence, and they hurriedly flew towards the western island. However, he sensed several people following behind them, so he checked their identities on the system map. 'Shang Wuzi is interested in Shang Xinyu, but she keeps rejecting him, so I'm not surprised that he followed us secretly. However, I don't understand why Shang Xiaoyin brought her two friends to follow us; it's not a big deal, especially since they won't be able to set foot on the island.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was able to bring them to the western island in a few minutes, but he chose to fly leisurely because there were so many eyes constantly monitoring him.

In the underground bedroom, a pink gas suddenly enveloped the bed, and the two sleeping women immediately inhaled it. As a result, they become restless, their breathing becomes irregular, and their bodies begin to wiggle due to the effects.
"Mhnn."

Upon hearing their moans, Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes, frowning at the sight of the pink gas. However, another pink gas suddenly appeared and enveloped him, causing his lust to overflow rapidly.

Fortunately, Zhang Fei himself was a lust demon lord, and he immediately suppressed his lust before sucking in the pink gas that enveloped him. He then moved to the side of the bed and sucked in the pink gas there; he immediately grabbed the hands of the two women to channel his light qi.
However, Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue suddenly opened their eyes, pounced directly at him, and scrambled to kiss him like lustful female wolves.
'Sigh! Lust has overtaken their minds. Zhang Fei swiftly turned them over and used his enhanced demon touch on them, causing both women to experience their first orgasm.
"Ahh!" Both women released loud moans as their bodies jerked up and down repeatedly, and their pussies squirted out loads of their sticky liquid, drenching the bed beneath their lower bodies.
However, the effects of the pink gas had not yet worn off, so Zhang Fei decided to imprison their subconscious in a dream, or they would continue to act wild.
Zhang Fei immediately got out of bed and checked around the room for the source of the pink gas, but he didn't find any cracks or holes, and the room was completely sealed from the outside.

"What exactly is the purpose of the test in this room? How should I complete it to bring them out of here?" Just as Zhang Fei thought it, the pink gas suddenly reappeared in the room and filled it, causing him to frown. He then sat cross-legged on the floor, closed his eyes, and absorbed it continuously. 'Perhaps this is similar to the lust challenge from the sin challenge, so I think I just need to withstand its effect for a certain amount of time, and the exit will open by itself. Mei, please alert me if something appears in this place.'
[Yes, Master.]
After that, Zhang Fei started cultivating again as his body continued to absorb the pink gas, and he also sealed all his senses so its effect would not affect him.

Not long after, a completely pink woman appeared in front of Zhang Fei, but Mei or the system could not detect her presence. She crouched down in front of him, touched his face, and a smile appeared on her face. 'Who are you really? Your abilities have piqued my interest, particularly because you are the first man to successfully absorb my pink lotus miasma without experiencing its effects. Even the powerful cultivators in my home realm could not withstand its effects, and they would immediately carry out sexual assault on any woman in front of them. Unfortunately, your cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms, and it will likely take several thousand years for you to ascend to my home realm.'

The woman then touched Zhang Fei's forehead and shared something with him, but she then touched his chest before planting something else into his body. Unlike usual, the system didn't react to stop her, and she pulled her hand back afterward. 'Hehe! Little kid, you already know where to find me, right? Even if I have to wait for you for thousands of years, I will continue to wait for you there, so you must come to me after you ascend to my home realm. For now, I'll let you and the two women pass this test, and you guys can proceed to the next room. I hope you can reach the tenth floor as soon as possible.'
After that, the woman immediately disappeared from that place, and all the pink gas that filled the room also disappeared with her.
Mei, who noticed this, immediately informed her master.

Zhang Fei quickly opened his eyes, but his expression looked confused as he read some new things that appeared in his mind. He also felt that there was something inside his body, but he couldn't find it. 'Mei, check my body thoroughly.'
[Master, I checked your body when the system detected something entering your body, but I couldn't find anything, and the system didn't stop it either.]

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows after hearing that, but a door suddenly appeared on the left wall, which was the door to another area. He immediately stood up, approached the two women on the bed, and channeled his qi into their bodies to make sure that the effects of the pink gas had disappeared.
After he found that the two were no longer affected by it, Zhang Fei immediately released their subconscious, and he woke them up afterward.

Slowly, Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue opened their eyes, their expressions a little strange at the sight of Zhang Fei. Although their lust previously controlled them, they still remember that they had kissed him. Moreover, they had dreamed of him just now, which made their hearts beat faster.

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue suddenly felt something strange in their lower bodies; they were not innocent women, so they immediately realized the strangeness, causing their faces to be completely red.

Zhang Fei smiled, observing their reaction. "You two were affected by something earlier, so I was forced to use my ability to make you guys orgasm. Nevertheless, there is no need for you to be concerned, particularly since I did not commit any indecent acts toward you two. Anyway, the exit is now open, so cleanse yourselves first, and we will immediately continue our journey."

"Yin'er is a kind-hearted and gentle girl, and she has accumulated a lot of good karma, so her breakthrough is not as difficult as other cultivators."
After waiting for an hour, they could sense that Yao Yin's aura was becoming stronger, surpassing that of other cultivators who had reached the quasi-divine realm.
*Swoosh*
Immediately, a Qi shockwave swept through the surrounding area of the building, and the light pillar vanished into the sky, causing the four people waiting outside to exhale in relief.
A while later, the door of the building finally opened, and a woman with light brown hair that flowed down to her buttocks walked out from inside.
Her face was not beautiful when compared to the princesses of the kingdoms, but her calm expression gave peace to those who looked at her, especially her light brown pupils.
Her appearance is very simple in a white inner dress combined with a light green outer dress, but her figure is quite attractive with beautiful curves, proportional breasts, and long legs.
Yao Yin immediately looked at her parents with a smile.
"Father and mother, Yin'er finally broke through to this stage."
"Your years of hard work have finally paid off, Yin'er." Yao Qihu then took out a sword and handed it to his daughter.
"This seven star sword is a heaven-grade sword, and your grandfather prepared it especially for you."
Yao Yin immediately received the sword and drew it from its sheath, but the blade was extremely thin, making it very flexible.
"I will go to my grandparents to thank them."
"Before you meet them, we would like to discuss something with you, Yin'er." Mu Hongyin said this as she walked to her daughter's side.
"Your relationship with Xianwu has been delayed for too long, so Brother Xian and Sister Shi came here to propose to you.
Since you've broken through, you should have no more objections to marrying him, right?"
"Yes, Mother." Yao Yin then looked at Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang.
"Uncle Xian and Aunt Shi, Yin'er accepts Brother Xianwu's proposal, and we can be married whenever you want."
Hearing that, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang felt a sense of relief.
"All right, you can go meet your grandparents first, and we will start preparing for your wedding with our son today."
"Yes."
After purchasing numerous materials, Zhang Fei [1] promptly led Zhang Lingxue to the former Lian Jinshu shop, where Yang Caojing and several workers were already waiting for them.
"Emperor Xian asked me to bring them here, and you can direct them as you wish to renovate this shop."
"Thank you, Senior Yang." After Yang Chaojing left, Zhang Fei [1] immediately led the workers into the building and directed them to start renovating the interior.
The four guards from the Alchemy Union had already moved their goods to their branch in the Yun Kingdom, making their work simple.
"After the renovation is complete, we will immediately open our first shop in this realm.
However, you must teach me more alchemy recipes, and the two of us will perform alchemy together to meet the market demand."
Zhang Lingxue immediately agreed.
"Since you are used to concocting rank one pills, I will start teaching you to concoct rank two pills, and your alchemist rank will rise to master alchemist after you successfully concoct one.
Anyway, how is the situation inside the maze?"
"Troublesome." Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained the situation to Zhang Lingxue, causing her to frown.
"For now, it is still just my guess, but I am certain that it is not wrong, and they really do come from the realms beyond the upper realms."
"Are you going to discuss this matter with Big Sis Yao?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her.
"Someone from the Phoenix clan will arrive in our realm in less than two weeks, so I will bring Big Sis Yue back there at that time, and I will discuss it with Feng Yao later."
Zhang Lingxue agreed with that.
"I'm sure Big Sis Yao will be very interested in it, and she might want to go to this realm.
It would benefit us if she moved here, and you could learn alchemy from her."
