In the Wasteland Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women were preparing to leave for the western island, but Shang Yaolin was puzzled because her mother still hadn't woken up from her sleep.
"Aunt Qiangyin is probably tired, so she decided to sleep a little longer, but you don't have to worry about her, and we can leave a message for her."

After Shang Yaolin left a message for her mother, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately released Murong Qianying's subconscious from his dream imprisonment, and he was sure that it was more than enough to make her fall for him completely.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then led the two women to leave the Shang Clan residence, and they hurriedly flew towards the western island.

However, he sensed several people following behind them, so he checked their identities on the system map. 'Shang Wuzi is interested in Shang Xinyu, but she keeps rejecting him, so I'm not surprised that he followed us secretly.
However, I don't understand why Shang Xiaoyin brought her two friends to follow us; it's not a big deal, especially since they won't be able to set foot on the island.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was able to bring them to the western island in a few minutes, but he chose to fly leisurely because there were so many eyes constantly monitoring him.
In the underground bedroom, a pink gas suddenly enveloped the bed, and the two sleeping women immediately inhaled it.
As a result, they become restless, their breathing becomes irregular, and their bodies begin to wiggle due to the effects.
"Mhnn."
Upon hearing their moans, Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes, frowning at the sight of the pink gas.
However, another pink gas suddenly appeared and enveloped him, causing his lust to overflow rapidly.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei himself was a lust demon lord, and he immediately suppressed his lust before sucking in the pink gas that enveloped him.
He then moved to the side of the bed and sucked in the pink gas there; he immediately grabbed the hands of the two women to channel his light qi.
However, Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue suddenly opened their eyes, pounced directly at him, and scrambled to kiss him like lustful female wolves.
'Sigh!
Lust has overtaken their minds.
Zhang Fei swiftly turned them over and used his enhanced demon touch on them, causing both women to experience their first orgasm.
"Ahh!" Both women released loud moans as their bodies jerked up and down repeatedly, and their pussies squirted out loads of their sticky liquid, drenching the bed beneath their lower bodies.
However, the effects of the pink gas had not yet worn off, so Zhang Fei decided to imprison their subconscious in a dream, or they would continue to act wild.
Zhang Fei immediately got out of bed and checked around the room for the source of the pink gas, but he didn't find any cracks or holes, and the room was completely sealed from the outside.
"What exactly is the purpose of the test in this room?
How should I complete it to bring them out of here?" Just as Zhang Fei thought it, the pink gas suddenly reappeared in the room and filled it, causing him to frown.

He then sat cross-legged on the floor, closed his eyes, and absorbed it continuously. 'Perhaps this is similar to the lust challenge from the sin challenge, so I think I just need to withstand its effect for a certain amount of time, and the exit will open by itself.
Mei, please alert me if something appears in this place.'
[Yes, Master.]
After that, Zhang Fei started cultivating again as his body continued to absorb the pink gas, and he also sealed all his senses so its effect would not affect him.
Not long after, a completely pink woman appeared in front of Zhang Fei, but Mei or the system could not detect her presence.
She crouched down in front of him, touched his face, and a smile appeared on her face. 'Who are you really?
Your abilities have piqued my interest, particularly because you are the first man to successfully absorb my pink lotus miasma without experiencing its effects.
Even the powerful cultivators in my home realm could not withstand its effects, and they would immediately carry out sexual assault on any woman in front of them.
Unfortunately, your cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms, and it will likely take several thousand years for you to ascend to my home realm.'
The woman then touched Zhang Fei's forehead and shared something with him, but she then touched his chest before planting something else into his body.
Unlike usual, the system didn't react to stop her, and she pulled her hand back afterward. 'Hehe!
Little kid, you already know where to find me, right?
Even if I have to wait for you for thousands of years, I will continue to wait for you there, so you must come to me after you ascend to my home realm.
For now, I'll let you and the two women pass this test, and you guys can proceed to the next room.
I hope you can reach the tenth floor as soon as possible.'
After that, the woman immediately disappeared from that place, and all the pink gas that filled the room also disappeared with her.
Mei, who noticed this, immediately informed her master.
Zhang Fei quickly opened his eyes, but his expression looked confused as he read some new things that appeared in his mind.
He also felt that there was something inside his body, but he couldn't find it. 'Mei, check my body thoroughly.'
[Master, I checked your body when the system detected something entering your body, but I couldn't find anything, and the system didn't stop it either.]
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows after hearing that, but a door suddenly appeared on the left wall, which was the door to another area.
He immediately stood up, approached the two women on the bed, and channeled his qi into their bodies to make sure that the effects of the pink gas had disappeared.
After he found that the two were no longer affected by it, Zhang Fei immediately released their subconscious, and he woke them up afterward.
Slowly, Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue opened their eyes, their expressions a little strange at the sight of Zhang Fei.
Although their lust previously controlled them, they still remember that they had kissed him.
Moreover, they had dreamed of him just now, which made their hearts beat faster.

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue suddenly felt something strange in their lower bodies; they were not innocent women, so they immediately realized the strangeness, causing their faces to be completely red.
Zhang Fei smiled, observing their reaction.
"You two were affected by something earlier, so I was forced to use my ability to make you guys orgasm.
Nevertheless, there is no need for you to be concerned, particularly since I did not commit any indecent acts toward you two.
Anyway, the exit is now open, so cleanse yourselves first, and we will immediately continue our journey."

chapters.title: Chapter 567 The First Key
paragraphs: As they walked on either side of Zhang Fei, the two women kept wondering about their previous dreams. Xian Xianqin, who had already begun to feel attracted to him, didn't find it too bothersome, but she still thought it strange to dream about him.

Yun Xinyue's dream bothered her because she had not been attracted to Zhang Fei, and she only regarded him as her savior. Moreover, in her dream, their relationship seemed unusual. 'Am I really attracted to him? Why do I have such a dream about him?'

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was plagued by numerous questions, particularly regarding several things that the mysterious woman had given him and implanted into his body. 'Who exactly is that woman? Could it be that she and the Moonlit Passion Temple came from those mysterious realms? Why did she give the Forbidden Lotus Codex to me?'
[After I read the sub-techniques in that technique, I discovered that the effects of some of them were similar to your lust demon lord abilities, Master.]

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, having personally studied those sub-techniques. 'Unlike the Flawless Yin-Yang Art, which unites our bodies, or the Soul Harmonization Method, which unites our souls, the Lotus Ascension Art requires us to unite our bodies, minds, and souls to form a singular new entity from our union. However, it is not easy to master it, especially since it requires unwavering hearts and absolute trust toward each other. If both partners lack these qualities and fail to form the new entity, we will face a severe backlash, and the worst scenario is that we will both perish.'
[Master, it does sound difficult, but I think it's not a problem for you if you use it with your main harem members, but I'm a bit doubtful about all your partners.]

Zhang Fei did not deny Mei's opinion, especially since he was aware that his partners were different from his main harem members. Although they were always eager to dual-cultivate with his two clones, their feelings for him were not as deep as Liu Hua and the others, and their feelings might waver one day.

[Master, all of you have deep feelings for each other, but in my opinion, your feelings for Zhang Lin are the deepest, as you were each other's first love, and she has been with you for a longer period than the others. That's why you should try the Lotus Ascension Art with her first, as I'm confident that the chances of the two of you forming a new entity are very high.]

Zhang Fei smiled upon hearing that. 'You're right; the feelings between me and Lin'er are indeed the deepest. Unfortunately, I'm still trapped in this maze, and I'll never dual cultivate with her using my clones, so I'll do it after I get back.'
"Zhang Fei." Both women called out softly.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei turned to each of them individually. "What's up?"
"What are you thinking about? Why are you so serious?" Xian Xianqin asked.
Yun Xinyue then added. "Moreover, the way you're smiling at yourself gives me the impression that you're thinking about something perverted."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at Yun Xinyue's words. "Do you really think I'm that perverted, Princess Xinyue? I am indeed lustful, and my sex drive is very high, but that doesn't mean I can't control myself. If I were truly perverted, you two would have already lost your virginity to me, remember?"

After Zhang Fei mentioned that, the two princesses' faces turned red, and Yun Xinyue immediately ran towards the next room, which was not far in front of them. However, she did not dare go in there alone and instead waited for them.

Unlike the Yun Princess, Xian Xianqin immediately grabbed Zhang Fei's left hand. "I don't know how I became like that, but I'm grateful that you didn't do anything to me. If you had done such a thing to me while my mind was in a mess, I wouldn't hesitate to kill you, and I would kill myself after that."

"If other men were by your side just now, they would probably pounce on you right away. However, I am different from them and already have numerous women by my side, so I would never do such a thing to you." Zhang Fei then lifted Xian Xianqin's chin and rubbed her lips with his other hand, causing her heart to pound. "Even though we only kissed for a moment, your lips were really soft and sweet."

Xian Xianqin's face turned completely red because Zhang Fei brought up their previous kiss, which was her first kiss with a man. Unfortunately, she kissed him in a confused state of mind, leaving him disappointed and regretful in her heart.
Xian Xianqin suddenly put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck, stood on tiptoes, and kissed him directly.

Zhang Fei immediately pulled Xian Xianqin closer, hugged her, and returned her kiss. However, the Xian Princess was still too amateur at kissing, so he guided her to kiss more slowly before increasing the rhythm of their kisses.
In the distance, Yun Xinyue stood in a daze as she watched Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin kiss, but she then rubbed her lips as she recalled her kiss with him before.
Xian Xianqin was shocked when Zhang Fei's tongue entered her mouth, and she subconsciously pushed him back. "Sorry, I didn't mean to push you like this."
"It's okay." Zhang Fei immediately stopped her. "This is your first conscious kiss, and you don't have much knowledge about kissing, so it's natural for you to be shocked and push me away."
Xian Xianqin was relieved to hear that. "Thank you for your understanding."

"Let's go; we have to go to that room now." Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei, and they immediately approached Yun Xinyue, who was standing at the front of the room. "There are three paths ahead, so we must choose one, but I don't know what will await us at the end. Moreover, I feel that someone deliberately put us on a dangerous route, so we have to be more careful in choosing our next path."
Both women nodded at Zhang Fei, and they felt the same as him, but Yun Xinyue then pointed to the door to their right. "Do you think we should go there first?"
"Since you have already chosen our two paths, please let me choose ours this time." Xian Xianqin then led them to the path on their left.

A while later, they reached the end of the path, only to find a three-headed giant beast lying in the spacious room. Moreover, the beast's form was very strange, and its body was a combination of several types of beasts. The beast's appearance shocked them, but then their gaze settled on a golden key around its neck.
"The first key!"

Zhang Fei immediately pulled both women behind him. "This beast is not ordinary; this beast is a human creation. Despite its cultivation being limited to the heaven realm, we must exercise caution, particularly given its unknown abilities."
"A beast created by humans?" Both women turned to him in shock.

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "People call this beast a chimera; it is the result of experiments that combine the DNA of several beasts to create a new type of beast. Judging from its appearance, this beast is a combination of lion, serpent, dog, and scorpion."

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue reexamined the beast, finding its appearance to be exactly as Zhang Fei had described. However, they could not recognize the types of beasts that made up its body, especially since it did not exist anywhere. "Are you thinking about facing this beast alone?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then took out the moonlit whisper sword. "You two need to wait here, and you can move if I'm unable to defeat this beast."

Zhang Fei immediately entered the room and activated his heavenly fox aura, causing the beast to open its eyes slowly. However, it did not flinch before the pressure of his aura, and it immediately rose to its feet before releasing three different sounds.
"Hiss."
"Roar."
"Bark."
The beast swung its scorpion tail toward Zhang Fei, but Zhang Fei immediately teleported, causing the attack to hit the ground. The poison that emerged from the tip caused the ground to melt.
"Oh?" Zhang Fei smiled, seeing their reactions. "You guys are really great! Not many beasts can withstand my beast aura, but you are still not my opponent."
Zhang Fei immediately teleported several times to confuse the beast, but its three heads sniffed his location, and its serpent head opened its mouth wide before shooting black venom at him.
Once again, Zhang Fei evaded the beast's attack, and its venom melted the wall behind him, causing the two women to become tense as they watched them.

Yun Xinyue immediately took out her spear and wanted to move in, but Xian Xianqin grabbed her hand and stopped her. "If Zhang Fei is serious, he can kill this beast with one strike, so we don't need to move now."
"Then why is he wasting time with this beast?" Yun Xinyue inquired with a frown.
"I don't know." Xian Xianqin replied as she tried to read Zhang Fei's movements, but he moved too fast. "This beast is not as strong as Huan Yao or Zhou Fang, so I am sure he can defeat it."

However, a middle-aged man suddenly moves towards the two princesses from behind at full speed, and he doesn't give them a chance to react. He immediately knocked them unconscious, carried them on his shoulders, and took them away from the place.

Zhang Fei, who was fighting with the chimera beast, immediately noticed the middle-aged man's actions. He immediately released his full power and used his Clone Illusion Steps, which caused five illusions to appear around the beast, confusing it.
'Tch! I'll come back later to subdue this chimera.' Zhang Fei swiftly maneuvered beneath the beast's neck, grabbed the golden key, and hurried away to catch up with them.
The beast, realizing he had taken the golden key, tried to chase after Zhang Fei. However, the door's formation bounced the beast back, causing it to release three enraged roars.
'Have you scanned the man, Mei?'
[Master, I can't scan that guy because his speed is too fast, and the system's detection capabilities are limited.]
Zhang Fei saw the middle-aged man take the two princesses to the road north, so he chased after them, but they had already disappeared by the time he got there.
[Master, the wall on your left is just an illusion, and the man took them away through the path behind it.]

Zhang Fei immediately moved along the road, but he encountered two fork roads. He then used his natural awareness ability to track the two women, and he proceeded straight down the right path as their qi was moving through it. A thick rock suddenly blocked the path behind him as soon as he entered it. He frowned at that, but he immediately ignored it and focused on chasing them.

Before long, Zhang Fei arrived at the room at the end of the path, but it was a dead end, and the qi of the two women also disappeared from his sight. He was certain that the middle-aged man couldn't escape from the room, so he checked the walls on all three sides, but neither he nor Mei could find any other path. The area below them was also solid ground, so they couldn't possibly disappear down.

Since there were no other paths, Zhang Fei looked up at the ceiling before crouching down, and he jumped immediately up with full strength. As he expected, he managed to pass through the ceiling of the room, which led him to a small garden.

Zhang Fei arrived and saw the middle-aged man standing in the center of the room, his arms crossed in front of his chest, while the two princesses were unconscious and chained to the wall at the far back.
Zhang Fei immediately questioned the middle-aged man. "Who are you? Why did you kidnap them?"

"A little brat like you doesn't deserve to know my name." The middle-aged man immediately took a fighting stance with both his fists clenched. "If you want to get them back, you have to defeat me first. If you lose to me, they will die here."
[Master, the system cannot scan his status, so you should be careful when fighting him.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly, stored his sword, and walked in front of the middle-aged man. "I may be a little brat in your eyes, but I am much more manly than you, and I would never threaten others by holding their comrades hostage. Since you are so eager to fight with me, I will face you now."
The middle-aged man smirked slightly before disappearing from his spot, but he reappeared behind Zhang Fei in a split second, and he immediately threw his fist toward his back.
However, Zhang Fei immediately delivered a kick to the middle-aged man's abdomen, causing him to stagger with a shocked expression.
Zhang Fei immediately spun around, moved in front of the middle-aged man, and punched his right fist toward his face.
Immediately, the middle-aged man crossed both arms in front of his face to block Zhang Fei's attack, but his attack knocked him back several steps.
"Is this your maximum speed?" Zhang Fei asked with disdain in his tone. "If your speed is only this much, then I'm disappointed."
*Boom*
"Bastard!" The middle-aged man roared and sprinted towards Zhang Fei, using his full power to attack him. "I will destroy your arrogance and kill you, arrogant brat!"

"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and skillfully dodged every attack from the middle-aged man, particularly as his attacks appeared to move in slow motion before his eyes. "Aren't you a hypocrite, Old Brat? You arrogantly insulted me earlier, but you can't accept my insults and call me arrogant."
Since he still hadn't managed to land a hit on Zhang Fei, the middle-aged man became even more furious at his words, and his aura immediately exploded, boosting his speed and attack power.
However, the middle-aged man was shocked when Zhang Fei suddenly grabbed his right hand, especially since his speed had increased several times compared to his original speed.
Zhang Fei immediately threw him into the air before flying towards him, but the middle-aged man right away stabilized himself there and prepared to attack him.

Zhang Fei's five illusions swiftly encircled him, prompting the middle-aged man to remain vigilant. The five immediately moved to attack him, so he retaliated by attacking them, but all of his attacks were passed through them.
Before the middle-aged man could react, Zhang Fei had already appeared behind him and punched him with both fists directly, sending him flying forward.
However, Zhang Fei did not stop there; he immediately attacked the middle-aged man in succession, starting from his head, chest, stomach, both hands, and legs, causing him pain.
Ending his series of attacks, Zhang Fei swung his qi-covered right leg towards his head, causing the middle-aged man's body to slide towards the ground swiftly.

Just before his body slammed onto the ground, the middle-aged man immediately corrected his position. He stomped both feet onto the ground, causing the ground beneath him to dip inward. He then looked up at Zhang Fei, who was standing in the air with a disdainful smile on his face. 'What the hell with this brat? How does he actually train? How can he have such a high speed when his cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms?'

"Old Brat, I can't kill you because your cultivation is much higher than mine, but you will never be able to defeat me with your pathetic speed." The middle-aged man became even more enraged upon hearing Zhang Fei address him as such. "You are a member of the Immortal Soul Palace, and your sect is located in the realms beyond the upper realms, right?"
The middle-aged man was shocked to hear that. "How do you know about that?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at his question. "I had guessed from the start that this tower did not belong to the middle or upper realms, and I was slightly convinced when the little girl who gave me the test on the demon heart challenge slipped off the tongue about her master. If my guess was correct, her master is your master, and that person controls this tower."

"Since you have already chosen our two paths, please let me choose ours this time." Xian Xianqin then led them to the path on their left.
A while later, they reached the end of the path, only to find a three-headed giant beast lying in the spacious room.
Moreover, the beast's form was very strange, and its body was a combination of several types of beasts.
The beast's appearance shocked them, but then their gaze settled on a golden key around its neck.
"The first key!"
Zhang Fei immediately pulled both women behind him.
"This beast is not ordinary; this beast is a human creation.
Despite its cultivation being limited to the heaven realm, we must exercise caution, particularly given its unknown abilities."
"A beast created by humans?" Both women turned to him in shock.
Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"People call this beast a chimera; it is the result of experiments that combine the DNA of several beasts to create a new type of beast.
Judging from its appearance, this beast is a combination of lion, serpent, dog, and scorpion."
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue reexamined the beast, finding its appearance to be exactly as Zhang Fei had described.
However, they could not recognize the types of beasts that made up its body, especially since it did not exist anywhere.
"Are you thinking about facing this beast alone?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then took out the moonlit whisper sword.
"You two need to wait here, and you can move if I'm unable to defeat this beast."
Zhang Fei immediately entered the room and activated his heavenly fox aura, causing the beast to open its eyes slowly.
However, it did not flinch before the pressure of his aura, and it immediately rose to its feet before releasing three different sounds.
"Hiss."
"Roar."
"Bark."
The beast swung its scorpion tail toward Zhang Fei, but Zhang Fei immediately teleported, causing the attack to hit the ground.
The poison that emerged from the tip caused the ground to melt.
"Oh?" Zhang Fei smiled, seeing their reactions.
"You guys are really great!
Not many beasts can withstand my beast aura, but you are still not my opponent."
Zhang Fei immediately teleported several times to confuse the beast, but its three heads sniffed his location, and its serpent head opened its mouth wide before shooting black venom at him.
Once again, Zhang Fei evaded the beast's attack, and its venom melted the wall behind him, causing the two women to become tense as they watched them.
Yun Xinyue immediately took out her spear and wanted to move in, but Xian Xianqin grabbed her hand and stopped her.
"If Zhang Fei is serious, he can kill this beast with one strike, so we don't need to move now."
"Then why is he wasting time with this beast?" Yun Xinyue inquired with a frown.
"I don't know." Xian Xianqin replied as she tried to read Zhang Fei's movements, but he moved too fast.
"This beast is not as strong as Huan Yao or Zhou Fang, so I am sure he can defeat it."
However, a middle-aged man suddenly moves towards the two princesses from behind at full speed, and he doesn't give them a chance to react.
He immediately knocked them unconscious, carried them on his shoulders, and took them away from the place.
Zhang Fei, who was fighting with the chimera beast, immediately noticed the middle-aged man's actions.
He immediately released his full power and used his Clone Illusion Steps, which caused five illusions to appear around the beast, confusing it.
'Tch!
I'll come back later to subdue this chimera.' Zhang Fei swiftly maneuvered beneath the beast's neck, grabbed the golden key, and hurried away to catch up with them.
The beast, realizing he had taken the golden key, tried to chase after Zhang Fei.
However, the door's formation bounced the beast back, causing it to release three enraged roars.
'Have you scanned the man, Mei?'
[Master, I can't scan that guy because his speed is too fast, and the system's detection capabilities are limited.]
Zhang Fei saw the middle-aged man take the two princesses to the road north, so he chased after them, but they had already disappeared by the time he got there.
[Master, the wall on your left is just an illusion, and the man took them away through the path behind it.]
Zhang Fei immediately moved along the road, but he encountered two fork roads.
He then used his natural awareness ability to track the two women, and he proceeded straight down the right path as their qi was moving through it.
A thick rock suddenly blocked the path behind him as soon as he entered it.
He frowned at that, but he immediately ignored it and focused on chasing them.
Before long, Zhang Fei arrived at the room at the end of the path, but it was a dead end, and the qi of the two women also disappeared from his sight.
He was certain that the middle-aged man couldn't escape from the room, so he checked the walls on all three sides, but neither he nor Mei could find any other path.
The area below them was also solid ground, so they couldn't possibly disappear down.
Since there were no other paths, Zhang Fei looked up at the ceiling before crouching down, and he jumped immediately up with full strength.
As he expected, he managed to pass through the ceiling of the room, which led him to a small garden.

Zhang Fei arrived and saw the middle-aged man standing in the center of the room, his arms crossed in front of his chest, while the two princesses were unconscious and chained to the wall at the far back.
Zhang Fei immediately questioned the middle-aged man.
"Who are you?
Why did you kidnap them?"
"A little brat like you doesn't deserve to know my name." The middle-aged man immediately took a fighting stance with both his fists clenched.
"If you want to get them back, you have to defeat me first.
If you lose to me, they will die here."
[Master, the system cannot scan his status, so you should be careful when fighting him.]
Zhang Fei nodded slightly, stored his sword, and walked in front of the middle-aged man.
"I may be a little brat in your eyes, but I am much more manly than you, and I would never threaten others by holding their comrades hostage.
Since you are so eager to fight with me, I will face you now."
The middle-aged man smirked slightly before disappearing from his spot, but he reappeared behind Zhang Fei in a split second, and he immediately threw his fist toward his back.
However, Zhang Fei immediately delivered a kick to the middle-aged man's abdomen, causing him to stagger with a shocked expression.
Zhang Fei immediately spun around, moved in front of the middle-aged man, and punched his right fist toward his face.
Immediately, the middle-aged man crossed both arms in front of his face to block Zhang Fei's attack, but his attack knocked him back several steps.
"Is this your maximum speed?" Zhang Fei asked with disdain in his tone.
"If your speed is only this much, then I'm disappointed."
*Boom*
"Bastard!" The middle-aged man roared and sprinted towards Zhang Fei, using his full power to attack him.
"I will destroy your arrogance and kill you, arrogant brat!"
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and skillfully dodged every attack from the middle-aged man, particularly as his attacks appeared to move in slow motion before his eyes.
"Aren't you a hypocrite, Old Brat?
You arrogantly insulted me earlier, but you can't accept my insults and call me arrogant."
Since he still hadn't managed to land a hit on Zhang Fei, the middle-aged man became even more furious at his words, and his aura immediately exploded, boosting his speed and attack power.
However, the middle-aged man was shocked when Zhang Fei suddenly grabbed his right hand, especially since his speed had increased several times compared to his original speed.
Zhang Fei immediately threw him into the air before flying towards him, but the middle-aged man right away stabilized himself there and prepared to attack him.
Zhang Fei's five illusions swiftly encircled him, prompting the middle-aged man to remain vigilant.
The five immediately moved to attack him, so he retaliated by attacking them, but all of his attacks were passed through them.
Before the middle-aged man could react, Zhang Fei had already appeared behind him and punched him with both fists directly, sending him flying forward.
However, Zhang Fei did not stop there; he immediately attacked the middle-aged man in succession, starting from his head, chest, stomach, both hands, and legs, causing him pain.
Ending his series of attacks, Zhang Fei swung his qi-covered right leg towards his head, causing the middle-aged man's body to slide towards the ground swiftly.
Just before his body slammed onto the ground, the middle-aged man immediately corrected his position.
He stomped both feet onto the ground, causing the ground beneath him to dip inward.
He then looked up at Zhang Fei, who was standing in the air with a disdainful smile on his face. 'What the hell with this brat?
How does he actually train?
How can he have such a high speed when his cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms?'

"Old Brat, I can't kill you because your cultivation is much higher than mine, but you will never be able to defeat me with your pathetic speed." The middle-aged man became even more enraged upon hearing Zhang Fei address him as such.
"You are a member of the Immortal Soul Palace, and your sect is located in the realms beyond the upper realms, right?"
The middle-aged man was shocked to hear that.
"How do you know about that?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at his question.

"I had guessed from the start that this tower did not belong to the middle or upper realms, and I was slightly convinced when the little girl who gave me the test on the demon heart challenge slipped off the tongue about her master.
If my guess was correct, her master is your master, and that person controls this tower."

chapters.title: Chapter 568 Blank Book Reward
paragraphs: For quite some time, the middle-aged man stared at Zhang Fei. He then waved his hand, released the two princesses, and disappeared from the scene.

Zhang Fei was greatly irritated by the similarity between the middle-aged man and the little girl, who rushed away as soon as he mentioned anything related to them. "What exactly do they want from me? Why are they so secretive? Could it be that they are scheming something against me?"
*Boom*
A small wooden box suddenly fell from the sky right in front of Zhang Fei, and he saw a strange carving on the lid. He ignored the carving and opened the box directly, finding a book inside.
"Hmm?" After taking the book, Zhang Fei felt confused, especially since it had no title and no writing inside. "What kind of book is this? Do I need a special way to read it?"
[Master, put the book in the system inventory, and I will try to analyze it.]

Zhang Fei immediately fulfilled Mei's request before teleporting to where the two women were, and he right away woke them up. A few moments later, they opened their eyes and leaped to their feet, only to be stunned, especially since they had been moved to a garden.
Their expressions turned gloomy, especially since they felt helpless during the last two tests. "Where are we? Who attacked us before?"

"Calm down, you two." Zhang Fei then explained what had happened to them, and he also showed them the golden key. "I don't know the identity of that middle-aged man, but I am now completely certain that he and the little girl I met before coming from those realms, and their master is the one who controls this tower. Even if you two don't let your guard down, you guys still won't be able to face him because his cultivation and speed are much higher than yours, so you don't need to be disappointed with yourselves. Anyway, let's go to the next room so we can finish this maze challenge quickly."

Both women nodded and followed behind Zhang Fei, but they clenched their fists tightly as they looked at his back. His cultivation was far below theirs, but they couldn't help him and had to rely on him through their tests, which disappointed them.

A while later, the three of them arrived in a room, but they were faced with three puzzles on the three walls of the room. "Let's solve these puzzles first, and we will determine our next path after that."

Somewhere inside the tower, Hua Mei'er laughed out loud after the middle-aged man arrived there. "Hahahaha! Old Brat! So funny! The others will definitely laugh at you if they hear about that, Sima Yun!"

"Shut up! All of this happened because of your stupidity! You foolishly informed that brat about our master!" Hua Mei'er immediately covered her mouth, and Sima Yun then turned to the old man. "Master, my speed is indeed not the fastest in our realm, but my speed is not bad either, and I am the fastest among my brothers and sisters. However, that brat's speed surpasses mine, and I feel that his speed is on par with that guy."

Zhang Fei's speed perplexed the old man, particularly considering the vast distance between their home realm and the Nine Stars Realm. Furthermore, they had learned that he originated from the lower realms and had recently reached the middle realms. "I don't know how he managed to achieve such a high speed with his low cultivation, and I'm also not sure where he got the information about our realms from, but I've decided not to send any of you to test him anymore."

"I think that's the best decision, master." Sima Yun said as he nodded. "This realm is in the middle realms, and his cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms. I acknowledge that he excels among cultivators of his generation, and there aren't many younger generations in our realms who can match him. However, it could be detrimental to him if he gains too much knowledge about us or our realms."

The old man then ordered his other disciples to cancel his original plans and return. "We only need to wait for him to reach this floor, but he may take decades or centuries, and we will explain everything then."
"Master, what about that vile woman's soul? Are you going to let her control that little girl?" Hua Mei'er posed a serious question.

"That little girl will meet him soon, and that vile woman's soul will be useful to him, so I'll let him handle her himself." Hua Mei'er and Sima Yun could only sigh in their hearts after their master said that, but they had no intention of persuading him to change his mind, especially since they were truly annoyed with Zhang Fei.

"Haha." Zhou Meiling laughed to herself as she looked at the corpses of many demons in front of her. "Their cultivation is quite high, and some of them are stronger than this little girl. Unfortunately, their life and soul forces are too weak, so I have to find other prey to strengthen my soul before I can reshape my body."
Suddenly, the wall on Zhou Meiling's right opened on its own, and she faintly smiled as she looked at the man in front of her.
The man was also a little surprised to see Zhou Meiling, but he was shocked when he saw so many demons' corpses. "Did you kill them, Princess Meiling?"

"They tried to force me to serve them, so I killed them." Zhou Meiling then walked to the man's side and hugged his arm, which made him feel awkward. She gently wiped his face with a silk cloth before posing a question. "Why does your face appear so tired, Prince Renfu?"

"Haish! You better not ask that." Bai Renfu then pointed to the room behind them. "I got separated from my big brother and Shouyi, and I was trapped inside for so long just to solve a puzzle, so I'm really tired now."

"I see." Zhou Meiling then pulled Bai Renfu to walk with her. "Since we were both separated from our families, it would be better if we explored this maze together. This way, we could more easily fight the enemies that would come our way, and we could help each other if we encountered other puzzles."
Bai Renfu immediately agreed, swallowed some pills, and then walked with Zhou Meiling, oblivious to the evil glimmer in her gaze.
Zhou Meiling licked her lips as she glanced at Bai Renfu. 'His condition is weakening now, so I will wait for him to recover first before absorbing his life and soul forces.'

A young man, a young woman, and a brown wolf casually walked side by side until they arrived at the next room. They were a little surprised when they saw the two women who were sound asleep, causing them to think that the two of them were too careless.

However, one of the women immediately opened her eyes upon sensing their presence, and she was relieved after recognizing their identities. "I didn't expect to meet you two here, Prince Long Chen and Princess Xian Jinglan."

"Why are you both sleeping here, Princess Bai Tian'er? Aren't you afraid of being attacked by demons or people from those kingdoms?" Xian Jinglan asked as he waved his hand, and two white lights quickly enveloped the two women, helping them relieve their fatigue.

Bai Tian'er let out a heavy sigh before telling them about some of the rooms she and Ye Zhiqiu had passed through before, but Xian Jinglan and Long Chen weren't surprised by that, especially since they had also encountered the same problems. "The changes in this maze are too extreme, and I don't know how long it will take for us to get out of this place."

"Haha." Long Chen laughed and sat down in front of the two women. "The changes are indeed unusual, but I enjoyed my time here. Actually, I was hoping to meet Zhang Fei here so I could spar with him, but instead, we met those beasts non-stop, and now we met you two."

"You are indeed similar to your father, and your mind is always filled with fighting and fighting, Prince Long." Xian Jinglan said this as she brought her brown wolf to rest by their side. "How long have you two been here?"
"Two or three hours, perhaps." Bai Tian'er then turned to her friend. "We had to fight too many beasts in a row, which forced Zhiqiu to use his secret technique, leaving her completely exhausted."
Xian Jinglan nodded in understanding. "Even though I want to leave this place, I'm not in a rush to leave either, so we'll wait for her to recover before continuing our journey."
"So, how was your previous adventure?" Long Chen and Xian Jinglan then shared numerous details with Bai Tian'er, including their separation from Jin Dabao, among other things.
"Wake up?" Xian Changyue promptly inquired as soon as her nephew opened his eyes.

Xian Xianwu did not immediately respond to his paternal aunt; instead, he rubbed his dizzy head. He looked around the room, realizing they were no longer in the previous garden but rather in a room reminiscent of a prison. "What happened to me, Aunt? Where are we now?"

"You were previously affected by some flower plants in the garden, so I immediately took you away after the effect was enough for them." Xian Changyue then looked around. "I met many beasts and demons, and I couldn't deal with them alone, so I took you to escape to this prison."
Xian Xianwu nodded slightly and sat down directly. "How much time has passed?"

"A few hours." Xian Changyue quickly grasped Xian Xianwu's hand, assessed his condition, and then exhaled with a sense of relief. "Since you've recovered now, we should continue our journey, or we'll be stuck in this maze for too long."
The two of them immediately left the prison and went through the only path in front of them, but they saw someone unexpected in the next room. "Bai Chongxi?"
Bai Chongxi, who was seriously inspecting the room, was startled to hear that. As he turned to face them, Xian Changyue suddenly moved in front of him and grabbed his neck.
Bai Chongxi tried to grab Xian Changyue's hand, but she immediately slapped his hand away. "Ugh! Please... please spare me."

"Why should I spare you?" Xian Changyue coldly asked. "Your parents have repeatedly assisted Huangfu Shou in his attacks on my Xian Kingdom, and you hold the position of crown prince within your kingdom. If I kill you now, then Bai Yaowei and Chen Ruyue will suffer, and their situation will be to our advantage."

"You... you don't know our true situation." Xian Changyue furrowed her brows. "My... my parents never wanted to attack other kingdoms, but they are already under the control of the person behind Huangfu Shou, and they cannot refute his orders."
"Who is the person behind Huangfu Shou?"

Bai Chongxi shook his head slightly. "I... I don't know the identity of that person, but I know that that person is really strong, and he is much stronger than all the emperors or empresses in our realm. Moreover, Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu are already aware of the existence of that person, or else they have long attacked the Huangfu Kingdom."

After hearing that, Xian Changyue became deeply contemplative, particularly considering the close ties between the two demon kingdoms and the Zhou Kingdom. Their numbers should have been more than enough to destroy the Huangfu Kingdom, but they never once attacked them, and they continued to build up their strength to fight against Huangfu Shou. "Is that person a cultivator from the upper realms?"
"I really don't know the identity of that person, so I'm unsure whether that person is a cultivator from the middle or upper realms."

"Why doesn't that person control you and your siblings?" Bai Chongxi answered with a shake of his head, especially since he didn't know the person's reasons. Xian Changyue immediately released him, waved her hand to the right, and swiftly led them away through an open path. "Let's go."
'Do you believe him, Aunt?'

Xian Changyue shook her head slightly. 'I won't believe him before I can find out the truth myself, but your father and I have long suspected that there is someone else behind Huangfu Shou, so I will investigate it after we return to our kingdom.'
In another area, Ximen Chuixue and the other three were busy fighting the demons from the Dark Demon Kingdoms, but they were clearly in a pinch as their enemies outnumbered them.

A white circle suddenly appeared above them, and dozens of light arrows immediately rained down on the demons. Additionally, two men suddenly charged toward the demons and beat them up, which brought relief to Ximen Chuixue and the others.
In a few minutes, the demons were exterminated, but the two men and a tiny girl immediately left Ximen Chuixue and his group to another area.
"Are they always like that, Brother Chui?"

Ximen Chuixue nodded to Yuan Luo. "Even though the beasts and natural races have never been hostile to humans, they have never liked humans either, so you shouldn't be surprised if they are indifferent to us. At least they helped us to get rid of these demons, or else we would die by their hands."
"So, where are we going now? Are we going to follow them?" Ru Yanyue asked them.
Ying Shanhu dismissed that with a shake of his head. "Didn't you hear what Brother Chui said just now? They don't like humans, so we shouldn't follow them and instead go in the opposite direction."
"One of them is Prince Long Tian, and he is quite temperamental, so we will go to the right." Yuan Luo and the other two immediately agreed, following Ximen Chuixue in a different direction.
Ru Yanyue then asked again. "If they don't like humans, why did they approach Zhang Fei? Isn't he human like us?"

Ying Shanhu was also curious about it, especially since he could see that the people from the beast and natural races were trying to draw Zhang Fei to their side. Ximen Chuixue and Yan Luo naturally knew their reasons, but they had no intention of disclosing his other two identities to their friends.

Meanwhile, a small man kept grumbling in his heart, especially since he was locked up alone in a prison. No matter how hard he tried to destroy the place, the walls and iron in front of him absorbed all his attacks. Moreover, there was a puzzle that appeared in front of the door, so he had no choice but to solve it first before he could leave the place.
The man was none other than Jin Dabao, the dwarf. "Damn it! If I hadn't been separated from Long Chen and Xian Jinglan, I wouldn't have been locked up in this miserable place."
The ceiling of the room suddenly opened by itself, and two women immediately fell into it, surprising Jin Dabao.
*Bam... Bam...*
"Ouch!" One of the women screamed after falling on her buttocks.
The other woman immediately cursed loudly. "Shit! Those damn beasts! If they hadn't chased us, we wouldn't have fallen into that trap!"
The two women looked around, but they were surprised to find Jin Dabao in the room. 'Tch! What kind of creature is he? Why is his body so tiny?'
Jin Dabao paid them no mind. "Hey! If you two want to go out, you guys better help me solve this puzzle, or we'll rot in this place."

The two women were Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei, who were separated from their two brothers. Although they did not like Jin Dabao, they also did not want to continue being trapped in that place, so they began to help him solve the puzzle.
Huangfu Xiaoying then asked him. "How long have you been trapped in this place?"
"A few hours." Jin Dabao then turned to them. "Don't talk too much and focus on solving this puzzle."
'Tch! This old bastard!' Huangfu Xiaoying only dared to curse in her heart because Jin Dabao was stronger than her and her sister.
Although Huangfu Xiaomei remained silent, Jin Dabao's attitude also annoyed her. 'Tch! If we are able to escape this location and reunite with our brothers, I will kill this old bastard directly.'

"You are indeed similar to your father, and your mind is always filled with fighting and fighting, Prince Long." Xian Jinglan said this as she brought her brown wolf to rest by their side.
"How long have you two been here?"
"Two or three hours, perhaps." Bai Tian'er then turned to her friend.
"We had to fight too many beasts in a row, which forced Zhiqiu to use his secret technique, leaving her completely exhausted."
Xian Jinglan nodded in understanding.
"Even though I want to leave this place, I'm not in a rush to leave either, so we'll wait for her to recover before continuing our journey."
"So, how was your previous adventure?" Long Chen and Xian Jinglan then shared numerous details with Bai Tian'er, including their separation from Jin Dabao, among other things.
"Wake up?" Xian Changyue promptly inquired as soon as her nephew opened his eyes.
Xian Xianwu did not immediately respond to his paternal aunt; instead, he rubbed his dizzy head.
He looked around the room, realizing they were no longer in the previous garden but rather in a room reminiscent of a prison.
"What happened to me, Aunt?
Where are we now?"
"You were previously affected by some flower plants in the garden, so I immediately took you away after the effect was enough for them." Xian Changyue then looked around.
"I met many beasts and demons, and I couldn't deal with them alone, so I took you to escape to this prison."
Xian Xianwu nodded slightly and sat down directly.
"How much time has passed?"
"A few hours." Xian Changyue quickly grasped Xian Xianwu's hand, assessed his condition, and then exhaled with a sense of relief.
"Since you've recovered now, we should continue our journey, or we'll be stuck in this maze for too long."
The two of them immediately left the prison and went through the only path in front of them, but they saw someone unexpected in the next room.
"Bai Chongxi?"
Bai Chongxi, who was seriously inspecting the room, was startled to hear that.
As he turned to face them, Xian Changyue suddenly moved in front of him and grabbed his neck.
Bai Chongxi tried to grab Xian Changyue's hand, but she immediately slapped his hand away.
"Ugh!
Please... please spare me."
"Why should I spare you?" Xian Changyue coldly asked.
"Your parents have repeatedly assisted Huangfu Shou in his attacks on my Xian Kingdom, and you hold the position of crown prince within your kingdom.
If I kill you now, then Bai Yaowei and Chen Ruyue will suffer, and their situation will be to our advantage."
"You... you don't know our true situation." Xian Changyue furrowed her brows.
"My... my parents never wanted to attack other kingdoms, but they are already under the control of the person behind Huangfu Shou, and they cannot refute his orders."
"Who is the person behind Huangfu Shou?"
Bai Chongxi shook his head slightly.
I don't know the identity of that person, but I know that that person is really strong, and he is much stronger than all the emperors or empresses in our realm.
Moreover, Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu are already aware of the existence of that person, or else they have long attacked the Huangfu Kingdom."
After hearing that, Xian Changyue became deeply contemplative, particularly considering the close ties between the two demon kingdoms and the Zhou Kingdom.
Their numbers should have been more than enough to destroy the Huangfu Kingdom, but they never once attacked them, and they continued to build up their strength to fight against Huangfu Shou.
"Is that person a cultivator from the upper realms?"
"I really don't know the identity of that person, so I'm unsure whether that person is a cultivator from the middle or upper realms."
"Why doesn't that person control you and your siblings?" Bai Chongxi answered with a shake of his head, especially since he didn't know the person's reasons.
Xian Changyue immediately released him, waved her hand to the right, and swiftly led them away through an open path.
"Let's go."
'Do you believe him, Aunt?'

Xian Changyue shook her head slightly. 'I won't believe him before I can find out the truth myself, but your father and I have long suspected that there is someone else behind Huangfu Shou, so I will investigate it after we return to our kingdom.'
In another area, Ximen Chuixue and the other three were busy fighting the demons from the Dark Demon Kingdoms, but they were clearly in a pinch as their enemies outnumbered them.
A white circle suddenly appeared above them, and dozens of light arrows immediately rained down on the demons.
Additionally, two men suddenly charged toward the demons and beat them up, which brought relief to Ximen Chuixue and the others.
In a few minutes, the demons were exterminated, but the two men and a tiny girl immediately left Ximen Chuixue and his group to another area.
"Are they always like that, Brother Chui?"
Ximen Chuixue nodded to Yuan Luo.
"Even though the beasts and natural races have never been hostile to humans, they have never liked humans either, so you shouldn't be surprised if they are indifferent to us.
At least they helped us to get rid of these demons, or else we would die by their hands."
"So, where are we going now?
Are we going to follow them?" Ru Yanyue asked them.
Ying Shanhu dismissed that with a shake of his head.
"Didn't you hear what Brother Chui said just now?
They don't like humans, so we shouldn't follow them and instead go in the opposite direction."
"One of them is Prince Long Tian, and he is quite temperamental, so we will go to the right." Yuan Luo and the other two immediately agreed, following Ximen Chuixue in a different direction.
Ru Yanyue then asked again.
"If they don't like humans, why did they approach Zhang Fei?
Isn't he human like us?"
Ying Shanhu was also curious about it, especially since he could see that the people from the beast and natural races were trying to draw Zhang Fei to their side.
Ximen Chuixue and Yan Luo naturally knew their reasons, but they had no intention of disclosing his other two identities to their friends.
Meanwhile, a small man kept grumbling in his heart, especially since he was locked up alone in a prison.
No matter how hard he tried to destroy the place, the walls and iron in front of him absorbed all his attacks.
Moreover, there was a puzzle that appeared in front of the door, so he had no choice but to solve it first before he could leave the place.
The man was none other than Jin Dabao, the dwarf.
"Damn it!
If I hadn't been separated from Long Chen and Xian Jinglan, I wouldn't have been locked up in this miserable place."
The ceiling of the room suddenly opened by itself, and two women immediately fell into it, surprising Jin Dabao.
*Bam...
Bam...*
"Ouch!" One of the women screamed after falling on her buttocks.
The other woman immediately cursed loudly.
"Shit!
Those damn beasts!
If they hadn't chased us, we wouldn't have fallen into that trap!"
The two women looked around, but they were surprised to find Jin Dabao in the room. 'Tch!
What kind of creature is he?
Why is his body so tiny?'
Jin Dabao paid them no mind.
"Hey!
If you two want to go out, you guys better help me solve this puzzle, or we'll rot in this place."
The two women were Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei, who were separated from their two brothers.
Although they did not like Jin Dabao, they also did not want to continue being trapped in that place, so they began to help him solve the puzzle.
Huangfu Xiaoying then asked him.
"How long have you been trapped in this place?"
"A few hours." Jin Dabao then turned to them.
"Don't talk too much and focus on solving this puzzle."
'Tch!
This old bastard!' Huangfu Xiaoying only dared to curse in her heart because Jin Dabao was stronger than her and her sister.
Although Huangfu Xiaomei remained silent, Jin Dabao's attitude also annoyed her. 'Tch!
If we are able to escape this location and reunite with our brothers, I will kill this old bastard directly.'

paragraphs: In another area, Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan continued to run forward, especially since countless beast rats were chasing behind them.

At first, there weren't many beast rats, so they killed them right away. Beyond their expectations, the beasts kept multiplying every time they killed them, and their numbers became even greater, so they decided to escape.
They were confused as they could not find the end of the path despite running for a considerable amount of time, which led them to realize that they had fallen into one of the maze's traps.
"What should we do now, Big Brother? We'll be exhausted if we can't find the way out soon, and we can't kill these rats either." Huangfu Xiaofan asked.

Huangfu Lian didn't respond to his little brother, and he kept running forward as his eyes scanned every area they passed, looking for a way out of the trap. After searching for quite some time, he discovered the areas they passed were completely similar, which made him realize that they had been running in the same place all this time. "Damn it! I've never been trapped in a trap like this before, and this place is like an endless loop."
"Big Brother! Look up ahead!"

Huangfu Lian frowned after reading the words that appeared there, but he immediately stopped and took out his weapon, especially since the instructions said that they had to kill the beast rats until there were none left in order to get out of that place. "Let's fight them, Xiaofan!"

In another room, many humans are pinned to the wall. Two people in front of them, who were none other than Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang, smiled with satisfaction after killing them. "These humans are too weak, Brother. We don't even need ten percent of our strength to kill them."

"Yeah." Ximen Hongwu nodded in agreement with that. "From their clothes, they should be Huangfu Kingdom's people, so killing them doesn't matter. Huangfu Shou is too powerful, and our father still doesn't dare to attack him and his kingdom because of a powerful person behind him."
Ximen Yueliang tilted her head to her brother. "Who exactly is that person? How could there be a cultivator stronger than our father in our realm?"

"No one knows the identity of that person." Ximen Hongwu then guided his sister along the path to their left. "That person once appeared in front of our father and uncle, but they couldn't see that person's face or figure, so they didn't know whether the person was a man or a woman. That person could suppress them to the point where they couldn't move a single finger, so they suspected that the person came from the upper realms, but they couldn't be sure of that person's purpose in coming to our realm."

"The upper realms?" Ximen Yueliang muttered with a frown. "If that person is really that powerful, that person shouldn't need to care about affairs in our realm, right? Do you think there is something in our realm that interests that person?"

Ximen Hongwu shrugged in response. "As far as I know, only this tower is the most interesting in our realm, but I have never heard news of that person appearing here, so I am confused about that person's purpose in supporting Huangfu Shou. Anyway, we don't need to think about that person, especially since we're clearly not his or her opponent."

"Yeah, you're right." A while later, they arrived at the next room, where they found a man lying on the ground unconscious with his body covered in blood. The two immediately checked his condition after they recognized his identity, which was none other than Zhou Tai. "Brother, he's still alive, but his condition is critical."

Ximen Hongwu immediately took out a pill and forced Zhou Tai to swallow it. "If he weren't Zhou Xiaochuan's son, I would leave him to die here. The pill will stabilize his condition, but I don't think he will be able to continue this challenge with such injuries."

"Hehe." Ximen Yueliang chuckled. "Zhou Xiaochuan is our father's puppet, and he would have killed him long ago if he didn't need slaves to get rid of the other kingdoms, so it shouldn't be a problem if we let this guy die here."

Ximen Hongwu shook his head at his sister's ignorance, but he couldn't blame her either, especially since she never interfered in royal affairs. "Zhou Fang has been eliminated, and Zhou Tai is in such a condition, so there is only Zhou Meiling left to accompany Zhou Tong. However, that girl and the people of their kingdom are too weak, so they won't be able to help him. Let's take a break first."

"Yeah, I'm tired too." Ximen Yueliang then sat down, leaning against one of the walls. "This challenge is really boring! We've been walking for hours and gone through many obstacles, but we still haven't reached the inner area."

"In the last challenge, it took me and the others more than two weeks to get out of here." Ximen Yueliang was surprised to hear that. "Moreover, this maze has undergone a lot of changes, and we're not gathered together like in previous challenges, so it might take us a little longer."
Ximen Yueliang released a heavy sigh before closing her eyes. "Protect me, brother. I want to sleep sometime."

Meanwhile, Zhou Tong continued to explore the maze alone, but he felt frustrated because he could not find his brother and sister. Additionally, he frequently encountered beasts at the heaven and sovereign ranks, which further irritated him.
After being unconscious for quite some time, Qian Ying finally opened her eyes. She immediately felt a sharp pain in her head, and everything in front of her seemed to be spinning.

Qian Ying immediately used her qi to relieve her nausea, but she found herself completely naked and in another room. She immediately got off the stone bed and surveyed the surrounding area, discovering a variety of strange equipment she had never seen before. "What kind of place is this? Where does all this equipment come from?"
Qian Ying then took a spare dress from her storage ring and wore it before walking out through the only door, where she found many people inside.

"These people are people from the five human kingdoms." Qian Ying then looked for Ximen Yan and Bai Shouyi, but she couldn't find either of them among the people, so she went to the next room and found her master there.
Qian Ying immediately stopped in her spot after she sensed that Ximen Yan was not himself, and he appeared to be under control.

"Hehehe! I didn't expect you to wake up faster than I thought after you were exposed to the toxic substance." Ximen Yan spoke, emitted an eerie laugh, and turned to face Qian Ying. "You guessed right that I control this guy, and I did it because my body was destroyed a long time ago, so I will use his body for a while to escape from this place."
"What are you going to do to my master?" Qian Ying asked nervously.
"Nothing." Ximen Yan replied with a shake of his head. "After I get out of here, I will leave this guy's body, and I will look for a stronger body to replace it."
Qian Ying raised her eyebrow. "Where is Bai Shouyi?"

"I didn't find the person you meant, and I only found the two of you in the trap room." Ximen Yan then walked into the previous room. "As for these people, I didn't bring them here but someone else. They previously fell into a trap and became unconscious like you and this guy, and they will wake up by themselves after some time."
Qian Ying naturally didn't care about those people. "Who exactly are you?"

"They call me Ma Kuangyu, and those traitors sent me here, but I won't explain the details to you." Ximen Yan then led Qian Ying away. "Let's go; we have to find a way to leave this cursed place as soon as possible."
In one room, several people sat together and discussed their next plans, especially since they were separated from their group and there were not many of them.
'What do you think about that, Li Yao? You are our leader, so I will follow your decision.' A young man asked via a voice transmission.
'I agree with them, Guo Jihai.' Li Yao replied with a nod of agreement. 'There are only ten of us here now, and we already know each other, so it's fine if we go together.'

Guo Jihai then speaks to his fiancée, Su Zhen. 'Prince Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin are good people, so we don't need to worry about him. However, we must exercise caution around Prince Xian Yu and Prince Xian Mu due to their notoriety and their father's involvement with the Dark Demon Kingdom. Therefore, I want you to stay close to my side.'

Su Zhen herself had heard about it a long time ago, so she immediately agreed. Moreover, she could see that Xian Yu and Xian Mu were repeatedly stealing glances at her and Li Yao, giving her a bad feeling. 'All right, I won't be far from you. Then, what about their three friends?'
"I'll kill them if they touch you or Li Yao." Su Zhen smiled upon hearing that and rested her head on Guo Jihai's shoulder. 'Hey, how about we get married after we get back from this tower?'
Su Zhen was surprised by his proposal, but they had been lovers for years. 'In that case, you should ask your parents to talk to my parents, and I will marry you afterward.'
'Haha! ' Guo Jihai laughed and hugged his fiancée tightly.

Although they were interested in seizing Su Zhen and Li Yao, Xian Yu and Xian Mu did not think much about them. Instead, their minds were more focused on meeting Zhang Fei as soon as possible, and they wanted to persuade him to join their side so they could use him to weaken Xian Feng and his family.
'Do you think that guy will be willing to join us, Big Brother?' Xian Mu asked.

Xian Yu immediately shook his head in response. 'That guy has a close relationship with Xian Xianqi, and they seem to be exploring their relationship to become lovers, so I'm not sure he will be willing to join us. Even so, we will try to persuade him, and we can ask our father to do something for him if he refuses us.'

'Our mother previously told me that Zhang Fei owns a restaurant in the capital, and several women there have close relationships with him, so she has sent people to monitor them in order to find his residence.' Xian Yu himself also learned this information from their mother. 'Hey, big brother, are we going to make a move on Li Yao and Su Zhen soon?'
Xian Yu glanced at the two women before shaking his head. 'We should not rush, and we will wait for the right time to seize them.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

Along with the appearance of the two notifications, Zhang Fei heard the sound of mechanical gears from the three walls in the room, especially after he and the two princesses managed to complete the three puzzles. Instantly, the three walls disappeared upwards, and three new paths appeared in front of them. "You can choose one, Princess Xianqin."
"This way." Xian Xianqin pointed to the path in front of her.

"Let's go then." Zhang Fei immediately led them away through that path, but they arrived at a dead-end room with a treasure chest in the middle. Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately approached it and opened it, where they found various items, such as jewels, elemental crystals, and several others. "Are these treasure chests always available in this maze?"
"Yes." Yun Xinyue then told him. "Back then, we found millions of jewels of various colors, and we also found many precious pills, which were very helpful for our cultivation."
Xian Xianqin also informed him. "We found a soul weapon in our last challenge, but it didn't choose me or Xianwu; it chose Bai Tian'er."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei was truly surprised at that. "Hey! Finding a soul weapon is not as simple as finding a cabbage, but if we manage to find one during this challenge, we will be extremely fortunate. Therefore, we will continue to search for other treasures.'

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue giggled as they listened to him. "This maze has a limited number of treasure chests, with only five located in the outer, inner, and center areas. Moreover, there are still quite a lot of participants left, and some of them may have found the others. That's why we shouldn't have too much hope of finding them, and we will find them if we are lucky."

"Yeah, you two are right." After he stored all the items inside the treasure chest in the system inventory, Zhang Fei immediately led them back to the previous room. They proceeded through one of the other doors, only to find themselves in an empty, dead-end room, forcing them to turn back.
Zhang Fei then led them through the last door until they arrived at the three-way intersection, but he sensed something from the path on the left, so he immediately led them there.
When they arrived there, they found a young woman lying naked in an unconscious state, and they immediately recognized her identity because she was Bai Shouyi.
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue exchanged confused glances as they felt strange about Bai Shaoyi's situation. They then glanced at Zhang Fei, but he was unfazed by her naked body.

'Why did she suddenly appear here? Did those people bring her to me on purpose? Why did they do that?' Zhang Fei immediately went over to Bai Shouyi, crouched down beside her, and checked her condition. "I don't know what happened to her, but I found a strange substance in her body. It didn't harm her life, but it paralyzed her."
"Can you remove it from her body?" Xian Xianqin inquired as she and Yun Xinyue walked beside him.

"I'll try it." Zhang Fei then sat Bai Shouyi down before sitting behind her. He then pressed his palm against her back, locked the poison inside her body with his senses, and channeled his fire qi into it to evaporate it.
"Ugh!" Bai Shouyi let out a soft groan as her body started to turn red from Zhang Fei's fire qi, and sweat started to pour down her body.
An hour later, Zhang Fei had already pulled his hand back, and Bai Shouyi collapsed onto his chest.

"Princess Xinyue, your body is the same size as Bai Shouyi's, so you can lend her your spare dress." Yun Xinyue nodded and took out a spare dress, and Xian Xianqin helped her put it on Bai Shouyi. After she was fully dressed, Zhang Fei immediately carried the Bai Princess on his back and led them to leave the place, and they then walked away through the last path. "Are you both considering taking action against this woman? After all, she is the princess of the Bai Kingdom, and her kingdom poses a threat to your two kingdoms. She even tried to kill you during the battle challenge, Princess Xinyue."

"No." Both women immediately shook their heads at Zhang Fei. "We are not cowards, and we would never do anything to someone defenseless. Moreover, we have heard from our parents that Huangfu Shou only controls her parents, so she and her siblings should be innocent."

Zhang Fei himself knew nothing about the situation in the Bai Kingdom, so he chose not to comment on it. "You guys said that we only need three keys to get out of this maze, so the other two keys should be in the inner and center areas, right?"

"That's right." Both women nodded at him. "We can only find the other two keys in the two areas, so we must head to the inner area soon to find the second key. Unfortunately, this maze is much more complicated than before, so I think it will take a few days to reach the inner area."

"That's okay. We don't have to rush, and who knows, we might find another treasure chest." Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue shook their heads at Zhang Fei's response, but they also hoped to find the other treasure chests.
