Su Zhen was surprised by his proposal, but they had been lovers for years. 'In that case, you should ask your parents to talk to my parents, and I will marry you afterward.'
'Haha! ' Guo Jihai laughed and hugged his fiancée tightly.
Although they were interested in seizing Su Zhen and Li Yao, Xian Yu and Xian Mu did not think much about them.
Instead, their minds were more focused on meeting Zhang Fei as soon as possible, and they wanted to persuade him to join their side so they could use him to weaken Xian Feng and his family.
'Do you think that guy will be willing to join us, Big Brother?' Xian Mu asked.

Xian Yu immediately shook his head in response. 'That guy has a close relationship with Xian Xianqi, and they seem to be exploring their relationship to become lovers, so I'm not sure he will be willing to join us.
Even so, we will try to persuade him, and we can ask our father to do something for him if he refuses us.'

'Our mother previously told me that Zhang Fei owns a restaurant in the capital, and several women there have close relationships with him, so she has sent people to monitor them in order to find his residence.' Xian Yu himself also learned this information from their mother. 'Hey, big brother, are we going to make a move on Li Yao and Su Zhen soon?'
Xian Yu glanced at the two women before shaking his head. 'We should not rush, and we will wait for the right time to seize them.'
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

Along with the appearance of the two notifications, Zhang Fei heard the sound of mechanical gears from the three walls in the room, especially after he and the two princesses managed to complete the three puzzles.
Instantly, the three walls disappeared upwards, and three new paths appeared in front of them.
"You can choose one, Princess Xianqin."
"This way." Xian Xianqin pointed to the path in front of her.
"Let's go then." Zhang Fei immediately led them away through that path, but they arrived at a dead-end room with a treasure chest in the middle.
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue immediately approached it and opened it, where they found various items, such as jewels, elemental crystals, and several others.
"Are these treasure chests always available in this maze?"
"Yes." Yun Xinyue then told him.
"Back then, we found millions of jewels of various colors, and we also found many precious pills, which were very helpful for our cultivation."
Xian Xianqin also informed him.
"We found a soul weapon in our last challenge, but it didn't choose me or Xianwu; it chose Bai Tian'er."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was truly surprised at that.
"Hey!
Finding a soul weapon is not as simple as finding a cabbage, but if we manage to find one during this challenge, we will be extremely fortunate.
Therefore, we will continue to search for other treasures.'
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue giggled as they listened to him.
"This maze has a limited number of treasure chests, with only five located in the outer, inner, and center areas.
Moreover, there are still quite a lot of participants left, and some of them may have found the others.
That's why we shouldn't have too much hope of finding them, and we will find them if we are lucky."
"Yeah, you two are right." After he stored all the items inside the treasure chest in the system inventory, Zhang Fei immediately led them back to the previous room.
They proceeded through one of the other doors, only to find themselves in an empty, dead-end room, forcing them to turn back.
Zhang Fei then led them through the last door until they arrived at the three-way intersection, but he sensed something from the path on the left, so he immediately led them there.
When they arrived there, they found a young woman lying naked in an unconscious state, and they immediately recognized her identity because she was Bai Shouyi.
Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue exchanged confused glances as they felt strange about Bai Shaoyi's situation.
They then glanced at Zhang Fei, but he was unfazed by her naked body.
'Why did she suddenly appear here?
Did those people bring her to me on purpose?
Why did they do that?' Zhang Fei immediately went over to Bai Shouyi, crouched down beside her, and checked her condition.
"I don't know what happened to her, but I found a strange substance in her body.
It didn't harm her life, but it paralyzed her."
"Can you remove it from her body?" Xian Xianqin inquired as she and Yun Xinyue walked beside him.
"I'll try it." Zhang Fei then sat Bai Shouyi down before sitting behind her.
He then pressed his palm against her back, locked the poison inside her body with his senses, and channeled his fire qi into it to evaporate it.
"Ugh!" Bai Shouyi let out a soft groan as her body started to turn red from Zhang Fei's fire qi, and sweat started to pour down her body.
An hour later, Zhang Fei had already pulled his hand back, and Bai Shouyi collapsed onto his chest.
"Princess Xinyue, your body is the same size as Bai Shouyi's, so you can lend her your spare dress." Yun Xinyue nodded and took out a spare dress, and Xian Xianqin helped her put it on Bai Shouyi.
After she was fully dressed, Zhang Fei immediately carried the Bai Princess on his back and led them to leave the place, and they then walked away through the last path.
"Are you both considering taking action against this woman?
After all, she is the princess of the Bai Kingdom, and her kingdom poses a threat to your two kingdoms.
She even tried to kill you during the battle challenge, Princess Xinyue."
"No." Both women immediately shook their heads at Zhang Fei.
"We are not cowards, and we would never do anything to someone defenseless.
Moreover, we have heard from our parents that Huangfu Shou only controls her parents, so she and her siblings should be innocent."
Zhang Fei himself knew nothing about the situation in the Bai Kingdom, so he chose not to comment on it.
"You guys said that we only need three keys to get out of this maze, so the other two keys should be in the inner and center areas, right?"
"That's right." Both women nodded at him.
"We can only find the other two keys in the two areas, so we must head to the inner area soon to find the second key.
Unfortunately, this maze is much more complicated than before, so I think it will take a few days to reach the inner area."
"That's okay.

We don't have to rush, and who knows, we might find another treasure chest." Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue shook their heads at Zhang Fei's response, but they also hoped to find the other treasure chests.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 Illusion Trap
paragraphs: After his subordinates were ready, Zhang Fei [4] immediately summoned Zilvora, Orith, and Balena to meet him at the tower. Nauvia was completely shocked by their appearance, especially considering that the three female demons were far stronger than her, surpassing even the strength of Oz the Second, Zygoz, and Tharnon.

After he introduced the three of them to Nauvia, Zhang Fei [4] immediately took all of them to the Netherworld Realm. At first, he didn't plan to bring You Han with them, but he changed his mind and brought her along.

Once they got there, Zhang Fei [4] took all of them to the former incubus tower, but it was now changed to Elion Tower, which was Orith's idea. He then explained to his subordinates, Kyllia, Naeth, and others, how to absorb the demon aura in that realm, and he also provided them with his Yang Qi to strengthen their bodies further.

Additionally, Zhang Fei [4] also picked up his brother-in-law and Yan Zhixiu from the ghostveil forest to live in his tower so that they wouldn't feel lonely in that realm. However, Zhang Wuji felt awkward living with over a hundred female demons, so he chose to occupy a building right outside the tower.
Zhang Fei [4] initially intended to take Nauvia to the succubi tower, but she declined due to her dislike of the lust demon races, so he left her there.

After they left, Feltia [2] immediately appeared at Elion Tower, bringing the demons who always lived in the training space, such as the Amaris Twins, Eve, Fyr, Ashreth, Leora, Ursula, Nadea, Angela, Virgil, and Nadea.

Although the eleven female demons have become demon cultivators, they still need the demon aura to increase their demon rank and power. Moreover, they have long adapted to level three of the gravity feature, but they are still unable to train at level four.
"Hey, Elion! You haven't explained to us how you can move between realms."
Zhang Fei[4] immediately turned to Zilvora. "I am a demon cultivator, which sets me apart from ordinary demons like the three of you, and I possess some special abilities."
Zhang Fei [4]'s revelation not only shocked Zilvora but also shocked Orith. On the other hand, Balena was not surprised by it, as she had guessed from the first time she met him.
Orith immediately hugged his arm. "Does that mean we can become demon cultivators?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei[4] nodded to them. "You guys have cultivation veins, so you can become demon cultivators. However, you can't cultivate here, and you have to go to other realms to cultivate."

"Then, take us to another realm to cultivate." Zilvora and Orith eagerly anticipated the opportunity to become demon cultivators, as it would enhance their strength. As for Balena, she didn't think much about that, and she thought more about returning to her home realm, the Blue Water Realm.

"I've considered taking you all to another realm, but the majority of humans in the realms I'm familiar with harbor animosity toward demons. In addition, most of them are stronger than you and would kill you all if they noticed your presence in their realm." Zilvora and Orith's expressions turned gloomy after hearing that. "However, I have thought of a suitable place for you guys, and I am thinking of bringing you there."
"Where?"

"The realm behind the portal in the Dead Forest." As soon as Zhang Fei [4] said that, Zilvora and Orith's eyes widened, particularly because the horror of the guardian protecting the portal was still fresh in their minds. "As I said before, I have some special abilities, and you have also witnessed my speed, so I am confident I can take you guys past the guardian easily."
"Why do you suddenly want to go to that realm?" Zilvorta asked doubtfully. "Back then, I asked you to help me save the other demon kings and queens, but you rejected me."

Zhang Fei [4] pulled Zilvora and gave her a brief kiss. "Do you still not understand why I refuse to help you? I want you, but I can't beat you in a fight, and I'm sure you'll come to me if I refuse you."
Unlike Zilvora, who was dumbfounded, Orith laughed out loud at Zhang Fei [4]'s answer. "Hahaha! In the end, she came to you and became your woman."

"Tch!" Zilvora gritted her teeth in annoyance as she recalled the day she fell into her hands. Even so, she no longer regretted it, especially after she had sex with him too many times. "Can you take us there now?"
"Easy." Zhang Fei [4] immediately used the warp portal. "Once you enter, we will immediately arrive at the Dead Forest, and I will take you guys to that realm directly."
"Wait! I have to tell my subordinates first." Orith immediately contacted several of her subordinates to take care of the tower while she was away. "Let's go now!"
After a while, they reached the Dead Forest, where Zhang Fei [4] tied his tails to their waists and brought them into invisible states.

After arriving a little away from the portal's location, Zilvora and Orith trembled violently upon seeing the guardian. Zhang Fei [4] immediately used his teleportation, moved in front of the portal, and brought the three female demons into it.
Upon sensing activity from the portal, the guardian immediately opened its eyes, but it was too late as they had already entered it.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Azure Sky Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.] (A/N: This realm is not important, so I won't write much about what happens there.)
"Hey! Are our demon emperor and Ilsath in this realm?" Orith immediately asked.

'This realm doesn't have any quests or system upgrades, huh?' Zhang Fei [4] then nodded to Orith. "They should be in this realm, but this realm is much larger than the Netherworld Realm, so we need time to find them. For now, we will find a quiet place, and I will teach the three of you to become demon cultivators. After that, we will start looking for the two of them."

The three female demons agreed with him, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately looked for a quiet place on the map. In a few seconds, they arrived at an uninhabited area, but there was a natural cave there, so he led them inside and guided them to become demon cultivators.
After they started cultivating, Zhang Fei [4] immediately looked for Ilsath and Azaroth's location. 'Oh? After they become demon cultivators, I'll take them here since they're nearby.'

Zhang Fei and the others leisurely walked along the path in front of them, but they looked bored, especially since it was much longer than the paths they had walked before. "Have you ever walked this long path before?"
Xian Xianxin immediately told him. "Back then, we accidentally stepped into one of the traps in this maze, and it sent us down a very long path, which took us about two days to get through."

"Your group was really lucky back then, Xianqin." Yun Xinyue then shared her experience. "Back then, my group accidentally walked into a trap, and we were caught in an endless loop, which took us so long to complete the maze challenge. We also had to clean up the beasts, whose numbers multiplied exponentially each time we killed them."
"How did you guys get over that hurdle back then?"

Yun Xinyue released a heavy sigh. "Big Brother Aoxian realized that we made a fatal mistake by killing them one by one, so he instructed us to use area attacks to kill them all at once. We finally managed to get through that obstacle, but we spent four to five days trapped inside."
"I see." Zhang Fei suddenly spotted a light ahead of them. "We're almost there."

"Let's go there!" Zhang Fei and Xianqin followed Yun Xinyue, who took the lead by running ahead of them. However, they halted at the room's entrance upon discovering several demon corpses inside, their bodies in a dismembered state. "They are demons from the Ximen Demon Kingdoms."
"Based on their corpses, it appears that they suffered a terrible death." Xian Xianqin said with a frown. "Moreover, there is no other way here, so I think whatever killed them is still inside."
[Master, the system did not detect anything in that room.]

'That's weird! How could they die like this?' Zhang Fei swiftly lowered Bai Shouyi from his back and retrieved his divine-grade sword. "I'll check inside, and I'll teleport out immediately if there's any danger inside."

Zhang Fei carefully entered the room, but nothing happened, so he rushed to the center of the room. However, a net of light elements quickly descended from the ceiling, prompting him to teleport out of the room immediately.

Both women were shocked to see that, but they were also relieved after the net disappeared to the ground. Xian Xianqin then pointed to the tiger head statue in the middle of the opposite wall. "Fei, I think we should activate it to open the next path."
"I agree with you." Zhang Fei then looked at the tiger head statue seriously, finding a button in its mouth. "The button to activate it is hidden in the mouth, so I'll go there to activate it."

Zhang Fei immediately teleported in front of the tiger head statue, but three light nets suddenly appeared from above and on the two walls on both sides. He hurriedly inserted his hand into the mouth and pressed the button, causing the three of them to disappear instantly.
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Quickly, the wall in front of Zhang Fei sank into the ground, revealing a staircase leading to the upper floor. Upon seeing this, the two women immediately lifted and supported Bai Shouyi, bringing her to his side. However, he immediately took the unconscious woman from their hands and carried her on his back again. "Let's go."

In less than half an hour, they had already arrived at the next room, but a small wave of wind immediately swept past them as soon as they entered it, causing their eyes to go blank and fall to the floor.
However, Zhang Fei's eyes immediately returned to normal thanks to the illusion negation he mimicked from the black Amaris, so he was freed right away from the illusion.
Unfortunately, the fate of the women was not as good as Zhang Fei's, and they were already trapped in the illusion, including Bai Shouyi, who was still unconscious.

Zhang Fei immediately checked their conditions, but he was unable to release them from the illusion, especially since the illusion negation only applied to him. Even his light element failed to wake them, so he moved them to the side and waited for them to wake up on their own.
Zhang Fei immediately took out the book without a title before opening each page. 'What is the result of your analysis of this book, Mei?'
[Master, the system cannot analyze the book, so I do not know its benefits, and you may have to find a special method to bring out the writing inside.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow in thought, but then he tried to channel his four elements into the book. Unfortunately, the book showed no reaction, so he took a bottle of water from the inventory and poured it on it, but his efforts were once again in vain. 'Hmm? Could it be that this book is an artifact?'

To prove his guess, Zhang Fei bit his thumb and dripped his blood onto the book, but it still showed no reaction. 'What the hell with this book? Why isn't it showing anything? What should I use to activate it?'
[Why don't you try burning it, Master?]

After a moment of frowning, Zhang Fei remembered a method from a novel he had read in the past and immediately opened his palm to use his fire qi. He then placed the book on his dark flames, but his flames were unable to burn it; instead, it floated away. 'Hmm? Don't tell me it has consciousness.'

Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's guess was wrong, and the book immediately fell into the distance. He immediately sucked the book back into his hand and thought of another way to make the writing appear, but he couldn't think of any other way, so he put the book away again.

"The book should come from those realms, and I might be able to find a way to make the writing appear there." Zhang Fei then turned to the three women and let out a heavy sigh, especially since he didn't know when they would break free from the illusion.

Xian Xianqin became irritated upon realizing she had been trapped in an illusion, particularly considering she had already fallen into the two previous traps. She frowned as soon as her parents appeared before her eyes, but two black swords suddenly pierced their bodies from behind, and their blood sprayed on her.
Xian Xianqin was unfazed by that, but she felt even more annoyed after seeing the woman holding those two swords, especially since she was Qian Ying.
"Hehe." Qian Ying laughed after she pulled the two swords out of Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang's bodies, pointing both at Xian Xianqin. "This time, it's your turn to die, Little Princess."
*Boom*

As Xian Xianqin pulled out her green sword, her aura erupted. She immediately slashed it toward Qian Ying, but she quickly dodged it. "If I hadn't overcome my demon heart, I might have believed that you were real. Unfortunately, I have overcome my demon heart, so you better not waste my time and release me from this illusion."
"Are you sure that this is just an illusion?" Immediately, Qian Ying vanished from in front of Xian Xianqin, then reappeared behind her, stabbing both daggers toward her back.

Xian Xianqin immediately spun around, deflected Qian Ying's daggers, and kicked her stomach, sending her flying backward. "I've been friends with her for so long, and she's tried to kill me many times, so I'm very familiar with her attack patterns."

Qian Ying immediately disappeared from that place, but Xian Xianqin was stunned when two men appeared in front of her, and both of them were naked. 'Whoever is controlling this illusion is obviously a pervert who would show me such a sight!'

Xian Xianqin's face reddened at the sight of their lower bodies, but she immediately ignored that and charged toward the two. She slashed them with her sword straight away, causing both of them to disappear.
However, the test for Xian Xianqin didn't stop there, and various other figures repeatedly appeared before him no matter how hard he destroyed them. "Tch! This is really a waste of my time!"

Unlike Xian Xianqin, Yun Xinyue encountered difficulties within the illusion. Her body trembled violently as she witnessed the death of her parents and family in front of her, causing her tears to flow freely from her eyes.

Unfortunately, Yun Xinyue's nightmare didn't end there; the illusion showed her the destruction of the Yun Kingdom, with an army of demons slaughtering its entire populace. Flames and black smoke covered the entire area of the kingdom, causing her to start suffering from a mental breakdown.
Yun Xinyue fell to the ground and cried as loud as she could. "Stop! Please! Stop it! Don't kill them!"

Bai Shouyi continued to tremble and cry, particularly due to the fact that she was naked and tied to the wall. Moreover, Ximen Yan, who was also naked, stood in front of her, his expression so lustful that he was eager to pounce at her. "No! No! Don't do it! Don't violate me!"
"Hahaha!" Ximen Yan laughed as he approached Bai Shouyi. "Are you ready to surrender yourself to me, Little Princess?"
"No! Please don't do that to me." Bai Shouyi continued to cry as she begged.
Ximen Yan ignored Bai Shouyi's pleas and tried to touch her body, but a white light suddenly shot out of it and hit him directly.

In an instant, the situation in that place changed. Bai Shouyi fell to the ground, and clothes already covered her body. She looked around the area in a daze before wiping away her tears. "Have I been caught in an illusion?"

Unfortunately, the fate of the women was not as good as Zhang Fei's, and they were already trapped in the illusion, including Bai Shouyi, who was still unconscious.
Zhang Fei immediately checked their conditions, but he was unable to release them from the illusion, especially since the illusion negation only applied to him.
Even his light element failed to wake them, so he moved them to the side and waited for them to wake up on their own.
Zhang Fei immediately took out the book without a title before opening each page. 'What is the result of your analysis of this book, Mei?'
[Master, the system cannot analyze the book, so I do not know its benefits, and you may have to find a special method to bring out the writing inside.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow in thought, but then he tried to channel his four elements into the book.
Unfortunately, the book showed no reaction, so he took a bottle of water from the inventory and poured it on it, but his efforts were once again in vain. 'Hmm?
Could it be that this book is an artifact?'
To prove his guess, Zhang Fei bit his thumb and dripped his blood onto the book, but it still showed no reaction. 'What the hell with this book?
Why isn't it showing anything?
What should I use to activate it?'
[Why don't you try burning it, Master?]
After a moment of frowning, Zhang Fei remembered a method from a novel he had read in the past and immediately opened his palm to use his fire qi.
He then placed the book on his dark flames, but his flames were unable to burn it; instead, it floated away. 'Hmm?
Don't tell me it has consciousness.'
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's guess was wrong, and the book immediately fell into the distance.
He immediately sucked the book back into his hand and thought of another way to make the writing appear, but he couldn't think of any other way, so he put the book away again.

"The book should come from those realms, and I might be able to find a way to make the writing appear there." Zhang Fei then turned to the three women and let out a heavy sigh, especially since he didn't know when they would break free from the illusion.
Xian Xianqin became irritated upon realizing she had been trapped in an illusion, particularly considering she had already fallen into the two previous traps.
She frowned as soon as her parents appeared before her eyes, but two black swords suddenly pierced their bodies from behind, and their blood sprayed on her.
Xian Xianqin was unfazed by that, but she felt even more annoyed after seeing the woman holding those two swords, especially since she was Qian Ying.
"Hehe." Qian Ying laughed after she pulled the two swords out of Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang's bodies, pointing both at Xian Xianqin.
"This time, it's your turn to die, Little Princess."
*Boom*
As Xian Xianqin pulled out her green sword, her aura erupted.
She immediately slashed it toward Qian Ying, but she quickly dodged it.
"If I hadn't overcome my demon heart, I might have believed that you were real.
Unfortunately, I have overcome my demon heart, so you better not waste my time and release me from this illusion."
"Are you sure that this is just an illusion?" Immediately, Qian Ying vanished from in front of Xian Xianqin, then reappeared behind her, stabbing both daggers toward her back.
Xian Xianqin immediately spun around, deflected Qian Ying's daggers, and kicked her stomach, sending her flying backward.
"I've been friends with her for so long, and she's tried to kill me many times, so I'm very familiar with her attack patterns."

Qian Ying immediately disappeared from that place, but Xian Xianqin was stunned when two men appeared in front of her, and both of them were naked. 'Whoever is controlling this illusion is obviously a pervert who would show me such a sight!'
Xian Xianqin's face reddened at the sight of their lower bodies, but she immediately ignored that and charged toward the two.
She slashed them with her sword straight away, causing both of them to disappear.
However, the test for Xian Xianqin didn't stop there, and various other figures repeatedly appeared before him no matter how hard he destroyed them.
"Tch!
This is really a waste of my time!"
Unlike Xian Xianqin, Yun Xinyue encountered difficulties within the illusion.
Her body trembled violently as she witnessed the death of her parents and family in front of her, causing her tears to flow freely from her eyes.
Unfortunately, Yun Xinyue's nightmare didn't end there; the illusion showed her the destruction of the Yun Kingdom, with an army of demons slaughtering its entire populace.
Flames and black smoke covered the entire area of the kingdom, causing her to start suffering from a mental breakdown.
Yun Xinyue fell to the ground and cried as loud as she could.
"Stop!
Please!
Stop it!
Don't kill them!"
Bai Shouyi continued to tremble and cry, particularly due to the fact that she was naked and tied to the wall.
Moreover, Ximen Yan, who was also naked, stood in front of her, his expression so lustful that he was eager to pounce at her.
"No!
No!
Don't do it!
Don't violate me!"
"Hahaha!" Ximen Yan laughed as he approached Bai Shouyi.
"Are you ready to surrender yourself to me, Little Princess?"
"No!
Please don't do that to me." Bai Shouyi continued to cry as she begged.
Ximen Yan ignored Bai Shouyi's pleas and tried to touch her body, but a white light suddenly shot out of it and hit him directly.
In an instant, the situation in that place changed.
Bai Shouyi fell to the ground, and clothes already covered her body.
She looked around the area in a daze before wiping away her tears.
"Have I been caught in an illusion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 571 Small Meeting
paragraphs: "Shouyi."
Hearing such a familiar voice startled Bai Shouyi, and her expression softened when she saw the old man's figure in front of her; even her eyes filled with longing.
"Grandpa!" Bai Shouyi immediately stood up and ran towards the old man, but her body passed right through him.

The old man immediately turned to her. "This is just a small part of my soul that I intentionally planted in your soul to prevent unexpected things like what happened just now, so you can't hug me. Even though this place is only an illusion, it will undoubtedly affect you for the rest of your life, which is why my soul immediately moves to protect you."
"Thank you, grandpa." Bai Shouyi then asked. "Does this mean you're still alive?"

"Haha." The old man laughed and nodded to him. "I still live healthily in the upper realms now, but I haven't been able to return to our realms, especially since I and the others became disciples in one of the sects there."
Bai Shouyi was dumbfounded in response to that. "How can you all become disciples again at your age, Grandpa?"

"We are indeed old in our realm, but we are still very young in the upper realms, and many people there are much older than us by several thousand years." Bai Shouyi nodded in understanding before informing the old man about the state of their family and kingdom, a fact that caused him to frown. "Huangfu Shou can't possibly control your parents with his current strength, so I'm sure someone stronger than him is helping him control them. You, Chongxi, and Renfu should leave our kingdom to investigate."
"How can we investigate that matter, Grandpa? Our parents are helpless, and the three of us are far weaker than them, so there's no way we can investigate that matter."

The old man shook his head at her. "You three can't investigate that matter, but there are several other kingdoms besides our kingdom. Xian Feng and Yun Shang might have noticed the problem with Huangfu Shou, so you guys can go to one of them to ask for help, and you can tell them about my guess."

"Grandpa, you've been away for a long time, so you're unaware that our father has continuously assisted Huangfu Shou in attacking them." Bai Shouyi sighed softly before continuing. "I'm uncertain if they, especially Uncle Yun, will be willing to assist us. Moreover, I almost killed Yun Xinyue with my poison during the previous battle challenge, and I'm sure his envoy has reported it to him."

"At least try to meet them first, and you will know the answer after meeting them." Bai Shouyi nodded to the old man. "This soul of mine will disappear soon, and I won't be able to protect you anymore, so you should take better care of yourself."
"Yes, Grandpa."
"All right, I'll use this soul's last power to help you escape this illusion so you can continue the maze challenge." Bai Shouyi disappeared immediately after the old man waved his hand.

Zhang Fei was trying to calm the Yun Princess, who was experiencing a mental breakdown inside the illusion, when she heard Bai Shouyi's soft moan. "Oh? She can break free from the illusion faster than Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, huh?"

Bai Shouyi slowly opened her eyes and looked around the room, but her expression turned to fear when she saw Zhang Fei hugging Yun Xinyue. She quickly stood up and moved away from them, making him smile in amusement. 'Wasn't I kidnapped by that strange tongue before? How can I be here with them now?'
"Why are you that scared?" Zhang Fei asked with a shake of his head. "If I wanted to do something bad to you, I could have done it since I found you passed out naked."
"Huh?" Bai Shouyi was stunned for a moment before stuttering. "You... you saw me naked before?"

"Hey! Even though I saw you naked, I'm not interested in you." Zhang Fei's reply made Bai Shouyi's face turn red with shame and anger at the same time, but she couldn't deny that her figure was inferior when compared to Xian Xianqin or Yun Xinyue. "How did you get in that room in such a situation?"

Bai Shouyi immediately suppressed her anger, sat down at a distance, and explained her previous situation to Zhang Fei. Her explanation convinced him that his previous guess was correct. 'I still don't understand why they sent this woman to me.'

Xian Xianqin suddenly groaned and opened her eyes, and she immediately let out a sigh of relief after seeing the interior of the room. However, she was shocked to hear Yun Xinyue scream in terror; she immediately sat up and turned to face them. "What happened to her? Why did she become like this?"

"Xinyue encountered a terrible illusion, and her weak mental state collapsed because of it." Zhang Fei then told the two women about it based on the words that came out of the Yun Princess's mouth. "I don't have a solution to help her, so we can only wait for her to break free from the illusion. However, I'm not sure if she will be able to continue this challenge with her mental state like this, but we might fail if she gives up because she is part of our group."

"Yeah, you're right." On the one hand, Xian Xianqin was deeply concerned about Yun Xinyue's condition, but on the other hand, she was determined not to fail the challenge. She then turned to Bai Shouyi. "How is your condition? Is your body okay?"
"I'm fine." Bai Shouyi then asked them. "Can you take me with you guys after we're done with our challenges?"

"Why is that?" Bai Shouyi immediately informed Xian Xianqin about her conversation with her grandfather during the illusion, a revelation that surprised both the Xian Princess and Zhang Fei. "What do you think about that, Fei?"

Zhang Fei immediately considered and weighed all the options. "I think it's okay if we bring her with us, but we can't do it outside, especially since Huangfu Shou's people are also in this tower. Unfortunately, I cannot do anything at the moment, but if the survival challenge rules and formations remain unchanged, I may be able to do something."
"How are you going to do it?"
"How can you take me away?"

"I can't explain it now, and we'll find out the results during the survival challenge." Suddenly, a path opened up on the north wall after Yun Xinyue stopped screaming, indicating that she was free from the illusion. However, she immediately fell unconscious because her experience inside was too much for her, but Zhang Fei right away carried her on his back. "Let's move now, especially since we've wasted so much time here."

Both women immediately followed the path behind him, and a quarter of an hour later, they arrived at a room filled with dozens of heaven-rank beasts. However, the situation did not pose a significant challenge for them, as Zhang Fei used his heavenly fox aura to suppress the beasts, and he also used his essence absorption technique to absorb their essences, a move that horrified the Xian and Bai Princesses.
[You gained 500,000 Beast Essences.]

Zhang Fei actually didn't want to use that technique, but he needed more power to protect himself and those around him. He still needed about five million beast essences to evolve his beast form to six-tails. "I know you two are scared, but I have no other choice, and I will continue to use that technique every time we encounter beasts."

Xian Xianqin and Bai Shouyi remained silent, following Zhang Fei until they reached a two-way intersection. They took the left path first but ended up in a collapsed room, so they turned around again and took the right path.

When they reached the next room, Xian Xianqin and Bai Shouyi immediately drew their weapons due to the presence of several demons from the Dark Demon Kingdom. Zhang Fei also took out his sword, but he also used his exorcismus ability because the light element was the main weakness of demons, and the effect of the ability was stronger thanks to his understanding of light element law.

After they had cleared out the demons, they hurriedly continued their journey to the next area. However, the path ahead was filled with trap weapons, and since there was no other way out of the area, Zhang Fei tied his tail to Xian Xianqin and Bai Shouyi's waists before teleporting them several times.

Unlike Bai Shouyi, who was relieved that she didn't have to do anything, Xian Xianqin was extremely frustrated because Zhang Fei had done everything for them. A while later, they arrived at an empty room with only a staircase leading up. They hurriedly climbed up and unexpectedly encountered two people. "I didn't expect to meet the two of you here, Second Prince Long and Senior Xianzi."

"Hehehe." Xi Xianzi laughed before floating toward Zhang Fei and touching Yun Xinyue's forehead. "It appears that this girl has endured a traumatic experience before, but she is fortunate to have met me now, so I will assist her in healing her mental state."
"Thank you."
"No problem." Xi Xianzi immediately withdrew her hand. "She'll wake up soon, so you guys don't need to worry about her anymore."
"Have you all met the others before?" Long Tian inquired.
Zhang Fei pointed to Bai Shouyi. "We found her unconscious in one of the rooms, so we took her with us. Where are First Prince Long and the others? Did you get separated from them?"

"My big brother is currently with Princess Jinglan and Jin Dabao, but I am uncertain about their current situation due to these powerful restrictions." They nodded in understanding, and Long Tian continued. "At first, Xianzi and I entered here together with Zheng Ru, but he made a mistake and fell into a trap, and we still haven't managed to find him."
"Did you guys meet a lot of beasts and demons before?" Xi Xianzi asked.

"We only met beasts three times and demons once, but we encountered a lot of tests, so we wasted a lot of time." Zhang Fei then asked them. "Have you succeeded in finding the key hidden in this outer area?"

"That's for sure!" Xi Xianzi immediately showed them the golden key. "Since we've got our key, it would be best if we started looking for a way into the inner area, especially since I'm getting bored with the situation inside this maze."

Zhang Fei and the others agreed with that, and they rushed to find a route to the inner area of the maze. Unfortunately, it was not easy with the vast area, and they had to face many obstacles, such as beasts, traps, and dead ends.

In another area, Zhou Meiling was annoyed that Bai Renfu was so useless, so she had to spend a lot of qi to clear the obstacles that blocked their way, especially when they encountered beasts and demons. 'Tch! This useless bastard! I should have killed him from the moment we met!'

Bai Renfu was actually afraid of Zhou Meiling, especially since she repeatedly absorbed the life and soul forces of beasts and demons. That's why he deliberately kept his distance from her and saved his qi, as he was afraid that she would suddenly attack him and kill him. 'Tch! This woman looks beautiful on the outside, but her inside is really rotten! I think she got that ability from the demons of both demon kingdoms, especially since her father had a close relationship with them.'
*Drap... Drap...*

Suddenly, they heard the sound of heavy footsteps coming from behind, so they immediately looked back and saw Zheng Ru running quickly toward them. Zhou Meiling smiled faintly as she looked at the giant. "Hey! How-"

Zheng Ru disregarded the two of them and proceeded straight ahead, causing Zhou Meiling to frown and want to chase after him. However, Bai Renfu stopped her immediately. "You must not find trouble with that guy, or we will face serious trouble if the other natural races find out about your actions, and Xian Jinglan will definitely kill us."

Zhou Meiling scowled at Bai Renfu, aware that the people from the natural races, particularly Xian Jinglan, were far stronger than them, so they could not defeat them. "Let's go! We've found the key, so we have to find a way to the inner area as soon as possible."
"Have you ever seen such a beast, Prince Long?" Bai Tian'er posed the question, pointing to the strange beast in the room in front of them.
Xian Jinglan answered him first. "According to Lang, the beast was not born naturally, but it was a combination of several beasts, and it seemed to be the result of human creation."
"Human creation?" Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu were shocked when they heard that. "How could humans create such a beast?"

"I don't care how they managed to do that, but I can't let this beast suffer." Long Chen immediately walked into the room and stood in front of the beast before touching its head. "I am a beast like you, so I understand your feelings, and I will relieve you of your suffering."
The beast nodded slightly, and Long Chen immediately fired his dragon qi into its brain, causing it to fall and die instantly.

"Rest in peace." Long Chen immediately took the golden key from the beast's neck before walking out of the room. "That's why we never liked humans, especially since too many of them were lower than beasts. If my parents hadn't stopped me, I would have led the beasts to slaughter the humans on that island."
Long Chen immediately walked in the other direction ahead of them; his attitude made Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu sigh heavily in their hearts, especially since they were both humans.

"He is a beast, so it is natural for him to be angry when he sees other beasts being treated like that, so you two don't need to take his attitude to heart." Xian Jinglian spoke to the two women as she followed Long Chen. Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu exchanged glances for a moment and followed them directly.
*Clang... Clang...*
After they tried to solve the puzzle for several hours, Jin Dabao and the Huangfu sisters finally managed to solve it, and the door to their prison opened by itself.

Jin Dabao ignored the two women and hurriedly left the room, causing Huangfu Xiaoying and Huanggu Xiaomei to become even more furious with his attitude. However, their vast difference in cultivation rendered them powerless to fight him, and they immediately left the room, heading in the opposite direction to the male dwarf.
Huangfu Xiaoying immediately spoke to her sister. "What should we do now? We can't possibly pass through those obstacles with just the two of us, and we might die if we encounter beasts or demons."

"Do we have any other choice?" Huangfu Xiaomei inquired with a heavy sigh. "If we give up now, then we will fail, and we will not be able to proceed to the next challenge. If that happens, our father will punish us severely once we return to our kingdom, and he might even give us to that mysterious person."
Huangfu Xiaoying shuddered as soon as her sister mentioned that mysterious person. "I would rather die than fall into that person's hands."

"We've wasted time in this prison, so we should move quickly to find the golden key, and we'll find a way to the inner area after that." Both women immediately rushed to the next area, but their fears came true as they encountered a group of demons there. Without thinking twice, Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei immediately activated their protective artifacts and fled the place, but the demons rushed after them.

Fortunately, the goddess of luck was still on their side as a large rock suddenly descended from above, blocking the demons' path. Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei immediately ran at full speed toward the end of the path, arriving at a room with a portal in the middle, which they immediately entered.

"You must not find trouble with that guy, or we will face serious trouble if the other natural races find out about your actions, and Xian Jinglan will definitely kill us."
Zhou Meiling scowled at Bai Renfu, aware that the people from the natural races, particularly Xian Jinglan, were far stronger than them, so they could not defeat them.
"Let's go!
We've found the key, so we have to find a way to the inner area as soon as possible."
"Have you ever seen such a beast, Prince Long?" Bai Tian'er posed the question, pointing to the strange beast in the room in front of them.
Xian Jinglan answered him first.
"According to Lang, the beast was not born naturally, but it was a combination of several beasts, and it seemed to be the result of human creation."
"Human creation?" Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu were shocked when they heard that.
"How could humans create such a beast?"
"I don't care how they managed to do that, but I can't let this beast suffer." Long Chen immediately walked into the room and stood in front of the beast before touching its head.
"I am a beast like you, so I understand your feelings, and I will relieve you of your suffering."
The beast nodded slightly, and Long Chen immediately fired his dragon qi into its brain, causing it to fall and die instantly.
"Rest in peace." Long Chen immediately took the golden key from the beast's neck before walking out of the room.
"That's why we never liked humans, especially since too many of them were lower than beasts.
If my parents hadn't stopped me, I would have led the beasts to slaughter the humans on that island."
Long Chen immediately walked in the other direction ahead of them; his attitude made Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu sigh heavily in their hearts, especially since they were both humans.

"He is a beast, so it is natural for him to be angry when he sees other beasts being treated like that, so you two don't need to take his attitude to heart." Xian Jinglian spoke to the two women as she followed Long Chen.
Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu exchanged glances for a moment and followed them directly.
*Clang...
Clang...*
After they tried to solve the puzzle for several hours, Jin Dabao and the Huangfu sisters finally managed to solve it, and the door to their prison opened by itself.
Jin Dabao ignored the two women and hurriedly left the room, causing Huangfu Xiaoying and Huanggu Xiaomei to become even more furious with his attitude.
However, their vast difference in cultivation rendered them powerless to fight him, and they immediately left the room, heading in the opposite direction to the male dwarf.
Huangfu Xiaoying immediately spoke to her sister.
"What should we do now?
We can't possibly pass through those obstacles with just the two of us, and we might die if we encounter beasts or demons."
"Do we have any other choice?" Huangfu Xiaomei inquired with a heavy sigh.
"If we give up now, then we will fail, and we will not be able to proceed to the next challenge.
If that happens, our father will punish us severely once we return to our kingdom, and he might even give us to that mysterious person."
Huangfu Xiaoying shuddered as soon as her sister mentioned that mysterious person.
"I would rather die than fall into that person's hands."

"We've wasted time in this prison, so we should move quickly to find the golden key, and we'll find a way to the inner area after that." Both women immediately rushed to the next area, but their fears came true as they encountered a group of demons there.
Without thinking twice, Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei immediately activated their protective artifacts and fled the place, but the demons rushed after them.
Fortunately, the goddess of luck was still on their side as a large rock suddenly descended from above, blocking the demons' path.
Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei immediately ran at full speed toward the end of the path, arriving at a room with a portal in the middle, which they immediately entered.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 Resting Area
paragraphs: As they arrived in another room, Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei exchanged glances upon discovering one of their targets. However, they sighed in their hearts, realizing that their target was under the protection of one of the powerful cultivators in their realm. The presence of one of their allies among them surprised both of them. 'Why is Bai Chongxi with Xian Changyue and Xian Xianwu? Is he thinking about betraying us?'

'I don't know.' Huangfu Xiaomei shook her head slightly. 'Anyway, we should keep our attitude for the time being so we can go with them to other areas, making it easier for us to pass this challenge.'
'Damn it! Why do I have to meet them now?' Bai Chongxi inwardly cursed. 'It would be bad if they reported me to their father, and Huangfu Shou would force my father to hand me over to him.'
'Aunt, are you going to take action against them?' Xian Xianwu asked his paternal aunt via a voice transmission.

Xian Changyue briefly glanced at the two women before walking away. 'For now, we don't need to bother with those two girls. It would be better if we looked for the path to the inner area, especially since we have found the first key.'
'All right.' Xian Xianwu immediately followed his aunt.

On the other hand, Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei immediately moved to both sides of Bai Chongxi. They flanked him, interrogated him, and forced him to say his reason for being with the two people in front of them.

Bai Chongxi immediately told them about his adventures in the maze before he met Xian Changyue and Xian Xianwu, but Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei continued to wear suspicious looks. 'It's up to you two to believe me or not, but I've told you the truth. It would be better if we didn't fight them, as that woman is only slightly weaker than our fathers, and she has the power to kill us whenever she wants.'

Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei remained silent in response to Bai Chongxi's warning, particularly because they were already aware of Xian Changyue's strength and would not foolishly seek trouble with her.

After they were trapped in an endless loop and fought countless rat beasts, Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan finally managed to escape from the place. They got a lucky break from their previous misfortune, especially since they immediately arrived at the location of one of the keys, and there was a treasure chest inside.
"Haha." Huangfu Xiaofan laughed with satisfaction after he took the golden key. "What a stroke of luck! Not only did we find the first key, but we also got a lot of valuable treasures."
"Let's go! We have to find our sisters and the path to the inner area." Huangfu Lian promptly placed the treasures in his storage ring and proceeded to walk, with his brother trailing closely behind.

After some time, they reached a new location, coincidentally encountering their greatest adversary, Zhou Tong. Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan became tense as soon as they saw him because his cultivation was several levels above theirs, and they wouldn't necessarily be able to defeat him even if they worked together to fight him.

However, they were fortunate that Zhou Tong was not in the mood to fight, as he was too concerned about the condition of Zhou Meiling and Zhou Tai. As a result, he immediately rushed away from the Huangfu siblings, heading in the opposite direction.

The Huangfu siblings were completely relieved by Zhou Tong's departure, and they immediately went in another direction to avoid fighting him, especially since there were still many challenges left on the first floor of the Star Tower.

Meanwhile, Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu felt relieved because the presence of Long Chen, Xian Jinglan, and Lang greatly eased their journey in exploring each area of the maze. Moreover, they also found two golden keys, so their business in the outer area was done, and they only needed to find a way to the inner area.

Upon arriving at the four-crossed road, they were taken aback by the sight of two men running from the roads to their right and left. Xian Jinglan immediately questioned one of them. "Why did it take you so long to return to our side, Jin Dabao?"

"Haish!" Jin Dabao sighed heavily. "After I got separated from you two, I was trapped in a prison with a puzzle, so I had to solve it first. I was lucky the Huangfu Kingdom's two princesses were trapped there, or I wouldn't have been able to escape so quickly, and I may have given up this challenge."

"I will beat you up if you dare give up this challenge, Dabao." Jin Dabao scowled at the other individual, who turned out to be Zheng Ru. "I was also separated from Prince Long Tian and Xianzi, but I didn't encounter significant obstacles during my journey here. However, I previously met Zhou Meiling and Bai Renfu, and I sensed something unusual from that little girl."
"What's so strange about Zhou Meiling?" Xian Jinglan asked.
Zheng Ru shook his head. "I don't know what's strange about her, but I felt an unusual aura coming from her body, so I immediately avoided her when she wanted to stop me."

"Hey! We should not linger here and immediately go to the inner area; I'm sure Tian'er and Xi Xianzi are on their way there now." All of them immediately agreed and followed behind Long Chen, but Jin Dabao and Zheng Ru repeatedly turned to look at Bai Tian'er and Ye Zhiqiu.
Unlike Ye Zhiqiu, who felt awkward about it, Bai Tian'er was much more indifferent and relaxed, and she returned their glances with a seductive smile.
As soon as they arrived at their next destination, the five people at two different ends of the room stood still in their spots as they stared at each other.
'Brother.' Ximen Yueliang called out softly as he hid behind Ximen Hongwu, but his eyes kept watching Ximen Yan and Qian Ying, who were standing across from them.

Ximen Hongwu was nervous, as Ximen Yan's cultivation level was slightly higher than his own, and his cousin still had Qian Ying by his side. Moreover, his little sister's fighting ability wasn't that great, so there was no way she could help him fight them.
Ximen Yan smiled and spoke to them. "Cousin, let's forget our enmity for now, and we can go together to find a way to the inner area."
Qian Ying raised her eyebrows in response, but she remained silent. Although Ma Kuangyu controlled Ximen Yan, he was still her master, so she would not move without his order.
"Have you found the key, Cousin?" Ximen Yan nodded to Ximen Hongwu. "We've also found our key, so let's look for the path to the inner area."
Meanwhile, Zhou Tai followed them from behind without saying a word, but he could be relieved that he didn't have to explore the rest of the outer area alone.
Just like everyone else, Ximen Chuixue's group, Li Yao's group, and the remaining participants had also found the first key, so they all immediately rushed to find the path to the inner area.

After searching for several hours and going through various obstacles, Zhang Fei's group finally arrived at a room with a large gate, so they went straight in.

Zhang Fei was pleasantly surprised by the spaciousness of the place, with numerous doors connecting various areas on each side of the walls. However, he was more interested in the gate at the north end, especially since it was the main gate to the inner area.
Since all of them were completely exhausted and Yun Xinyue still had not woken up from her faint, Zhang Fei led them to a corner to rest while waiting for the other group to arrive.

Bai Shouyi immediately separated herself from them and sat alone in another area. She chose to keep her distance from them for the time being, particularly because the people of the Huangfu Kingdom would suspect her if she joined them.

Xi Xianzi immediately checked Yun Xinyue's condition. "Her condition has stabilized since I helped her before, but the previous illusion was too impactful for her. She seemed to have difficulty accepting the events inside, so she still hasn't woken up."

After he thought about it, Zhang Fei decided to use the dream imprisonment to imprison Yun Xinyue's subconscious for a while, and he also gave her a pleasant dream to reverse the impact of that illusion. "Are we going to face the same challenges in the inner area?"

Xian Xianqin immediately informed him. "The inner area isn't as large as the outer area, but the traps and tests there are much more troublesome. Furthermore, we will encounter beasts in sovereign to quasi-divine realms, and certain rooms will spawn powerful enemies for us, necessitating heightened caution during our exploration."
"Strong enemies?" Zhang Fei asked with raised eyebrows.
"We don't know where they came from, but I think they are prisoners in this tower, just like those skeletons we found the first time."

"What do you mean by skeletons?" After Xian Xianqin mentioned it, Long Tian immediately inquired, prompting Zhang Fei to inform both him and Xi Xianqi about it. However, he did not inform them that the Star Tower originated from realms beyond the upper realms, nor did he disclose the existence of Hua Mei'er or Sima Yun. "Did you really absorb their souls?"

Zhang Fei nodded to Long Tian. "They have become vengeful souls, and I can't purify them all at once. Moreover, I have to increase my soul power to the earthly soul level before I can meet someone important, so I choose to absorb them because they don't have any negative impact on me."
"Does their vengeful nature really not influence you, Zhang Fei?"
"No." Zhang Fei answered Xi Xianzi with a shake of his head. "If their vengeful nature influenced me, I would have changed by now, but I'm still the same as before, right?"

"That's true." Xi Xianzi then warned Zhang Fei. "I think that kind of shortcut won't end well for you, so you must not use such a method to improve yourself too often, or you will suffer bad consequences. Anyway, I hope we won't be separated from our group once we enter the inner area, or we will waste more time than before, especially with the increasing difficulty of each obstacle."

One of the doors at the far end suddenly opened, so Zhang Fei and the others immediately turned their heads toward it. They saw Zhou Meiling and Bai Renfu walking out from there, but they immediately sensed something unusual from the Zhou Princess.
[Master, the system has detected the presence of another soul within Zhou Meiling's body, which appears to have taken control of both her mind and body.]
Zhang Fei frowned slightly. 'What about Zhou Meiling's soul? Has the foreign soul devoured it?'
[Zhou Meiling's soul appears to be sleeping in her soul space, but if it continues to control her, she may not survive.]

Zhang Fei himself didn't care whether Zhou Meiling would live or die, but he was worried that the foreign soul would suddenly come out of his body and control others, especially the people in his group. He then informed Xian Xianqin, Long Tian, and Xi Xianzi, who immediately turned to him in shock. 'I am a soul cultivator, so I can sense it. However, I don't know the strength of the foreign soul, so you guys must be fully aware of it, lest it move into your bodies and affect you.'

All of them nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei and ignored Zhou Meiling directly, but their eyes and senses continued to monitor the Zhou Princes as they discussed their next plans to explore the inner area.

Zhou Meiling ignored Bai Renfu, who was running toward Bai Shouyi, as she noticed their behavior. Instead of approaching them, she sat on the opposite side, observing the five of them from her seat. She was not interested in Long Tian and the others, but Zhang Fei's presence among them caught her attention.

'Compared to the male pure dragon and the female fairy, that human brat is more interesting, and his strength is truly high despite his low cultivation. With his strong physique, it's no surprise that this woman and her brothers want to capture him. Although I don't like occupying a man's body, I think his body will be a perfect vessel for my soul, and I might be able to reshape my body faster if I possess him.' Zhang Meiling immediately closed her eyes and circulated her qi to restore her stamina, especially considering that Bai Renfu's uselessness had used up a lot of her qi.
"How is your condition, Shaoyi? Did you encounter any danger before?" Bai Renfu inquired as he sat beside his sister.

"Ximen Yan and Qian Ying initially captured me, but we fell into a trap. When I opened my eyes again, I was already with Zhang Fei and the others, and my journey became easier after that." Bai Shouyi then told his second brother about his encounter with their grandfather's soul, which shocked Bai Renfu. 'He asked the three of us to investigate the situation behind Huangfu Shou, but we couldn't possibly do it alone, so he asked me to see Uncle Xian or Uncle Yun, believing that they could help us find out the truth and free our parents from their influence.'

Bai Renfu immediately agreed to that. 'In that case, we will wait for our big brother, and we will discuss this matter with him to think of a way to escape from the surveillance of Huangfu Shou and his subordinates.'

Sometime later, two other doors opened simultaneously, and several groups of people walked out of them. The first to come out was Xian Changyue's group, and she immediately led her nephew to gather with Zhang Fei and the others.
Xian Xianwu and Xian Changyue were relieved that Xian Xianqin was fine, but they were confused about Yun Xinyue's situation, so Zhang Fei explained everything to them.

On the other hand, Bai Chongxi joined his brother and sister, and Bai Shouyi immediately told him about his meeting with their grandfather, to which he agreed right away. Unfortunately, they couldn't possibly escape from Huangfu Shou and his subordinates just like that, so they needed help from others, and Zhang Fei's group was their best choice.

Meanwhile, Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying sat in another area, but they kept glancing at Zhang Fei's group, especially Yun Xinyue, who had not yet woken up, raising many questions in their minds.
The other newly arrived groups were Lin Yao's group and Xian Yu's group. They immediately separated themselves while waiting for their other group members to arrive.
Not long after, Xian Qifeng and his wife, Luo Qinglin, walked out of another gate, leading some of their group members to rest in another area.

To their surprise, they saw the two groups of demons from the two demon kingdoms walking side by side, and the situation between them was different from what they had known so far, especially since Ximen Yan and Ximen Hongwu seemed to be close to each other.
However, Ximen Hongwu immediately took Ximen Yueliang away, and Ximen Yan took Qian Ying away with him.

After they sat down on one side, Ximen Yan immediately observed the people present, but his gaze then fell on Zhang Fei. 'So he's the kid that these people targeted, huh? He's much weaker than them, but he's made it this far. Furthermore, he appears to notice that I possess this demon kid, indicating that he is a soul cultivator. In that case, I will meet and converse with him later, and I am hopeful that he will be willing to assist me in escaping this tower.'

After they waited for some time, the other groups also arrived at the place, and they immediately joined their respective groups. However, none of them went straight to the inner realms, and they chose to rest first so that they could explore it with full strength.

Instead, Yun Xinyue immediately hugged Zhang Fei after she remembered her dream, buried her face in her stomach, and asked him through voice transmission. 'Did you give me that dream?'
'Why did you guess like that?'
'You have too many strange abilities, and that dream helped me overcome my fear, so I thought you gave it to me.'

'You're right; I gave the dream to you.' Yun Xinyue looked up at Zhang Fei after he admitted it. 'I heard everything you said when you were trapped in the illusion, and I knew it was very bad, so I did it to fix your mental state.'
Yun Xinyue nodded slightly and hugged him again. 'I would definitely go crazy if you didn't do that, so I sincerely thank you, and I will never forget it for the rest of my life.'

'It's okay; you don't need to think too much about it.' Zhang Fei then looked towards the gate to the inner area, and several groups decided to go there: Zhou Tong's group, Huangfu Lian's group, Bai Chongxi's group, and the two demon kingdoms' group. 'Mei, are the restrictions still suppressing us?'

chapters.title: Chapter 574 Enter Inner Area
paragraphs: [There are no restrictions in this place, Master. The system's detection system returned to normal as soon as we entered this place, and you should be able to open a portal to the Yin-Yang Space or the training space. However, I don't think it's a good idea to open both in this place, especially since those people must be watching you from somewhere inside this tower. As for the inner area, I can't confirm whether there are restrictions or not, so you should go in there first.]

Zhang Fei immediately woke up Xian Xianqin, who was sleeping beside him, before lifting her and Yue Xinyue to their feet. Next, he woke up Xian Changyue and his team members, especially since he did not want to be left behind by their five enemy groups.

The people from the beast and natural races' kingdoms also immediately woke up once they sensed their movements. Xian Qifeng, Li Yao, and Mu Yu also woke up their team members. All of them began to prepare themselves to enter the inner area.

Once they were ready, they immediately led their respective groups to enter the gate to the inner area. As before, they were immediately transported to different areas, but they were no longer separated from their group members. Even though there were more of them than before, they still had to move more carefully due to the stronger and more numerous obstacles in the area.
"Phew!" Once they reached the starting area, Yuan Luo patted her chest in relief. "Fortunately, we're staying together this time, so we don't have to spend much time passing through this inner area."

"Even though we're together now, the traps in this area may still separate us, so we must always be careful where we step." Bai Tian'er said that as she scanned the area around them, but she then asked Zhang Fei, especially since there were three paths around them. "Which direction should we take first?"
"Why do you ask me, Senior Sister?" Zhang Fei then pointed at Xian Changyue. "She is our senior, so she should be the one to lead us and make decisions, and I will follow her decisions."
Bai Tian'er turned to him directly. "For decades, the obstacles and tests in this maze have never changed even once, but everything changed because of your presence."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows at that point, but Ye Zhiqiu immediately spoke to him. "I also think the same as Tian'er."
"Me too." Ru Yanyue and the others nodded in agreement.

Ximen Chuixue then patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "Aunt Changyue is our senior, but your adventure with Princess Xianqin and Princess Xinyue in the outer area before proved that you can lead us, so you don't need to refuse and lead us through this inner area."
"Just lead them, Zhang Fei."

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh before trying to open his map, and it worked. He could see that the path on their left was a dead end, and he could also see the trap in that room, so they didn't need to waste time going there. Meanwhile, many beasts in the sovereign realm awaited them on the right path, and many other living beings awaited them on the path ahead.

Zhang Fei wanted to check the path beyond the two rooms, but the map couldn't detect that far, so he had to clear the two rooms first before the system could detect the next paths beyond them. "Let's check the right path first, and we'll turn around if it's a dead end."

In a few minutes, they arrived at the room at the end of the right path, but Xian Xianqin immediately hugged Zhang Fei's arm and asked. 'Are you going to absorb their beast essence again? If you do that, Yuan Luo and the others will definitely be horrified, and Aunt Changyue will probably be suspicious of you.'

'I didn't intend to use that technique.' Zhang Fei then turned to his group members, who couldn't wait to slaughter the beasts. "Their number is around two hundred, but they are only sovereign-rank beasts."
"Let's kill them, Brother Chui!" Ximen Chuixue and the others immediately followed them, including Xian Xianqin, and fought those beasts head-on.

Zhang Fei prohibited Yun Xinyue from joining them due to her mental instability. He then turned to Xian Changyue, who also did not join them. "Do you have any information about the person behind Huangfu Shou?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei informed Xian Changyue about Bai Shouyi's grandfather's suspicions. "I didn't expect that Bai Yuntian would be so protective of his granddaughter, and he left a small part of his soul in hers. My brother and I have long suspected that there was someone else behind Huangfu Shou, but we haven't managed to get any information about that mysterious person, especially since that person never appeared on the surface directly. Moreover, that evil emperor tightly closed every area of his kingdom, so it was difficult for us to infiltrate there. Do you intend to investigate this matter?"

Zhang Fei shook his head in denial. I won't interfere in kingdom affairs because it will only cause me more trouble and enemies, so you and Emperor Xian can handle this matter yourselves. Nevertheless, I will help Bai Shouyi and her two brothers to escape from their kingdom, and I will send them to a safe place so that they can escape from Huangfu Shou's clutches."
"What are your plans for them?"

"I haven't thought about it yet, and I'll think about it after we return from this tower." Zhang Fei then looked at his group of members who were slaughtering those beasts. "What is certain is that we must send them somewhere else where Huangfu Shou and his subordinates cannot find them, so we cannot take them to the Xian or Yun Kingdoms."

"Why not hide them in the beast or natural races' kingdoms?" Zhang Fei and Xian Changyue looked at Yun Xinyue directly. "People from those races obviously want to establish good relations with you, so I think you can make use of them a little to protect Bai Shouyi and his two brothers."

"I think Xinyue's idea is quite good." Xian Changyue said this with a nod. "All these years, no human has been able to establish a deep relationship with them, but they took the initiative to come to you. I can tell that they intend to draw you to their side, so you can use that opportunity."
Zhang Fei immediately agreed with them. "All right, I will discuss this matter with Long Chen and Xian Jinglan first, and I hope they are really willing to help us."

Sometime later, Xian Xianqin and the others came out of the room after killing all the beasts, and Yuan Luo looked the happiest among them because he got an earth element crystal, which corresponded to her element. Regrettably, no other paths were available in the room, so they quickly returned to their previous path.
"Shall we check the left path?"

"There's no room at the end of the left path, so we don't need to waste our time, and we can take the front path." They all turned to face Zhang Fei directly. "Why are you all looking at me like that? Have you still not realized that our senses are no longer suppressed like before?"

After hearing that, Xian Changyue and the others directed their senses toward the room at the end of the left path, only to discover that it was indeed a dead end, as Zhang Fei had previously mentioned.
Bai Tian'er then curiously asked. "Since when did you realize that?"

"I always try to use my senses, so I've noticed it since we rested in the resting area." Zhang Fei's answer left them speechless, including Xian Changyue, especially since not a single one of them tried to use their senses. He then led them through the path ahead, but his next action surprised them again, especially since he drew his sword and deflected the various weapons that came out of the two walls on their sides. "I've studied the patterns on the walls in the outer area, and these walls are no different from there, so I can guess there are traps behind them."

Since they had already traversed the outer area alongside Zhang Fei, Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue were not surprised by this. However, their members were left in complete shock, leaving them with questions in their minds. 'This guy! Can he really figure everything out just because of that?'

After they had walked for some time, they arrived at the four-way intersection once again. Zhang Fei immediately led them to the left path, where they found a treasure chest. Unfortunately, they only found jewels, and there were no other items inside. Upon their return to the intersection, he swiftly guided them to the correct path, as numerous enemies awaited them on the opposite path. 'Hey! It's so convenient to have the system, and I don't have to spend much time in this area. This way, I can return to my residence faster, and I'll go into seclusion again after that.'

Zhang Fei led them through all the safe routes, but he also took them to every room filled with beasts because there was a chance for them to get elemental crystals that would be useful to them, so he couldn't possibly ignore them.
However, they still had to work hard in some rooms, especially since they were faced with some difficult riddles, which took them quite a long time to solve.

Unlike Zhang Fei's group, all the other groups had to exert great effort to navigate through all the paths they encountered, as none of them realized that the restrictions on their senses had been lifted, requiring them to check each path individually.

The inner area of the maze, while not as large as the outer area, is still quite spacious. A few hours later, they arrived in front of a room that was completely different from the others, but they didn't see anything inside.
Zhang Fei's map didn't reveal anything inside, but he always believed that anything too calm must be hiding something frightening, which made him reconsider entering.
"Let's enter so we can proceed to the next area."

"Stop!" Zhang Fei immediately stopped Bai Tian'er as she was about to enter the room. "You're too reckless if you want to enter now, Senior Sister. Look at the interior of the room; you've never encountered such a room before, right?"
"That's right." Bai Tian'er then asked. "Did you sense something unusual in it?"

"Senior Sister, a calm sea can be deadly sometimes, so we shouldn't take it lightly." Zhang Fei then took a huge chunk of beast meat and threw it straight into it, and numerous weapons shot out from the three walls and ceiling, cutting it to pieces before disappearing again.
After seeing that, Bai Tian'er and the others immediately took a deep breath, and cold sweat dripped down their foreheads.

Xian Changyue then spoke to them. "Those weapons are not ordinary, and their grade is extremely high, at the celestial or divine grade. Even if we shield our bodies with qi, we may not be able to withstand them, as they have the potential to breach our defenses."
"So, how are we going to get through this room?" Ying Shanhu asked.

Ru Yanyue then pointed to the path across the room. "The distance between the two doors is too far, and the movement of the weapons is too fast. Some of us might be able to fly there at full speed, but some of us might not be able to do it, including me."

Ye Zhiqiu and the others were also perplexed by this, but Xian Xianqin pointed at Zhang Fei as he spoke. "As long as he is with us, we can pass through this room easily, and we don't have to bother avoiding those attacks."

When they all looked at him questioningly, Zhang Fei shook his head. "I have a feeling that there is still something else hidden in this room, so I won't bring you guys into it in a hurry. Anyway, just be patient for a moment, and I'll check first."

Since Zhang Fei could use his demon abilities without transforming into his lust demon form, he immediately created five white fox familiars, surprising everyone, including Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, who had never seen them before.

Zhang Fei then sent the five of them into the room, but as soon as they entered, the trap mechanism activated, causing the weapons to attack them immediately. Seeing that, he swiftly controlled them to avoid the attacks and sent them forward to check the path at the other end. However, an unexpected event occurred, causing the end of the room to appear even more distant.
In the end, Zhang Fei canceled all five of his familiars. "See that? There are traps within traps, and we will definitely die if we force our way into this room."
"We are your seniors, but your actions make us feel inferior, and we would die without you." Yu Chongming said this as he smiled bitterly.
Ximen Chuixue then asked. "Can you reach the other end with your speed?"

"I can't be sure, especially since I don't know how far the hidden trap will activate. Moreover, I believe that the hidden trap is not the only one, and there might be another one inside. Zhang Fei then crouched in front of the entrance, carefully examining each wall before turning his attention to Ye Zhiqiu. "Can you freeze those weapons, Senior Sister?"

"I can use a special technique to freeze those weapons, but their grade is too high, and there are too many of them, so I can't freeze them all at once." Ye Zhiqiu then turned to Bai Tian'er and Xian Changyue. "I have to borrow your Qi; only then can I freeze them."
"Sure."

Ye Zhiqiu then stood in front of the entrance, and the two women stood behind her, pressing their palms against her back. "Are you going in now, Zhang Fei? Once the trap is activated, I will immediately freeze them. However, you should not trust my abilities completely, especially since I might fail to freeze some of them, so you must be on full alert."
"Got it." Zhang Fei observed the interior area, recalling the movement patterns of those weapons.
"Do you need my wind element's help, Fei?"
"You don't need to waste your qi, Princess Xianqin. My speed is enough to avoid them." Zhang Fei then said to Ye Zhiqiu. "Get ready, Senior Sister. I'll go inside now."
Hearing that, Bai Tian'er and Xian Changyue immediately channeled their qi into Ye Zhixiu's body, and she right away prepared to use her special technique. "I'm ready, Zhang Fei."

Zhang Fei swiftly entered the room, and as soon as those weapons emerged from all directions, he instantly teleported to dodge them. Wasting no time, Ye Zhiqiu activated her special technique, causing the temperature in the room to drop rapidly and frost to cover the walls of the room.

Ye Zhiqiu then tried to freeze all the weapons, but some remained unfrozen and continued to pursue Zhang Fei. "Be careful! I can't freeze them for too long because those weapons are too powerful, so you have to get to the other side quickly."

Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately teleported across the room, but the entrance continued to move away from his reach. He immediately used his wind element and enhanced condition to increase his speed further, and he didn't forget to use his clone illusion steps to trick them before using the nine cloud steps.
Using all of that, Zhang Fei almost reached the other end, but a figure suddenly appeared in front of him and kicked him at high speed, sending him flying backward towards the entrance.
Ye Zhiqiu, Bai Tian'er, and Xian Changyue immediately dodged to the side so they didn't collide with Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei immediately regained control of his body, landed precisely at the entrance, and gazed in shock at the figure. The recognition of the figure shocked Xian Xianqin and the others as well, especially since it was Zhang Fei himself. "How is this possible?"
