chapters.title: Chapter 575 Fighting "Zhang Fei"
paragraphs: Zhang Fei's copy crossed his arms in front of him as he looked at them. "What are you waiting for? You can only go to another area through this room, but you have to defeat me first, so fight me now."
"What's really going on here, Fei?" Xian Xianqin asked as she looked at Zhang Fei's copy, and she could see that it was indeed real; even their cultivation and aura were also similar.
Zhang Fei inspected the interior of the room once more before sharing his findings with them. "I think this room is a formation array, and it may be an advanced or master-grade formation array."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei's copy laughed at that. "You are right, Me. This room is indeed a formation array, and you could say that I am a perfect copy of you, created by the array."

"Let me try to fight him." Ximen Chuixue immediately stepped forward, unleashing his full power of cultivation. "I had to hold back my strength in our training because you are a member of our team, but that guy is not the real you, so I will use all my strength to face him now."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that. "Since he is a perfect copy of me, he should have all my abilities, so you better be careful when fighting him."
"Yeah." Two black gauntlets immediately covered Ximen Chuixue's hands as he walked into the room, but Zhang Fei's copy instantly disappeared from his sight.

"Be careful!" Zhang Fei shouted to the two.
Zhang Fei's copy abruptly split into two, shocking Ximen Chuixue and Bai Tian'er as they both charged at them at breakneck speed.

When Xian Changyue and Bai Tian'er regained consciousness, Zhang Fei's copy had already grasped their hands and used the enhanced demon touch once more, causing both women to moan with a strong jolt to their bodies.

Yuan Luo, Ye Zhiqiu, Ran Yanyue, and Xian Xianqin exchanged glances before running into the room.

"Boitata is a dragon serpent, but Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu are sea serpents." Zhang Fei swiftly touched the backs of Xian Changyue and Bai Tian'er to soothe their lust, particularly because he was well-versed in the impact of his enhanced demon touch. Forget it; I will continue to monitor that kid to discover his other abilities."

chapters.title: Chapter 576 Tests And Obstacles
paragraphs: *Slash... Slash... Slash...*

Following the death of their last enemy, Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei collapsed onto their buttocks, breathing heavily, their bodies adorned with numerous claw-like wounds. Both of them immediately took out a bottle of ointment and smeared it on their wounds, causing them to grimace because some of them were quite deep.

Huangfu Xiaofan's condition was not much different from his two sisters, but he was still better than them. He also smeared ointment on his wounds as he looked at their dead enemies with a frown, especially since they were neither human, demon, nor beast. "Since when have there been strange living creatures like this in this tower, Big Brother?"

"If you ask me, then who should I ask?" Huangfu Lian crouched beside one of the corpses. "The tower's appearance in our realm is already quite mysterious, so I don't find these creatures' presence too surprising. I never met them when I challenged this tower back then, and I thought they only appeared for this challenge this time. Judging from their form, I feel that they are a combination of human, demon, and beast."
Huangfu Xiaofan nodded slightly in response. "Their upper body is clearly a human body, but their lower body is that of a boar beast, and their small wings are like those of a demon."
"Do you think the owner of this tower created them, Big Brother?" Huangfu Xiaoying asked.
Huangfu Xiaomei joined in. "How can humans create creatures like this?"

"We don't know anything about this tower, so we don't know whether the owner is human or not." Huangfu Lian then observed their dead and living members. "There are only a few of us left now, so I'm not sure we can get through this inner area, especially with so many new obstacles we've never encountered before."

Their expressions became gloomy after hearing that, especially since they would fail miserably if they failed to pass the maze challenge. Huangfu Xiaofan then spoke. "The best way for us is to find Bai Chongxi's group, and we can use them as a sacrifice to pass those obstacles. Unfortunately, it is not easy to find them in this kind of situation, and we can only hope for luck to meet them."

"Forget it." Huangfu Lian said this as he stood up. "We just need to try our best, and we don't need to force ourselves. Our lives hold the utmost importance, and we still have a lot of chances to challenge this tower in the future. Therefore, we will immediately surrender if we encounter more challenging obstacles."

Huangfu Xiaofan, Huangfu Xiaomei, and Huangfu Xiaoying nodded in agreement with their big brother. Although they are eager to complete the first floor of the Star Tower, they don't want to die in it. After they rested for some time, Huangfu Lian immediately led them to continue their journey.
In another area, Bai Chongxi's and his group's journey was much easier compared to Huangfu Lian's group. They didn't encounter any strange creatures; they only encountered beasts and puzzles.
Even so, they spent a significant amount of time defeating those beasts due to their limited numbers and the complexity of the puzzles they faced.
Sometime later, they arrived at the next room, but the entrance to the room immediately closed as soon as they entered it, and water began to pour out of the floor beneath them.
"This is serious, Big Brother!" Bai Renfu uttered these words frantically, then pointed to the wall. "We have to solve those riddle questions quickly, or else we will drown in this room."

Bai Shouyi ignored her second brother, went to the riddles on the wall, and seriously read them one by one. "I think I can answer these riddle questions, big brother. However, I need time to answer them all so you all can rest first."
"All right, I leave them to you, Shouyi." Bai Chongxi then ordered his group to rest.
Zhou Tong and his group had also arrived in another room, but it was different from the other previous rooms, especially since it was filled with mirrors.
Zhou Tai immediately approached one of the mirrors and took a closer look. "What kind of mirror is this? Could it be an artifact mirror?"
"I'm not sure if these mirrors are artifacts." Zhou Tong also approached one of the mirrors and touched it, but it did not react at all.

Zhou Meiling, standing behind, gave a faint smile as she gazed at the mirrors. The woman's soul that possessed her had been trapped in the tower for a very long time, and she had seen various areas within it. She noticed their effects immediately, but she had no intention of telling them, instead waiting for the mirrors to react.
Zhou Meiling then walked to Zhou Tai's side. "These mirrors are no different from the ordinary mirrors in our palace, so I'm confused about the purpose of the owner of this tower placing them here."
"That's true."
All those mirrors suddenly released bright light, sucking them in before they could react. Zhou Meiling quickly grabbed Zhou Tai's hand, and both of them were sucked into the same mirror.
Zhou Tai was surprised to find himself in a glass room filled with glass furniture. "What kind of place is this?"

"I don't know." Zhou Meiling answered with feigned ignorance. "Since our Big Brother isn't here, I want to rest first, especially since I'm really tired because he keeps forcing us to walk forward in a hurry."

Zhou Tai let out a heavy sigh at that. "Our Big Brother has always been ambitious, and he wants to be the first to complete this maze challenge, especially since he is the strongest among the others."

Zhou Meiling then pulled Zhou Tai toward a long glass bench and sat down together before laying her head on her second brother's shoulder. "Sometimes, I think it would be better if we were born as ordinary people without status, so we don't have to bother thinking about royal affairs."
"Hahaha." Zhou Tai laughed. "I want something like that, but fate has predetermined our lives, so we must accept it."

Zhou Meiling's body suddenly released a purple smoke, which directly entered Zhou Tai's body through his nose. She then turned her gaze to her second brother and reached for his cheeks, causing his heart to flutter due to the smoke's effect.
Zhou Meiling kissed her second brother, and Zhou Tai immediately responded. Quickly, their mouths moved wildly as their kiss heated up, and their tongues danced in rhythm.

Unfortunately, Zhou Tai didn't realize that his little sister was absorbing his life force and soul powers, but Zhou Meiling did not rush to absorb both. 'His life force and soul powers are stronger than that useless Bai Renfu, but unfortunately, I can't kill him because Zhou Tong will suspect me. If I get the chance, I will kill their big brother by absorbing his life force and soul powers dry, and I will kill this guy after that.'

In a room, Long Chen and his group were trapped in the same room as Zhang Fei's group before, but their opponents were much more numerous because they entered it together, and the formation array copied all of them.
Even so, they didn't think much of it and instead enjoyed their fight with their copies, especially since they didn't have to hold back their strength to fight them.

Xian Jinglan and the other natural races were trapped in a mini maze, and they were all separated from each other. However, they finally realized that their senses were no longer suppressed like before, so they could find their way out more easily.
They eventually got out of the mini maze and went to another area, but obstacles blocked their path and strange creatures awaited them at the end.

Xian Yu and Xian Mu's group were really unlucky because they fell into a trap and landed on a scale. Above them, a clue guided them to complete the test, which required them to balance the scale before the time limit expired. If they fail to do so, they will fall into the fiery crater below them and die.

Unfortunately, balancing the scales was not easy because there were quite a lot of them, and they had different weights. Not only that, but hot steam continued to billow out of the fiery crater below them, disrupting their concentration.

Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin's group were also quite unlucky as they were sent to a vast wilderness, and their task was to find five items scattered around the place, so their task was much more difficult than looking for a needle in a haystack.
Moreover, the place had two scorching suns, and it was really hot even though they had covered their bodies with their Qi, causing sweat to pour down their bodies and dizziness to hit them.

Li Yao and her group were quite lucky compared to some of them, but they were also annoyed because they were sent to the side of a large lake after they entered a portal, and they were given a task that required great patience.

Their task was to fish for the largest aquatic beast in the lake, but there was only one of the largest beasts in it, and they were not given any fishing rods or bait to fish for it. Additionally, their cultivation was sealed by the formation around the lake, so they had to find bait and fish manually.

Since most of them belonged to royal families and nobles, they had never engaged in such activities before. Unfortunately, they were left with no alternative but to dig up bait and search for something to use as a fishing rod.

Inside a prison, Ximen Yueliang sat leisurely on a chair with her legs propped up against each other, and she propped her chin up as she watched Ximen Hongwu and the rest of their group try to solve the big puzzle in front of them. "Ugh! Why are all the obstacles in this maze so annoying? The obstacles in the outer area are already so troublesome, but the obstacles in the inner area are even more troublesome! If the situation continues like this, I will never be able to capture Xian Xianwu and Zhang Fei Tch! If I fail to capture them here, I will ask my mother to capture them for me, and they will be my puppets for the rest of their lives!"

"Hey, Yueliang! Be patient and stop grumbling, okay?" Ximen Hongwu spoke to his little sister in an annoyed tone. "I also want to get out of here quickly, but this puzzle is really complicated, and your grumbling is disturbing our concentration."
"Stop talking and solve the puzzle as quickly as possible!"

Ximen Hongwu's lips twitched because Ximen Yueliang was acting like a spoiled child too often, but he did not say anything further and concentrated on solving the puzzle. 'This is all our mother's fault; she spoils her too much.'
"Don't you know the way out of this place?" Qian Ying asked her master, as there was only darkness in front of them.
Ximen Yan shook his head at her. "I have indeed been locked up in this tower for a long time, but the areas inside often change on their own, so I don't know the way out."
"Who exactly are you? Why did those people betray you and lock you up here?"

Ximen Yan turned to Qian Ying. "As I said before, my name is Ma Kuangyu. They are my friends, but they are greedy people, and they are after my most precious item. Fortunately, I realized their evil intentions towards me, so I immediately hid it in a safe place, and they will never be able to find it."
Qian Ying appeared intrigued upon hearing that. "What kind of item is that?"

"I won't tell you about it." Ximen Yan's answer made Qian Ying frown. "It's not beneficial for you to know too much about me, as it could lead to obstacles in your cultivation. Therefore, there's no need for further questions, as I will never divulge any information."
"What will you do next after you leave this tower?" Qian Ying asked again.

"Haha." Ximen Yan laughed at that. "After I leave this tower, I will leave this body and find someone who can help me reshape it. After that, I will focus on restoring my cultivation, and I will look for those people to settle accounts with them."
"How can you reshape your body if you are already dead?" Ximen Yan did not intend to answer Qian Ying and sped up his pace directly.

In just a few seconds, they found themselves inside a spacious house filled with furniture. However, they quickly realized that the doors and windows were covered with arrays, preventing them from leaving immediately.
Moreover, they couldn't find any puzzles or riddle questions anywhere, and Zhang Fei's map also didn't show anything on it except for their presence.

Yun Xinyue immediately told them. "My group and I were trapped in this place last time, and the riddle questions will appear once every hour, but we only have one hour to solve them. If we fail to solve them, then we have to wait for the next one."

"I don't think it's a problem for us." Zhang Fei then pointed at the rooms. "We've walked for a long time and gone through many obstacles or battles, and it should be almost midnight, so we can wait for the riddles to come out while resting."

They immediately agreed with that and chose their respective rooms, but Yuan Luo and the other disciples swiftly pulled Zhang Fei's three wives with them, especially since they still had many questions for them.
Yun Xinyue also went to one of the rooms to rest because the previous illusion still weighed on her mind, and she was afraid that the events in the illusion might become a reality in the future.
Bai Tian'er and Xian Changyue wanted to ask Zhang Fei about his abilities, but they felt that the time was not right, so they also decided to rest first.
"Aren't you going to sleep, Princess Xianqin?"

Xian Xianqin pouted her lips because Zhang Fei continued to address her as such. "We're getting closer now, and we've even kissed, so I want you to call me something else, especially when we're both like this."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly, hugged her waist, and planted a brief kiss on her lips. "What if I call you Qin'er?"
Xian Xianqin nodded with a smile before hugging him back. "You can call me that when we're alone, but you have to call me Xianqin when we're with others, okay?"
"Okay."
Xian Xianqin then led Zhang Fei to sit on a sofa and placed her head on his shoulders. "Can you tell me about your five clones? Who are Shang Yaolin and Shang Xinyu?"
Zhang Fei told Xian Xianqin about his five clones, and he also explained to her about the two women, including the reason he approached them.

Xian Xianqin was shocked after hearing that Zhang Fei's five clones had their own woman, but she didn't want to talk about that anymore. "I didn't expect that you have already faced cultivators from the upper realms with your current cultivation, so I'm no longer surprised that you dare to face cultivators in this realm, especially since they are much stronger than us."

"Even though I dare to face them, I still have to plan everything well, or I will die in their hands." Zhang Fei embraced Xian Xianqin. "You can rest now, and I will wait for the riddle question to come out."
"No." Xian Xianqin refused with a slight shake of her head. "I still want to talk to you to get to know you better, so I'll accompany you to wait for it to come out."

chapters.title: Chapter 577 Upgraded
paragraphs: After they had flown for two full days, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women from the Shang Clan finally arrived at the outskirts of the western island, and he immediately led them to find a place to rest as it was almost midnight. Moreover, they were not sure about the situation on the island because the demi-humans were very secretive and disliked humans, so they had to be more careful before going to meet them.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] led them to the edge of a river and made a campfire right away to warm their bodies, especially since the air temperature in the realm was much cooler than usual. He then checked his map to locate the four people who had followed them and found them on a small island a little way away from their location.

'Heh! You guys won't be able to follow us anymore, and I'll bring these two ladies back with my warp portal later, so you can wait for us as long as you want.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to them. "You guys should use your transformation techniques to transform into demi-human races, and I will disguise your auras so they won't be able to recognize you."

Both women nodded in agreement and used their transformation techniques straight away, leaving Zhang Xiaolong [3] dumbfounded. Shang Yaolin turned into a rabbit demi-human, and Shang Xinyu turned into a cat demi-human.
"Hehe." Shang Yaolin giggled and teased Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you want to eat an innocent rabbit like me, Sir Fox?"

'Since when are you innocent?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then lifted Shang Yaolin onto his lap and planted a gentle kiss on her lips. "Naturally, I want to eat you, little rabbit. Unfortunately, we can't do that now, or this miss cat will be embarrassed of us."

Shang Yaolin immediately turned to Shang Xinyu. "Do you want to try something intimate with Long'er, Xinyu? I know that you have been interested in him for a long time, and I know this because you often call his name in your dreams."

Shang Xinyu neither agreed nor denied it, but she knew that she liked Zhang Xiaolong [3] in her heart, especially after seeing his adult form for the first time, which matched the figure of the man in her dreams. That's why she decided to stay in her and Shang Yaolin's room, but Murong Qianying's arrival three weeks ago forced her to return to her room.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled faintly as he had long been aware of Shang Xinyu's feelings, but he had never done anything to her because he was different from Shang Yaolin. "All right, you don't need to force Big Sister Xinyu, Big Sis Yaolin."

After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed their hands and used the body modification ability to alter their appearance slightly so they looked like real demi-humans. "Anyway, let's rest now, and we'll go to the nearest town tomorrow morning."
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly received a voice transmission from Tie Xuan, informing him that the extermination sword's upgrade was complete. 'Three days faster than he estimated, huh?'
Since his third clone was on the western island, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to the Wasteland Realm to meet Tie Xuan, who right away handed him the demon extermination sword.

Before upgrading, the demon extermination sword was already black, but the upgrade made it even blacker. However, Zhang Fei [5] felt that his sword had become heavier, its blade sharper, and its aura more deadly, especially for demons.
*Zing... Zing...*

The demon extermination sword vibrated in excitement after it returned to Zhang Fei [5]'s hand, making him smile. He then rubbed the sword as he spoke. "Not only did you miss me, but I missed you very much, and I'm glad we can be together again."
"Are you satisfied with the results of the upgrade?" Tie Xuan asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned the demon extermination sword to his body before answering him. "I'm completely satisfied with the upgrade, Senior Brother."

"Hahaha." Tie Xuan laughed as he patted Zhang Fei [5]'s shoulder. "Your sword is already a heaven-grade soul weapon now, and it can still be upgraded once or twice, but I don't have the materials for its next upgrade. If you want to upgrade it again, you have to go to the Xianjin Realm in the upper realms, but you won't be able to do it now."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then asked him. "Can I use your sword for a while?"

Tie Xuan nodded to him. "No problem; you can use it for a while, and I'll let you know when I'm going to sell it. Since you're here now, I'll teach you how to forge a spirit-grade weapon properly, and you can use the materials available here to forge the perfect one."
"All right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately agreed with that because he really couldn't wait to increase his blacksmith rank so that he could forge quality equipment for those close to him.

As expected, Zhang Fei managed to inflict a deep slashing wound on the beast's body, causing its poisonous blood to spray on him. However, it did not affect him thanks to his poison immunity, but he immediately warned Xian Changyue to be careful because the poison was lethal to her.
Zhang Fei then touched the beast's body, and he used his essence absorption ability and demon absorbing technique on it, causing it to roar in pain.
*Roar*

However, Zhang Fei's actions caused the beast to become berserk, and its aura increased severalfold. It immediately attacked blindly without regard for itself, shooting its shockwave and poison, and its tail attacked randomly, forcing Xian Changyue to move away from it hurriedly.

Unlike her, Zhang Fei immediately moved onto the beast's back and grabbed one of the thorns that the demon extermination sword had previously cut. He continued to use his essence absorption ability and demon absorbing technique against it, but its cultivation was simply too high, so it was still far from weakening.

Outside the room, Xian Xianqin and the others continued to use their respective techniques to attack the beast, and they were forced to swallow recovery pills to recover their Qi, especially since their techniques drained a lot of their Qi.
The demon extermination sword continued to strike the beast, concentrating on its head to prevent it from attacking Zhang Fei or Xian Changyue.

After they relentlessly fought it for two full hours, and Zhang Fei never stopped using both of his absorbing abilities, the beast began to weaken visibly. Even its attacks, particularly its tail attacks, were no longer as powerful as they once were.
However, the beast was not completely weakened, and it continued to struggle to fight back against them.
After another two hours, the beast looked significantly weaker because Zhang Fei continuously absorbed its life force, soul force, and beast essence.

Seeing the beast stagger, Xian Changyue immediately controlled her two short swords using her qi and stabbed them into its stomach because its blood was poisonous, causing the beast to roar in pain and frustration.

Zhang Fei immediately accelerated his actions in absorbing its life force, soul force, and beast essence. Eventually, the beast collapsed on the floor, exhaling its last breath, and its massive body appeared extremely dry.
*Rumble... Rumble...*
With the death of the chimera beast, the wall behind it immediately opened by itself, revealing the treasure chest.
[You gained 5,000,000 Beast Essence from Chimera Beast.]

The demon extermination sword immediately returned to his side and entered his body, and he stored the moonlit whisper sword again. 'How much more beast essence do I need to evolve to six-tails, Mei?'

[You only need two hundred and fifty thousand more beast essences, Master. After you leave this tower, you can dual-cultivate with Boitata, Zhang Yue, Zhang Lingxue, Shen Yu, and Shen Xueyi. This will enable you to evolve to six-tails immediately, but you will require a significant amount of beast essence to evolve to seven-tails, so you will need to seek assistance from numerous stronger female beasts.]

Naturally, Zhang Fei had already realized it, especially since his demon rank required one hundred and eighty million female essences to rise to the archduke rank. Therefore, he guessed that he would also need that much beast essence to evolve to six tails.
'Are you okay?' Zhang Fei nodded to Xian Changyue, who had just landed beside him. 'What kind of technique did you use on this beast? Why did its body dry up like this?'

'Your brother and sister-in-law must have told you about my beast's identity, right?' Xian Changyue nodded in response to Zhang Fei's question. 'I needed too much beast essence to evolve, and this chimera beast had a lot, so I absorbed most of it.'
Xian Changyue frowned immediately. 'Wouldn't using such a shortcut harm you?'

'Yes.' Zhang Fei did not deny that. 'I rarely use my ability, and I only use it when I meet a beast as strong as this chimera beast, but it's very rare because I'm not that crazy to go into the nest of a beast that is much stronger than me. Moreover, my beast form hasn't evolved for a long time, and I really can't wait for my next evolution, so I used it this time.'

'I see.' Xian Changyue nodded in understanding before warning Zhang Fei. 'I can understand your desire to become strong, but you should always be careful in using such shortcuts, lest you suffer the backlash. My niece has fallen in love with you, and I don't want her to suffer because something happened to you.'
"Fei!" Zhang Fei immediately turned to Xian Xianqin and welcomed her into his arms. "Are you hurt?"

"The beast might have hurt Senior Changyue and me if you guys hadn't come here, but we're fine, thanks to all of your help." Zhang Fei immediately brought the two women down from the beast's corpse and stored it in the inventory, allowing Mei to examine the remains. He then turned to his group members, and most of them looked exhausted after using their full strength for several hours. "You guys can open the treasure chest, and we'll rest here until we fully recover."

Bai Tian'er and the others agreed with that, and they immediately sat down on the other side of the wall. Since they did not join their fight, Ximen Chuixue, Yuan Luo, and Ying Shanhu immediately opened the treasure chest and brought everything before them.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

'Having a lot of clones is convenient, so I don't have to take care of the two daily quests myself. Unfortunately, I can only have a maximum of five clones; that's acceptable.' Zhang Fei instructed them to divide the items among themselves, given that the only interesting items available were jewels. Moreover, he had already obtained a full treasure chest in the outer area, and he had also obtained so many beast essences from the chimera beast. Additionally, he still had his two shops in the Sky Jade Realm, so it wasn't difficult for him to get jewels. As for coins, his restaurant in the Nine Stars Realm is always busy, and he will also open his new shop soon.

Zhang Fei then took Xian Xianqin to the opposite side to rest, but Yun Xinyue decided to join them. The two women sat flanking him, resting their heads on his shoulders. Bai Tian'er, who was sitting in the distance, felt jealous of them.

'It seems that Xinyue has also started to fall in love with you, Fei.' Xian Xianqin whispered through voice transmission as she observed Yun Xinyue, who had fallen asleep because her condition had not fully recovered and the previous fight had consumed a lot of her energy.

Zhang Fei realized that ever since he saved Yun Xinyue's life from Bai Shouyi's poison, he could see the change in her attitude when they met those vengeful souls. She became more attached to him after the test in the underground bedroom because he gave her a dream about him, and he gave her another dream after she was trapped in the illusion. "You should also rest, Xianqin."
"Yeah." Xian Xianqin immediately hugged Zhang Fei's arm and closed her eyes.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Lingxue were inside their newly renovated shop, and he had deliberately prepared a special room at the back for his wife to perform alchemy. "So when are we going to open this shop, husband?"

"I will bring you back to the deserted valley in the Sky Jade Realm so you can choose herbs that are suitable to sell in this realm, and you can also go back to the central region to find Feng Yao and discuss it with her." Zhang Lingxue nodded to Zhang Fei [1] because she was already familiar with all the types of herbs in that place, and many of them could be sold in the Nine Stars Realm. "Currently, Zhang Fei [5] is learning blacksmithing from Tie Xuan in the Wasteland Realm, so I have to go to Earth to buy mattresses and other things, and I will pick you up again after I buy everything. After that, we'll open this shop, but we must still beware of Alchemy Union members in the other three kingdoms."
"All right, let's go now, and I hope Big Sis Yao is willing to join us in this realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 580 Meeting Some People
paragraphs: Zhang Lingxue had already sat in front of Feng Yao, sharing with her the details of the Star Tower, particularly Zhang Fei's discoveries inside the Immortal Soul Palace and the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Have you heard of that tower before?"

"No." Feng Yao answered with a shake of her head. "I don't have much information about the middle realms, and I only know a few planets. The tower doesn't exist on all the planets in the middle realms, so I've never heard of it. However, I know a lot about the upper realms, so I can say with certainty that the Immortal Soul Palace and the Moonlit Passion Temple do not exist there, which confirms Zhang Fei's guess that the tower comes from the realms beyond the upper realms."
"What is the purpose of those people from those realms sending their tower to the middle realms?"

"Talents." Zhang Lingxue looked at Feng Yao in confusion. "Not everyone is born with great talents, and there are only a few of them who are great talents, even in the upper realms. Highly talented people are usually born randomly, and they can be born in any realm, including the lower and middle realms; even many cultivators from the upper realms often go to the lower or middle realms to find people with the best talents. Given the numerous challenges that cultivators encounter in the Star Tower, I believe they purposefully use it to seek out the most talented individuals in the middle realms."
Zhang Lingxue nodded in understanding at that. "Do you want to go to the Nine Stars Realm with us, Big Sis Yao?"

"Yes." Feng Yao immediately agreed because the existence of the Star Tower piqued her interest, especially since her parents had tried to find a way to go to the realms beyond the upper realms. Unfortunately, their efforts had never yielded any results, so she wanted to check out the tower herself. "However, I can't go there before someone from my clan arrives in this realm, and she will arrive in two days. After she arrives here, I will hand over the matters in this realm to her, and I will go there with you guys."

"Hahaha." Zhang Lingxue laughed in satisfaction with Feng Yao's decision, and she immediately moved to sit beside her while hugging her arm. "I'm thrilled with your decision, Big Sis. This way, we can be together as usual, and you can teach my husband more about alchemy."

Feng Yao shook her head as she smiled. "Honestly, I didn't expect that Zhang Fei would learn alchemy, and he deliberately learned it for your sake, especially since the Alchemy Union has started to target you."

Zhang Lingxue suddenly remembered something and inquired directly. "Did you take any action against the Alchemy Union? Lian Jinshu sent his men to capture my husband twice, but they suddenly withdrew from the Xian Kingdom after he returned to this realm to see you."

"I sent Feng Xishui to their headquarters to suppress them, and Huoyun Zhiyan immediately withdrew his people from the Xian Kingdom because he was afraid of my phoenix race." Feng Yao then shared with Zhang Lingxue the issues that had previously arisen between her Phoenix race and the Alchemy Union. "Even though Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia are the best alchemists there, they never handle alchemy matters outside directly, and they ask my parents to take care of everything."
"I see." Zhang Lingxue then asked about another matter. "Anyway, how is Shi Wu's progress? Is she much better now?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded and informed her. "That little girl is always diligent in her cultivation and training, and her cultivation has reached the 1-Star Core Realm thanks to Zhang Fei's yang qi. Her combat experience is also not bad because Mu Zhiwu and Hao Yingmu always bring her along with them when they go to the forest and other places, and they teach her the correct way to fight using her wood elements, but she's still not as skilled as you or your other sisters."

"I think it's not a problem because my husband decided to take her and Shi Xi to the Nine Stars Realm, but they need to train harder in private to catch up with us." Zhang Lingxue then lifted Feng Yao to her feet before taking out the teleportation device. "Let's go to that valley; I have to pick a lot of herbs for us to sell in that realm."
"All right."

When they arrived at the deserted valley, Feng Yao and Zhang Lingxue found four women from the Hidden Sea Palace there. They were the sect master Hai Yuzhen, the elders Hai Twins, and the female disciple Yue Lanxin.
"Oh?" The four women were shocked by their appearance, especially Zhang Lingxue. Hai Yuzhen directly asked her. "Didn't you go with Zhang Fei to the middle realms?"

"Yes." Zhang Lingxue and Feng Yao immediately approached them. "We are planning to open a shop where we will sell alchemical items, so I returned to this realm to gather some herbs. Are the four of you interested in going to that realm? There, the Qi is abundant, and our cultivation has significantly increased; even my husband has reached the 1-Star Earth Realm."

Zhang Lingxue's revelation of Zhang Fei's cultivation shocked Hai Yuzhen and Yue Lanxin, especially since the last time they met him was four and a half months ago. At that time, his cultivation was still at the 7-Star Soul Realm, but he had already advanced to the Earth Realm after less than a year of cultivation.

Unlike them, Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin had always believed that Zhang Fei would match or even surpass them in a short time, so they were not surprised to hear that his cultivation had reached that stage.
"Did he come here with you?" Zhang Lingxue immediately told them about her and Zhang Fei's plans. "Now that you're here, could you please share your knowledge about that realm with us?"
"Sure." As she began to select suitable herbs, Zhang Lingxue told them many things about the Nine Stars Realm, including the Star Tower, which piqued their interest.

Zhang Fei [1] was already with Huang Rong and the other six women, but they were disappointed that he had come without using his real body, especially since they had last had sex with him before he took the others to the Nine Stars Realm.

Zhang Fei [1] smiled amusingly at their expression and explained to them that his real body was undergoing numerous tests in the Star Tower. "When I finish those challenges, I'll take you there. You guys can stay there for a while, and I will always accompany you, so you don't have to be disappointed like this. Anyway, I need a lot of goods for my new shop there, and I also have to add the stock for the two shops in the Sky Jade Realm."

Huang Rong immediately took her smartphone, contacted people in their country, and ordered them to buy the usual items. "They will immediately prepare everything, and you can pick them up at our company warehouse."
"How about the two female angels, Fei?" Yang Lu'er inquired.

Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows slightly and searched the earth for their whereabouts, but he only found Jiang Yinghua and could not locate Meng Tianshi. "Yinghua is still here, but her friend seems to have returned to the Tian Realm."
Hearing that, Zou Ling directly asked. "Are you interested in Yinghua, Fei? Otherwise, you wouldn't have taken her to the Sky Jade Realm, right?"

"Yinghua is so beautiful, so it's natural that I have an interest in her, right? However, I have no intention of approaching her because of the Tian Realm issue, and the Throne has already decided to attack Earth in a month, so I will wait until I have resolved the issue." Their expressions became serious after Zhang Fei [1] said that. "All right, that problem is beyond your capabilities, so you don't need to think about it. I will make sure you all are safe, and I have made some plans to deal with them. If they dare to attack here with their many troops, then I will bring an army of cultivators here to slaughter them, and their corpses will become fertilizer for this world."

The women massaged their foreheads because Zhang Fei said such terrible things too easily, but they realized that the life of a cultivator was much more complicated, and such things were all too common in the cultivation world.

After he accompanied them for a few hours, Zhang Fei [1] went straight to their company in their country and took all the supplies that Huang Rong's men had bought. He then went to the Sky Jade Realm and added more stock for his shop in the Heavenly Sword City, but he didn't go straight to the deserted valley. He first went to the Desolate Sect to meet Gang Jinshu, especially since Shi Xi studied under his guidance.

"Oh?" Gang Jinshu was surprised by Zhang Fei [1]'s sudden arrival. "Did you come here to pick up Xi'er and take her to that realm? Her cultivation has already reached the 1 Star Core Realm thanks to your Yang Qi, and I have also taught her a lot about fighting and controlling metal over the past few months, so she should be able to go there."

paragraphs: "Sect Master, I will not go to that realm." Yue Lanxin suddenly said to Hai Yuzhen. "I know you want me to go there for my own good, and I am also interested in it. However, I do not want to rely on anyone, and I will go there with my own abilities in the future."

Hai Yuzhen wanted to say something to Yue Lanxin, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately stopped her. "Since Senior Sister Lanxin wants to go to the middle realms using her own abilities, we must respect her wishes, and you don't need to force her, Sect Master Yuzhen."
"All right." Hai Yuzhen then spoke to the Hai Twins. "You two should return to our sect immediately to pack up, and you should train as hard as possible in that realm."
Unlike Yue Lanxin, the Hai Twins did not refute Hai Yuzhen's orders, and they went straight back to the sect to pack up.
Zhang Lingxue then spoke to Hai Yuzhen. "I think you can start preparing someone to replace you, and we will pick you up once you get one."

"I want to enjoy my life in this realm, so you don't have to bother picking me up." Hai Yuzhen then looked up at the sky. "If fate permits, I will go to the middle realms someday, and we will meet again there. I will take Lianxin back to our sect now, and you can take Dongxin and Dongyin away after they come back here."
Following the disappearance of the two women, Zhang Lingxue immediately questioned her husband. "Aren't you interested in Sister Yuzhen and Yue Lanxin?"

"No." Zhang Fei [1]'s answer surprised Zhang Lingxue. "You can't see it, but I can see the hostility in Hai Yuzhen's eyes, and it's probably because of her hatred for demons. Yue Lanxin is pretty, but her beauty doesn't interest me. Instead, I'm more interested in Hong Xuan and Ying Sha, and I might meet them later."

Zhang Lingxue immediately realized why Zhang Fei [1] preferred those two women over Yue Lanxin. "Both of them are ordinary compared to Lanxin, and you chose them over her because they are lilies, right?"
"You're right." Zhang Fei [1] then turned to Feng Yao. "People from your phoenix race will arrive in this realm in two days, right?"

"Yes." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "Feng Jinqiu will arrive in two days, and you can bring your big sister here to learn about the ice phoenix scripture from her. She can protect this realm alone, and I will go with you to the Nine Stars Realm after that."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to her again. "I still can't believe that the Star Tower belongs to the people of those realms, but I wouldn't have known it if I hadn't met that little girl and the old bastard. Unfortunately, they killed one of the souls I met there when he was about to tell me about their realms, so I couldn't get any deeper information about them. Moreover, there were many strange creatures in that tower, one of which was chimera beasts."

"Chimera beasts?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately told Feng Yao about the beasts, which made her even more eager to go to the Star Tower. "Sometimes knowing many things beyond our reach is not a good thing, so you don't need to think too much about their identities, and you should focus more on reaching the seven divine realms first. Once you break through that stage and ascend to the upper realms, you can start looking for information about their identities and their realms."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] and Feng Yao discussed some other things, and Zhang Lingxue asked the Shi sisters to help her pick herbs. Meanwhile, Lian Xiang was curious about their conversation about the Star Tower and the realms beyond the upper realms, but she chose not to ask anything, at least for now.

Sometime later, Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin returned to the deserted valley, only to be disappointed by Hai Yuzhen's decision to hide from them. Zhang Fei [1] then sent the six women into his training space, and he asked Zhang Lingxue to teach Lian Xiang and the others how to properly train in it, especially the gravity and comprehension features.

After he sent Feng Yao back to the Blazing Phoenix Sect, Zhang Fei [1] went straight to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but he deliberately used his invisibility so that no one would notice his presence. He went to see Shen Yang first because Shen Xueyi had handed over the affairs of their shop in the Southern River City to him, and he handed over the stock to him while discussing some matters.

Zhang Fei [1] offered him to go to the Nine Stars Realm, but Shen Yang rejected his offer on the grounds of protecting the Shen Clan, so he did not force him. He then went to the core disciple area to meet Li Mengmeng, who immediately pulled him into her room. "Why did you suddenly return to this realm?"
"Have you ever heard of Star Tower?"

Zhang Fei [1]'s question momentarily took Li Mengmeng aback. "I've never seen that tower in person, but I've heard about it from several natural races who ascended to my realm. They said that it appeared in their realm out of nowhere several thousand years ago, but none of them have ever managed to reach the tenth floor even with their cultivation at the seven divine realms, especially since the ninth floor's trials were too difficult for them."

"Even cultivators in the seven divine realms can't reach the tenth floor, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] then let out a heavy sigh. "Since they couldn't reach that floor with their strength that high, I certainly won't be able to reach it with my current strength."

"Hehe." Li Mengmeng giggled at that. "Other cultivators might not be able to reach that floor, but you are different from them. I believe that you will be able to reach that floor someday, so you don't need to force yourself to reach it now. Instead, you should enjoy their tests, which can help you improve in some aspects."
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei [1] asked her again. "How long are you going to stay here? Aren't you going to return to your realm?"

"Don't you still have some matters left in this realm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows at Li Mengmeng's question. "As I told you three months ago, I came to this realm to look for the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and you are his successor. I will wait here for the time being, and I will leave after you have finished your business here. After that, I will wait for you to come to the Evergreen Spirit Haven, and we will warmly welcome the arrival of the successor of our savior."
"You knew that would take a long time, right?"

"I know that." Li Mengmeng replied with a nod. "We are not ordinary humans but cultivators, and time has no meaning for us, especially since we can live tens, thousands, or even tens of thousands of years. That's why you don't need to think about that and focus on the path ahead of you, and you will be able to go to my realm one day."

"That's for sure! I will definitely go to the upper realms in the future, and the Evergreen Spirit Haven will be my first destination." Li Mengmeng smiled upon hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s answer. "In that case, I'll leave now, and I'll come to you again if I have any other questions for you."
"All right, you can meet me whenever you want, and I will try to answer all your questions."

Zhang Fei [1] then used the map to locate Hong Xuan and Ying Sha, discovering them in a large hot pool not far from their sect, a location only accessible to core disciples or elders. Although Ying Sha is still an inner disciple, she is Hong Xuan's lover, allowing her to enter the place freely.

Zhang Fei [1] canceled his invisibility and rushed there, surprising both women with his arrival, as he had not appeared for several months. Moreover, several disciples also disappeared with him, including Fu Lingshan, who was also a core disciple. Apart from them, Shi Yue, Xi Zihua, and Yan Luan'er also went with him.
Ying Sha's and Hong Xuan's faces turned red once he took off all his clothes, revealing his perfectly formed body and huge sleeping dick.
Zhang Fei [1] smiled at that, walked toward Hong Xuan and Ying Sha, and soaked beside them.

Ying Sha and Hong Xuan exchanged confused glances, particularly since Zhang Fei [1] should have known that they were lilies and disliked men. However, they recalled that he had two pairs of lilies by his side, namely Gu Yan and Luo Yu, Xi Zihua and Yan Luan'er.

'Are you two satisfied using that tool to satisfy each other?' Ying Sha and Hong Xuan were startled when Zhang Fei [1] spoke into their minds. 'I know you two don't like men, but I like women like you two, and I want you guys to be my partners. Honestly, I've been eyeing you two for a long time, but I've been too busy with my affairs, so I only got around to meeting you now.'
Hong Xuan then questioned Zhang Fei [1]. 'Why do you want us as partners if you know we hate men?'
'No man has ever touched you two, and I always like to see lily couples pleasuring each other.'
'This guy's face is as thick as a wall, or else he wouldn't be this shameless.' Both women muttered in their hearts.

'Haha.' Zhang Fei [1] laughed. 'You guys may not like men now, but you two will change your minds after experiencing the pleasure I can give you, and it's much more satisfying than that tool. If you two don't believe me, you can give me your hands, and I will prove it here.'

Ying Sha and Hong Xuan raised their eyebrows in response, but they were also curious about it, so they extended their hands to Zhang Fei [1]. paragraphs: "Are they not chasing us anymore?" Shang Xinyu inquired after they reached a different location.

"Haha." Shang Yaolin laughed before telling her. "Xinyu, Long'er has the teleportation ability that he inherited from his father, so you don't have to worry about those people, especially since they've lost track of us now."

"That's right, Big Sis Xinyu." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked into the distance. "We're already halfway to the northern city, but we shouldn't rush to that city, especially since they might have partners there. For the time being, I want to look for herbs in this area, and we'll go there after the situation has calmed down."
Both women agreed with that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led them to another area, especially since Mei found a lot of herbs there.

Meanwhile, Ye Hu and the other two had arrived at a hut where a demi-human man with the appearance of a black bear was waiting for them. They then reported the presence of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women to him. "What should we do, Big Brother Xiong Ju?"

"Hmm?" Xiong Ju pondered briefly before issuing the order. "Based on their route and their herb-hunting activities, I believe they intend to go to the northern city. Therefore, you should go there and instruct our team to monitor the entire area. Once the three of them appear, you must capture them immediately. I don't care about the two women, but that male fox's ability seems interesting, so I want to recruit him into our group."
"Big Brother, may we have the two women?"
Xiong Ju nodded to them. "Don't waste any more time and go to that city, or they will escape, and we will have a hard time finding them."

Even though they were only sovereign-rank beasts, Bai Chongxi and his two siblings were overwhelmed by the beasts blocking them in one room, especially since there were too many of them and they had fought other enemies many times before.
"Big brother, there are too many of them, so we should retreat now to rest first." Bai Renfu spoke as he attacked one of the beasts.
Bai Shouyi agreed with his second brother. "After we rest, we can fight them again."
"All right." Bai Chongxi immediately ordered the remaining members of their group to retreat outside, and they rested there. "Swallow recovery pills, especially since we've wasted so much time."
In another area, Huangfu Lian's group was overwhelmed by the strange creatures in front of them, particularly due to their exhaustion from fighting numerous enemies and avoiding numerous traps.

In the end, Huangfu Lian decided to retreat and rest first before fighting them again, but one of the strange creatures suddenly sprayed a black liquid from its mouth, which directly hit the backs of Huang Xiaoying and Huang Xiaomei.

"Retreat!" Huangfu Lian shouted as he hurled an artifact at the strange creatures, causing them to bounce against the back wall. He and Huangfu Xiaofan then helped their two sisters out, but Huang Xiaoying and Huang Xiaomei right away fell unconscious.
*Tear... Tear..*
Huangfu Lian immediately laid them on their stomachs and tore the backs of their dresses, but his expression became serious once he saw the black liquid begin to enter their bodies.
"What kind of black liquid is this, Big Brother?"

"I don't know; I've never seen it before." Huangfu Lian immediately took out some pills, forced the two women to swallow them, and then pressed his palms on their backs to remove the black liquid from their bodies. Unfortunately, his efforts were in vain, and the black liquid spread even faster, so he decided to seal it inside their bodies to prevent it from spreading further. "Xiaofan, we have no other choice but to surrender, or else they will die."

Huang Xiaofan nodded in agreement with that. "Our father will definitely be furious because we failed to capture Xian Xianwu, Xian Xianqing, and Yun Xinyue. However, Xiaoying and Xiaomei's lives are more important, so we should give up. As for Zhang Fei, we can tell him about that guy, and he will definitely send people to capture him later."
"Yeah." Huangfu Lian immediately raised his hand and shouted upwards, and all of them right away disappeared from that place before being sent out of the tower.
Huangfu Shou's people immediately approached them, and they swiftly brought all of them back to their kingdom at full speed, especially given the concerning condition of the two princesses.

After being trapped in the mirror for a whole day, Zhou Tong finally managed to find his way out, but he was no longer in the previous room, and he was sent to another room, separating him from his two siblings and group.
"Fuck! What an annoying trap!" Even so, Zhou Tong felt fortunate to find the second key in the mirror, but he still needed to locate his group before he could enter the core area.
*Tap... Tap...*
Zhou Tong immediately turned towards the sound of the footsteps, but he right away bowed to them. "Prince Hongwu and Princess Yueliang."
"Where are your other members? Why aren't they here?" Zhou Tong immediately explained to Ximen Hongwu about their situation. "In that case, you could join us to find the way to the gate faster."
"Yes, Prince."
As he led them, Ximen Hongwu asked his sister a question. 'Are you interested in turning this guy into your puppet?'

'No.' Ximen Yueliang answered by shaking her head. 'This guy's cultivation is indeed high, but he is just a useless man, and his family is under our control, so I have no interest in him. We are still having difficulty attacking the Xian Kingdom, so I want Xian Xianwu as my puppet, and I will use him to help our parents destroy his kingdom. As for Zhang Fei, I will not hand him over to anyone, and I will keep him by my side to serve me.'
'You're already captivated by Zhang Fei, huh?' Ximen Hongwu commented by shaking his head.
'Hehe.' Ximen Yueliang giggled in response. 'He is handsome and talented, and all women will undoubtedly be attracted to him, including me.'
Ximen Hongwu released a heavy sigh at her answer, and he asked them to speed up their pace, especially since he wanted to reach the gate to the core area as quickly as possible.

The other two royal members of the Zhou Kingdom had also managed to get out of the mirror, but Zhou Tai's condition was already very weak because his little sister had absorbed so much of his life and soul powers.

At first, Zhou Meiling thought that they would meet Zhou Tong after getting out of the place, so she didn't kill Zhou Tai directly, but they were sent to another area instead. Since they were separated from their big brother, she decided to kill her second brother by absorbing his remaining life and soul powers, causing his body to dry up.

"Hehehe! This way, Zhou Tong and their father will not suspect me, and I will kill them one by one after I return to their kingdom." Zhou Meiling then left the room, but she ran into Ximen Yan's group, who had just come out of the darkness. "Prince Yan."
"Hmm?" Ximen Yan turned to Zhou Meiling directly, but he raised his eyebrows before ordering Qian Ying. "If she tries to do something, you can kill her straight away."

Zhou Meiling was shocked to hear that, but she immediately stepped back when Qian Ying turned to her. 'What the heck is going on with this guy? Doesn't this little girl's family have a good relationship with his family? Why did he order his right-handed woman to kill her?'
"Move." Ximen Yan immediately led his group in front, but Qian Ying moved behind Zhou Meiling, forcing her to follow them.
'Damn it! I have to think of a way to escape from them. ' Zhou Meiling grumbled in her heart.
Zhou Meiling didn't have to wait long as they entered a room full of strange creatures. Qian Ying had to assist Ximen Yan's group, so she immediately fled from them.
"Aren't you going to stop her?" Qian Ying asked as she started attacking those creatures.

Ximen Yan personally engaged in combat with their adversaries. "That girl has been possessed by one of the souls locked in this tower, and that soul is very evil, so we don't need to think about her."
"I see."
After she managed to escape from them, Zhou Meiling rushed to find a way out of the inner area.

Li Yao's group finally succeeded in capturing the largest aquatic beast in the lake after spending so much time trapped. To their surprise, the second key was in the beast's body, and they were immediately sent out to another room after they got it.
When they appeared in the room, Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin's group, who had just completed their test in the wilderness, also arrived there.

"Why are you all so exhausted, Qinglin?" Li Yao asked Luo Qinglin, who immediately told her about their previous test. "Our group also got a similar test, but we were a little luckier than you guys, and we only needed to lure the largest aquatic beast."
"You guys are really lucky." Luo Qinglin then asked her husband. "How about we rest first? We're all very exhausted now, and there's no way we can fight off the enemies that might come our way."

"Yeah, we'll take a break first." Xian Qifeng then turned to Li Yao and the others. "What if we move together? That way, we can face other obstacles more easily, and we might be able to find a way out faster."
"Sure." Since the Yun and Xian Kingdoms had a good relationship, Li Yao immediately agreed with Xian Qifeng, and they rested together in the room to recover their condition.
Xian Yu and Xian Mu's group also managed to pass their hurdles on the scales after trying for a whole day, but some of them died in the test after they fell into the fiery crater below them.

They arrived in the same room as the group of the natural races, who were resting inside. However, Xian Yu and Xian Mu refrained from approaching them due to the clear hostility of Zheng Ru and the group, leading their members to take a rest on the opposite side.

Xian Jinglan, the elf princess, observed them repeatedly and discovered a demon aura emanating from their bodies. 'Their father's decision to join Ximen Gongfu was truly foolish, but it's puzzling how they managed to conceal that aura from Emperor Xian and his wife. If they had known about that, they would have imprisoned these two kids.'
"Guys, it's time for us to leave, as demon scents have contaminated this place." Xi Xianzi abruptly spoke as she floated away, and her group members swiftly followed suit.
'Big Brother, did they notice the demon aura on our bodies?' Xian Mu inquired, his gaze fixed on the group of natural races.

Xian Yu nodded with a frown. 'The natural races possess such abilities, so they must have detected it. However, we don't need to worry about them, especially since they won't meddle in our affairs.' "Let's rest now, and we'll continue our journey afterward."
"Yes."

Unlike their groups, the group from the Beast Kingdom did not look tired at all. They were more interested in exploring the maze and were in no hurry to get to the exit because they kept encountering new, powerful opponents, so Long Chen kept leading them forward without rest.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh after the two notifications appeared, but he then turned to his group members. "Since you've all recovered, we should move now because time is ticking, and the other groups are probably far ahead, so we should catch up with them."

All of them were already bored and fed up with the situation in the test, so they immediately agreed with him, and Zhang Fei hurriedly led them to the room at the end of the path in front of them. There, they encountered dozens of beasts in the sovereign realm, but their cultivation in the seven divine realms made it no big deal, and they immediately slaughtered their enemies without mercy.

After they collected the items that appeared, they hurriedly continued their journey through the only path in front of them. Time passed quickly, and they had already traversed several other rooms. They repeatedly encountered numerous enemies, which forced them to engage in combat.
On the map, Zhang Fei saw that they had reached the middle of the inner area, but they hadn't found the second key, so they focused on finding it first.
After they passed through several more rooms, they finally found the second key in the next room, but they were once again faced with a riddle question to retrieve it.
"I reveal your flaws, yet I hold no judgment. Look into me, and you may see eternity. Destroy me, and you shatter yourself. What am I?"
"Hehe." Bai Tian'er chuckled after she read the question. "This question is too easy for me because our master once said something similar, and the answer is our inner self."
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Instantly, the wall blocking the key disappeared by itself, and Zhang Fei immediately pulled it into his hand. "Now we have no business in the inner area, so we can focus on finding the gate to the core area."

"By the way, we have to prepare for the worst once we enter the core area." Zhang Fei turned to Bai Tian'er, who immediately provided him with an explanation. "We will face one last test in the core area by fighting the gatekeeper, but the beast is powerful and has many strange abilities, including the ability to use soul attacks. Back then, it took us two days to defeat it, but we had several other soul cultivators at that time. Unfortunately, you and I were the only soul cultivators in our group this time, so we had to work hard to protect the others while attacking it."

"If we take too long to defeat it, the other groups might arrive there, and the situation will become chaotic for us, especially since they might take advantage of that to attack us." Ying Shanhu added.
Zhang Fei frowned for a moment before turning to Xian Changyue. "Senior, if that happens, you can concentrate on shielding us from their attacks, and we will battle the beast."
"All right, leave them to me."

Zhang Fei then led them out of the room, but they unexpectedly fell into a trap that even his system couldn't detect. The trap sent them straight into a mini-maze, which was filled with demons. Moreover, they were separated from each other, so they were forced to fight them one by one in order to leave the place.
Zhang Fei immediately summoned the demon extermination sword because his first opponent was a pure giant demon with an inhuman appearance, and the demon's rank was the same as his at the duke rank.
However, the soul of a young boy suddenly appeared above the demon's head, causing Zhang Fei to raise his eyebrows. "Please free us from this place, Big Brother."

"Who are you? How did you get trapped here? What do you mean by us?" Zhang Fei inquired with heightened vigilance, but the demon extermination sword continued to vibrate, seemingly eager to slay the demon before them.

The young boy shook his head at Zhang Fei. "I don't remember my name, and I don't remember how I ended up in this place. I hope you can free us by killing this demon, which is an amalgamation of the souls of many people imprisoned here, or else we will remain imprisoned here."

"All right, I will free you all." After using his demon eyes, Zhang Fei immediately held the demon extermination sword with both hands, channeled his light element into it, and slashed it at the demon.

sentences.text: "Are they not chasing us anymore?" Shang Xinyu inquired after they reached a different location.
"Haha." Shang Yaolin laughed before telling her.
"Xinyu, Long'er has the teleportation ability that he inherited from his father, so you don't have to worry about those people, especially since they've lost track of us now."
"That's right, Big Sis Xinyu." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked into the distance.
"We're already halfway to the northern city, but we shouldn't rush to that city, especially since they might have partners there.
For the time being, I want to look for herbs in this area, and we'll go there after the situation has calmed down."
Both women agreed with that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led them to another area, especially since Mei found a lot of herbs there.
Meanwhile, Ye Hu and the other two had arrived at a hut where a demi-human man with the appearance of a black bear was waiting for them.
They then reported the presence of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women to him.
"What should we do, Big Brother Xiong Ju?"
"Hmm?" Xiong Ju pondered briefly before issuing the order.
"Based on their route and their herb-hunting activities, I believe they intend to go to the northern city.
Therefore, you should go there and instruct our team to monitor the entire area.
Once the three of them appear, you must capture them immediately.
I don't care about the two women, but that male fox's ability seems interesting, so I want to recruit him into our group."
"Big Brother, may we have the two women?"
Xiong Ju nodded to them.
"Don't waste any more time and go to that city, or they will escape, and we will have a hard time finding them."

Even though they were only sovereign-rank beasts, Bai Chongxi and his two siblings were overwhelmed by the beasts blocking them in one room, especially since there were too many of them and they had fought other enemies many times before.
"Big brother, there are too many of them, so we should retreat now to rest first." Bai Renfu spoke as he attacked one of the beasts.
Bai Shouyi agreed with his second brother.
"After we rest, we can fight them again."
"All right." Bai Chongxi immediately ordered the remaining members of their group to retreat outside, and they rested there.
"Swallow recovery pills, especially since we've wasted so much time."
In another area, Huangfu Lian's group was overwhelmed by the strange creatures in front of them, particularly due to their exhaustion from fighting numerous enemies and avoiding numerous traps.

In the end, Huangfu Lian decided to retreat and rest first before fighting them again, but one of the strange creatures suddenly sprayed a black liquid from its mouth, which directly hit the backs of Huang Xiaoying and Huang Xiaomei.
"Retreat!" Huangfu Lian shouted as he hurled an artifact at the strange creatures, causing them to bounce against the back wall.
He and Huangfu Xiaofan then helped their two sisters out, but Huang Xiaoying and Huang Xiaomei right away fell unconscious.
*Tear...
Tear..*
Huangfu Lian immediately laid them on their stomachs and tore the backs of their dresses, but his expression became serious once he saw the black liquid begin to enter their bodies.
"What kind of black liquid is this, Big Brother?"

"I don't know; I've never seen it before." Huangfu Lian immediately took out some pills, forced the two women to swallow them, and then pressed his palms on their backs to remove the black liquid from their bodies.
Unfortunately, his efforts were in vain, and the black liquid spread even faster, so he decided to seal it inside their bodies to prevent it from spreading further.
"Xiaofan, we have no other choice but to surrender, or else they will die."
Huang Xiaofan nodded in agreement with that.
"Our father will definitely be furious because we failed to capture Xian Xianwu, Xian Xianqing, and Yun Xinyue.
However, Xiaoying and Xiaomei's lives are more important, so we should give up.
As for Zhang Fei, we can tell him about that guy, and he will definitely send people to capture him later."
"Yeah." Huangfu Lian immediately raised his hand and shouted upwards, and all of them right away disappeared from that place before being sent out of the tower.
Huangfu Shou's people immediately approached them, and they swiftly brought all of them back to their kingdom at full speed, especially given the concerning condition of the two princesses.

After being trapped in the mirror for a whole day, Zhou Tong finally managed to find his way out, but he was no longer in the previous room, and he was sent to another room, separating him from his two siblings and group.
"Fuck!
What an annoying trap!" Even so, Zhou Tong felt fortunate to find the second key in the mirror, but he still needed to locate his group before he could enter the core area.
*Tap...
Tap...*
Zhou Tong immediately turned towards the sound of the footsteps, but he right away bowed to them.
"Prince Hongwu and Princess Yueliang."
"Where are your other members?
Why aren't they here?" Zhou Tong immediately explained to Ximen Hongwu about their situation.
"In that case, you could join us to find the way to the gate faster."
"Yes, Prince."
As he led them, Ximen Hongwu asked his sister a question. 'Are you interested in turning this guy into your puppet?'
'No.' Ximen Yueliang answered by shaking her head. 'This guy's cultivation is indeed high, but he is just a useless man, and his family is under our control, so I have no interest in him.
We are still having difficulty attacking the Xian Kingdom, so I want Xian Xianwu as my puppet, and I will use him to help our parents destroy his kingdom.
As for Zhang Fei, I will not hand him over to anyone, and I will keep him by my side to serve me.'
'You're already captivated by Zhang Fei, huh?' Ximen Hongwu commented by shaking his head.
'Hehe.' Ximen Yueliang giggled in response. 'He is handsome and talented, and all women will undoubtedly be attracted to him, including me.'
Ximen Hongwu released a heavy sigh at her answer, and he asked them to speed up their pace, especially since he wanted to reach the gate to the core area as quickly as possible.

The other two royal members of the Zhou Kingdom had also managed to get out of the mirror, but Zhou Tai's condition was already very weak because his little sister had absorbed so much of his life and soul powers.
At first, Zhou Meiling thought that they would meet Zhou Tong after getting out of the place, so she didn't kill Zhou Tai directly, but they were sent to another area instead.
Since they were separated from their big brother, she decided to kill her second brother by absorbing his remaining life and soul powers, causing his body to dry up.
"Hehehe!

This way, Zhou Tong and their father will not suspect me, and I will kill them one by one after I return to their kingdom." Zhou Meiling then left the room, but she ran into Ximen Yan's group, who had just come out of the darkness.
"Prince Yan."
"Hmm?" Ximen Yan turned to Zhou Meiling directly, but he raised his eyebrows before ordering Qian Ying.
"If she tries to do something, you can kill her straight away."
Zhou Meiling was shocked to hear that, but she immediately stepped back when Qian Ying turned to her. 'What the heck is going on with this guy?
Doesn't this little girl's family have a good relationship with his family?
Why did he order his right-handed woman to kill her?'
"Move." Ximen Yan immediately led his group in front, but Qian Ying moved behind Zhou Meiling, forcing her to follow them.
'Damn it!
I have to think of a way to escape from them. ' Zhou Meiling grumbled in her heart.
Zhou Meiling didn't have to wait long as they entered a room full of strange creatures.
Qian Ying had to assist Ximen Yan's group, so she immediately fled from them.
"Aren't you going to stop her?" Qian Ying asked as she started attacking those creatures.
Ximen Yan personally engaged in combat with their adversaries.
"That girl has been possessed by one of the souls locked in this tower, and that soul is very evil, so we don't need to think about her."
"I see."
After she managed to escape from them, Zhou Meiling rushed to find a way out of the inner area.
Li Yao's group finally succeeded in capturing the largest aquatic beast in the lake after spending so much time trapped.
To their surprise, the second key was in the beast's body, and they were immediately sent out to another room after they got it.
When they appeared in the room, Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin's group, who had just completed their test in the wilderness, also arrived there.
"Why are you all so exhausted, Qinglin?" Li Yao asked Luo Qinglin, who immediately told her about their previous test.
"Our group also got a similar test, but we were a little luckier than you guys, and we only needed to lure the largest aquatic beast."
"You guys are really lucky." Luo Qinglin then asked her husband.
"How about we rest first?
We're all very exhausted now, and there's no way we can fight off the enemies that might come our way."
"Yeah, we'll take a break first." Xian Qifeng then turned to Li Yao and the others.
"What if we move together?
That way, we can face other obstacles more easily, and we might be able to find a way out faster."
"Sure." Since the Yun and Xian Kingdoms had a good relationship, Li Yao immediately agreed with Xian Qifeng, and they rested together in the room to recover their condition.
Xian Yu and Xian Mu's group also managed to pass their hurdles on the scales after trying for a whole day, but some of them died in the test after they fell into the fiery crater below them.
They arrived in the same room as the group of the natural races, who were resting inside.
However, Xian Yu and Xian Mu refrained from approaching them due to the clear hostility of Zheng Ru and the group, leading their members to take a rest on the opposite side.

Xian Jinglan, the elf princess, observed them repeatedly and discovered a demon aura emanating from their bodies. 'Their father's decision to join Ximen Gongfu was truly foolish, but it's puzzling how they managed to conceal that aura from Emperor Xian and his wife.
If they had known about that, they would have imprisoned these two kids.'
"Guys, it's time for us to leave, as demon scents have contaminated this place." Xi Xianzi abruptly spoke as she floated away, and her group members swiftly followed suit.
'Big Brother, did they notice the demon aura on our bodies?' Xian Mu inquired, his gaze fixed on the group of natural races.
Xian Yu nodded with a frown. 'The natural races possess such abilities, so they must have detected it.
However, we don't need to worry about them, especially since they won't meddle in our affairs.' "Let's rest now, and we'll continue our journey afterward."
"Yes."
Unlike their groups, the group from the Beast Kingdom did not look tired at all.
They were more interested in exploring the maze and were in no hurry to get to the exit because they kept encountering new, powerful opponents, so Long Chen kept leading them forward without rest.
