chapters.title: Chapter 583 Leave The Demon Maze
paragraphs: *Swoosh... Swoosh...*

As soon as the demon extermination sword struck it, the giant demon's body immediately emitted black light before splitting into hundreds of human souls, leaving Zhang Fei stunned for a moment by their numbers.
"Thank you, young man. We have been trapped for too long and turned into the demon, but we can be relieved now."

"Exactly how did you guys end up here?" Zhang Fei frowned as they immediately told him everything, including the identity of the person who had locked them up there. "Leave now and enter the reincarnation circle."
One by one, the human souls shot into the sky and disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight, but the young boy was still floating in front of him. "Big brother, can I ask you for one more favor?"

"Sure." The young boy promptly shared a few things with Zhang Fei. "All right, I will go to that realm in the future, but I can't promise that I can meet your family because your death was too long ago."
"Thank you, Big Brother." After that, the young boy immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight.

"The world of cultivation is indeed too cruel and dangerous, but I never thought that there would be a cultivator so cruel that he or she would sacrifice millions of people just to fulfill his or her ambition. Unfortunately, they don't know the exact identity of that person, so I have to be more careful when I go to the upper realms in the future." Zhang Fei then rushed off to find his group members, but many demons blocked his path.

Zhang Fei easily killed them with the upgraded demon extermination sword and his light element. Furthermore, the demon maze had no restrictions, allowing him to search for the demons and their group members without significant obstacles, ultimately freeing the souls of the humans who had transformed into those demons.

"Retreat, Senior Sister Zhiqiu." Hearing that, Ye Zhiqiu, who was too overwhelmed to face the demon, immediately jumped back. Zhang Fei's light sword Qi shot toward the demon, splitting it in two, and the human souls immediately scattered into the sky.
"What are they, Zhang Fei?" Ye Zhiqiu asked as she pointed to the sky.

"Those demons are the souls of humans, trapped in this maze." Ye Zhiqiu turned to Zhang Fei in shock, and he immediately relayed the information he had learned from the young boy and the previous souls, causing her to tremble in fear. "That person is indeed too cruel to sacrifice them, but he or she seems to live in the upper realms, so you don't need to worry too much about it."

"Yeah." Ye Zhiqiu then followed behind Zhang Fei, but she didn't need to exhaust herself fighting every demon they encountered, especially since he killed all of them with one attack. 'How strong is he really? I fought with one of those demons for so long, and I couldn't kill it with my current strength, yet they were like tofu before his attack.'

Ye Zhiqiu herself didn't know the name of Zhang Fei's sword, and the demon extermination sword was specially forged to kill the demons. Additionally, his light element was also stronger than many light element cultivators, especially after he mastered the initial stage of the light element law, which was thanks to Shi Qingzhuang sharing her method with him.

While they were en route to another area, a woman unexpectedly ran towards them, pursued by several demons. Zhang Fei and Ye Zhiqiu immediately recognized her identity, especially since she was Zhou Meiling.
After she managed to escape from Ximen Yan and Qian Ying, Zhou Meiling had the misfortune of entering one of the traps in the maze, which immediately transported her to the demon maze.
"Help!" Zhou Meiling cried out for help as she waved her hands.
Zhang Fei actually did not want to save Zhou Meiling, but he felt the need to free other human souls. He slashed the demon extermination toward those demons, exterminating them instantly.

Zhang Fei then took Ye Zhiqiu away quickly, especially since Mei had discovered another woman's soul within Zhou Meiling's body. Unfortunately, they had no information about the woman's soul, but her actions of controlling the Zhou Princess already showed that she was not a good woman.
Zhou Meiling was stunned once Zhang Fei and Ye Zhiqiu disappeared from her sight. "That brat! Why did he leave me here? Damn it! I need his body and soul power, so I have to chase him right away."

Zhang Fei himself had already told them about the woman's soul inside Zhou Meiling's body, so Ye Zhiqiu wasn't surprised by his decision to take her away from the Zhou Princess, but his speed was still astonishing to her.

After some time, Zhang Fei and Ye Zhiqiu encountered three other members of their group and proceeded to travel together. He continued to monitor the movements of Zhou Meiling, who was steadily approaching their location, especially considering that he had defeated a significant number of demons in their path.

Zhang Fei asked them to disregard Zhou Meiling and led them to locate their other members. They relentlessly ran through the dark path of the demon maze, eliminating every demon that stood in their way.
After several hours, they were reunited with most of them, except for four people. Unfortunately, they were unable to locate the two princesses due to their remote locations.

Zhang Fei was worried about Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, especially since the map showed that the path ahead of the two women was filled with demons and they were alone. Despite Xian Changyue and Ximen Chuixue being alone in distant locations, he did not worry about them, as they were capable of handling the demons that attacked them. "You guys can handle these demons, right? I have to go to Xianqin's location quickly, or she will be in danger."
"All right, you can pick up Princess Xianqin, and I will lead them to the exit." Ye Zhiqiu and the others nodded in agreement with Bai Tian'er.
"Always be careful of Zhou Meiling." After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately used his teleportation repeatedly, but the paths inside the demon maze were quite troublesome for him.

Bai Tian'er immediately led the others towards the exit, and they continued to monitor Zhou Meiling with their senses, especially since they feared that the woman's soul inside her body would move to one of them.

"Ugh!" Xian Xianqin, who was fighting with a demon, suddenly staggered backward. Her head grew heavy, and her vision began to blur, particularly after the demon used a soul attack against her. 'Shit! This demon's soul attack is not very strong, but it is still troublesome. If Zhang Fei or Senior Sister Tian'er were here with me, I wouldn't have faced such a difficult situation.'
*Swoosh*

Xian Xianqin immediately jumped to dodge as soon as the demon spat its acidic spit at her, and it caused the ground at her previous spot to dissolve. 'Tch! I am a cultivator and also a princess, so I can't continue to depend on other people, and I must defeat this demon myself.'

Xian Xianqin held the hilt of her sword with both hands, took an attacking stance with the blade pointed at the demon, and released her wind element strengthened with the wind element law. 'I haven't fully mastered this technique, but I have no other choice now, so I'll use it to defeat this demon.'

'Feather Wind Dance!' A green aura instantly enveloped Xian Xianqin's body as she dashed toward the demon. She maneuvered around the demon, repeatedly slashing her sword at it, each movement akin to a sword dance that swiftly covered its body in sword wounds.
*Slash... Slash... Slash...*
*Rip*

Xian Xianqin managed to cut off the demon's left arm, but it didn't show any reaction, as if it didn't feel any pain. The demon suddenly roared, and its aura exploded, causing the area to shake as it stomped its feet on the ground.

Xian Xianqin, who lost her balance, immediately stabilized herself and jumped away from the demon. The demon immediately dashed towards him and used a soul attack once again, causing him to stagger backward.
'Shit!' Xian Xianqin immediately stomped her right leg behind her, pointed her green sword at the demon, and released her full strength.
*Swoosh*

Following that, Xian Xianqin hastened toward the demon, focusing her gaze solely on its head, specifically its neck. As they faced each other, the demon was about to punch her, but she immediately jumped up in a sideways position, slashing her sword at its neck. 'Wind edge slash!'
*Splurt*

Blood spurted from the demon's neck, instantly flinging its head upwards, and its body fell to the ground, scattering human souls into the air. Xian Xianxin herself immediately landed on the ground unsteadily, but Zhang Fei suddenly appeared behind her and supported her. "Sorry, I'm late, Qin'er."

"Hah... Hah..." Xian Xianqin panted heavily and leaned her body into Zhang Fei's arms. "I can deal with the other demons, but this one is different from them. It can use a soul attack, so I have to use my full strength to kill it."

"I'm here now, and I will protect you from these demons." Zhang Fei then gave Xian Xianqin a piggyback ride, and he didn't forget to give her a Qi recovery pill so that she could recover her depleted Qi more quickly. "Xinyue's location is a little far from here, and she seems to be struggling to fight them, so we'll go there to save her."
"Yeah." Xian Xianqin then closed her eyes, circulated her breath, and absorbed Qi from the air.

Sometimes later, they arrived at Yun Xinyue's location, but she was lying exhausted on the ground with a dirty body, and her breathing was irregular. Despite her jealousy over Zhang Fei's rescue of Xian Xianqin before her, she remained silent and smiled at him. "Please carry me, Fei. I have never felt this tired before, especially since these demons are too persistent in attacking me, so my qi is very thin now, and my body doesn't want to compromise on moving."

"Honestly, I've been watching you from a faraway location, and your fighting skills are quite impressive, especially since these demons are not easy to defeat." Zhang Fei immediately put a Qi recovery pill into Yun Xinyue's mouth and carried her like a princess, particularly considering that Xian Xianqin was sleeping on his back. "The others should have gathered at the exit, so we'll go there directly."
"Yeah." Yun Xinyue then buried her face in Zhang Fei's chest and savored his manly scent. "I'll sleep first to recover."

When Zhang Fei arrived at the exit, he saw Zhou Meiling there with a sour look, especially since Xian Xianwu and the others ignored her. Moreover, Xian Changyue was with them, so she didn't dare to approach them.

Zhang Fei then led them to another area as he continued to carry the two women, making the female disciples wonder about their relationship. They knew that Xian Xianqin had fallen for him, but they never noticed that Yun Xinyue had also fallen for him, especially since she never showed it on her face.

Sometime later, they arrived at an empty room, and Zhou Meiling was still following them. Zhang Fei then laid the two women on the floor and asked the others to rest, but he and Xian Changyue remained awake while monitoring the Zhou Princess.

Zhou Meiling sat alone in front of them, hugged her legs, and buried her head between her knees. However, she repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Fei, thinking of ways to do something against him. 'Tch! This guy is extremely vigilant, and his soul power is very strong, making it impossible for me to possess him and take over his body. Moreover, Xian Changyue is constantly monitoring me, so I have to think of a way to separate him from them, and I have to weaken him first before taking over his body.'
'What are your plans for her? Are you going to help her expel that woman's soul from her body?'

Zhang Fei shook his head at Xian Changyue. 'I have no relationship with her, so why should I help her? Furthermore, the Zhou Kingdom is your kingdom's adversary, and their strength will be weakened if their princess dies.'

'You're wrong about that.' Xian Changyue then told Zhang Fei. 'Zhou Meiling is indeed talented, but she is not the main princess. There are several other princesses besides her, and the strongest one is Zhou Shenxin, whose cultivation is comparable to that of Zhou Tong. Furthermore, Zhou Xiaochuan views them as mere tools and doesn't care much about them, so her death won't have a significant impact.'

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after he remembered Xian Xianqin's explanation a few days ago that Zhou Xiaochuan had dozens of children. 'I have no plans against Zhou Meiling, but I want to do something about the woman's soul inside her body, especially since her soul is supposed to be strong.'
'Do you intend to absorb that woman's soul?' Xian Changyue asked with a frown.

'Yes.' Zhang Fei acknowledged it with a nod. 'I have to meet someone in ten days, and that person is the best soul cultivator. Unfortunately, he will not be willing to meet me if my soul power has not been broken through to the initial stage of the earthly soul level, so I will use that woman's soul to boost my soul power.'

'You're crazy; do you know that?' Zhang Fei smiled at Xian Changyue's remarks, causing her to sigh. 'Hey, I saw you dual soul cultivating with Bai Tian'er before, and my niece is already halfway to becoming your woman, so I thought you could teach her the soul cultivation path and do it with her.'

'I planned to teach Qin'er about soul cultivation, but I'll wait until we leave this tower.' Zhang Fei then asked Xian Changyue. 'Are you interested in the soul cultivation path? Although not all cultivators have talent in that path, I can teach you to become one, and you will enjoy the benefits of being a soul cultivator.'
Xian Changyue thought for a while before nodding. 'All right, I will learn about the soul cultivation path from you, and I will infiltrate the Huangfu Kingdom after I become one.'

'I think you should think twice about infiltrating that kingdom.' Xian Changyue wanted to refute him, but Zhang Fei hurriedly continued. 'I suspect that the powerful cultivator behind Huangfu Shou is a cultivator from the upper realms, and you should remember that there are many techniques or artifacts that can see through our concealment. If my guess is right, that person probably has one of them, and they will capture you if you infiltrate there rashly. Moreover, there are not many strong cultivators in your kingdom, and your kingdom will be even weaker if you fall into their hands. Additionally, that person can help him control Bai Yaowei, so I'm sure that person will also help him control you, which will complicate your kingdom's situation.'
Xian Changyue nodded her head repeatedly as a sign of understanding. 'So, what do you think I should do so that we can get information about the person behind Huangfu Shou?'

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei furrowed his brows in thought. 'Huangfu Shou's four children are in this tower, so I think we can capture one of them, and I can help you control him or her. That way, we can use him or her as our spy, eliminating the need for you to take risky actions to infiltrate their kingdom.'
'Do you also have a technique for controlling others?' Xian Changyue asked in surprise.
Zhang Fei realized that Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang had not told Xian Changyue about his demon identity. 'I have one, and I can use it on one of them, but we must find them first.'
'All right; I will follow your plan.'
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei didn't know yet that Huangfu Lian and his three siblings had been expelled from the Star Tower after he surrendered, and they had already returned to their kingdom.

sentences.text: *Swoosh...
Swoosh...*

As soon as the demon extermination sword struck it, the giant demon's body immediately emitted black light before splitting into hundreds of human souls, leaving Zhang Fei stunned for a moment by their numbers.
"Thank you, young man.
We have been trapped for too long and turned into the demon, but we can be relieved now."
"Exactly how did you guys end up here?" Zhang Fei frowned as they immediately told him everything, including the identity of the person who had locked them up there.
"Leave now and enter the reincarnation circle."
One by one, the human souls shot into the sky and disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight, but the young boy was still floating in front of him.
"Big brother, can I ask you for one more favor?"
"Sure." The young boy promptly shared a few things with Zhang Fei.
"All right, I will go to that realm in the future, but I can't promise that I can meet your family because your death was too long ago."
"Thank you, Big Brother." After that, the young boy immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight.

"The world of cultivation is indeed too cruel and dangerous, but I never thought that there would be a cultivator so cruel that he or she would sacrifice millions of people just to fulfill his or her ambition.

Unfortunately, they don't know the exact identity of that person, so I have to be more careful when I go to the upper realms in the future." Zhang Fei then rushed off to find his group members, but many demons blocked his path.
Zhang Fei easily killed them with the upgraded demon extermination sword and his light element.

Furthermore, the demon maze had no restrictions, allowing him to search for the demons and their group members without significant obstacles, ultimately freeing the souls of the humans who had transformed into those demons.
"Retreat, Senior Sister Zhiqiu." Hearing that, Ye Zhiqiu, who was too overwhelmed to face the demon, immediately jumped back.
Zhang Fei's light sword Qi shot toward the demon, splitting it in two, and the human souls immediately scattered into the sky.
"What are they, Zhang Fei?" Ye Zhiqiu asked as she pointed to the sky.

"Those demons are the souls of humans, trapped in this maze." Ye Zhiqiu turned to Zhang Fei in shock, and he immediately relayed the information he had learned from the young boy and the previous souls, causing her to tremble in fear.
"That person is indeed too cruel to sacrifice them, but he or she seems to live in the upper realms, so you don't need to worry too much about it."

"Yeah." Ye Zhiqiu then followed behind Zhang Fei, but she didn't need to exhaust herself fighting every demon they encountered, especially since he killed all of them with one attack. 'How strong is he really?
I fought with one of those demons for so long, and I couldn't kill it with my current strength, yet they were like tofu before his attack.'
Ye Zhiqiu herself didn't know the name of Zhang Fei's sword, and the demon extermination sword was specially forged to kill the demons.

Additionally, his light element was also stronger than many light element cultivators, especially after he mastered the initial stage of the light element law, which was thanks to Shi Qingzhuang sharing her method with him.
While they were en route to another area, a woman unexpectedly ran towards them, pursued by several demons.
Zhang Fei and Ye Zhiqiu immediately recognized her identity, especially since she was Zhou Meiling.
After she managed to escape from Ximen Yan and Qian Ying, Zhou Meiling had the misfortune of entering one of the traps in the maze, which immediately transported her to the demon maze.
"Help!" Zhou Meiling cried out for help as she waved her hands.
Zhang Fei actually did not want to save Zhou Meiling, but he felt the need to free other human souls.
He slashed the demon extermination toward those demons, exterminating them instantly.
Zhang Fei then took Ye Zhiqiu away quickly, especially since Mei had discovered another woman's soul within Zhou Meiling's body.
Unfortunately, they had no information about the woman's soul, but her actions of controlling the Zhou Princess already showed that she was not a good woman.
Zhou Meiling was stunned once Zhang Fei and Ye Zhiqiu disappeared from her sight.
"That brat!
Why did he leave me here?
Damn it!
I need his body and soul power, so I have to chase him right away."

Zhang Fei himself had already told them about the woman's soul inside Zhou Meiling's body, so Ye Zhiqiu wasn't surprised by his decision to take her away from the Zhou Princess, but his speed was still astonishing to her.
After some time, Zhang Fei and Ye Zhiqiu encountered three other members of their group and proceeded to travel together.
He continued to monitor the movements of Zhou Meiling, who was steadily approaching their location, especially considering that he had defeated a significant number of demons in their path.
Zhang Fei asked them to disregard Zhou Meiling and led them to locate their other members.
They relentlessly ran through the dark path of the demon maze, eliminating every demon that stood in their way.
After several hours, they were reunited with most of them, except for four people.
Unfortunately, they were unable to locate the two princesses due to their remote locations.
Zhang Fei was worried about Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, especially since the map showed that the path ahead of the two women was filled with demons and they were alone.
Despite Xian Changyue and Ximen Chuixue being alone in distant locations, he did not worry about them, as they were capable of handling the demons that attacked them.
"You guys can handle these demons, right?
I have to go to Xianqin's location quickly, or she will be in danger."
"All right, you can pick up Princess Xianqin, and I will lead them to the exit." Ye Zhiqiu and the others nodded in agreement with Bai Tian'er.
"Always be careful of Zhou Meiling." After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately used his teleportation repeatedly, but the paths inside the demon maze were quite troublesome for him.

Bai Tian'er immediately led the others towards the exit, and they continued to monitor Zhou Meiling with their senses, especially since they feared that the woman's soul inside her body would move to one of them.
"Ugh!" Xian Xianqin, who was fighting with a demon, suddenly staggered backward.
Her head grew heavy, and her vision began to blur, particularly after the demon used a soul attack against her. 'Shit!
This demon's soul attack is not very strong, but it is still troublesome.
If Zhang Fei or Senior Sister Tian'er were here with me, I wouldn't have faced such a difficult situation.'
*Swoosh*
Xian Xianqin immediately jumped to dodge as soon as the demon spat its acidic spit at her, and it caused the ground at her previous spot to dissolve. 'Tch!
I am a cultivator and also a princess, so I can't continue to depend on other people, and I must defeat this demon myself.'

Xian Xianqin held the hilt of her sword with both hands, took an attacking stance with the blade pointed at the demon, and released her wind element strengthened with the wind element law. 'I haven't fully mastered this technique, but I have no other choice now, so I'll use it to defeat this demon.'
'Feather Wind Dance!' A green aura instantly enveloped Xian Xianqin's body as she dashed toward the demon.
She maneuvered around the demon, repeatedly slashing her sword at it, each movement akin to a sword dance that swiftly covered its body in sword wounds.
*Slash...
Slash...
Slash...*
*Rip*
Xian Xianqin managed to cut off the demon's left arm, but it didn't show any reaction, as if it didn't feel any pain.
The demon suddenly roared, and its aura exploded, causing the area to shake as it stomped its feet on the ground.
Xian Xianqin, who lost her balance, immediately stabilized herself and jumped away from the demon.
The demon immediately dashed towards him and used a soul attack once again, causing him to stagger backward.
'Shit!' Xian Xianqin immediately stomped her right leg behind her, pointed her green sword at the demon, and released her full strength.
*Swoosh*
Following that, Xian Xianqin hastened toward the demon, focusing her gaze solely on its head, specifically its neck.
As they faced each other, the demon was about to punch her, but she immediately jumped up in a sideways position, slashing her sword at its neck. 'Wind edge slash!'
*Splurt*
Blood spurted from the demon's neck, instantly flinging its head upwards, and its body fell to the ground, scattering human souls into the air.
Xian Xianxin herself immediately landed on the ground unsteadily, but Zhang Fei suddenly appeared behind her and supported her.
"Sorry, I'm late, Qin'er."
"Hah...
Hah..." Xian Xianqin panted heavily and leaned her body into Zhang Fei's arms.
"I can deal with the other demons, but this one is different from them.
It can use a soul attack, so I have to use my full strength to kill it."

"I'm here now, and I will protect you from these demons." Zhang Fei then gave Xian Xianqin a piggyback ride, and he didn't forget to give her a Qi recovery pill so that she could recover her depleted Qi more quickly.
"Xinyue's location is a little far from here, and she seems to be struggling to fight them, so we'll go there to save her."
"Yeah." Xian Xianqin then closed her eyes, circulated her breath, and absorbed Qi from the air.
Sometimes later, they arrived at Yun Xinyue's location, but she was lying exhausted on the ground with a dirty body, and her breathing was irregular.
Despite her jealousy over Zhang Fei's rescue of Xian Xianqin before her, she remained silent and smiled at him.
"Please carry me, Fei.
I have never felt this tired before, especially since these demons are too persistent in attacking me, so my qi is very thin now, and my body doesn't want to compromise on moving."

"Honestly, I've been watching you from a faraway location, and your fighting skills are quite impressive, especially since these demons are not easy to defeat." Zhang Fei immediately put a Qi recovery pill into Yun Xinyue's mouth and carried her like a princess, particularly considering that Xian Xianqin was sleeping on his back.
"The others should have gathered at the exit, so we'll go there directly."
"Yeah." Yun Xinyue then buried her face in Zhang Fei's chest and savored his manly scent.
"I'll sleep first to recover."
When Zhang Fei arrived at the exit, he saw Zhou Meiling there with a sour look, especially since Xian Xianwu and the others ignored her.
Moreover, Xian Changyue was with them, so she didn't dare to approach them.
Zhang Fei then led them to another area as he continued to carry the two women, making the female disciples wonder about their relationship.
They knew that Xian Xianqin had fallen for him, but they never noticed that Yun Xinyue had also fallen for him, especially since she never showed it on her face.
Sometime later, they arrived at an empty room, and Zhou Meiling was still following them.
Zhang Fei then laid the two women on the floor and asked the others to rest, but he and Xian Changyue remained awake while monitoring the Zhou Princess.
Zhou Meiling sat alone in front of them, hugged her legs, and buried her head between her knees.
However, she repeatedly stole glances at Zhang Fei, thinking of ways to do something against him. 'Tch!
This guy is extremely vigilant, and his soul power is very strong, making it impossible for me to possess him and take over his body.
Moreover, Xian Changyue is constantly monitoring me, so I have to think of a way to separate him from them, and I have to weaken him first before taking over his body.'
'What are your plans for her?
Are you going to help her expel that woman's soul from her body?'
Zhang Fei shook his head at Xian Changyue. 'I have no relationship with her, so why should I help her?
Furthermore, the Zhou Kingdom is your kingdom's adversary, and their strength will be weakened if their princess dies.'
'You're wrong about that.' Xian Changyue then told Zhang Fei. 'Zhou Meiling is indeed talented, but she is not the main princess.
There are several other princesses besides her, and the strongest one is Zhou Shenxin, whose cultivation is comparable to that of Zhou Tong.
Furthermore, Zhou Xiaochuan views them as mere tools and doesn't care much about them, so her death won't have a significant impact.'

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after he remembered Xian Xianqin's explanation a few days ago that Zhou Xiaochuan had dozens of children. 'I have no plans against Zhou Meiling, but I want to do something about the woman's soul inside her body, especially since her soul is supposed to be strong.'
'Do you intend to absorb that woman's soul?' Xian Changyue asked with a frown.
'Yes.' Zhang Fei acknowledged it with a nod. 'I have to meet someone in ten days, and that person is the best soul cultivator.
Unfortunately, he will not be willing to meet me if my soul power has not been broken through to the initial stage of the earthly soul level, so I will use that woman's soul to boost my soul power.'

'You're crazy; do you know that?' Zhang Fei smiled at Xian Changyue's remarks, causing her to sigh. 'Hey, I saw you dual soul cultivating with Bai Tian'er before, and my niece is already halfway to becoming your woman, so I thought you could teach her the soul cultivation path and do it with her.'
'I planned to teach Qin'er about soul cultivation, but I'll wait until we leave this tower.' Zhang Fei then asked Xian Changyue. 'Are you interested in the soul cultivation path?
Although not all cultivators have talent in that path, I can teach you to become one, and you will enjoy the benefits of being a soul cultivator.'
Xian Changyue thought for a while before nodding. 'All right, I will learn about the soul cultivation path from you, and I will infiltrate the Huangfu Kingdom after I become one.'

paragraphs: A middle-aged woman in the Zhou Kingdom was heartbroken as she held a broken jade in her hand. Several other middle-aged women tried to comfort her, but she ignored them and continued to cry.

Behind them, a middle-aged man in a grand robe stood with a dark face, and he was the Emperor of the Zhou Kingdom, Zhou Xiaochuan. The middle-aged woman who continued to cry was one of his wives and Zhou Tai's mother, Rong Jinglin. "Were there people who had previously targeted Tai'er, Fang'er?"

"No, Father." Zhou Fang, standing behind him, responded by shaking his head. "Everything went smoothly during the first three challenges, but I don't know if there were any changes in the maze challenge."
Zhou Xiaochuan nodded in understanding. "I want you to go to the army barracks and train with them for a month, and I will test your combat abilities after you return."
"Yes, Father."

As Zhou Fang walked out of the room, a young woman with the appearance of a teenager in her mid-twenties gracefully walked in. Although she looked so young, she was actually as old as Zhou Tong, especially since she was Zhou Shenxin, the first princess of the Zhou Kingdom.

Zhou Shenxin was a beauty with a fine nose and cherry lips. Her beautiful cloud-like hair, which draped over her shoulders, revealed her slender nape. There was a mix of purity and seductiveness, aloofness, allure, and other strikingly contrasting dispositions on her beautiful face. She possessed a pair of sea-blue eyes, decorated with shapely eyebrows, and matched her fair white skin and clear-cut features.

Zhou Shenxin possessed a well-defined physique, particularly her legs. They were slim and long, and her backside was highly raised, displaying amazing flexibility. Her frontside was capable of intoxicating any man's soul and heart, particularly her round and bouncy breasts.
"Big Sister." Zhou Shenxin simply nodded to Zhou Fang and walked to their father's side, so he immediately walked away. 'Seductive but indifferent as always.'
"Why did you summon me, Father?" Zhou Shenxin inquired in a soft and melodious voice.

"Tai'er is dead." After a moment of shock, Zhou Shenxin turned her gaze to the few middle-aged women in front of them. "I don't know how he died, and their guards don't know either because he was in the maze challenge, but I'm sure one of those princes or princesses killed him."
"Do you want me to investigate the identity of Tai'er's murderer?"

"Yes." Zhou Xiaochuan nodded in response. "Your mastery of the Soul Whisper Art is the best among your brothers and sisters, and you also obtained a special demon bloodline from Nu Huangjin, so I want you to investigate this matter after they return. In addition, I want you to investigate a young man named Zhang Fei, who has close ties with the Xian Kingdom, and I want you to use all means to draw him to our side."

"Zhang Fei?" Zhou Xiaochuan promptly informed his eldest daughter about Zhang Fei, citing reports from his subordinates and Zhou Fang. Zhou Shenxin was surprised by this revelation, especially given his impressive strength. "If he's that strong and talented, I'm sure Young Master Yan and Young Master Hongwu will try to capture him. Not only them, but Huangfu Shou will also want him, so it won't be easy to bring him to our side."

"That's why I asked you to use all means." Zhou Xiaochuan turned to Zhou Shenxin. "He has a close relationship with Xian Xianqin, and we can use him to capture her, thereby forcing Xian Feng to surrender to us."
"Oh?" Zhou Shenxin was surprised to hear Zhang Fei's closeness to Xian Xianqin. "Does that mean he's on the Xian Kingdom's side now?"
"Yes." Zhou Xiaochuan replied with a slight nod. "He also seems to be close to Yun Xinyue, so bring him to me, or I will strip you of your stats as the first princess."

Zhou Shenxin was furious because of that, but she didn't say anything to refute her father, especially since it would be useless. "All right, I will do it, but I need information about his situation first. If Young Master Yan, Young Master Hongwu, or Huangfu Lian manage to capture him first in the maze challenge, then I won't be able to bring him to you."
"You can contact Zhou Hanling for that, as he is at the Star Tower now."
"Yes, Father." Zhou Shenxin then hurriedly left the room.
Zhou Xiaochuan looked at his wife and concubine for a while before leaving the room, and he also ordered some of his subordinates to infiltrate the Xian Kingdom.
"How are my two daughters, Luan Xing?" Huangfu Shou asked a middle-aged woman who was examining Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei.

Luan Xing let out a heavy sigh before turning to him. "Emperor, the black liquid has already spread throughout their cultivation veins, and it has begun to spread to their internal organs. For now, I can only prevent it from spreading further, but I have no method to remove it from their bodies."

When Huangfu Shou heard that, he became enraged and wanted to kill Luan Yingwu outright. However, his wife, Helian Yueyi, immediately stopped him. "Husband, this black liquid is not an ordinary thing, so you don't need to blame her."
"Leave."
Luan Yingwu, filled with gratitude, glanced at Helian Yueyi before hastily departing from the two women's room, driven by her fear that Huangfu Shou might suddenly change his mind and kill her.
Shortly after the female physician left, a mysterious person wearing a black robe and a black mask appeared in the room, surprising Huangfu Shou and Helian Yueyi. "Can you save my daughter, Senior?"

"I'll try it first." Based on his voice, the mysterious person was a man. He immediately sat down by the bed and checked the condition of the two women, but Huangfu Shou and Helian Yueyi did not notice the shocked expression behind his black mask. 'What kind of black liquid is this? I've seen many poisons and strange liquids in the upper realms, but I've never encountered anything like this before. This black liquid does not harm their lives, but it seems to be trying to take over their bodies, and they might become strange creatures in the maze.'

The man, having lived in Huangfu Palace for a long time and possessing a high level of cultivation, had heard reports from Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan about the events in the maze. He immediately did something about the black liquid in the two women's bodies before turning to Huangfu Shou and Helian Yueyi. "I have never seen this black liquid before, but I can say for sure that their lives are not in danger. It behaves like a parasite, and if it spreads throughout their bodies, it will transform them into those strange creatures. Therefore, I have sealed it inside their bodies for the time being."

Huangfu Shou and Helian Yueyi's faces turned pale, especially since their two sons had already described to them those strange creatures, and they were creatures that had no consciousness and only had the desire to kill. "Can you find something to remove the black liquid from their bodies, Senior?"

"I don't know." The man then took out a dagger, slashed Huangfu Xiaoying's back, and collected some of the black liquid into a bottle. "I'll go back to the upper realms to find the antidote, but I'm not sure if I can find it. You better seal this kingdom while I'm gone, or they'll attack you."
"Yes, I'll do it right now." After the man disappeared, Huangfu Shou hurriedly left his two daughters' room and ordered his subordinates to seal his kingdom.

Meanwhile, Helian Yueyi sat by the bedside as she rubbed her two daughters' heads, her expression filled with sadness at their condition. "Sigh! I hope he can find an antidote, or else they will turn into those strange creatures.

In another area, Huangfu Lian and his third brother sat together, their expressions intensely serious after hearing their father order his subordinates to seal their kingdom. He didn't even allow them to leave the kingdom, which meant that the problem they were facing was truly dire.
"Do you think our father's decision has anything to do with Xiaoying and Xiaomei's condition?" Huangfu Xiaofan asked his first brother.
"That's for sure." Huangfu Lian replied with a nod. "However, I don't know why he had to do it, especially since their condition has nothing to do with the safety of our kingdom."

Huangfu Xiaofan let out a soft sigh and stood up. "Fortunately, our father is willing to accept our failure, or else he will punish us. Since we can't leave, I will go to Brother Xiaogang's place, and I will train with him for the time being."

After his third brother left, Huangfu Lian tried to contact his two women, Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying. Unfortunately, the formation in the kingdom restricted communication with the outside world, so he rushed off somewhere else to have fun with his other women.

Zhang Lingxue, who was sitting in front of Zhang Fei [1], suddenly smelled the pill aroma coming out of the furnace, indicating that he was close to successfully concocting a rank-2 pill.
A while later, Zhang Fei [1] withdrew his fire qi and opened the lid of his furnace. He smiled with satisfaction as he removed two white pills from the furnace, both of which were of superior grade.
[Ding]
[Alchemy feature upgraded to level 2]
[New items available.]

Zhang Fei [1] ignored the notification and looked at the pills. "Even though these foundation pills are only rank 2, concocting them is quite difficult, but I finally managed to concoct them. Unfortunately, the effects are not as beneficial as mine, but they still hold value if we sell them in our shop."

"That's true." Zhang Lingxue then took the pills from his hands. "This way, you have officially become a master alchemist, and you can start learning to concoct rank-3 pills. If we can continue to concoct superior-grade pills, we can sell them at a high price. However, it will attract the attention of the alchemy union again, and they might take other actions against us. Although Big Sis Yao's suppression of their leaders may have prevented them from directly attacking us, their high popularity and long-standing control over the alchemy market could still hinder our business."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei [1] then touched her forehead, especially since he still hasn't imparted the Divine Alchemy Method to her. After all, she is his wife, so her alchemy skills will be further enhanced, making it easier for him to increase her alchemy rank.

Zhang Lingxue was momentarily stunned when the method flashed into her mind, and her expression changed to one of shock upon reading it. She had repeatedly seen Zhang Fei [1] bring out many extraordinary things, but the method was too extraordinary. "Husband, I am truly speechless; you possess an abundance of secrets, and the alchemy method is extremely valuable. If other alchemists know it, they will definitely try hard to get it."

"Naturally, I won't share it with anyone else, but you are my wife, so you can use it to develop your alchemist skills." Zhang Fei [1] then took out the Heaven Creation Furnace, making Zhang Lingxue glare at him in shock, especially after he explained its function. "You can use it to concoct pills, but you have to use it inside here, or else we'll be in big trouble if people find out about it."

Zhang Lingxue let out a heavy sigh, clearly aware that Zhang Fei [1] was not going to reveal the origin of the Heaven Creation Furnace to her. "I will use this furnace to concoct a few batches of several kinds of pills, and we will sell them directly at the opening of our new shop."

Zhang Fei [1] immediately stood up and left Zhang Lingxue to join his partners in the portable mansion. He immediately started dual-cultivating with them again, especially considering that his cultivation was on the verge of another breakthrough.

Zhang Lingxue immediately retrieved dozens of different types of pills from her storage ring, confident that the Heaven Creation Furnace would enable her to produce high-quality pills. Moreover, the time flow inside the training space was also two times faster, so she had plenty of time to concoct them before the opening of their shop.

On the western island of the Wasteland Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt very satisfied after he harvested several kinds of high-quality herbs. Even so, he still wanted to look for many other kinds of herbs so the items in his new shop would not be less varied than the alchemy shops owned by the alchemy union in the other three kingdoms.
"Are we going to the northern city today, Long'er?" Shang Yaolin inquired as she sat beside Zhang Xiaolong [3] while Shang Xinyu sat on the opposite side.

"I have a hunch that the three demi-humans who followed us yesterday are already waiting for us in that city, so we won't be going there, and we will go to the central area of this island instead." Both women nodded in agreement to Zhang Xiaolong [3], sharing the same thoughts. "I still have ten days before Senior Hun Di arrives in this realm, so we will spend that time on this island, and I will collect as many types of herbs as possible. Anyway, it's getting late now, so we should rest in this area, and we will start walking to the central area tomorrow morning."
Shang Yaolin immediately pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] to his feet. "There is a clear river not far from here, so we will go there to clean ourselves and rest there."

Before long, they had arrived at the river, and Shang Yaolin hurriedly took off her clothes before helping Zhang Xiaolong [3] undress. She then pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] into the river, shouting at Shang Xinyu. "Join us, Xinyu! You've seen us intimately too often, so you don't need to be shy anymore."

Shang Xinyu let out a soft sigh, undressed herself, and joined them in the river. However, her face was completely red as she watched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s adult figure, especially his lower body. Moreover, Shang Yaolin shamelessly started playing with it, causing lewd thoughts to start popping into his mind. 'Tch! Yaolin has become different since she was intimate with him, and she has become even more shameless.'

After killing the last demon beast in the Netherworld Realm, Zhang Fei [4] immediately returned the demon extermination sword to his body and turned his attention to the three female demons around him.
Orith immediately spoke to him. "Let's go back, Elion. I'm really bored watching you kill these demon beasts since earlier, and I want to have sex with you."
Zilvora and Balena shook their heads after hearing that, especially since Orith hardly ever thought about anything other than sex.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately took them back to the succubi tower, but Balena rushed back to her room. He then took Zilvora and Orith back to their room, but Ilsath was already waiting for them there.
Orith hurriedly approached Ilsath and sat by her side. "Hehe! Are you ready to have sex with Elion now?"

"Yes." Ilsath admitted it without hesitation. "I've been contemplating this for the past three days, and I've noticed a significant improvement in both your and Queen Zilvora's cultivation after having sex with him for a few days. paragraphs: After he passed through several obstacles, Zhang Fei arrived in front of an empty room. Although the system did not show anything inside, he thought there might be traps hidden within because the previous rooms were like that, so he did not enter it immediately and waited for Zhou Meiling to arrive.
A few minutes later, Zhou Meiling arrived in the area, using her speed to move toward Zhang Fei despite her lack of knowledge about his abilities and speed.
Zhang Fei immediately dodged Zhou Meiling's hand, grabbed it, and threw her into the room. Mei suddenly told him something that made him frown, but he immediately nodded in response.

Zhou Meiling was completely shocked by that, but Zhang Fei immediately entered the room. As he had predicted, the room contained a trap that triggered as soon as they entered, causing their qi to dissipate.

"Hehe." Zhou Meiling chuckled as she experienced this. "You deliberately lured me here, but you suffered yourself. My cultivation is at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, and your cultivation is at the 1-Star Earth Realm, so the Qi in my body is more abundant than yours. This way, I don't need to bother taking care of you; I just need to wait for you to weaken."

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei inquired calmly. "My cultivation is indeed lower than yours, but that doesn't mean that the Qi in my body is less than yours. Anyway, who exactly are you? Although you may deceive others, I am aware that you are a soul trapped in this tower, and you have taken control of her body."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei's words surprised Zhou Meiling. "I didn't expect you to realize it, little brat. You're right that I control this little girl, and my soul was locked up in this tower by someone, which happened about ten thousand years ago."

"Ten thousand years ago?" Zhang Fei was completely shocked by that. 'Tch! I didn't expect her to be such an old soul, and her experience is definitely much greater than mine, so I have to be careful of her.' "Who exactly are you?"
Zhou Meiling smiled and told him. "People in our home realms give me the nickname the purple demoness because I have killed countless people, and my name is Nalan Yushu."
'Purple demoness, huh?' Zhang Fei then asked her again. "Does this mean you came from the realms beyond the upper realms?"

"I did come from one of the planets in those realms, but I won't explain it to you." Zhou Meiling immediately moved towards him, but Zhang Fei quickly teleported away to avoid her. "Hmm? Despite your low cultivation, I didn't expect you to have such frightening speed."

Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "You may have been a strong cultivator before you died, but you are not as strong as you used to be, and Zhou Meiling is not as strong as you think. Moreover, you don't have much information about me, and you underestimate me too much."

"I admit that I did underestimate you." Zhou Meiling replied with an affirmative nod. "However, you also don't know me or my abilities, and you are overconfident just because you have your speed. Even though I've been dead for a long time, I still have all my abilities, and I will capture you before taking over your body."
"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled in response. "You can try it if you are so confident in your abilities."

Zhou Meiling smirked slightly before a purple smoke shot out from her body, and it quickly enveloped Zhang Fei. However, the system immediately activated its defense mechanism, and it dispelled the effects of the purple smoke.

Zhou Meiling, still unaware of the situation, immediately moved behind him and tried to grab his shoulder. Zhang Fei immediately spun around and punched her in the abdomen, causing her to stagger back and bend forward, feeling excruciating pain in her abdomen.
"Impossible! Why doesn't my purple smoke affect you?" Zhou Meiling shouted in shock as she clutched her stomach.
"Like I said before, you underestimate me too much." Zhang Fei took out the Hongxi dagger and threw it at her, but Zhou Meiling immediately moved to the side to avoid it.
However, Zhang Fei controlled the Hongxi dagger with his aura, and it immediately shot toward Zhou Meiling again.
Zhou Meiling immediately took out her sword and deflected it, but Zhang Fei had already moved in front of her with a black halberd in his hand, and he right away swung it at her.
*Clang*
Zhou Meiling blocked his attack with her sword, but Zhang Fei's attack was too heavy for her, causing her legs to bend and the floor beneath her to shatter.
Zhou Meiling immediately took out another sword and stabbed it at him, but the hongxi dagger moved and deflected it. Zhang Fei immediately kicked her chest, sending her flying backward.

"Argh!" Zhou Meiling spun in the air and stomped her foot on the wall behind her, but Zhang Fei once again moved in front of her. He grabbed her hand and slammed her directly onto the floor, causing her to scream in pain again. "Argh!"
*vomit*

Zhou Meiling immediately wiped the blood from her mouth and glared at Zhang Fei, who had moved into the distance. 'This bastard! Although his adversary was a delicate woman, he did not hesitate to strike me with such force.'

"You don't need to glare at me like that." Zhang Fei then pointed his abyssal black halberd toward Zhou Meiling. "Your soul may be strong, but that woman's body limits your abilities. I've met a cultivator from those realms before, and he couldn't even keep up with my speed, let alone you."

Zhang Fei's words caused Zhou Meiling's eyes to widen, and she truly realized that she had underestimated him. If the living cultivators from her realms couldn't keep up with his speed, then the cultivators from the middle realms would never be able to do so. 'Damn it! I have to leave this girl's body to possess that bastard's body forcefully, and I will destroy his soul before controlling him.'
'Are you sure that method will work, Mei?'
[One hundred percent, master. So you can lure Nalan Yushu out of Zhou Meiling's body and let her into your soul space.]

'All right.' Zhang Fei then provoked her. "Why don't you leave her body immediately? Don't you want to possess me and control my body? As long as you stay in that woman's body, you will never be able to win against me, and I will kill you together with her."

'Tch! This bastard! He has been looking down on me from the beginning!' As soon as Nalan Yushu left her body, Zhou Meiling immediately collapsed on the floor; her true soul was still trapped in her soul space.

Zhang Fei faintly smiled upon seeing this, and Nalan Yushu immediately surrounded him in her purple smoke form. In just a few seconds, she had infiltrated his body and then made her way into his soul space. He could have avoided it easily, but he wanted to try the method that Mei had told him about.

Nalan Yushu floated within Zhang Fei's soul space, searching for his soul and intending to destroy it. She had no idea that his soul space would be so vast, given his status as a soul cultivator and the fact that it would only continue to expand as his soul power increased.
Nalan Yushu raised her eyebrows as Zhang Fei's soul space, which was still bright, suddenly turned pitch black, and the darkness limited his vision and senses.

"What the hell happened here? How could this place be this dark?" As Nalan Yushu contemplated the change, countless chains suddenly shot toward her, directly entangling her soul. She struggled to destroy those chains, but they kept reconnecting. "Shit!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei immediately appeared before Nalan Yushu as he laughed. "Being locked up in the tower for ten thousand years seems to make you senile, and you forget that there are soul cultivators in this universe. Haven't you realized that I deliberately let you into my soul space? If I wanted to, I could avoid you easily, but I was aiming for your soul from the start. My soul space is under my control, and I can change it as I please, so you are in my grasp now."
"Bastard! Let go of me!" Nalan Yushu shouted in frustration, unable to make the chains disappear no matter how many times she shattered them.

"Why should I let go of the prey that has fallen into my hands?" Zhang Fei then approached Nalan Yushu and touched her soul. "At first, I intended to absorb your soul, but someone gave me another idea, so I gave up my intention and will use another method on you."
"What... what are you going to do to me?" Nalan Yushu asked stammeringly as she felt something emerge within her soul. "Stop... Don't do this to me!"

"Too late." Zhang Fei directly implanted his soul mark into Nalan Yushu's soul, and he also used the soul manipulation ability to merge her soul with his. "Heh! This way, your soul will be bound to me forever, and I will use you to do something in the future."
After Zhang Fei withdrew his hand, a black cage immediately appeared and confined Nalan Yushu. "Bastard! I will definitely kill you one day!"

"Do you think you still have a chance at that?" Zhang Fei asked with a slight smirk, and his soul space became bright again. "For now, enjoy your time here, and you will know my purpose in locking up your soul later."
*Bam... Bam...*

After Zhang Fei disappeared, Nalan Yushu tried to break the black cage, but it didn't budge an inch, causing her to slump to the bottom with a face full of anger. She then looked around the area, still confused by the darkness from earlier, especially considering its strength. "That bastard! He deliberately toyed with me from the start, and I foolishly walked into his trap!"

Once he returned to his body, Zhang Fei immediately approached Zhou Meiling, who was still unconscious. Mei told him that her soul was still sleeping in her soul space, especially since Nalan Yushu had possessed her for too long, weakening her soul. [What are you going to do to this woman? Are you going to implant your demon slave mark into his soul?]

"Despite her status as a princess, I don't find her attractive. Furthermore, you mentioned that her Yin Qi is significantly weaker than that of female cultivators at her level, so I won't do it. However, this woman is still useful to the Xian Kingdom, so I will hand her over to Xianqin, and she can use her for the benefit of her kingdom." Zhang Fei then sent Zhou Meiling into the Yin-Yang Space and left the room after the door opened.
Since Xian Changyue and the others had already cleared the areas in front of him, Zhang Fei could easily pass through them, and he used his teleportation ability repeatedly to catch up with them.

"Fei!" Xian Xianqin immediately shouted and ran toward Zhang Fei as soon as he appeared in front of them. She then checked his body from top to bottom, and she was relieved after finding no injuries on him. "What about that woman's soul? Where is Zhou Meiling now?"
"Did you absorb that woman's soul?" Xian Changyue also inquired from a slightly distant location.

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I abandoned my intention to absorb that woman's soul, especially since I needed her for something, so I locked her in my soul space for the time being. As for Zhou Meiling, I sent her to my private place, and we will take care of her later."

"Are you sure it won't be a problem?" Zhang Fei turned to Bai Tian'er. "Zhou Xiaochuan's aides are still in the waiting room of the tower now, and they will probably suspect us for Zhou Meiling's disappearance, especially since our kingdom has always been at odds with the Zhou Kingdom."

"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "No one saw me doing anything to Zhou Meiling, and you guys won't leak this matter to them, right? They will suspect us, but they won't be able to do anything to us as long as we keep quiet."
"You're right." Bai Tian'er nodded in response, then turned her attention to the two groups that had just arrived. The arrival of Long Chen's group and Xian Jinglan's group brought them relief.
"Haha!" Long Chen suddenly laughed as he walked beside Zhang Fei. "Unfortunately, we just met here, so we didn't have the chance to spar."

Zhang Fei himself actually wanted to spar with Long Chen and Long Tian, especially since both of them were pure dragons, so his bloodline would be useless to fight them. "Isn't there still the survival challenge? We can spar there later, but we must defeat the final boss to leave this place."

Long Chen nodded in agreement before glancing at the people. "I don't know what kind of beast we'll be facing this time, but it'll probably be stronger than the last maze challenge. If we work together to fight it, we may be able to defeat it faster using our numbers."
"Then what are we waiting for? Let's go in now." Xi Xianzi spoke as she took out the golden key that belonged to her group.
Long Chen and Zhang Fei also took out their golden keys, and the three of them immediately shot into the keyhole of the gate, unlocking it directly.
Long Chen, Xian Jinglan, and Zhang Fei immediately led their members into it before the gates closed again.
*Roar*

A loud and deafening roar from a beast greeted them from inside, pushing all of them back. A powerful soul attack followed, compelling nearly everyone to kneel on the ground, with the exception of Zhang Fei, Bai Tian'er, Long Feng, Long Tian, Xian Jinglan, and Xi Xianzi.

Long Chen and Long Tian's expressions darkened as they saw the gigantic beast standing upright on all fours in the middle of the room. Xian Jinglan and Xi Xianzi's expressions were also not good, especially since the beast was no different from the strange beasts they had encountered before.

"Another chimera beast, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered as he enveloped his group with his light element and soul power, especially since the beast's soul attack just now was very strong, suppressing the souls of non-soul cultivators.

Xian Jinglan, like Zhang Fei, took action to protect her group of non-soul cultivators. She continued to gaze at the beast, contemplating a strategy to defeat it, especially since not all of them were capable of fighting it.

[Master, the strength of this chimera beast surpasses that of the previous one, reaching the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. Moreover, the system detected some mythical beast bloodline in its body, but it does not have the demon bloodline like the previous one, so you must be extra careful when fighting it.]

Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that, and he immediately informed their group members, causing all of them to become tense. After all, the majority of their cultivation was in the quasi-divine realm, with Xian Changyue being the strongest among them, having reached the 3-Moon Divine Expansion realm.

Unlike the strength of the cultivators in the ten mortal realms, the strength of the cultivators in the seven divine realms is much different at each level, so the beast's strength clearly overpowers them.

Zhang Fei immediately summoned the demon extermination sword, and he also took the moonlit whisper sword. "It appears that the tower owner does not want us to pass this maze challenge by sending such a powerful beast, so we have no choice but to fight it with all our might."

All of them immediately took out their respective weapons and prepared to fight the last boss, but Zhang Fei asked those who were not soul cultivators not to get too close to the beast because the impact of its soul attacks would be stronger if they were too close to it, so he asked them to focus more on using long-range attacks.
"Let's go!"
