"I admit that I did underestimate you." Zhou Meiling replied with an affirmative nod.
"However, you also don't know me or my abilities, and you are overconfident just because you have your speed.
Even though I've been dead for a long time, I still have all my abilities, and I will capture you before taking over your body."
"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled in response.
"You can try it if you are so confident in your abilities."
Zhou Meiling smirked slightly before a purple smoke shot out from her body, and it quickly enveloped Zhang Fei.
However, the system immediately activated its defense mechanism, and it dispelled the effects of the purple smoke.
Zhou Meiling, still unaware of the situation, immediately moved behind him and tried to grab his shoulder.
Zhang Fei immediately spun around and punched her in the abdomen, causing her to stagger back and bend forward, feeling excruciating pain in her abdomen.
"Impossible!
Why doesn't my purple smoke affect you?" Zhou Meiling shouted in shock as she clutched her stomach.
"Like I said before, you underestimate me too much." Zhang Fei took out the Hongxi dagger and threw it at her, but Zhou Meiling immediately moved to the side to avoid it.
However, Zhang Fei controlled the Hongxi dagger with his aura, and it immediately shot toward Zhou Meiling again.
Zhou Meiling immediately took out her sword and deflected it, but Zhang Fei had already moved in front of her with a black halberd in his hand, and he right away swung it at her.
*Clang*
Zhou Meiling blocked his attack with her sword, but Zhang Fei's attack was too heavy for her, causing her legs to bend and the floor beneath her to shatter.
Zhou Meiling immediately took out another sword and stabbed it at him, but the hongxi dagger moved and deflected it.
Zhang Fei immediately kicked her chest, sending her flying backward.
"Argh!" Zhou Meiling spun in the air and stomped her foot on the wall behind her, but Zhang Fei once again moved in front of her.
He grabbed her hand and slammed her directly onto the floor, causing her to scream in pain again.
"Argh!"
*vomit*
Zhou Meiling immediately wiped the blood from her mouth and glared at Zhang Fei, who had moved into the distance. 'This bastard!
Although his adversary was a delicate woman, he did not hesitate to strike me with such force.'
"You don't need to glare at me like that." Zhang Fei then pointed his abyssal black halberd toward Zhou Meiling.
"Your soul may be strong, but that woman's body limits your abilities.
I've met a cultivator from those realms before, and he couldn't even keep up with my speed, let alone you."
Zhang Fei's words caused Zhou Meiling's eyes to widen, and she truly realized that she had underestimated him.
If the living cultivators from her realms couldn't keep up with his speed, then the cultivators from the middle realms would never be able to do so. 'Damn it!
I have to leave this girl's body to possess that bastard's body forcefully, and I will destroy his soul before controlling him.'
'Are you sure that method will work, Mei?'
[One hundred percent, master.
So you can lure Nalan Yushu out of Zhou Meiling's body and let her into your soul space.]
'All right.' Zhang Fei then provoked her.
"Why don't you leave her body immediately?
Don't you want to possess me and control my body?
As long as you stay in that woman's body, you will never be able to win against me, and I will kill you together with her."
'Tch!
This bastard!
He has been looking down on me from the beginning!' As soon as Nalan Yushu left her body, Zhou Meiling immediately collapsed on the floor; her true soul was still trapped in her soul space.
Zhang Fei faintly smiled upon seeing this, and Nalan Yushu immediately surrounded him in her purple smoke form.
In just a few seconds, she had infiltrated his body and then made her way into his soul space.
He could have avoided it easily, but he wanted to try the method that Mei had told him about.
Nalan Yushu floated within Zhang Fei's soul space, searching for his soul and intending to destroy it.
She had no idea that his soul space would be so vast, given his status as a soul cultivator and the fact that it would only continue to expand as his soul power increased.
Nalan Yushu raised her eyebrows as Zhang Fei's soul space, which was still bright, suddenly turned pitch black, and the darkness limited his vision and senses.
"What the hell happened here?
How could this place be this dark?" As Nalan Yushu contemplated the change, countless chains suddenly shot toward her, directly entangling her soul.
She struggled to destroy those chains, but they kept reconnecting.
"Shit!"
"Haha." Zhang Fei immediately appeared before Nalan Yushu as he laughed.
"Being locked up in the tower for ten thousand years seems to make you senile, and you forget that there are soul cultivators in this universe.
Haven't you realized that I deliberately let you into my soul space?
If I wanted to, I could avoid you easily, but I was aiming for your soul from the start.
My soul space is under my control, and I can change it as I please, so you are in my grasp now."
"Bastard!
Let go of me!" Nalan Yushu shouted in frustration, unable to make the chains disappear no matter how many times she shattered them.
"Why should I let go of the prey that has fallen into my hands?" Zhang Fei then approached Nalan Yushu and touched her soul.
"At first, I intended to absorb your soul, but someone gave me another idea, so I gave up my intention and will use another method on you."
"What... what are you going to do to me?" Nalan Yushu asked stammeringly as she felt something emerge within her soul.
"Stop...
Don't do this to me!"
"Too late." Zhang Fei directly implanted his soul mark into Nalan Yushu's soul, and he also used the soul manipulation ability to merge her soul with his.
"Heh!
This way, your soul will be bound to me forever, and I will use you to do something in the future."
After Zhang Fei withdrew his hand, a black cage immediately appeared and confined Nalan Yushu.
"Bastard!
I will definitely kill you one day!"
"Do you think you still have a chance at that?" Zhang Fei asked with a slight smirk, and his soul space became bright again.
"For now, enjoy your time here, and you will know my purpose in locking up your soul later."
*Bam...
Bam...*
After Zhang Fei disappeared, Nalan Yushu tried to break the black cage, but it didn't budge an inch, causing her to slump to the bottom with a face full of anger.
She then looked around the area, still confused by the darkness from earlier, especially considering its strength.
"That bastard!
He deliberately toyed with me from the start, and I foolishly walked into his trap!"
Once he returned to his body, Zhang Fei immediately approached Zhou Meiling, who was still unconscious.
Mei told him that her soul was still sleeping in her soul space, especially since Nalan Yushu had possessed her for too long, weakening her soul.
[What are you going to do to this woman?
Are you going to implant your demon slave mark into his soul?]
"Despite her status as a princess, I don't find her attractive.
Furthermore, you mentioned that her Yin Qi is significantly weaker than that of female cultivators at her level, so I won't do it.

However, this woman is still useful to the Xian Kingdom, so I will hand her over to Xianqin, and she can use her for the benefit of her kingdom." Zhang Fei then sent Zhou Meiling into the Yin-Yang Space and left the room after the door opened.
Since Xian Changyue and the others had already cleared the areas in front of him, Zhang Fei could easily pass through them, and he used his teleportation ability repeatedly to catch up with them.
"Fei!" Xian Xianqin immediately shouted and ran toward Zhang Fei as soon as he appeared in front of them.
She then checked his body from top to bottom, and she was relieved after finding no injuries on him.
"What about that woman's soul?
Where is Zhou Meiling now?"
"Did you absorb that woman's soul?" Xian Changyue also inquired from a slightly distant location.
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"I abandoned my intention to absorb that woman's soul, especially since I needed her for something, so I locked her in my soul space for the time being.
As for Zhou Meiling, I sent her to my private place, and we will take care of her later."
"Are you sure it won't be a problem?" Zhang Fei turned to Bai Tian'er.

"Zhou Xiaochuan's aides are still in the waiting room of the tower now, and they will probably suspect us for Zhou Meiling's disappearance, especially since our kingdom has always been at odds with the Zhou Kingdom."
"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement.
"No one saw me doing anything to Zhou Meiling, and you guys won't leak this matter to them, right?
They will suspect us, but they won't be able to do anything to us as long as we keep quiet."
"You're right." Bai Tian'er nodded in response, then turned her attention to the two groups that had just arrived.
The arrival of Long Chen's group and Xian Jinglan's group brought them relief.
"Haha!" Long Chen suddenly laughed as he walked beside Zhang Fei.
"Unfortunately, we just met here, so we didn't have the chance to spar."
Zhang Fei himself actually wanted to spar with Long Chen and Long Tian, especially since both of them were pure dragons, so his bloodline would be useless to fight them.
"Isn't there still the survival challenge?
We can spar there later, but we must defeat the final boss to leave this place."
Long Chen nodded in agreement before glancing at the people.
"I don't know what kind of beast we'll be facing this time, but it'll probably be stronger than the last maze challenge.
If we work together to fight it, we may be able to defeat it faster using our numbers."
"Then what are we waiting for?
Let's go in now." Xi Xianzi spoke as she took out the golden key that belonged to her group.
Long Chen and Zhang Fei also took out their golden keys, and the three of them immediately shot into the keyhole of the gate, unlocking it directly.
Long Chen, Xian Jinglan, and Zhang Fei immediately led their members into it before the gates closed again.
*Roar*
A loud and deafening roar from a beast greeted them from inside, pushing all of them back.
A powerful soul attack followed, compelling nearly everyone to kneel on the ground, with the exception of Zhang Fei, Bai Tian'er, Long Feng, Long Tian, Xian Jinglan, and Xi Xianzi.
Long Chen and Long Tian's expressions darkened as they saw the gigantic beast standing upright on all fours in the middle of the room.
Xian Jinglan and Xi Xianzi's expressions were also not good, especially since the beast was no different from the strange beasts they had encountered before.

"Another chimera beast, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered as he enveloped his group with his light element and soul power, especially since the beast's soul attack just now was very strong, suppressing the souls of non-soul cultivators.
Xian Jinglan, like Zhang Fei, took action to protect her group of non-soul cultivators.
She continued to gaze at the beast, contemplating a strategy to defeat it, especially since not all of them were capable of fighting it.
[Master, the strength of this chimera beast surpasses that of the previous one, reaching the 5-Moon Divine Expansion Realm.
Moreover, the system detected some mythical beast bloodline in its body, but it does not have the demon bloodline like the previous one, so you must be extra careful when fighting it.]
Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that, and he immediately informed their group members, causing all of them to become tense.
After all, the majority of their cultivation was in the quasi-divine realm, with Xian Changyue being the strongest among them, having reached the 3-Moon Divine Expansion realm.

Unlike the strength of the cultivators in the ten mortal realms, the strength of the cultivators in the seven divine realms is much different at each level, so the beast's strength clearly overpowers them.
Zhang Fei immediately summoned the demon extermination sword, and he also took the moonlit whisper sword.
"It appears that the tower owner does not want us to pass this maze challenge by sending such a powerful beast, so we have no choice but to fight it with all our might."

All of them immediately took out their respective weapons and prepared to fight the last boss, but Zhang Fei asked those who were not soul cultivators not to get too close to the beast because the impact of its soul attacks would be stronger if they were too close to it, so he asked them to focus more on using long-range attacks.
"Let's go!"

chapters.title: Chapter 587 Fight The Boss
paragraphs: Since the chimera beast was too strong, Long Chen and Long Tian immediately leaped into the air and transformed into their dragon form, which was significantly larger than the beast.

Long Chen's dragon form was sky blue, and Long Tian's dragon form was whitish blue. They immediately opened their mouths wide and released a deafening dragon roar, causing the entire area to shake violently.

However, the chimera beast was not intimidated by their dragon roars, especially since it had several mythical beast bloodlines in its body, and it still had some bloodlines from several other beasts.

Xi Xianzi, the fairy, also flew into the sky, closed her eyes, and clasped her hands together. Her mouth muttered the language of her race, and a wide white circle quickly formed above the chimera beast. "Radiant Dawn Formation!"
In that instant, countless white lights descended from the white circle and surrounded the chimera beast like a cage, blinding its line of sight.

The brown wolf Lang's body rapidly grew, transforming his appearance into one of terror. His muzzle sprouted sharp teeth, his claws grew longer and sharper, and his fine hairs turned into porcupine-like quills.

Lang then dashed toward the chimera beast with lightning speed, and he immediately jumped high into the air before diving down onto its back. He ran there while stabbing his claws at its back, but it immediately threw him back, forcing him to land a little bit in front of it.

Xian Jinglan immediately took out her golden wood staff and tapped the back end on the ground, and a large shady tree quickly grew behind her. Immediately, the tree released several balls of green and white, engulfing all the members of their teams.

Xian Jinglan then pointed her staff into the air while reciting the language of the elf race, and a white-green light shot out toward the chimera beast. The light then broke into several pieces and fell around the beast while many thick tree roots emerged from the ground, binding it.

Since she was a soul cultivator, Bai Tian'er immediately used her soul technique. In a split second, five women shadows that resembled her emerged from her body, and they flew straight towards the chimera beast.
The five shadows immediately entered the chimera beast's body, causing it to shake its head repeatedly as it struggled in place.

Long Tian and Long Chen shot fireballs at the chimera beast, which directly hit it. However, the beast immediately let out a loud roar accompanied by a soul attack, but it did not affect them too much, and the non-soul cultivators did not feel the nauseating sensation like before.

Zhang Fei was already standing beside the chimera beast, using his clone illusion steps to confuse it. He then teleported repeatedly around the beast as he slashed the moonlit whisper sword through its body, leaving several sword wounds on it.

Meanwhile, the demon extermination sword flew around the chimera beast and attempted to injure it with repeated slashes. Unfortunately, the beast's skin was too tough and thick, so their attacks were unable to give it deep wounds.
The giant race, Zheng Ru, was eager to attack the chimera beast. Unfortunately, he was not a soul cultivator and a close-range fighter, so he did not dare to move rashly to attack it.

Although Jin Dabao was not a soul cultivator, he was a dwarf with two elements: earth and metal. Since he could not use his metal element for long-range attacks, he used his earth element to manipulate the ground beneath the beasts, causing it to sway in various directions as the ground became too soft and wavy.
Since Zhang Fei and Lang were close-range fighters, Xian Xianqin was the first to react, using her wind element to boost their speed.

The other team members naturally wouldn't stay still. Ye Zhiqiu, with her ice element, created several large ice balls and threw them at the beast. Yu Chongming and Ru Yanyue immediately shot several flames at them, melting them instantly.
As the water rained down on the chimera beast, Xian Xianwu and Yun Xinyue quickly moved to attack it using several lightning bolts, electrocuting it.
The other humans, beast races, and natural races also attack the chimera beast using ranged attacks.
Despite facing numerous attacks, the chimera beast remained upright and showed no signs of pain. Suddenly, a white light enveloped its body, healing any injuries it had sustained.

[Master, this beast not only has a very strong body, but it also has an astonishing recovery speed, and your combined attacks have no significant effect on it. Unfortunately, your numbers are not that many, and many of them will run out of qi before you can defeat it if this situation continues.]
Zhang Fei immediately flew away as he shouted to Long Tian, Long Feng, and Lang, who were near the chimera beast. "Back off! We can't attack it head-on like this, or we'll run out of Qi first."
The three immediately followed Zhang Fei's words and moved away from it, but the chimera beast immediately shot several colored balls at them, one of which was a poison ball.

"Fend off its other attacks! I'll handle the poison one!" Zhang Fei shouted as he flew towards the poison ball and slashed it with the moonlit whisper sword, causing it to split and splash in all directions, including wetting her body.
Long Feng and the others swiftly attacked the other balls, destroying them with their combined strikes.
"Fei!" Xian Xianqin shouted in panic after seeing that, and she wanted to fly toward Zhang Fei.

However, Xian Changyue immediately grabbed Xian Xianqin's hand to stop her, especially since she already knew that he was immune to poison. "Look at him! He's fine, so you don't have to panic like this."

Zhang Fei immediately cleansed the poison in his body, teleported to them, and landed in front of them. "It's okay, Qin'er. The chimera beast's poison has no effect on me, especially since I am completely immune to it."
Xian Xianqin breathed a sigh of relief and nodded after seeing that Zhang Fei was fine. "You have to be more careful, okay?"

"Yeah." Long Chen and Long Tian, who had returned to their human forms, immediately landed beside them. Xian Jinglan and Xi Xianzi also approached them. "Despite its high cultivation, the beast's attacks are not particularly powerful, with the exception of its soul attack. However, its body thickness and recovery speed are really troublesome, and there's no way we can defeat it with just our numbers."
Xian Jinglan nodded in agreement. "Our only option now is to stay away from the beast for the time being, and we have to wait for the other groups to arrive."
The chimera beast suddenly launched several powerful soul attacks, but Zhang Fei and several soul cultivators immediately blocked them using their soul power.

"We should spread out to avoid the soul beast's attacks, especially since its attacks become very powerful if we gather like this." Xi Xianzi spoke to them. "Moreover, it won't be able to charge at us, so we'll be safe as long as we stay on the sidelines, and we only need to fend off its long-range attacks."

"In that case, we should lead our respective groups, and we will try to attack this beast from several sides." After they agreed, Long Feng and Long Tian led their group members to the left side, but they still kept a distance from the beast.
Xian Jinglan and Xi Xianzi also rejoined their group, and they moved to the right side of the beast as they guarded against its attacks.
"What should we do now?" Xian Changyue asked Zhang Fei.

"Let me think first." Zhang Fei replied with his serious gaze fixed on the chimera beast, especially since it was the strongest beast he had ever faced in terms of cultivation and bloodline. Although the moonlit whisper sword was a divine grade, he was sure that it was not stronger than the demon extermination sword, so he asked for the sword to return. "Let me use you to try something."
*Zing... Zing... Zing...*

Zhang Fei then held his sword with both hands above his head and thought about his next move. 'The darkness of corruption can weaken it, but it will expose my identity, so I can't use it in front of them. I can't use the demon claw either, so the only thing I can use now is the hellflames incantation. I'll try combining it with the sword elemental method and sword energy method, and I hope it can injure this beast.'

After he thought about it, Zhang Fei immediately channeled his fire, darkness, and wind elements into his sword, and he strengthened both of them with their element laws. His fire and darkness elements were to execute the technique, and his wind element was to strengthen it.

When Zhang Fei was ready, he immediately swung his sword and simultaneously used all three techniques. A huge crescent-shaped dark red sword energy quickly shot towards the chimera beast, leaving a trail of flames on the ground.

The chimera beast hurriedly launched a massive water ball from its mouth, which collided with Zhang Fei's attack. However, his attack immediately split its attack in two, continued moving towards it, and directly slashed its body.
*Roar*
*Bam... Bam...*

The chimera beast roared in pain and stomped its feet on the ground when Zhang Fei's hellflames spread and burned its body, but his hellflames couldn't really hurt the beast because its body quickly recovered, and his hellflames slowly disappeared. 'Whoever created this beast, that person must be a madman!'

Suddenly, the gate opened again, and four other groups rushed in. They were surprised for a moment when they saw Zhang Fei and the others, but their expressions turned to shock at the size and cultivation of the chimera beast, making them feel a little hopeless because it was too strong for them.
Li Yao and Xian Qifeng immediately led their group to join Zhang Fei's group, and he explained to them about the beast's abilities, so they immediately took out their weapons to join in the attack.

Meanwhile, Xian Yu guided his group to a different location, refraining from joining any existing groups. However, they had heard Zhang Fei's explanation earlier, so they also prepared to attack the beast.
Not long after, the two demon groups also arrived at that place, and they immediately scattered while waiting for the others to move.

'Brother, this beast is too strong, and we will never be able to defeat it. Our lives are much more important, so I think we should surrender now.' Ximen Yueliang whispered to Ximen Hongwu as she glanced at the chimera beast.

Ximen Hongwu immediately rejected his sister's wishes. 'Our parents have always shielded you, so you have never directly encountered the harshness of the cultivation world.' I myself do not want to die, but I am not a coward. Furthermore, I am a demon prince who will inherit our father's legacy in the future. If I surrender now, I will never be able to face our enemies.'
'You! Foolish brother! I don't care about you, so you can go and die!' Ximen Yueliang then retreated as far away from their group as possible.
Ximen Hongwu sighed heavily because his sister was too cowardly; he then looked toward the other groups, wondering about their plans to defeat the beast.
On the other side, Qian Ying was also having a discussion with her master, but Ximen Yan forbade her from moving and asked her to wait for the others to move first.

Ximen Yan then turned to Zhang Fei, who seemed to be in deep thought. 'What's your next plan, kid? The others are indeed much stronger than you, but I believe that you are the key to defeating this beast.'

Zhou Tong, who joined them, looked anxious, especially since he had not found his brother and sister. He glanced at the gate repeatedly and waited for their arrival, but unfortunately, he did not know that Zhou Tai was dead and Zhou Meiling was in Zhang Fei's hands.

A short while later, another group arrived, and Bai Chongxi intended to lead his group to the opposite side. However, Bai Shouyi intervened and instructed them to move closer to Zhang Fei's group in case the other groups attempted to attack them, allowing them to seek his assistance if necessary.
'Are you sure he will help us? How will he help us?' Bai Chongxi asked his sister.
'I'm sure he will definitely help us.' Bai Shouyi stole a glance at Zhang Fei before continuing. 'However, I don't know how he will help us, so we can only wait for the right time.'
Bai Chongxi nodded in response. 'For the time being, we don't need to think about that, and we should focus on defeating this terrifying beast.'
Zhang Fei, contemplating a strategy to defeat the chimera beast, repeatedly glanced at the other groups, puzzled by the Huangfu Kingdom group's absence.

Xian Changyue, standing beside him, was equally perplexed by this. She thought that something had happened to the group from the Huangfu Kingdom, which would thwart Zhang Fei's plans for them if that happened. Additionally, she was also confused because she did not find Zhou Tai by Zhou Tong's side, especially since he could not possibly leave his brother alone.
*Roar*

The chimera beast suddenly let out another loud roar, and its aura gradually grew stronger, causing them to become tense. As they expected, it immediately launched several long-range attacks toward all of them at once, which were accompanied by powerful soul attacks, overwhelming the groups that did not have soul cultivators in their entourage.
The leaders of each group immediately ordered their members to counter the chimera beast's attacks, and several explosions occurred after their attacks collided with each other.
[Master, you have no choice but to use the darkness corruption, or you will continue to be stuck here if you don't defeat this beast.]

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh and nodded slightly, but then he remembered someone. He immediately looked at Ximen Yan and sent a voice transmission to him, especially since he had long been aware that someone else's soul was controlling him. He was certain that the soul was part of the souls trapped in the Star Tower, which meant the soul also came from the realms beyond the upper realms.
Upon receiving Zhang Fei's voice transmission, Ximen Yan immediately soared into the sky and opened both palms forward, causing darkness to spread throughout the entire area quickly.
All the groups, including Zhang Fei's group, became wary of Ximen Yan's actions, fearing that he might attack them in the darkness.
Without further delay, Zhang Fei unleashed the demon claw, instantly directing the chimera beast's attention toward the ethereal demon claw above it.

As soon as the chimera beast attacked the claw, Zhang Fei immediately teleported behind it, used the darkness corruption, and unleashed the demon king's roar, which caused the beast to stagger and shake its head.

Seeing that, Zhang Fei used the hellflames incantation once again, along with the abyssal lightning tribulation, to attack the chimera beast. Additionally, he utilized another sub-technique from the Nine Demon Secret Scripture: Nine Nether Fiend Summoning, which resulted in the appearance of nine massive black gates surrounding the chimera beast.
A few seconds later, nine terrifying dark creatures emerged from each gate. They immediately attacked the chimera beast with brutality, causing it to continue roaring and attacking blindly.
"Deflect its attacks!" Zhang Fei immediately returned to his group members' side to help them block the chimera beasts' attacks.

Not only his group, but the other groups also immediately moved to fend off the chimera beast's attack outside their confusion, especially since it suddenly attacked them blindly. After all, Ximen Yan's darkness blocked their vision and senses, and Zhang Fei disguised all his attacks through the darkness, so none of them noticed his actions except for the male demon.
Although all of Zhang Fei's attacks had a significant impact on the chimera beast, its regeneration ability allowed its injuries to continue to recover.
"I will fight the beast head-on." Before Xian Xianqin could stop him, Zhang Fei had already disappeared from their side, and he had moved to the beast's side again.

Long Feng and the others swiftly attacked the other balls, destroying them with their combined strikes.
"Fei!" Xian Xianqin shouted in panic after seeing that, and she wanted to fly toward Zhang Fei.
However, Xian Changyue immediately grabbed Xian Xianqin's hand to stop her, especially since she already knew that he was immune to poison.
"Look at him!
He's fine, so you don't have to panic like this."
Zhang Fei immediately cleansed the poison in his body, teleported to them, and landed in front of them.
"It's okay, Qin'er.
The chimera beast's poison has no effect on me, especially since I am completely immune to it."
Xian Xianqin breathed a sigh of relief and nodded after seeing that Zhang Fei was fine.
"You have to be more careful, okay?"
"Yeah." Long Chen and Long Tian, who had returned to their human forms, immediately landed beside them.
Xian Jinglan and Xi Xianzi also approached them.
"Despite its high cultivation, the beast's attacks are not particularly powerful, with the exception of its soul attack.
However, its body thickness and recovery speed are really troublesome, and there's no way we can defeat it with just our numbers."
Xian Jinglan nodded in agreement.
"Our only option now is to stay away from the beast for the time being, and we have to wait for the other groups to arrive."
The chimera beast suddenly launched several powerful soul attacks, but Zhang Fei and several soul cultivators immediately blocked them using their soul power.
"We should spread out to avoid the soul beast's attacks, especially since its attacks become very powerful if we gather like this." Xi Xianzi spoke to them.
"Moreover, it won't be able to charge at us, so we'll be safe as long as we stay on the sidelines, and we only need to fend off its long-range attacks."

"In that case, we should lead our respective groups, and we will try to attack this beast from several sides." After they agreed, Long Feng and Long Tian led their group members to the left side, but they still kept a distance from the beast.
Xian Jinglan and Xi Xianzi also rejoined their group, and they moved to the right side of the beast as they guarded against its attacks.
"What should we do now?" Xian Changyue asked Zhang Fei.
"Let me think first." Zhang Fei replied with his serious gaze fixed on the chimera beast, especially since it was the strongest beast he had ever faced in terms of cultivation and bloodline.
Although the moonlit whisper sword was a divine grade, he was sure that it was not stronger than the demon extermination sword, so he asked for the sword to return.
"Let me use you to try something."
*Zing...
Zing...
Zing...*

Zhang Fei then held his sword with both hands above his head and thought about his next move. 'The darkness of corruption can weaken it, but it will expose my identity, so I can't use it in front of them.
I can't use the demon claw either, so the only thing I can use now is the hellflames incantation.
I'll try combining it with the sword elemental method and sword energy method, and I hope it can injure this beast.'
After he thought about it, Zhang Fei immediately channeled his fire, darkness, and wind elements into his sword, and he strengthened both of them with their element laws.
His fire and darkness elements were to execute the technique, and his wind element was to strengthen it.
When Zhang Fei was ready, he immediately swung his sword and simultaneously used all three techniques.
A huge crescent-shaped dark red sword energy quickly shot towards the chimera beast, leaving a trail of flames on the ground.
The chimera beast hurriedly launched a massive water ball from its mouth, which collided with Zhang Fei's attack.
However, his attack immediately split its attack in two, continued moving towards it, and directly slashed its body.
*Roar*
*Bam...
Bam...*

The chimera beast roared in pain and stomped its feet on the ground when Zhang Fei's hellflames spread and burned its body, but his hellflames couldn't really hurt the beast because its body quickly recovered, and his hellflames slowly disappeared. 'Whoever created this beast, that person must be a madman!'
Suddenly, the gate opened again, and four other groups rushed in.

They were surprised for a moment when they saw Zhang Fei and the others, but their expressions turned to shock at the size and cultivation of the chimera beast, making them feel a little hopeless because it was too strong for them.
Li Yao and Xian Qifeng immediately led their group to join Zhang Fei's group, and he explained to them about the beast's abilities, so they immediately took out their weapons to join in the attack.
Meanwhile, Xian Yu guided his group to a different location, refraining from joining any existing groups.
However, they had heard Zhang Fei's explanation earlier, so they also prepared to attack the beast.
Not long after, the two demon groups also arrived at that place, and they immediately scattered while waiting for the others to move.
'Brother, this beast is too strong, and we will never be able to defeat it.
Our lives are much more important, so I think we should surrender now.' Ximen Yueliang whispered to Ximen Hongwu as she glanced at the chimera beast.

Ximen Hongwu immediately rejected his sister's wishes. 'Our parents have always shielded you, so you have never directly encountered the harshness of the cultivation world.' I myself do not want to die, but I am not a coward.
Furthermore, I am a demon prince who will inherit our father's legacy in the future.
If I surrender now, I will never be able to face our enemies.'
'You!
Foolish brother!
I don't care about you, so you can go and die!' Ximen Yueliang then retreated as far away from their group as possible.
Ximen Hongwu sighed heavily because his sister was too cowardly; he then looked toward the other groups, wondering about their plans to defeat the beast.
On the other side, Qian Ying was also having a discussion with her master, but Ximen Yan forbade her from moving and asked her to wait for the others to move first.
Ximen Yan then turned to Zhang Fei, who seemed to be in deep thought. 'What's your next plan, kid?
The others are indeed much stronger than you, but I believe that you are the key to defeating this beast.'
Zhou Tong, who joined them, looked anxious, especially since he had not found his brother and sister.
He glanced at the gate repeatedly and waited for their arrival, but unfortunately, he did not know that Zhou Tai was dead and Zhou Meiling was in Zhang Fei's hands.
A short while later, another group arrived, and Bai Chongxi intended to lead his group to the opposite side.
However, Bai Shouyi intervened and instructed them to move closer to Zhang Fei's group in case the other groups attempted to attack them, allowing them to seek his assistance if necessary.
'Are you sure he will help us?
How will he help us?' Bai Chongxi asked his sister.
'I'm sure he will definitely help us.' Bai Shouyi stole a glance at Zhang Fei before continuing. 'However, I don't know how he will help us, so we can only wait for the right time.'
Bai Chongxi nodded in response. 'For the time being, we don't need to think about that, and we should focus on defeating this terrifying beast.'
Zhang Fei, contemplating a strategy to defeat the chimera beast, repeatedly glanced at the other groups, puzzled by the Huangfu Kingdom group's absence.
Xian Changyue, standing beside him, was equally perplexed by this.
She thought that something had happened to the group from the Huangfu Kingdom, which would thwart Zhang Fei's plans for them if that happened.
Additionally, she was also confused because she did not find Zhou Tai by Zhou Tong's side, especially since he could not possibly leave his brother alone.
*Roar*
The chimera beast suddenly let out another loud roar, and its aura gradually grew stronger, causing them to become tense.

As they expected, it immediately launched several long-range attacks toward all of them at once, which were accompanied by powerful soul attacks, overwhelming the groups that did not have soul cultivators in their entourage.
The leaders of each group immediately ordered their members to counter the chimera beast's attacks, and several explosions occurred after their attacks collided with each other.
[Master, you have no choice but to use the darkness corruption, or you will continue to be stuck here if you don't defeat this beast.]
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh and nodded slightly, but then he remembered someone.
He immediately looked at Ximen Yan and sent a voice transmission to him, especially since he had long been aware that someone else's soul was controlling him.
He was certain that the soul was part of the souls trapped in the Star Tower, which meant the soul also came from the realms beyond the upper realms.
Upon receiving Zhang Fei's voice transmission, Ximen Yan immediately soared into the sky and opened both palms forward, causing darkness to spread throughout the entire area quickly.
All the groups, including Zhang Fei's group, became wary of Ximen Yan's actions, fearing that he might attack them in the darkness.
Without further delay, Zhang Fei unleashed the demon claw, instantly directing the chimera beast's attention toward the ethereal demon claw above it.

As soon as the chimera beast attacked the claw, Zhang Fei immediately teleported behind it, used the darkness corruption, and unleashed the demon king's roar, which caused the beast to stagger and shake its head.
Seeing that, Zhang Fei used the hellflames incantation once again, along with the abyssal lightning tribulation, to attack the chimera beast.

Additionally, he utilized another sub-technique from the Nine Demon Secret Scripture: Nine Nether Fiend Summoning, which resulted in the appearance of nine massive black gates surrounding the chimera beast.
A few seconds later, nine terrifying dark creatures emerged from each gate.
They immediately attacked the chimera beast with brutality, causing it to continue roaring and attacking blindly.
"Deflect its attacks!" Zhang Fei immediately returned to his group members' side to help them block the chimera beasts' attacks.
Not only his group, but the other groups also immediately moved to fend off the chimera beast's attack outside their confusion, especially since it suddenly attacked them blindly.
After all, Ximen Yan's darkness blocked their vision and senses, and Zhang Fei disguised all his attacks through the darkness, so none of them noticed his actions except for the male demon.
Although all of Zhang Fei's attacks had a significant impact on the chimera beast, its regeneration ability allowed its injuries to continue to recover.
"I will fight the beast head-on." Before Xian Xianqin could stop him, Zhang Fei had already disappeared from their side, and he had moved to the beast's side again.

chapters.title: Chapter 588 Defeat The Boss
paragraphs: "Aunt Changyue."
"Yes." Xian Changyue immediately ordered their group members to attack the chimera beast. "Attack the beast! Zhang Fei can avoid your attacks, so you don't need to hold back."
Ye Zhiqiu and the others nodded in agreement, and they used combined attacks like before to attack the chimera beast. The groups of Li Yao, Xian Qifeng, and Bai Chongxi also joined the attack.

Bai Tian'er used her soul attack as usual, but she used a different technique. When she released her cultivation soul, it shot toward the beast instantly. However, she was shocked to see the nine terrifying creatures that Zhang Fei had summoned, all of which were mindlessly attacking the beast by repeatedly biting, tearing, and stabbing. Her soul immediately shot into the beast's body and tried to control it from within, causing its movements to become sluggish.

Unlike their group, Xian Yu forbade his brother and their group members from helping them, especially since they hoped that they would die at the hands of the chimera beast, especially Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu. This way, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang would be weakened by their deaths, and their father could return to their kingdom to take it over from them.

Long Chen and Long Tian immediately led their group members to attack the chimera beast from a distance, and the two of them repeatedly unleashed their dragon roars, followed by several large fireballs.
Xi Xianzi felt annoyed because her light techniques were useless in that darkness, especially since it was simply too dark and swallowed her light.
Jin Dabao continued to use his earth technique to manipulate the ground beneath the chimera beast, and he also tried to restrain its movement by restraining its four legs with earth mounds.

Unlike Xi Xianzi, Xian Jinglan's light technique was still quite significant in the darkness, and she combined it with her wood element to create several trees around the chimera beast, which immediately attacked it.
Ximen Yan also immediately moved towards the chimera beast to attack it from close range, and Qian Ying naturally followed her master to attack it.

Zhou Tong was actually too lazy to fight the chimera beast, preferring to use their situation to capture Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue. However, Ximen Yan ordered him to join him and Qian Ying. Since his father had long sworn allegiance to the demons, he had no choice but to join them.
Ximen Hongwu led their subordinates to fight it. They were not soul cultivators, and the beast was simply stronger than them; they chose to use long-range attacks instead of close-range attacks.

Ximen Yueliang sat far behind them, keeping her eyes fixed on Xian Xianwu as her mind raced to come up with a plan to capture him. Unfortunately, the Xian Prince was surrounded by so many people, and they were more experienced than her in fighting. Furthermore, Xian Changyue was also with them; even her parents did not dare to underestimate her, let alone her.

'Tch! The situation was really unfavorable since we entered this maze, so I had to think of another way to capture him.' Ximen Yueliang suddenly remembered something and pulled out a bottle from her storage ring. As she opened the lid, a small black wasp flew out. She immediately directed the small black wasp towards Xian Xianwu, and it swiftly flew towards him, concealing itself in the darkness. 'Hehe! This way, no one will notice my actions.'

The black wasp quickly arrived at Xian Xianwu's back, and it immediately stung his nape, injecting something into his body. Feeling the sting, the Xian Prince immediately slapped it, but it flew away first.

The black wasp then moved to Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue before stinging them, and it immediately returned to Ximen Yueliang afterward, causing her to smile in satisfaction. 'Hahaha! The effect won't take effect right away, but it will undoubtedly affect them soon, and they will submit to me.'

Zhang Fei relentlessly attacked the chimera beast with the demon extermination sword, utilizing all his demon techniques, particularly the demon corruption, to further weaken it. His ethereal demon claw also continued to distract the beast, giving him and the other three more freedom to attack it.

Zhang Fei himself has used his enhanced condition ability to increase his speed, physique, and stamina. This way, he won't get tired easily fighting the chimera beast, but he still has to swallow qi recovery pills because his demon techniques drain his qi to maintain the nine dark nether creatures. (A/N: His lust demon abilities, including everything he copied from other demons, don't use Qi. His demon cultivation techniques use Qi.)

Zhang Fei had tried using his petrification ability on the chimera beast, but it was completely useless because it never became a stone. Despite his desire to use the soul manipulation ability, he refrained from doing so because the beast's soul power had not weakened yet.

The chimera beast possessed by Bai Tian'er's soul seemed overwhelmed to face all their attacks, especially since Zhang Fei also repeatedly used his demon king's roar, instilling fear and confusion in it.

Zhou Tong, who was already in close proximity to the chimera beast, finally recognized Zhang Fei's demon techniques. He thought that he had something to do with the Ximen Demon Kingdom, especially since Ximen Yan was clearly trying to protect him.
Qian Ying also noticed Zhang Fei's action, but she remained silent and continued to move around, using her two daggers to attack the chimera beast.

After all of them attacked it for several hours, the chimera beast began to show signs of weakening. Zhang Fei immediately moved up to its back, touched it, and used his devouring art to weaken it further.

When the chimera beast realized this, it struggled to throw Zhang Fei off its back. He immediately stabbed the demon extermination sword into its back and channeled his dark-red flames into its body, causing it to let out a furious yet painful roar.
*Roar*
A powerful soul attack, far stronger than the previous ones, instantly swept across the area, causing all non-soul cultivators to collapse to the ground, with some even losing consciousness.

'Damn it!' Zhang Fei cursed in his heart, unleashing his dark-red flames as powerfully as possible to burn the chimera beast from within. He also used his plant generation ability to create several poisonous plants throughout the beast's entire body. Subsequently, he simultaneously employed his essence absorption technique and demon absorbing technique, drawing in the beast's life force, soul force, and essence. 'A beast with a cultivation of the seven divine realms is indeed extraordinary, but this chimera is much more terrifying than them because it was created from the combination of various beasts.'
Ximen Yan, who noticed Zhang Fei's actions, immediately smiled with satisfaction. 'Come on, kid! You must defeat this beast quickly so we can leave and talk.'
As the chimera beast weakened due to Zhang Fei's actions, its regeneration ability also slowed significantly, and their attacks became more impactful against it.
[Ding]
[The host's heavenly fox has evolved to six tails.]

After a fierce battle lasting several hours, the chimera beast finally fell to the ground without being able to fight back, much to everyone's relief. Before long, the beast's eyes became blank as it died due to the serious injury it suffered.

Ximen Yan immediately canceled his darkness and landed beside Zhang Fei, who was standing on the back of the chimera beast. 'As expected, you are the key to weakening this beast, and we can't defeat it without you.'

Zhang Fei immediately pulled out the demon extermination sword from the beast's back, and he was quite satisfied after his beast form evolved. Even so, his journey to be able to evolve to nine-tails was still very long, let alone to ten-tails.
Zhang Fei then turned to Ximen Yan. 'Shouldn't you be able to defeat this beast with your soul power?'

'Hahaha.' Ximen Yan laughed in response. 'If I leave this young demon's body, he will immediately take advantage of your situation to capture some people on your side, and you definitely don't want that to happen, right?'

Zhang Fei nodded slightly before looking at Xian Xianqin, who was flying quickly towards him. He immediately welcomed the Xian princess into his arms. "You don't need to worry anymore, okay? The attacks from all of you distracted the beast, and these three were also fighting beside me, so I didn't sustain any injuries."
"En." Xian Xianqin then glanced at Qian Ying, who was staring at her with hatred, causing her to sigh in her heart.
Soon, everyone present at that place surrounded the dead beast, but they were disappointed because they didn't get anything from it, especially since it took them so long to kill it.

Countless lights suddenly descended from the sky and enveloped them, causing the Qi in their bodies to surge drastically. Most of them felt that their cultivation had almost reached the last barrier, and some of them felt that they could break through to the next stage. Unfortunately, they still had other challenges to face, so they decided to postpone their breakthrough until they returned to their respective places.

After the lights disappeared, they were immediately sent out of the maze challenge and returned to the first floor of the Star Tower. However, the old man suddenly appeared at that place along with Hua Mei'er and Sima Yun.

Hua Mei'er was the first to speak. "It seems that your guess is correct, Master. That annoying brat does have the ability to reach the tenth floor, but he won't be able to do it at this time, and we have to wait for him for a few years or maybe decades."
"You deliberately sent this beast to test that little brat, but he still managed to kill it with the help of those people, Master." Sima Yun joined in.

The old man nodded to them. "This beast's cultivation is indeed high, yet its attacks are on par with cultivators in the ten mortal realms. If I send another one, they will never be able to defeat it, and they will die in its hands."
The two people took a deep breath after hearing that. "Do you think that old guy is still continuing his experiments, master?"

"Yes." The old man responded with a nod. "That old folk's identity is actually an ancient beast, but he is also a madman, and he is determined to create an ultimate beast that no one can match, including himself. Although our sect master and the others have tried to stop him and capture all the results of his experiments, he has always managed to escape from them, and they have yet to find his current hideout."
After that, the old man immediately put away the chimera beast's corpse, and the three of them disappeared from that place afterward.
They finally discovered the reason for the Huangfu Kingdom's absence after returning to the first floor, as they had been eliminated after giving up on the challenge, which relieved most of them.

As before, they were given the opportunity to rest for a day. They immediately returned to their previous place to rest because the maze challenge exhausted them physically and mentally, especially after they fought with the final beast.

Unlike them, Zhou Tong's expression was really bad after he got the voice transmission from his father's aides that Zhou Tai had failed and died inside the maze challenge. Additionally, Zhou Meiling did not come out of it, which made him think that his little sister had also died inside.

Zhou Tong then asked his father's aides to confirm it with his parents, but their response left him perplexed, especially since his parents had stated that Zhou Meiling's jade was still intact, indicating that she was still alive, but she had not returned.

Zhou Tong then went to one side, sat there, and observed everyone. He contemplated who might have kidnapped Zhou Meiling, but he did not suspect the demons from the two demon kingdoms, as his family was an ally of theirs.

Zhou Tong's gaze immediately fell on Zhang Fei because he had all of a sudden appeared in their realm, and not many people knew about him. Moreover, his strength was unreasonable because of his low cultivation, so he suspected that he kidnapped Zhou Meiling, but he also had no evidence of that. 'I hope the next challenge is the survival challenge, and I will immediately pursue that kid.'

As he hugged Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, who had fallen asleep on his shoulders, Zhang Fei continued to reflect on the previous changes in the maze challenge, feeling that those mysterious people had purposefully changed everything to test him.

Zhang Fei didn't mind their tests because some of them went in his favor, but he was enraged because the last chimera beast was clearly too strong for them. They deliberately sent it to them as a final test, and it endangered the people on his side. Fortunately, the other groups arrived not too long after them, or they would have been completely overwhelmed trying to fight it, and they would probably die because of it. 'Show my status, Mei.'

After reading the amount of beast essence he needed to evolve to seven tails, Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh in his heart, realizing that it was not an easy task for his beast form to evolve. 'I think I should go to the beast kingdom soon, or else it will take several years for my beast form to evolve again.'
[I think that is the best choice, Master. If you don't want to go there by yourself, you can send one of your clones there, and Zhang Fei [1] is the best choice for that.]

'Yeah, you're right. I'll think about that later, and I want to focus on completing the rest of the challenges first.' Zhang Fei then laid Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue on the floor before standing up and leaving. He then asked Ximen Yan to bring Qian Ying to see him.

A while later, they had gathered in another area, and Zhang Fei used a soundproof barrier to prevent others from hearing their conversation. "Who are you exactly?"

"My name is Ma Kuangyu, and I come from those places." Ximen Yan then conveyed his wish. "As long as I am confined here, I cannot reform my body. Unfortunately, I cannot leave this tower by myself, so I need your help to get out of this place."
Zhang Fei did not immediately agree to his request. "Why should I help you? I am unfamiliar with you, your character, or the reason for your imprisonment in this tower."

"Haha." Ximen Yan then touched Zhang Fei's forehead, sharing many memories with him, which included Ximen Yan and Ma Kuangyu. "You can see everything now, so you will understand my character and the reason I was locked up in this place."

Zhang Fei nodded and looked at Ma Kuangyu's memories first, especially since he was more important than Ximen Yan. Once he had seen everything, he immediately spoke to him. "So those people betrayed you for that item? Did you hide that item somewhere in those realms?"

"Yes." Ximen Yan nodded to him. "I found that item by accident, and I realized that it was very dangerous, so I kept it. Unfortunately, one of them realized the existence of the item, so they worked together to snatch it from me. Luckily, I realized it sooner, so I hid it in a safe place, and no one could open it except me. They killed me because they couldn't find it, and they wanted to torture me by sending my soul into this tower. If you are willing to help me, then I will owe you a few favors. Once I have successfully reformed my body, I will assist you with various tasks that will benefit both you and your women. You've seen my memories, so you shouldn't doubt my abilities anymore, right?"

Ximen Yan immediately canceled his darkness and landed beside Zhang Fei, who was standing on the back of the chimera beast. 'As expected, you are the key to weakening this beast, and we can't defeat it without you.'
Zhang Fei immediately pulled out the demon extermination sword from the beast's back, and he was quite satisfied after his beast form evolved.
Even so, his journey to be able to evolve to nine-tails was still very long, let alone to ten-tails.
Zhang Fei then turned to Ximen Yan. 'Shouldn't you be able to defeat this beast with your soul power?'

'Hahaha.' Ximen Yan laughed in response. 'If I leave this young demon's body, he will immediately take advantage of your situation to capture some people on your side, and you definitely don't want that to happen, right?'
Zhang Fei nodded slightly before looking at Xian Xianqin, who was flying quickly towards him.
He immediately welcomed the Xian princess into his arms.
"You don't need to worry anymore, okay?
The attacks from all of you distracted the beast, and these three were also fighting beside me, so I didn't sustain any injuries."
"En." Xian Xianqin then glanced at Qian Ying, who was staring at her with hatred, causing her to sigh in her heart.
Soon, everyone present at that place surrounded the dead beast, but they were disappointed because they didn't get anything from it, especially since it took them so long to kill it.
Countless lights suddenly descended from the sky and enveloped them, causing the Qi in their bodies to surge drastically.
Most of them felt that their cultivation had almost reached the last barrier, and some of them felt that they could break through to the next stage.
Unfortunately, they still had other challenges to face, so they decided to postpone their breakthrough until they returned to their respective places.
After the lights disappeared, they were immediately sent out of the maze challenge and returned to the first floor of the Star Tower.
However, the old man suddenly appeared at that place along with Hua Mei'er and Sima Yun.
Hua Mei'er was the first to speak.
"It seems that your guess is correct, Master.
That annoying brat does have the ability to reach the tenth floor, but he won't be able to do it at this time, and we have to wait for him for a few years or maybe decades."
"You deliberately sent this beast to test that little brat, but he still managed to kill it with the help of those people, Master." Sima Yun joined in.
The old man nodded to them.
"This beast's cultivation is indeed high, yet its attacks are on par with cultivators in the ten mortal realms.
If I send another one, they will never be able to defeat it, and they will die in its hands."
The two people took a deep breath after hearing that.
"Do you think that old guy is still continuing his experiments, master?"
"Yes." The old man responded with a nod.
"That old folk's identity is actually an ancient beast, but he is also a madman, and he is determined to create an ultimate beast that no one can match, including himself.

Although our sect master and the others have tried to stop him and capture all the results of his experiments, he has always managed to escape from them, and they have yet to find his current hideout."
After that, the old man immediately put away the chimera beast's corpse, and the three of them disappeared from that place afterward.
They finally discovered the reason for the Huangfu Kingdom's absence after returning to the first floor, as they had been eliminated after giving up on the challenge, which relieved most of them.
As before, they were given the opportunity to rest for a day.
They immediately returned to their previous place to rest because the maze challenge exhausted them physically and mentally, especially after they fought with the final beast.
Unlike them, Zhou Tong's expression was really bad after he got the voice transmission from his father's aides that Zhou Tai had failed and died inside the maze challenge.
Additionally, Zhou Meiling did not come out of it, which made him think that his little sister had also died inside.

Zhou Tong then asked his father's aides to confirm it with his parents, but their response left him perplexed, especially since his parents had stated that Zhou Meiling's jade was still intact, indicating that she was still alive, but she had not returned.
Zhou Tong then went to one side, sat there, and observed everyone.
He contemplated who might have kidnapped Zhou Meiling, but he did not suspect the demons from the two demon kingdoms, as his family was an ally of theirs.
Zhou Tong's gaze immediately fell on Zhang Fei because he had all of a sudden appeared in their realm, and not many people knew about him.

Moreover, his strength was unreasonable because of his low cultivation, so he suspected that he kidnapped Zhou Meiling, but he also had no evidence of that. 'I hope the next challenge is the survival challenge, and I will immediately pursue that kid.'

As he hugged Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, who had fallen asleep on his shoulders, Zhang Fei continued to reflect on the previous changes in the maze challenge, feeling that those mysterious people had purposefully changed everything to test him.
Zhang Fei didn't mind their tests because some of them went in his favor, but he was enraged because the last chimera beast was clearly too strong for them.
They deliberately sent it to them as a final test, and it endangered the people on his side.
Fortunately, the other groups arrived not too long after them, or they would have been completely overwhelmed trying to fight it, and they would probably die because of it. 'Show my status, Mei.'

After reading the amount of beast essence he needed to evolve to seven tails, Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh in his heart, realizing that it was not an easy task for his beast form to evolve. 'I think I should go to the beast kingdom soon, or else it will take several years for my beast form to evolve again.'
[I think that is the best choice, Master.
If you don't want to go there by yourself, you can send one of your clones there, and Zhang Fei [1] is the best choice for that.]
'Yeah, you're right.
I'll think about that later, and I want to focus on completing the rest of the challenges first.' Zhang Fei then laid Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue on the floor before standing up and leaving.
He then asked Ximen Yan to bring Qian Ying to see him.

A while later, they had gathered in another area, and Zhang Fei used a soundproof barrier to prevent others from hearing their conversation.
"Who are you exactly?"
"My name is Ma Kuangyu, and I come from those places." Ximen Yan then conveyed his wish.
"As long as I am confined here, I cannot reform my body.
Unfortunately, I cannot leave this tower by myself, so I need your help to get out of this place."
Zhang Fei did not immediately agree to his request.
"Why should I help you?
I am unfamiliar with you, your character, or the reason for your imprisonment in this tower."
"Haha." Ximen Yan then touched Zhang Fei's forehead, sharing many memories with him, which included Ximen Yan and Ma Kuangyu.
"You can see everything now, so you will understand my character and the reason I was locked up in this place."
Zhang Fei nodded and looked at Ma Kuangyu's memories first, especially since he was more important than Ximen Yan.
Once he had seen everything, he immediately spoke to him.
"So those people betrayed you for that item?
Did you hide that item somewhere in those realms?"
"Yes." Ximen Yan nodded to him.
"I found that item by accident, and I realized that it was very dangerous, so I kept it.
Unfortunately, one of them realized the existence of the item, so they worked together to snatch it from me.
Luckily, I realized it sooner, so I hid it in a safe place, and no one could open it except me.
They killed me because they couldn't find it, and they wanted to torture me by sending my soul into this tower.
If you are willing to help me, then I will owe you a few favors.
Once I have successfully reformed my body, I will assist you with various tasks that will benefit both you and your women.
You've seen my memories, so you shouldn't doubt my abilities anymore, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 589 The Cold Ice Phoenix
paragraphs: "Even though I've seen your memories, I still won't help you just like that." Zhang Fei's answer caused Ximen Yan to raise an eyebrow. "I have many people by my side, and they will suffer if something happens to me. At the very least, I will implant something in your soul as a precautionary measure to prevent you from taking over my body, and I will remove it once you manage to reform your body. If you agree with that, then I will help you, or you can forget it otherwise."
"I agree." Ximen Yan then turned to Qian Ying and restricted her movements, causing her to frown. "I'm sorry, but this kid wants you, so I have to do this to you."
"What are you going to do to me?" Qian Ying asked angrily, especially since her master was under Ma Kuangyu's control.

Ximen Yan immediately sealed Qian Ying's mouth and opened her top dress, revealing her dark yet smooth skin. "I knew from the beginning that someone was controlling you, implanting something in your body to seal your true memories, while your current memories are fabricated ones. I didn't do anything about it because I had no business with you two, and I used his body to help me find someone who could help me get out of this tower. I've found him now, and he wants you, so I'll help you return to your true self."
Qian Ying struggled to break free from her master, but his restriction was too strong for her. Ximen Yan then bit his thumb and dripped his blood onto her chest, revealing a black symbol there.
"What kind of symbol is that?" Zhang Fei asked him.

"This symbol is the Shadow Oblivion Seal, which is used to seal her true memories and replace them with new memories. Only her master can remove it." Zhang Fei arched his eyebrows, recalling that Ximen Gongfu's subordinate had captured Qian Ying. "His father's subordinates captured her, but the demon transferred her to him, and he's been her master since then."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Does this mean that her fabricated memories will disappear after you remove this Shadow Oblivion Seal from her?"

"I can't be sure of that because I have never learned this kind of technique before, but I can be sure that her true memories will return completely." Ximen Yan then asked him. "Are you concerned that her fabricated memories will remain intact?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "She is a close friend of Qin'er, and I want to free her for her sake. If her fabricated memories are still left behind, it might be dangerous for her."

Ximen Yan nodded slightly in response. "In that case, we have to try it first to know the result, but she has been under his control for so many years, and he has used her to do many evil things, including trying to kill Xian Xianqin too many times. If her true memories return, and her fabricated memories persist, it will probably deal a heavy blow to her."
[Master, if that happens, you can use your memory manipulation ability to erase those fabricated memories from her, allowing her to revert to her true self.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei then spoke to Ximen Yan. "You can remove it from her body first, and we will see the results first before I decide anything."

Ximen Yan touched the symbol and injected his qi into it, causing Qian Ying to writhe in pain. Zhang Fei could see the black symbol begin to evaporate, and it disappeared from her body a few minutes later.

As soon as Ximen Yan released his restriction, Qian Ying fell to the ground, her expression utterly confused as her true memories began to flood her mind. Soon, her eyes and body trembled violently as she recalled everything. She gazed at them, tears streaming from the corners of her eyes, before falling unconscious.

Ximen Yan crouched down beside Qian Ying and checked her condition. "I don't know if those fabricated memories disappeared or not, but she suffered a major blow after her true memories returned. For the time being, you should let her fall asleep, and you will know the result after she wakes up."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei then opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space and sent Qian Ying in there, especially since there were many people in his training space, and they would be in danger if she were still as evil as before. "What about this guy?"
Ximen Yan shrugged his shoulders and stood up. "You can do whatever you want to this guy, and you can even enslave him if you want to use him for other purposes."

Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't waste the good opportunity in front of him, so he directly implanted his demon slave mark into Ximen Yan's soul. He also planted his soul mark into Ma Kuangyu's soul so he would never be able to take over his body.

After they were done, Ma Kuangyu's soul left Ximen Yan's body and entered Zhang Fei's body before going to his soul space, where he found Nalan Yushu in a cage. 'Hey! I didn't expect you to be able to capture this evil woman's soul, but why did you lock her up and not absorb it?'
'I need her soul to accomplish something, and you will discover it soon.' Zhang Fei then gave some orders to Ximen Yan, and they returned to their respective places afterward.

The moment he returned to their side, Xian Changyue directly questioned Zhang Fei about his relationship with Ximen Yan because the demon prince had followed him before, and they had also talked for so long. 'I have no relationship with him, but I have some business with the soul that possessed him. By the way, that guy is my slave now, so you don't need to worry about him, and I will use him for things in the future.'
'Did you really enslave Ximen Yan?' Xian Changyue asked in shock, especially since it would be great for her kingdom if they could use him against his father, Ximen Gongfu.
Zhang Fei nodded to her. 'I have enslaved him, and I have freed Qian Ying from his control. However, that girl suffered a heavy blow after her true memories returned, and she fell unconscious.'

'My niece will be thrilled to hear that, especially since she and Qian Ying have been friends since they were little.' Xian Changyue then turned to Xian Xianqin. 'For the past years, that girl has always been her demon heart, but you managed to help her get through it, and she will be relieved after hearing this.'
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei then leaned against the wall. 'I will take a rest first, so I leave our protection to you.'
'All right.'
Since his other four clones were busy with their respective partners, Zhang Fei [5] brought Zhang Yue to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since someone from the Phoenix race would be arriving today.
The person had not yet arrived when they got there, so they chatted with Feng Yao while waiting for her, and she took them to tour the areas of the Blazing Phoenix Sect.
"When did you last see her?" Feng Yao suddenly asked Zhang Fei [5] as she pointed toward a young woman who was joking around while discussing with the other female disciples.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to the female disciple and recognized her instantly, especially since she was Chang Wenjie, the woman who wanted him to be hers back at the Blazing Volcano Mountain. "After the volcano, I only met her twice. Once in the southern region when we destroyed the Cai and You Clans, and the second time was after we destroyed the heretics, but I never spoke to her at those two meetings."

Feng Yao herself was aware of the issues between them, and Zhang Fei [5] was unwilling to accept her because of Chang Wenjie's excessive arrogance. "Wenjie has started to change after she returned from the volcano, and she has been working hard to change for the better. She is no longer as arrogant as she was back then, and she often helps the other disciples now. Naturally, you already know the reason behind her change, right?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response, but he did not forget his words to Chang Wenjie back then. "I did ask her to change if she wanted to be my woman, and I also told her that I might take her as a member of my harem after she changed. Seven months have passed since then, but we only met twice more after that, so the relationship between us was really bland."

Feng Yao nodded slightly before telling Zhang Fei [5]. "Wenjie has wanted to go see you many times, but she always felt that her change was still not good enough for you. She was afraid that you would reject her a second time, so she always gave up on her intention. I don't know your criteria for choosing a woman, but I think she's much better now, so you might consider taking her by your side."

"I agree with Big Sis Yao, Fei'er. I don't know her, so I don't know her character back then." Zhang Yue chimed in as she looked at Chang Wenjie. "I can see that the current her is good, and she doesn't have an arrogant air around her. She is friendly and warm with her sect sisters, and she is also willing to answer any of their questions."
"Do you want me to take her as a member of my harem?"

"I'm not asking you to take her as a member of your harem right away, but you can at least give her a chance to prove herself to you." Zhang Yue denied that with a shake of her head. "You rejected her once, so she decided to change for you, and she has changed now. That's why I think you can bring her with us to the Nine Stars Realm, and the two of you can build your relationship there."
"Yeah, you're right."

Feng Yao suddenly raised her eyebrows as she sensed something, and she immediately informed Zhang Fei [5]. "Feng Jinqiu has arrived, so I will bring your big sister to meet her. As for you, you should meet Chang Wenjie first, and you can catch up with us later."
Without waiting for Zhang Fei [5]'s answer, Feng Yao immediately took Zhang Yue with her. He thought for a moment before walking over to Chang Wenjie, leaving her stunned when she saw him.

The female disciples looked confused by Zhang Fei [5]'s presence, especially since he was clearly not a member of the sect. However, they noticed the change in Chang Wenjie's expression, and they guessed that he had come specifically to see her. They hurriedly left, whispering to each other, curious about his identity.
"You have changed." Zhang Fei [5] gently said it.

Chang Wenjie shook her head once she returned to her senses. "I've changed, but my changes still mean nothing in your eyes, right? We met twice in the last few months, but you never greeted me, let alone talked to me."

"You're right." Zhang Fei [5] then sat beside her. "I could see your changes at our second meeting, but I could still feel your arrogance at that time, so I didn't pay attention to you. You changed even more at our third meeting, but I was too busy with many matters at that time. As for now, I can see that you have completely changed, so I came to you to offer you a chance."
"A chance?"

"Even though you have changed, our relationship is still completely bland, so I will give you a chance to stay by my side." Chang Wenjie was delighted to hear that, but she immediately suppressed her excitement. "You must have heard that I brought Lingxue and the others to another realm, right?"

"Yes." Chang Wenjie replied with a nod. "I looked for my master at that time, and Sect Master Yao told me that she went with you to the Nine Stars Realm. Honestly, I was disappointed at that time because she left without telling me, but I can understand her feelings because you are her husband."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to her. "If you want, I'll take you to that realm and give us more time to bond."
"Do you really want to take me to that realm?" Chang Wenjie asked in disbelief.

"Back then, I asked you to change, and I also said that I might accept you after you change." Chang Wenjie naturally still remembered Zhang Fei's [5] words at that time, and that was what spurred her to continue changing during the past seven months. "I can see that you have changed, but I want to see them with my own eyes, so I want to bring you there."
Chang Wenjie had been looking forward to it for a long time. "I will go with you to that realm to prove to you that I have changed, and I hope you will accept me after you see everything."
"Go pack your things and inform your family about this matter." Zhang Fei [5] then stood up. "I will go see Feng Yao now, and you can come see me again when you are ready."
After that, Chang Wenjie immediately stood up from her seat, rushed back to her room in the sect, and also contacted her family.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately searched the map for the locations of Zhang Yue and the others, finding them in a room quite far from his. Upon reaching the room, a chill penetrated his bones, a sensation he had never experienced before. Even though his big sister has awakened her ice phoenix bloodline and physique, the coldness emanating from her body still pales in comparison.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the room before looking at Feng Jinqiu, the pure ice phoenix.

Feng Jinqiu's appearance was like autumn, her skin as white as the snow. She appeared to be only seventeen or eighteen years old but already possessed a graceful bearing and beauty that could topple kingdoms.
If Feng Yao was as hot as burning lava, then Feng Jinqiu was as cold as the coldest ice. Her aura is as cold as an iceberg, repelling anyone who dares to approach her.

Feng Jinqiu wore a long blue dress and a white silk belt around her curvy waist. Her blue hair was silky smooth, falling to her shoulders. Her blue eyes were as cold as the coldest ice, and her lips were icy pale but perfectly curved. Even without any makeup, her appearance didn't have a single flaw, and everything about her was truly flawless.

Feng Jinqiu raised her eyebrows as she noticed Zhang Fei [5] staring at her intensely, but she remained silent and instead spoke to Feng Yao. "Princess, I cannot train this little girl here because her ice element will disturb the people in the sect, so I must take her away to a secluded place before starting her training."

'Her voice is cold but melodious.' Zhang Fei [5] then told her. "Senior Jinqiu, you can take my big sister to the fallen moon cave in the north of this island, especially since there are a lot of moon crystals there, so the Yin Qi there is very strong."

Feng Jinqiu nodded in understanding and turned to Feng Yao, who immediately touched her forehead and shared the location of the fallen moon cave. She then grabbed Zhang Yue's shoulders and took her away directly, causing Zhang Fei [5] to sigh.
"Haha." Feng Yao chuckled at his sigh. "Are you thinking about getting Jinqiu? She is an ice phoenix, and her feelings are very cold, so it won't be easy for you if you want to get her."

"I once read that an ice phoenix is incredibly beautiful, and she truly is. I have an interest in her, but I am not thinking about it for now." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "Do you want to go to the Nine Stars Realm now?"
Feng Yao nodded at him. "I have explained everything to Jinqiu, and I have also asked the elders to help her so I can go there now."
