"You rejected her once, so she decided to change for you, and she has changed now.
That's why I think you can bring her with us to the Nine Stars Realm, and the two of you can build your relationship there."
"Yeah, you're right."
Feng Yao suddenly raised her eyebrows as she sensed something, and she immediately informed Zhang Fei [5].
"Feng Jinqiu has arrived, so I will bring your big sister to meet her.
As for you, you should meet Chang Wenjie first, and you can catch up with us later."
Without waiting for Zhang Fei [5]'s answer, Feng Yao immediately took Zhang Yue with her.
He thought for a moment before walking over to Chang Wenjie, leaving her stunned when she saw him.
The female disciples looked confused by Zhang Fei [5]'s presence, especially since he was clearly not a member of the sect.
However, they noticed the change in Chang Wenjie's expression, and they guessed that he had come specifically to see her.
They hurriedly left, whispering to each other, curious about his identity.
"You have changed." Zhang Fei [5] gently said it.
Chang Wenjie shook her head once she returned to her senses.
"I've changed, but my changes still mean nothing in your eyes, right?
We met twice in the last few months, but you never greeted me, let alone talked to me."
"You're right." Zhang Fei [5] then sat beside her.
"I could see your changes at our second meeting, but I could still feel your arrogance at that time, so I didn't pay attention to you.
You changed even more at our third meeting, but I was too busy with many matters at that time.
As for now, I can see that you have completely changed, so I came to you to offer you a chance."
"A chance?"

"Even though you have changed, our relationship is still completely bland, so I will give you a chance to stay by my side." Chang Wenjie was delighted to hear that, but she immediately suppressed her excitement.
"You must have heard that I brought Lingxue and the others to another realm, right?"
"Yes." Chang Wenjie replied with a nod.
"I looked for my master at that time, and Sect Master Yao told me that she went with you to the Nine Stars Realm.
Honestly, I was disappointed at that time because she left without telling me, but I can understand her feelings because you are her husband."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to her.
"If you want, I'll take you to that realm and give us more time to bond."
"Do you really want to take me to that realm?" Chang Wenjie asked in disbelief.

"Back then, I asked you to change, and I also said that I might accept you after you change." Chang Wenjie naturally still remembered Zhang Fei's [5] words at that time, and that was what spurred her to continue changing during the past seven months.
"I can see that you have changed, but I want to see them with my own eyes, so I want to bring you there."
Chang Wenjie had been looking forward to it for a long time.
"I will go with you to that realm to prove to you that I have changed, and I hope you will accept me after you see everything."
"Go pack your things and inform your family about this matter." Zhang Fei [5] then stood up.
"I will go see Feng Yao now, and you can come see me again when you are ready."
After that, Chang Wenjie immediately stood up from her seat, rushed back to her room in the sect, and also contacted her family.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately searched the map for the locations of Zhang Yue and the others, finding them in a room quite far from his.
Upon reaching the room, a chill penetrated his bones, a sensation he had never experienced before.
Even though his big sister has awakened her ice phoenix bloodline and physique, the coldness emanating from her body still pales in comparison.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the room before looking at Feng Jinqiu, the pure ice phoenix.
Feng Jinqiu's appearance was like autumn, her skin as white as the snow.
She appeared to be only seventeen or eighteen years old but already possessed a graceful bearing and beauty that could topple kingdoms.
If Feng Yao was as hot as burning lava, then Feng Jinqiu was as cold as the coldest ice.
Her aura is as cold as an iceberg, repelling anyone who dares to approach her.
Feng Jinqiu wore a long blue dress and a white silk belt around her curvy waist.
Her blue hair was silky smooth, falling to her shoulders.
Her blue eyes were as cold as the coldest ice, and her lips were icy pale but perfectly curved.
Even without any makeup, her appearance didn't have a single flaw, and everything about her was truly flawless.
Feng Jinqiu raised her eyebrows as she noticed Zhang Fei [5] staring at her intensely, but she remained silent and instead spoke to Feng Yao.
"Princess, I cannot train this little girl here because her ice element will disturb the people in the sect, so I must take her away to a secluded place before starting her training."
'Her voice is cold but melodious.' Zhang Fei [5] then told her.
"Senior Jinqiu, you can take my big sister to the fallen moon cave in the north of this island, especially since there are a lot of moon crystals there, so the Yin Qi there is very strong."
Feng Jinqiu nodded in understanding and turned to Feng Yao, who immediately touched her forehead and shared the location of the fallen moon cave.
She then grabbed Zhang Yue's shoulders and took her away directly, causing Zhang Fei [5] to sigh.
"Haha." Feng Yao chuckled at his sigh.
"Are you thinking about getting Jinqiu?
She is an ice phoenix, and her feelings are very cold, so it won't be easy for you if you want to get her."
"I once read that an ice phoenix is incredibly beautiful, and she truly is.
I have an interest in her, but I am not thinking about it for now." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her.
"Do you want to go to the Nine Stars Realm now?"
Feng Yao nodded at him.
"I have explained everything to Jinqiu, and I have also asked the elders to help her so I can go there now."

chapters.title: Chapter 590 Zhang Yue's Training
paragraphs: Feng Jinqiu had already brought Zhang Yue to the fallen moon cave, and she was satisfied with the place, especially since the quality and intensity of the Yin Qi inside were so high.

"Practicing the ice phoenix scripture in a cold place is the most ideal, yet this realm lacks such a place. That's why I will use my ice element to freeze this cave, and the coldness of my ice element is significant enough to help the current you. Furthermore, these moon crystals are beneficial for Yin living beings like us, allowing you to cultivate and absorb the Yin Qi within them." After that, Feng Jinqiu touched the wall, causing the entire cave, including the entrance, to freeze in a matter of seconds. She then took off her clothes until not a single thread remained on her flawless body, confusing Zhang Yue. "What are you waiting for? Take off your clothes and sit cross-legged in the middle, and I will help you improve your ice element first. Once your ice element is stronger, I will start helping you to learn every technique in the scriptures."
Zhang Yue followed her orders by undressing and sitting cross-legged in the middle of the cave, and Feng Jinqiu sat behind her with both palms touching her back. "What should I do now, Senior?"

"Start cultivating and absorbing the Yin Qi inside these moon crystals." Zhang Yue immediately closed her eyes, and she was lost in cultivation within a few seconds. Even her body was rapidly absorbing the Yin Qi, surprising Feng Jinqiu. 'My princess previously said that she was a novice cultivator, but she was able to do it this fast.'
Feng Jinqiu then closed her eyes, channeled her ice qi into Zhang Yue's body, and encased their bodies in an ice crystal.

After they had waited for some time, Chang Wenjie finally came to them. Zhang Fei[5] immediately sent her and Feng Yao to his residence in the Nine Stars Realm, but he returned to Earth to forge weapons and stand guard.

When they arrived there, Chang Wenjie was surprised by the number of people in the residence, and she saw many familiar faces, such as the five members of the Zhang Clan. Moreover, she had also met almost all of Zhang Fei's wives, except for a few women from Earth and the two Dryads.

Zhang Fei's young wives, such as Ye Lian, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Zhang Lin, were surprised by Chang Wenjie's arrival. They remembered that their husband rejected her seven months ago, but he suddenly sent her to their residence.

"You guys don't need to be confused because Wenjie has changed, so our husband decided to bring her here." They turned to Zhang Lingxue, who immediately walked in front of Chang Wenjie. "Even though he hasn't fully accepted you, you now have plenty of time to prove your changes to him, and he will definitely accept you one day."
"Yes, Master." Chang Wenjie then looked at the women gathered in the distance. "Who are they, Master?"

"You've met Zhang Chen, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, and Xu Ling'er before, right? Tang Ziyu is one of his official wives, and Guo Lan is his future wife; both of them came from his home realm. Lillea and Janette are also his wives, and they are a mother and a daughter, but they are demons." Chang Wenjie was surprised when Zhang Lingxue introduced the last two names. "Wang Zhetian and Dou Luotian are his grandfather and step-grandmother. The two people beside them are their grandchildren, Wang Xiaofeng and Wang Zhuxian. The other four are Ming Han, Zhang Hanzi, and their two children, Ming Hao and Ming Yanyu. While the red-haired woman is Qing Tan, his maternal aunt."

Chang Wenjie nodded in understanding before turning to the disciples from the two sects who were training together in front of their big house. However, she only recognized Qin Zheng, Zhu Hongtao, and their daughter Zhu Qianzhi, especially since she had met them several times in the past.

"They belong to the Yin-Yang Pavilion Sect, and they are our husband's friends." Zhang Lingxue then told Chang Wenjie their names one by one, and she also told her the names of the disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect. "They are Ye Lian's close friends, so he brought them all here to liven up the atmosphere. Several other women, including Zhu Yan and the Wen Twins, reside in the royal capital. Join them to get to know each other, especially since you'll be part of our big family."
Despite their past dislike for Chang Wenjie, Ye Lian and the others warmly welcomed her, particularly after their husband decided to accept her into their family.
Zhang Lingxue then asked Feng Yao. "What are your plans now?"
"I thought I would check out the Star Tower after this." Feng Yao asked in turn. "When will he open his new shop?"

"The renovation was completed two days ago, and my husband has bought all the items, but he is still busy with his cultivation and forging." Feng Yao was surprised to hear that Zhang Fei was also a blacksmith. "He learned forging from Gang Zhishou in this realm, and he also learned it from Tie Xuan in the Wasteland Realm."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding before examining all the formations surrounding the residence and the surrounding area. "It wasn't Zhang Fei who created all these formations, right?"

"Actually, he is also an array master, but his ability is still not enough to create all these formations, so he asked Fa Zhen for help." Zhang Lingxue then hugged Feng Yao's arm. "How about we go for a walk in the capital?"

"I haven't had a good time for a long time, so we can go there now, and I'll go to the Star Tower later." Feng Yao then released the seal on her cultivation, as the world law in that realm was stronger than in the Sky Jade Realm. This resulted in her cultivation returning to the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm. "Let's go now."

Even though she had not practiced using the gravity feature, and the phoenix was not the fastest beast, her speed was still extremely fast. Feng Yao and Zhang Lingxue were able to arrive at the capital in just a few minutes.

Since the guards at the south gate already knew Zhang Lingxue, they were able to enter the city easily. However, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately detected Feng Yao's presence and quickly appeared before them.
Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang exchanged looks of shock, especially after they realized that Feng Yao's cultivation was much higher than theirs.

"You are the son of Xian Xianjue, and your wife is the daughter of Shi Baoyin, right?" Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang were even more shocked to hear their fathers' names from Feng Yao's mouth. "You guys must be confused because they have never returned to this realm since they ascended, but I can tell you two that they are still alive and well. They have joined a sect in one of the realms there, but their low status prevents them from returning here."

"Who exactly are you, senior?" Xian Feng asked as he cupped his hands towards Feng Yao, but his actions shocked the people around them. After all, he was their emperor, and they didn't know the phoenix princess, yet he was so respectful to her.

"My name is Feng Yao, and I come from one of the realms there." Feng Yao then pointed at Zhang Lingxue. "Even though we are not blood sisters, we have lived together for a very long time, and I already consider her my blood sister."

Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang finally knew the reason why the alchemy union decided to withdraw their members from their kingdom, especially since they had previously sought trouble with Zhang Fei and Zhang Lingxue, but it turned out both of them had a stronger backer than the organization. "Are our fathers really still alive now, senior? Which sect did they join?"

"They are still alive, and they joined my Blazing Phoenix Sect." Zhang Lingxue was surprised by Feng Yao's answer, especially since she had never told her that their sect also existed in the upper realms. "I learned about this realm from them, and I asked Zhang Fei to bring Lingxue and the others to this kingdom, especially since I've heard a lot about it from them. Anyway, I want to relax with my sister, so I hope you two don't follow us, or else these people will bother us later."
"Yes, Senior." Both people once again cupped their hands to Feng Yao. "In that case, you two can enjoy your time in our kingdom, and we will return to our palace."

After they disappeared, the two women immediately walked away to the commerce district. Zhang Lingxue then asked Feng Yao. "What exactly is your purpose in establishing our sect in the Sky Jade Realm?"

"Didn't I tell you about it two days ago?" Zhang Lingxue raised her eyebrows for a moment before nodding in understanding. "My phoenix race is still strong now, but we are running out of new talents. That's why I decided to establish our sect there, so I can protect that realm while looking for the best talents to bring to our main sect in the future, and you are one of them. However, you are Zhang Fei's wife now, and I am sure that he will not let you join me. Even if he allows you to join us, it will only be a setback for you."
"Haha." Zhang Lingxue laughed awkwardly in response. "Can your race accept a human like me?"

"Not all of them can accept the presence of humans, but many of them don't mind it." Zhang Lingxue was not surprised by that, and she had expected it instead. "That's why we didn't establish our sect in our Phoenix realm, but we established it in a realm not far from our realm, so humans and other living beings can coexist there."
After that, Zhang Lingxue guided Feng Yao to their new shop and also took her to their restaurant, during which they engaged in a conversation.

In the royal palace, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang sat side by side, and both of them were still wondering about Feng Yao's true identity. However, they were certain that Feng Yao's status was not ordinary. They believed that her status should surpass theirs, as it was evident from her words that her family was the owner of the Blazing Phoenix Sect.

Shi Qingzhuang spoke to her husband. "I still didn't expect that Zhang Fei had such a powerful backer, but I think it's good, especially for our daughter. Changyue informed me that Xianqin had grown closer to him since their trip to the tower, and it was thanks to him that she completed her demon heart challenge."

"You're right." Xian Feng agreed with his wife. "However, it's evident to both of us that Zhang Fei and Feng Yao find it bothersome to interfere in our kingdom's affairs, so we should refrain from bothering them. As for our daughter's relationship with him, Xianqin is an adult now, so we should let her decide for herself. If their fates align, they will undoubtedly become husband and wife in the future."

"I hope they will truly become husband and wife, or our daughter will be heartbroken if their relationship fails." Shi Qingzhuang then told her husband about something else. "You were busy with the ministers before, so Changyue contacted me to tell you something. She said that Zhou Meiling had fallen into Zhang Fei's hands, and he had also enslaved Ximen Yan."
"Huh?" Xian Feng turned to his wife in shock. "Are you serious about that?"

"Yes." Shi Qingzhuang then told her husband how the two people fell into Zhang Fei's hands, which shocked Xian Feng. "Changyue doesn't know Zhang Fei's plans for Zhou Meiling yet, but he seems to intend to use Ximen Yan to go to the Dark Demon Kingdom, especially since he himself is a demon. Additionally, he managed to free Qian Ying from the demon's control, but she fell into a coma after her memories returned, and she doesn't yet know the changes that will happen to her."

Xian Feng felt a sense of relief upon hearing the news about Qian Ying, particularly because he had always felt guilty about her. "I think it's good, and I hope she will return to her old self so our daughter can throw away the guilt in her heart."

"I hope so, too." Shi Qingzhuang then asked him. "Are you going to discuss the matter of Zhou Meiling and Ximen Yan with Zhang Fei? If he hands them over to us, then we can use them to suppress Zhou Xiaochuan and Ximen Gongfu."
"No." Xian Feng immediately rejected it. "If Zhang Fei hands them over to us, I will accept them gladly. However, I will refrain from discussing it with him and instead await his plan for them."
"I see." After that, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang discussed other matters, including their plans for their son's marriage to Yao Yin.
After they spent some time in the capital, Feng Yao immediately sent Zhang Lingxue back to Zhang Fei's residence, and she rushed to the Star Tower at top speed.

When she arrived there, Feng Yao was blocked by the barrier that covered the entire island. She then touched it and tried to check the strength of the barrier, but it was beyond her imagination. 'As expected, this barrier is much stronger than all the barriers I have encountered in the upper realms, including the one in the Xianjin Realm. Moreover, I need a special key to enter it, but I don't have one.'

Many cultivators suddenly appeared in the sky above Feng Yao, and most of them were guards sent by all the kingdoms, except for the people of the Hangfu kingdom. One of them had a high status in that realm, especially since she was the Empress of the Ximen Kingdom, Nu Huangjin.
Feng Yao immediately looked up, scrutinizing each person. "I have no business with you anyway, so don't bother me, or I'll eliminate you."

Even though Feng Yao threatened them like that, four of them immediately descended before her, causing her to frown. They were people from the beast and natural races' kingdoms. "Please forgive us for disturbing you, but we just want to know whether you come from there, Senior."

"You're right. I did come from there, but I won't discuss that with you. Tell Long Huang and Xian Lianghua that I don't want any disturbance, so they don't have to come to me." The four people immediately nodded to Feng Yao. "Do any of you have the key to enter this barrier?"
"I have one, Senior." A man from the beast kingdom responded, handing Feng Yao a token. "You only need to activate this token with your Qi, and you can enter this barrier directly."
"Thank you." Feng Yao immediately activated the token and left them by entering the barrier.

The four people exchanged glances for a moment, and they immediately contacted their two emperors to inform them of Feng Yao's previous message. After that, they immediately disappeared from that place again, but the other cultivators still stayed there as they wondered about Feng Yao's identity.

As she stood in mid-air, Nu Huangjin continued to look towards the barrier. 'The woman just now was clearly much stronger than all the cultivators in this realm, so I must inform my husband of her presence, or we will be in big trouble if we cross paths with her.'

Soon, Feng Yao arrived in front of the stone obelisk and gazed at it, recalling Zhang Lingxue's story about it. She then touched it and used a little of her power, causing the ten crystals there to light up at once. 'It's not difficult to light them, but I can't enter the tower because the top 100 rankings are already inside. I must wait for them to come out before I can challenge this tower.'
To Feng Yao's surprise, the tower door suddenly opened by itself, and the tower immediately sucked her inside before closing again.

"Changyue doesn't know Zhang Fei's plans for Zhou Meiling yet, but he seems to intend to use Ximen Yan to go to the Dark Demon Kingdom, especially since he himself is a demon.
Additionally, he managed to free Qian Ying from the demon's control, but she fell into a coma after her memories returned, and she doesn't yet know the changes that will happen to her."
Xian Feng felt a sense of relief upon hearing the news about Qian Ying, particularly because he had always felt guilty about her.
"I think it's good, and I hope she will return to her old self so our daughter can throw away the guilt in her heart."
"I hope so, too." Shi Qingzhuang then asked him.
"Are you going to discuss the matter of Zhou Meiling and Ximen Yan with Zhang Fei?
If he hands them over to us, then we can use them to suppress Zhou Xiaochuan and Ximen Gongfu."
"No." Xian Feng immediately rejected it.
"If Zhang Fei hands them over to us, I will accept them gladly.
However, I will refrain from discussing it with him and instead await his plan for them."
"I see." After that, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang discussed other matters, including their plans for their son's marriage to Yao Yin.
After they spent some time in the capital, Feng Yao immediately sent Zhang Lingxue back to Zhang Fei's residence, and she rushed to the Star Tower at top speed.
When she arrived there, Feng Yao was blocked by the barrier that covered the entire island.

She then touched it and tried to check the strength of the barrier, but it was beyond her imagination. 'As expected, this barrier is much stronger than all the barriers I have encountered in the upper realms, including the one in the Xianjin Realm.
Moreover, I need a special key to enter it, but I don't have one.'
Many cultivators suddenly appeared in the sky above Feng Yao, and most of them were guards sent by all the kingdoms, except for the people of the Hangfu kingdom.
One of them had a high status in that realm, especially since she was the Empress of the Ximen Kingdom, Nu Huangjin.
Feng Yao immediately looked up, scrutinizing each person.
"I have no business with you anyway, so don't bother me, or I'll eliminate you."
Even though Feng Yao threatened them like that, four of them immediately descended before her, causing her to frown.
They were people from the beast and natural races' kingdoms.
"Please forgive us for disturbing you, but we just want to know whether you come from there, Senior."
"You're right.
I did come from there, but I won't discuss that with you.
Tell Long Huang and Xian Lianghua that I don't want any disturbance, so they don't have to come to me." The four people immediately nodded to Feng Yao.
"Do any of you have the key to enter this barrier?"
"I have one, Senior." A man from the beast kingdom responded, handing Feng Yao a token.
"You only need to activate this token with your Qi, and you can enter this barrier directly."
"Thank you." Feng Yao immediately activated the token and left them by entering the barrier.
The four people exchanged glances for a moment, and they immediately contacted their two emperors to inform them of Feng Yao's previous message.
After that, they immediately disappeared from that place again, but the other cultivators still stayed there as they wondered about Feng Yao's identity.

As she stood in mid-air, Nu Huangjin continued to look towards the barrier. 'The woman just now was clearly much stronger than all the cultivators in this realm, so I must inform my husband of her presence, or we will be in big trouble if we cross paths with her.'
Soon, Feng Yao arrived in front of the stone obelisk and gazed at it, recalling Zhang Lingxue's story about it.

She then touched it and used a little of her power, causing the ten crystals there to light up at once. 'It's not difficult to light them, but I can't enter the tower because the top 100 rankings are already inside.
I must wait for them to come out before I can challenge this tower.'
To Feng Yao's surprise, the tower door suddenly opened by itself, and the tower immediately sucked her inside before closing again.

chapters.title: Chapter 591 Sin Challenge
paragraphs: As soon as Feng Yao walked onto the first floor, the remaining participants immediately looked at her in confusion. Their confusion came from the fact that only those in the top 100 rankings could enter, and some of the challenges had already ended.
'This woman is a true fire phoenix, and she is much stronger than our parents.' Long Chen whispered to his little brother after he sensed Feng Yao's calm but blazing aura.
Long Tian nodded. 'Did she come from another realm? What was her reason for coming here? There has never been a phoenix in this realm, but she suddenly appeared here.'

'She probably came from the upper realms, especially since our parents knew all the mythical beasts in these middle realms.' Long Chen immediately turned his head away when Feng Yao glanced at them. 'Phoenixes are the gentlest mythical beasts, but they can also be deadly, so we shouldn't go near this woman.'
'Jinglan, did you notice that woman's identity?' Xia Xianzi whispered to her friend as she stole a glance at Feng Yao.

'That woman is a mythical beast, the fire phoenix. Her cultivation is far above my parents, so I'm sure she came from the upper realms. However, I'm not sure why she came here or how she gained access to this tower, given that she wasn't present from the start.' Xian Jinglan then ordered her other members not to keep looking at Feng Yao.

The three groups from the Bai, Xian, and Yun Kingdoms, under the leadership of Bai Chongxi, Xian Qifeng, and Li Yao, were also surprised by Feng Yao's arrival. However, all of them immediately turned their gazes back, and they wondered in their hearts about her, including her identity and how she managed to enter the tower.

Unlike them, the other group from the Xian Kingdom, led by Xuan Yu, kept their eyes on Feng Yao, and the two princes seemed eager to approach her. However, they suddenly felt a chill down their spines, especially when her red eyes gave them a piercing stare, causing all of them to tremble in fear.

On the other hand, Zhou Tong clenched his fists tightly, and his Adam's apple moved up and down as he repeatedly swallowed his saliva. His gaze was like that of a man who had been infatuated with a woman, and his mind was imagining something wrong with Feng Yao.

'This woman is truly powerful! She's the most worthy woman to accompany me.' Unnoticed by everyone in the room except for Zhang Fei, Zhou Tong suddenly trembled as Feng Yao's pressure suppressed him from above. 'Fuck! She is indeed powerful, but she is too arrogant to suppress me like this! I don't care who she is; I will definitely make her submit to me in the future!'
Unfortunately, Zhou Tong was too naive, as he did not know Feng Yao's identity, and it was impossible for him to subdue the princess of the phoenix race.
'Hey! Foolish brother! Your eyes are almost popping out of their sockets!'
Ximen Hongwu seemed unmoved, his gaze solely focused on Feng Yao's figure, a glimmer of eagerness to possess her flashing in his eyes.

Even so, Ximen Hongwu realized that Feng Yao was far beyond his reach. Even strong demon cultivators like his parents couldn't stand a chance against her, let alone him, with his meager cultivation. 'Such a perfect woman! She's an unblemished fire goddess!'

'Tch!' Ximen Yueliang gritted her teeth as she watched her big brother continue in this manner, but she had to admit that Feng Yao was indeed an enchanting beauty, surpassing the beauty of any woman present. 'Where did she come from? Since when was there a woman as beautiful as her in this realm? Even the Elf Empress's beauty could not compare to hers! Unfortunately, she is a woman; if she were a man, I would do everything in my power to control her.'

Feng Yao ignored them and walked toward the last group; to be precise, she walked toward Zhang Fei. Bai Tian'er and the others were perplexed as she approached them, but they observed that her gaze remained focused on their leader.

The other groups were also intrigued by Feng Yao's motive for approaching Zhang Fei, but some of them had already deduced that the two have a relationship. Some of them, especially Zhou Tong, were jealous and wanted to destroy him.

When she arrived in front of them, Feng Yao immediately teased Zhang Fei, especially since Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue were flanking him and sleeping on his shoulders. "Did you come here to train or find some new women? Your luck with women will make all men jealous, considering they are the Xian and Yun princesses, right?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "You are right; they are Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, the two princesses of the two kingdoms. By the way, how did you get into this tower?"

Feng Yao immediately showed the token to Zhang Fei. "Someone from the beast race gave it to me, so I was able to pass through the barrier. At first, I was testing my strength on the stone obelisk and thought I had to wait for you guys to leave before entering. However, this tower suddenly sucked me in, and here I am now."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows in response to that. "Apparently, your talents attracted those people, and they purposefully brought you here."
"I think so, too." They then looked up as a black portal suddenly descended from the ceiling, immediately drawing Feng Yao into it.

Following the disappearance of the phoenix princess, Zhang Fei caught everyone's attention, prompting Xian Changyue to question him directly. "Who is that woman? How do you know her? I can't sense her cultivation, so I'm sure her cultivation has already surpassed the divine expansion realm."

"I will not reveal her true identity, but her name is Feng Yao. Her cultivation has indeed surpassed the divine expansion realm, so she is the strongest cultivator in this realm." Zhang Fei's response stunned everyone, but he then asked Xian Changyue. Did you believe my words from a few days ago? She is a special woman, so I want her as my woman. Unfortunately, she is still far beyond my reach, and I still have to work hard to win her over."

Yuan Luo, Ru Yanyue, and Ye Zhiqiu massaged their foreheads after Zhang Fei said that, especially since they already knew that he had many wives and partners by his side. Moreover, their princess had clearly fallen in love with him, but he was still thinking about getting Feng Yao.

Unlike them, Bai Tian'er fell into pensiveness because Zhang Fei had rejected him too many times, and she even took the initiative to seduce him when they were trapped in the trap house before. Although Bai Tian'er felt confident when comparing herself to Xian Xianqin or Yun Xinyue, she felt inferior to some of his wives, and Feng Yao further exacerbated her sense of inferiority. 'Tch! Why do those beautiful women have to be by his side? If they weren't by his side, he wouldn't reject me over and over again.'
'No wonder Feng Yao could pressure the alchemy union to the point where they withdrew their people from my kingdom; it turns out she is so powerful.' Xian Changyue said it with a soft sigh.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

At the same time as the two notifications appeared in Zhang Fei's mind, Feng Yao also appeared in front of them, but a red portal suddenly descended and pulled her in, which was the portal to the battle challenge. However, it didn't last long, and she returned to the room in less than five minutes.
"Who is your opponent?" Zhang Fei asked Feng Yao because all the participants had passed the battle challenge.
Feng Yao shrugged her shoulders. "I don't know who my opponent is, but he is too weak, even though his cultivation is on par with mine."

Zhang Fei immediately guessed that the man was one of the mysterious people who controlled the tower, but a portal suddenly descended from above them. Since they had never entered the portal before, he immediately woke up Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue.

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue were astonished when they saw Feng Yao, but they didn't have time to ask Zhang Fei, especially since the new portal instantly sucked them all into it and sent them to the next challenge.

When he arrived at the location of the challenge, Zhang Fei saw seven different colored doors surrounding him, and he immediately guessed that it was the Sin Challenge, especially since Ying Shanhu had told him that the challenge was related to the seven deadly sins.

The golden door suddenly opened by itself, and the room was filled with a large number of various treasures. Numerous artifacts appeared there, ranging from weapons, armor, and various other types, most of which were immortal grade.

"What a useless test." Zhang Fei said as he shook his head. "Even though you guys come from the realms beyond the upper realms, I'm sure you won't have so many precious items of such high grade. That's why I know they're not real, so you guys don't need to waste my time and remove these illusions from my view."

All the treasures immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight, and countless delicious foods appeared in front of him, causing him to laugh out loud at the gluttony test. "Hahahaha! To tell you the truth, all these foods look delicious from the outside, but I know that they don't taste as good as they look, and my grandmother's dishes are much more delicious than them. So you guys can continue with the test, or I'll get bored with trivial tests like this."

After all the food disappeared, the room turned bright red, and Zhang Fei felt his anger overflowing for no apparent reason. He realized that the third test was the wrath, so he immediately sat cross-legged and enveloped his body with his light element to calm his anger. However, the more he calmed his anger, the more it overflowed.
'Mei, inform me if the test has disappeared.'
[Yes, Master.]
After that, Zhang Fei sealed all his senses, including his subconscious, so the effects of the wrath test would not affect him.

After an hour, the wrath test finally disappeared because Zhang Fei did not vent his anger, and the sloth test replaced it. Mei immediately informed him, especially since he might be considered sleeping if he continued in that position.

Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes, but the effects of the sloth test gave him extreme drowsiness. "Compared to the previous three tests, this test is quite difficult, but it's still not a big deal for me."

Zhang Fei instantly rose to his feet, utilizing his demon body technique and enhanced condition ability. He also used his plant generation to create various colorful plants that soothed his eyes, and he started running around the room to overcome his drowsiness.

"I wonder how many participants will make it through this Sin Challenge, but I'm afraid that Xianqin and Xinyue will fail their tests." Another hour passed, but Zhang Fei did not fall asleep, and the sloth test immediately disappeared by itself. The envy test swiftly took its place, instilling in him a deep sense of envy and causing him to sigh softly. "Everyone has envy in their hearts, including me. Fortunately, I am not overly envious, as I already possess numerous precious things in my life, particularly my wives, partners, and all my family members, who consistently treat me with kindness. Instead, people envy me for their presence by my side, and many of them have the desire to snatch them away from me."

Later, the envy test vanished, as Zhang Fei remained unaffected by the envy in his heart. Then, the pride test surfaced, reinforcing his already high pride as a heavenly fox. Once again, he decided to seal his senses and subconscious so he would not react to the effects of the pride test.

As soon as Mei informed him that the pride test was over, Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes, but dozens of naked women appeared before him, and many familiar faces were among them, such as Qing Tan, Shen Huang, Shen Xinya, Zhang Chen, Feng Yao, Xian Xianqin, Yun Xinyue, and many other women.

"Do those people really believe that these illusionary women can seduce me?" Zhang Fei immediately stood up, unleashing his aura to knock them all back. He then released the pink gas from his body and moved towards them. He also used his enhanced demon touch on all of them, causing them to burn with their own lust. "Hahaha! You guys can satisfy yourselves, and I will enjoy this beautiful view from here."
[Master, keep in mind that there's one more test left, and the last one has something to do with your karma.]

"I don't know what awaits me after this, but I just need to wait for this lust test to end, and I am confident that I will pass it." After Zhang Fei waited for an hour, all the women finally disappeared from his sight. He immediately summoned the demon extermination sword, readying himself to face his karma, particularly the retribution of his bad karma.

Zhang Fei immediately looked up into the sky as soon as a collection of black clouds appeared above him, and flashes of lightning could be seen from them. "Do they intend to use lightning tribulations to test me? Does this mean I just have to survive them?"
Countless people suddenly appeared in front of him, and all of them were people who had been his enemies and died at his hands, including Zhang He and Chen Xin.

However, the figure of a little girl among them drew Zhang Fei's attention, but he was certain he had never known her before. He suddenly felt a sharp prick inside his brain, and his eyes shook as if he remembered something. "Ugh!"
[Ding]
[The system detected an abnormal activity in the host's brain.]
Mei was shocked by the notification. [Master! I don't know who that little girl is, but you must control yourself because your final test in this challenge is underway!]

As he continued to stare at the little girl's figure, Zhang Fei took a deep breath and squeezed the hilt of his sword. Those people suddenly moved towards him and attacked him directly, so he immediately avoided them, but several lightning bolts suddenly descended.

"If I had never faced two lightning tribulations before, I might be afraid of you guys, but I'm no longer afraid." Zhang Fei immediately flew into the sky and met the lightning bolts head-on, causing them to strike his body and electrocute him directly. "Damn it! They were just illusions, but the attacks felt so real!

Zhang Fei ignored the pain as his regenerative healing factor continued to restore his body. He moved towards the other lightning bolts, but suddenly, those people flew towards him and attacked him once more. "Since I've already killed you all once, I'll kill you all a second time."

Zhang Fei's fight this time was not easy, especially since all those people had the same strength and speed. Fortunately, they did not have his techniques or other abilities, especially his enhanced condition ability. Furthermore, those lightning bolts kept falling from the sky to attack him, and he could not avoid them, so he was forced to fight those people while enduring the pain.
Given their overwhelming numbers, Zhang Fei chose to fly in order to evade them. He then used his qi to control the hongxi dagger and ordered the demon extermination sword to block their attacks.
As he fled, Zhang Fei hurriedly put on the abyssal demon equipment set. Once he had everything on, he immediately attacked those people with his black halberd.

Since they were only illusions and Zhang Fei couldn't absorb them, he decided to use the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation to attack them in a specific area. Additionally, he used the Nine Nether Fiends Summoning to summon those nine darkness creatures.

As he continued to stare at the little girl's figure, Zhang Fei took a deep breath and squeezed the hilt of his sword.
Those people suddenly moved towards him and attacked him directly, so he immediately avoided them, but several lightning bolts suddenly descended.

"If I had never faced two lightning tribulations before, I might be afraid of you guys, but I'm no longer afraid." Zhang Fei immediately flew into the sky and met the lightning bolts head-on, causing them to strike his body and electrocute him directly.
"Damn it!
They were just illusions, but the attacks felt so real!
Zhang Fei ignored the pain as his regenerative healing factor continued to restore his body.
He moved towards the other lightning bolts, but suddenly, those people flew towards him and attacked him once more.
"Since I've already killed you all once, I'll kill you all a second time."
Zhang Fei's fight this time was not easy, especially since all those people had the same strength and speed.
Fortunately, they did not have his techniques or other abilities, especially his enhanced condition ability.
Furthermore, those lightning bolts kept falling from the sky to attack him, and he could not avoid them, so he was forced to fight those people while enduring the pain.
Given their overwhelming numbers, Zhang Fei chose to fly in order to evade them.
He then used his qi to control the hongxi dagger and ordered the demon extermination sword to block their attacks.
As he fled, Zhang Fei hurriedly put on the abyssal demon equipment set.
Once he had everything on, he immediately attacked those people with his black halberd.
Since they were only illusions and Zhang Fei couldn't absorb them, he decided to use the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation to attack them in a specific area.
Additionally, he used the Nine Nether Fiends Summoning to summon those nine darkness creatures.

paragraphs: In the beast kingdom, Long Huang and Long Baiyun were sitting opposite each other, and they were discussing their subordinates' reports regarding Feng Yao.
"What do you think was her reason for coming to this realm, husband?"

Long Huang frowned as he thought of several reasons. "I think she has two special reasons for coming here, but I can't say for sure. The first is that she came to this realm specifically to challenge the tower, and the second is that she came here because of Zhang Fei. I believe the first reason is the most plausible, as the tower never added additional participants once other challenges were started. However, our subordinates reported that the tower did allow her to enter and gave her two tests. Furthermore, she has recently completed the third test, placing her just one test behind the others."
"I agree with you." Long Baiyun replied with a nod. "Why do you think that she came here because of Zhang Fei?"

Long Huang directly told his wife. "Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, but he has two other identities, which makes me think that there is something special behind his existence. Perhaps the phoenix race already knows about his existence, so they sent one of their members to look for him. Since the woman has already said that she doesn't want to be disturbed by anyone, we don't need to go see her, and we will know her real reason for coming here someday."
"You're right; we just have to wait for the truth to reveal itself."

In the kingdom of the natural races, Xian Lianghua had a discussion with his wife about Feng Yao's presence within their realm. Unlike Long Baiyun and Long Huang, they used a special method to monitor Zhang Fei, which his system could not detect. They already knew that he brought the phoenix princess to their realm, especially since her first arrival was in his residence.
"What are your plans next?"

"Since the woman doesn't want to be bothered by anyone, I don't plan anything." However, Xue Jingling didn't seem to believe Xian Lianghua's words, especially considering that they had been together for hundreds of years and she was completely familiar with his character. "Actually, I've asked our daughter to establish a good relationship with Zhang Fei, so it will be easier for us to approach and find more detailed information about him or the woman, and I believe that she will succeed in doing so."
Xue Jingling released a soft sigh. "What if our daughter is captivated by him? Will you allow them to be together if that happens?"

"Why not? Although Zhang Fei has both human and demon bloodlines, he is also a heavenly fox, so I think it's okay if that's really the case." Xue Jingling responded to Xian Lianghua with a frown. "All right, you don't need to behave like this, especially since our daughter is more mature and smarter than you imagine, and her observation is excellent, so I believe she will not attract him."
"I hope you're right, as I do not want our daughter to marry a demon."
Meanwhile, Feng Yao returned to the first floor, and she became the first to complete the Sin Challenge. "I guess that kid must have had a hard time facing his karmic test."
Another woman suddenly came out beside Feng Yao, and she was Xiang Changyue. "Oh? Did you come back here a long time ago, Senior?"

"The seven deadly sins aren't a problem for me, and my karmic test isn't troublesome either." Feng Yao turned to Xian Changyue. "It seems you don't have much bad karma, or else you wouldn't have come back here by now."

"My karmic test this time was a little tougher than last time because a lot of things have changed since then, and I've done quite a lot of bad things in the last few years, but I was able to complete it without any major difficulties." Xian Changyue then glanced at Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, and the members of the natural races who had just appeared. "At first, I thought Zhang Fei would be the first to complete the challenge, but it seems I was wrong."

Xi Xianzi, Xian Jinglan, and the other natural races immediately paid attention to Feng Yao because they did not have much information about Zhang Fei. Moreover, she seemed to have a good relationship with him, so they wanted to hear her answer about him.

"You are unfamiliar with Zhang Fei's character. He might be able to complete the other challenges more easily, but the karmic test will be very troublesome for him." Xian Changyue looked at Feng Yao again. "He is much younger than the two of us, but the living beings who died at his hands, be they humans, demons, or beasts, are far more numerous. Additionally, he is too cunning, and he has too many terrible methods up his sleeve, so his karmic test is definitely much tougher than all the participants."

After spending several days in the maze with Zhang Fei and learning about his abilities, including the ability to enslave others, Xian Changyue is no longer surprised by this. "Do you think he'll make it through?"
"Yes." Feng Yao gave her a nod. "Even though his karmic test is very tough, I believe he will be able to pass it, and he just needs a lot of time to complete it."

Not long after, all the participants started to return to the first floor one by one, especially those who had successfully passed it in the past. However, the tower immediately kicked out many of them for failing their tests, significantly reducing the number of participants.

Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, who had just appeared at the place, looked very embarrassed. Their faces were completely red, and they immediately rushed to one of the walls to rest, confusing Xian Changyue. 'Ugh! The tests are too crazy, especially the lust test!'

The two princesses then looked around, but they could not find Zhang Fei there. Having witnessed some of his crazy actions, such as absorbing those vengeful souls, they could immediately surmise that he had encountered problems in his karmic test. 'I don't know how difficult your karmic test is, but you must succeed, and we will complete all the challenges on the first floor together.'

A few hours later, Zhang Fei finally managed to eliminate all his enemies, and the lightning tribulations had also disappeared. His appearance was quite messy, and his clothes were also full of holes. However, he noticed that the little girl was still standing in her previous spot, so he immediately approached her and knelt down before her. "I don't know how you could appear here when we never had any problems in the past, but you should still be alive now, right, Luo Yunxiao? Do you hate me because I forgot about you for so long?"

Without saying anything, Luo Yunxiao pointed her index finger at Zhang Fei's chest and shot something into his body. However, he didn't feel anything, and the system also didn't show any reaction to it.

"What did you just do to me?" Instead, Luo Yunxiao disappeared from Zhang Fei's sight, which perplexed him. A portal immediately appeared and sucked him in, taking him back to the first floor. 'Check my body, Mei.'
[Yes, I'm doing it now, Master.]
"Fei!" Xian Xianqin was the first to call out, run toward Zhang Fei, and shamelessly jump up to hug him. "What happened to you? Why do you look this shabby?"
"Did you encounter your past enemies during your karmic test?" Feng Yao inquired.

Zhang Fei nodded with a bitter smile. "I encountered all my previous opponents during my test, and their strength was comparable to mine, making it extremely challenging. Moreover, the test attacked me with several lightning tribulations, so it took me several hours to clear it."

"Several lightning tribulations?" Almost all the participants, except for Feng Yao, Xian Xianwu, Xian Xianqin, and Xian Changyue, were shocked to hear that Zhang Fei had experienced two lightning tribulations when he broke through to the Earth Realm.

"I think it's good for you, especially since you'll experience it again when you break through to 2-Star." Feng Yao then checked Zhang Fei's body before asking via voice transmission. 'You should have touched the final barrier, and you can break through whenever you want, right?'

'Yes.' Zhang Fei then glanced at several people before continuing. 'I purposely held back my breakthrough because we might face the survival challenge soon, and I wanted to use it to get rid of those who are targeting me. However, some of them have already failed the maze challenge, so I decided to break through soon.'
"All right, you should clean yourself up and rest for a while, especially since the next challenge could start at any time." Feng Yao then left with Xian Changyue, leaving the lovebirds behind.
Zhang Fei then took Xian Xianqin away with him, but he noticed the red hues on both her cheeks, so he teased her. 'Did you meet me during the lust challenge, dear princess?'
'Don't mention that test! I don't want to talk about it.' Xian Xianqin exclaimed loudly as her face turned even redder.
'Haha.' Zhang Fei laughed as his guess was right on target. 'Actually, I met you during my test, and you tried to seduce me with your naked body.' "Ouch!"
After she stomped on Zhang Fei's foot, Xian Xianqin immediately ran away from him and returned to Yun Xinyue's side, where she hid her embarrassed face on her friend's shoulder.
Zhang Fei scratched his head before rushing off to another area to clean himself and change his clothes. 'Did you find something inside my body, Mei?'

[Unfortunately, I couldn't find anything, so I don't know what that little girl shot into your body, Master.] Zhang Fei frowned in response to that. [Anyway, who exactly is that little girl? Why wasn't she in your previous memories?]
Zhang Fei himself was confused by that. 'Honestly, I don't have an answer for that, Mei. I only remembered about Luo Yunxiao when I met her earlier, or else I would never have remembered her.'
[Have you had an accident in the past that caused you to lose some of your memories?]
'I've never had an accident, including when I worked in the factory.'
[That's weird, Master. Anyway, I'll try to examine your brain to find out the cause, and I'll let you know when I find the answer.]
'All right, you can do it.' After he finished changing his clothes, Zhang Fei immediately returned to Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue's side to rest, and they did not disturb him.

[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]

"Yes." Qing Yi immediately told her son. "The Luo family resides a few houses away from ours, and the relationship between the two of you is very close, especially since you both share the same age and attend the same elementary school. However, her parents took her to move abroad when you both were ten years old, but I don't understand why you couldn't remember her after they were gone. I once tried discussing her with you, but you said that you had never met her."
Zhang Lin then added. "Since then, we never talked about her again because you acted strangely after you heard about her, and we kept all your photos with her in a safe place."

"Did I have an accident after they left?" After the two women shook their heads, Zhang Fei [1] fell into deep thought, wondering why his memories of Luo Yunxiao had disappeared. "Forget it; I don't want to think about him for now, and I will definitely find the answer one day."

After that, Zhang Fei [1] returned to the training space again, but he did not dual-cultivate with his partners. Instead, he asked Zhang Lingxue to teach him how to concoct a rank three pill while they discussed further plans for their new shop.

"Are you completely satisfied now?"

"Not yet." Ilsath responded to Orith with a slight shake of her head. "Having sex with him all day was satisfying, but I'm not completely satisfied yet. Unfortunately, my body still lacks the strength and stamina of yours, leaving me completely exhausted yesterday."
"Haha." Orith chuckled at that. "If you were willing to have sex with her that day, your body would have been as strong as mine by now, and you probably wouldn't have been thrown into that portal."

Ilsath then leaned on the lake's edge and watched the dark sky. "If I hadn't been stranded in that realm, I might never have known about demon cultivators. "In that case, you should have sex with Elion more often."
"Yes."
Zilvora shook her head, listening to the two succubi. She then turned to Zhang Fei [4], who looked thoughtful. "Are there any other demon cultivators in this realm besides us in this realm?"

"Alder, the wolf king, is a demon cultivator." Zilvora was shocked for a moment to hear that, but she remembered that his strength was indeed much higher than that of other demon kings or queens, and he even dared to oppose Oz the First. "I've long wanted to meet him, but I didn't know his character, and he was much stronger than me, so I always dropped my intentions."

Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding and got out of the lake. "Get dressed; we are going to Black Moon City now."

After the three female demons were dressed, Zhang Fei [4] immediately enveloped them in his aura and took them away towards Black Moon City. paragraphs: In a far distant realm, above the sky, there is a floating white palace hidden behind the clouds, and various giant flying beasts fly around it with great joy. The palace is truly magnificent, gigantic, and vast. The palace is very similar to the ancient palace of the ancient emperor, and countless living beings of various races live side by side in harmony, except for demon races.

The top of the palace is restricted to almost everyone, and only certain people have the right to enter it. In one room at the top, a young woman in her early twenties stands in front of one of the walls, and her eyes are looking at several paintings of a man. The paintings show different versions of the man from when he was a baby, a toddler, and a child around ten years old.

The young woman's eyebrows were like willows; her almond-shaped white eyes were beautifully glittering. Her expression was like the calm ocean, as her lips were a shade of beautiful and natural pink. Her neck was like a beautiful swan holding up her beautiful head. Below her sleek shoulders was a busty but humbly concealed chest. Below her hourglass waist, her rear was perfectly sized, giving her figure an elegant curve to perfect her beauty. The folds of her skirt subtly reveal her flawless and smooth long legs. She exuded a pure and unblemished air, banishing all thoughts that men would have to violate her; she looked like an immortal fairy that had descended onto the earth.

"Zhang Fei." The young woman's eyes trembled as she called out the name with a soft but calming voice, and longing filled her eyes. "Back then, we were forced to leave the Earth, and I didn't want you to keep missing me, so I asked my father to seal your memories of me. Since there is no qi on Earth, I'm not sure how you managed to become a cultivator, but I'm glad that you succeeded in becoming one. Unfortunately, we live in two different worlds now, and I can't go there to meet you. If I force myself to meet you, those people will find out about you, and they will kill you."
A middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman unexpectedly entered the room. Upon noticing the young woman gazing at the paintings, they exchanged a brief glance before releasing soft sighs.
The middle-aged woman then approached the young woman, stood behind her, and embraced her from behind. "Did you remember Zhang Fei again, Yunxiao?"
"Yes, Mother." The young woman was none other than the little girl Zhang Fei had met when he underwent his karmic test, Luo Yunxiao. "He has become a cultivator like us now."
"Eh?" The middle-aged woman was shocked to hear that. "How could Zhang Fei become a cultivator? Could it be that Qi has returned to the Earth?"

"I don't know how he became a cultivator, but I'm sure Qi hasn't returned to the Earth." Luo Yunxiao answered with a shake of her head. "I previously sensed that my soul, which my father left in his body, has just awakened. He has already met my soul, so I know he has become one, especially since my soul will never awaken as long as he is still an ordinary mortal."
"Do you know where he lives now?"

"No." Luo Yunxiao then turned to face her mother. "Back then, I was still small, and my soul was weak, so it disappeared before I could talk to him. Even so, my soul had already given a bit of my qi to him, so I will be able to find him after he ascends to this realm in the future."

"I'm sorry that I separated you from Zhang Fei, Yunxiao." The middle-aged man spoke as he approached them. "Those people managed to find us because of my mistake, and the Earth would be in danger if they went there, so I was forced to bring you two back to this realm."

"You don't need to apologize to me, Father." Luo Yunxiao shook her head slightly. "Even if they never found us, we would still have to leave the Earth sooner or later, especially since our presence there would only bring disaster to its inhabitants, which is why I never blamed you. Anyway, my master previously summoned me to visit her, so I must go to her place now."

After Luo Yunxiao left, the middle-aged woman leaned on her husband. "What should we do, Fenghan? Zhang Fei has become an important part of our daughter, and she will never be able to forget him. Since he has only just become a cultivator, he will not be able to ascend to this realm anytime soon, and our daughter will have to wait a very long time to see him again. Due to the significant time difference between the two realms, she is now several hundred years older than him, and she will be much older than him when he ascends to this realm."

Luo Fenghan sighed heavily before leading his wife, Huang Xiaoyu, away. "Our daughter has long decided her future, remember? She doesn't even want to get married, and she prefers to live in solitude because of Zhang Fei. That's why we don't need to do anything and leave everything to her, especially since she will never change her mind again. I don't know how long it will take him to ascend to this realm, but we both know that he is not a foolish child, and I am sure he will succeed in coming here one day. Besides, our daughter has a very long lifespan due to her current cultivation, and her lifespan will continue to increase as her cultivation increases. Like us, our ages are also very far apart, so it doesn't matter if she has to wait for him for hundreds or even thousands of years."
"Haha." Huang Xiaoyu laughed softly upon hearing this. "Back then, you were still a snotty brat, and I was several thousand years older than you. However, I eventually developed feelings for you."

"This snotty brat is the luckiest in this realm, and all the men envy me, especially since I was able to steal their goddess." Huang Xiaoyu hit Luo Fenghan's chest lightly after hearing that. "We've been married for so long now, and we also have three great children, so I'm completely satisfied with my life."

"I am also satisfied with my life, especially since I have you and our children." Huang Xiaoyu then looked up at him. "If I think about it, among our three children, Yunxiao is the only one who inherited your character, and her little brothers' characters are more similar to mine."

Luo Fenghan's lips twitched at that. "Speaking of them, our two sons haven't been home for a long time, so I think we should ask them to return, and we'll immediately arrange their marriages to their lovers. They've been together for so long, but they have no intention of marrying them yet."

"Just like me before I accepted you, our two sons also think too much when it comes to their romance." Huang Xiaoyu replied with a heavy sigh. "All right, I will contact them and ask them to come home, and we will arrange their wedding with Bing Xingying and Cheng Mengyao directly."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women had arrived at the northern city, but it was already late at night, and all the shops were closed, so he led them to an inn to rest. He found the names of the three demi-humans who had followed them three days ago on the map. 'As expected, they were really waiting for us here, but fortunately, we have changed our appearance, so they shouldn't recognize us.'
As soon as they arrived at their room, Shang Yaolin immediately asked. "Are they still following us?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told the two women the location of the demi-humans. "They seem to have many friends in this city, so you two should stay in this room, and I will look around the shops in this city for herbs myself tomorrow."

Shang Yaolin wasn't overly concerned about the demi-humans, and she could seek assistance from her clan if they encountered any issues. However, she also didn't want to find trouble with them, so she chose to agree with him.

Shang Xinyu was not concerned about the demi-humans either, especially since Shang Yingyue was aware of their departure. She believed that her senior sister was closely monitoring their situation, and she would step in to save them if they encountered any trouble.

Shang Xinyu raised her eyebrows as Shang Yaolin pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] onto the bed, and the two of them immediately began warming up for more intimate activities. Since there were two beds inside, she decided to lie down on the other bed and seal her senses so she wouldn't have to hear their activities.

Zhang Fei opened his eyes when the two notifications appeared, especially since another challenge was about to begin, and the other people were also preparing to wait for the next challenge. 'Six challenges left; I hope to pass them all so I can try challenging the second floor directly.'

A while later, a portal descended and sucked them all in, and Zhang Fei instantly arrived at an empty place, which he believed was the location of the willpower challenge. However, the challenge was not a problem for him at all, so he immediately sat cross-legged on the floor before closing all his senses and starting to absorb Qi.

The old man suddenly appeared before Zhang Fei and observed him with seriousness. 'Sigh! Who taught this kid to cultivate using such a method? The purpose of this test is to assess his ability to maintain focus in the absence of time, but he purposefully closed all his senses to prevent boredom, rendering the test useless for him."
Mei naturally detected the old man's presence, so she reported it to her master, and Zhang Fei immediately unsealed his senses. "So you are the master of the two people I met before, Senior?"
The old man was surprised to hear that, and Zhang Fei opened his eyes immediately. "How could you detect my presence?"

"We don't know each other, so I can't possibly tell you my secret, right?" The old man nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately questioned him. "Are you guys intentionally using this tower to scout for talents from the lower realms? Based on everything I encountered in the maze challenge, I can conclude that this tower is also a prison."

"You're right about all that, Kid." The old man once again nodded to Zhang Fei. "This tower is a prison for evil and vile living creatures, and there are still many towers scattered throughout the various realms. We use the towers to test people in all these realms to find the best talents, but only five can reach the top of each tower at a time. Many living beings have reached the top in other realms, but no one in this realm has ever made it."
"Only five people at a time?" Zhang Fei was surprised by that.
"People without top talent will only face failure in our realm, so we don't want to waste our time with them." The old man then asked. "Did the phoenix woman tell you about our realms?"

Zhang Fei nodded to him. "Feng Yao's parents suspected that there were other realms beyond the upper realms, but they never managed to find a way to get there. The stories from the people in this realm about the tower's appearance led me to suspect that it had a connection to those realms, and your two disciples confirmed my suspicions. Can you tell me about those realms?"

"No." The old man rejected Zhang Fei outright. "You don't need to think about those realms for now, and you should focus on reaching the top of this tower first. If you want to know about them, you can come to this tower again after your cultivation reaches the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and I will tell you everything then."

Zhang Fei frowned after hearing that because the Divine Ascension Realm was too far out of reach for him; even Feng Yao's parents' cultivation was only at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, and the nameless one's cultivation was at 2-Moon.
"Since this challenge is useless to you, I will let you pass this test."

"Wait a minute, senior." The old man raised his eyebrows at Zhang Fei. "Since you are supervising and holding full control over this tower, you should know about the little girl who appeared in front of me during the Sin Challenge, right?"
"A little girl? Which little girl are you referring to?" The old man asked in confusion.

"Did you really not see the little girl?" The old man shook his head, leaving Zhang Fei puzzled. 'Could it be that I was the only one who could see her? How could that happen?' "All right, you can send me out of this place, senior."
After he sent him out, the old man immediately waved his hand, and a screen showing footage of Zhang Fei in the Sin Challenge appeared in front of him.

The old man closely observed every detail of the activities, but he was still unable to locate the figure of the little girl. At the end of the recording, he only saw Zhang Fei kneeling on the ground, but there was no one in front of him, and he heard him call out Luo Yunxiao's name.

"Luo Yunxiao? Luo surname? Who exactly is that little girl? How could she appear in this place?" After he searched for that name in his memories for some time and was unable to find it, the old man immediately returned to his private place.
When Zhang Fei arrived on the first floor, Feng Yao had also just appeared there. "As expected, the willpower challenge is nothing for you, so they deliberately sent you out early."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "You are no different from me, right?"
Feng Yao nodded at him. "I used your method to seal my senses, so they also sent me out early."

"Unfortunately, we have to wait quite a while for the next challenge, especially since the others will definitely have a hard time passing it this time." Zhang Fei then told Feng Yao about his conversation with the old man through voice transmission, causing the phoenix princess's expression to turn serious. 'I think you can tell them about this matter so they can try to challenge the tower in other realms, and they can find the answer if they manage to reach the top floor.'

Feng Yao agreed with Zhang Fei and used the interspatial communication device to inform her parents, but they did not give her an immediate answer. "I heard from Lingxue that you have successfully refined a rank-2 pill, and since we have nothing to do now, I will teach you how to concoct a rank-3 pill."
"Okay." Zhang Fei naturally would not refuse because he was eager to learn how to concoct a rank-3 pill, and his first clone was also learning about it from Zhang Lingxue.

They immediately returned to their original places and sat facing each other. Feng Yao then took out her alchemy furnace and several types of herbs, and she first explained them to Zhang Fei, including the method to process them before using them to concoct the pill.

Although some people were watching them from the waiting room, Feng Yao didn't care much about them because she was much stronger than them. After she finished explaining everything, she showed Zhang Fei how to process the herbs directly, so he could understand it easier by watching directly.
After she finished processing the herbs, Feng Yao began to heat her alchemy furnace before starting the concocting process, and Zhang Fei watched her every action with great seriousness.
