chapters.title: Chapter 594 Soul Challenge
paragraphs: A few minutes after Feng Yao started concocting the pill, several participants returned to the first floor. They were members of Zhang Fei's group, and since he had taught them to seal their senses, the test held no significance for them.

They were surprised when they saw Feng Yao doing alchemy, but they immediately sat around her and Zhang Fei. Though they weren't interested in alchemy, it was a rare chance to watch an alchemist perform live, and they were curious about her skills.

After three hours of concocting the pill, Feng Yao immediately turned off her fire and took five pills from her furnace, surprising Zhang Fei and the others with their numbers and superior grades. "Lingxue already told you that the result depends on the quantity of our ingredients, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to her. "In addition to the ingredients, we also need high concentration to concoct the pill, or some of the ingredients will be destroyed, and the amount of the result cannot be maximized."

"That's true." Feng Yao then gave the five pills to him. "This pill is a rank-3 Bone Mending Pill, and we can use it to recover broken bones and some internal injuries. I believe you can sell them in your shop later. I have given Lingxue many alchemy recipes, such as the Qi Essence Pill, the Refined Blood Pill, and several others. However, she can't possibly concoct all of them by herself because most of them are rank-3 and above. Therefore, if you want to compete with the alchemy union, you must improve your alchemy skills to assist her."

"I myself can't wait to improve my alchemy skills, so I keep practicing with Lingxue." Zhang Fei then put the five pills into the system inventory, and Feng Yao immediately stored her furnace and the remaining herbs in her storage ring again.
Bai Tian'er then asked them. "Are you really going to open an alchemy shop, Fei? Can I know your alchemist rank, Senior Feng?"
"My alchemist rank is at the ancestor rank." Feng Yao then pointed at Zhang Fei. "This kid has only been learning alchemy for three weeks, but he is already a master-rank alchemist."

Bai Tian'er and the others immediately looked at Zhang Fei in surprise, but he simply smiled and explained. "As you all know, I own a restaurant in the capital, but it's still not enough to support my family. Therefore, I plan to open another shop to meet our needs. However, my shop won't focus on alchemy stuff because of the alchemy shops owned by the alchemy union, and they will come to trouble me again if I try to compete with them, so I will also sell some other items."
"Other items?"
Zhang Fei then embraced Xian Xianqin. "I've already given her one of them, and she enjoyed using it, so I'm sure you guys will like it too."
"What kind of item did he give you, Princess?" Yuan Luo curiously asked.

Xian Xianqin immediately told them. "The item is a mattress for sleeping, but it's completely different from our hard bed because it's really soft, so I always comfortably sleep on it. My mother had thought about buying some for the bedrooms in the palace, but she had to wait for Zhang Fei to open his shop first."

Zhang Fei's decision to only give it to Xian Xianqin made Yuan Luo, Yun Xinyue, and the female disciples jealous. Bai Tian'er then asked him. "When are you going to open your shop? I will go see your shop as soon as we get back from this tower, and I will buy some mattresses for me and my family."

"You don't have to worry about that since my shop will be open when we get back, and you can visit it later." Zhang Fei then turned to the people from the other groups who had just arrived. "They managed to complete their challenges this quickly, huh?"

"Most of them have already passed the willpower challenge a few times, so it's no surprise that they managed to pass it again." Zhang Fei nodded to Xian Xianqin. "It appears that there won't be a decrease in the number of participants this time, which implies that our opponents will remain numerous if the next challenge is the survival challenge."

Xian Xianwu suddenly spoke. "Even though we still have to be careful, I'm sure the survival challenge this time will be a bit easier than last time. The Zhou Kingdom only has Zhou Tong left, and the participants from the Huangfu Kingdom have all failed. The groups from the beasts and natural races' kingdoms have never looked for trouble with us, and they obviously have an interest in Zhang Fei, so we don't need to worry about them. Li Yao and Xian Qifeng are also on our side, even though we are in different groups."

"Back then, Bai Chongxi and his two siblings became our opponents by helping the Huangfu Kingdom, but their situation should have changed now so we can exclude them." Yu Chongming added to the Xian Prince's words. "As for Xian Mu and Xian Yu, I can't guess their intentions, but they are always hostile toward Prince and Princess Xian."

Ximen Chuixue briefly glanced at Ximen Yan, Ximen Hongwu, and Ximen Yueliang, who had just appeared. "I think our main opponents this time are those demons from the two demon kingdoms, so we have to be wary of them. Moreover, they must be targeting Prince Xian, Princess Xian, and Princess Yun."

Zhang Fei smiled faintly because Ximen Yan was already in his hands, so he wouldn't be a problem for them. This way, he only needed to think of a way to get rid of Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang, but he was not worried about them either.
After they waited for a few more hours, all the participants returned to the first floor. The result was almost as Xian Xianqin had expected before, especially since only one person was eliminated.

Since they didn't need to expend any energy to complete the previous willpower challenge, the tower didn't give them any time to rest. Instead, it immediately sucked them in through another portal, sending them to the next challenge location.
When he arrived at the location of the next challenge, Zhang Fei immediately felt a strong pressure pressing on his soul, making him realize that it was the soul challenge.
[Master, the pressure is powerful, and it is beneficial for strengthening your soul. I think you can bring all your women here, and they can use this pressure to strengthen their souls.]
Zhang Fei naturally wanted all his women to strengthen their souls, but he was not sure about the character of the old man and his disciples, and he was afraid that they would target them.

However, the old man suddenly appeared in front of Zhang Fei, surprising him. "You can bring all the soul cultivators by your side to this place, and you don't have to worry that I will harm them. I usually won't allow others to do such a thing, but I will make an exception for you."
"Why do you want to help me, senior?" Zhang Fei doubtfully inquired.

The old man immediately answered him. "Your talent is better than all the participants, including the female phoenix. Although you won't be able to do it in the near future, I believe that you will succeed in reaching the tenth floor one day. That's why I will allow you to bring them here, and they will help you to become a better cultivator."
"If it's like that, I'll be in your debt, senior."

"No need." The old man shook his head at Zhang Fei. "I want to help them simply because of your talent; you owe me nothing. All right, you can bring them here now, and I will increase the pressure gradually so they won't have difficulty adapting to it."

After the old man disappeared, Zhang Fei used his clones to send all his wives, partners, and those closest to him who had reached the soul realm into the training space. As for Zhang Yue, she was still training together with Feng Jinqiu, so he did not bring her along. He also didn't bring some people to the challenge site, such as Hai Dongyin, Hai Dongxin, Lian Xiang, and Cai Wenjie, as they had just begun their training in his training space.

When they arrived at that place, Zhang Fei immediately summoned Boitata and several other beasts out of his beast space. They immediately felt pressure in their souls, prompting Zhang Fei to explain the situation to them. "We don't have much time, so you should start now and make the most of the time we have. Besides, the pressure will also increase gradually, so you must be prepared to face it."
All of them nodded to Zhang Fei before bringing out their cultivation souls, and they immediately began cultivating them by using the strong pressure that suppressed them.

From the screen at the top of the tower, the old man and his disciples watched them, looking shocked by their sheer number. Moreover, all of them were soul cultivators, and their soul power was higher than that of soul cultivators at their level.
"How could he have so many soul cultivators by his side, Master?" Hua Mei'er asked in disbelief.

Sima Yu was equally astounded by the sight of so many soul cultivators in one location. Even in their realms, each clan possessed only a handful of soul cultivators, whereas Zhang Fei had an abundance of them at his disposal. "Why do I think the number of soul cultivators in the middle realms is unusual, master?"

"You two are mistaken, and the number of soul cultivators in the middle realms is not as high as you think. From the way they cultivate their souls, I can see that most of them are not talented in the soul cultivation path, and they can be ones because of this kid." The old man then pointed at the screen. "Look at them; he is dual-soul cultivating with six of them at once, and I have never met a soul cultivator who can do such a thing; even our sect master can't do that. Dual soul cultivating with one person is already incredibly difficult, but he has no trouble helping them all at once."
"Are you planning to inform our sect master and the others about this kid's existence, master?"

"No." The old man replied with a shake of his head. "They've always appeared good, but we're unaware of their true hearts. You two must always remember that all living beings harbor jealousy and envy within their hearts, and this kid is currently too weak. For the time being, I won't reveal his existence to them, so please keep this information confidential. Unfortunately, if he manages to reach this floor, I will have no choice but to inform them."
Hua Mei'er and Sima Yu nodded in understanding to their master as they felt jealous of Zhang Fei's actions. "How long are you going to let them train in there, Master?"

The old man thought carefully before answering them. "I will stop their training after the last participant succeeds or fails in this challenge, so I think it will be quite long, especially since there are some soul cultivators among them."

"Master, I'm sure all the sects will fight over him once they find out about him, so I think you should think of something to place him so that he will be willing to join our sect." The old man immediately turned to Sima Yu. "Even though our sect is quite strong thanks to our sect master, there are still so many sects that are much stronger than our sect, and one of them is the Immortal Soul Palace. That's why I think we have to move before them to get his approval, or we will lose if he joins another sect."

"I agree with this old brat, Master." Sima Yu glared fiercely when Hua Mei'er called him that, but she ignored him. "Moreover, this kid has four elements, and he has already mastered the laws of three of them. If the people from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary find out about him, I'm sure that Sect Master Luo or his wife will come immediately to snatch him away."
Hearing that name, the old man immediately remembered his previous conversation with Zhang Fei. "Do either of you two know the names of Sect Master Luo's children?"

"Yes." Hua Mei'er nodded and answered him directly. "Sect Master Luo has two sons named Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jixuan, but few people know that he has a daughter. In fact, his daughter is his first child, but she has never appeared in public, and he seems to have deliberately kept her existence a secret, including from his sect members."
The old man raised his eyebrows after hearing that. "What's the daughter's name?"

"I have never personally met Sect Master Luo's daughter, but I have heard about her from my big sister, who is Senior Beiming Youhuang's disciple." Hua Mei'er then thought as she tapped her chin repeatedly. "If I remember correctly, her name is Luo Yunxiao."

The old man's expression turned to shock after hearing the name, especially since his guess was correct. He then looked at the screen again and thought deeply. 'What's going on? How did this kid get to know Sect Master Luo's daughter? Not even the cultivators in the upper realms know about our realms, and he lives in the middle realms now, so there's no way they can know each other, yet he knows her name. If they truly knew each other, the girl would have already marked this kid, and she would undoubtedly seek him out the moment he ascends to our realms in the future.'
"What happened, master? Why are you shocked after hearing that name?" Hua Mei'er asked in confusion.
"Nothing." The old man then asked again. "Do you know why Sect Master Luo concealed his daughter's existence?"
Hua Mei'er shrugged and shook her head. "My big sister doesn't know much about Luo Yunxiao because her existence is too secretive and mysterious, and she always appears and disappears like a ghost."

"I see." The old man nodded in understanding. 'Should I tell this kid about Luo Yunxiao? However, the difference between them is like heaven and earth, and he still doesn't have the ability to go to our realms, so I think it would only be detrimental to him if he knew about her now. I must put this matter on hold for the time being, and I'll inform him about her once he arrives on this floor.'

Zhang Fei [4] and the three female demons had already arrived at the southernmost area of the Netherworld Realm, but he did not immediately take them to the Black Moon City. Instead, he took them to hunt demon beasts to complete one of the two daily quests, and he also asked them to hone their fighting skills without using their demon power, especially since they would face other cultivators sooner or later.

In the northern area of the realm, Feltia [2] also took Nauvia and all his subordinates to hunt powerful demon beasts because his partners were with his real body, and he also needed a stronger army to face his enemies later.

Unlike them, Zhang Fei [1] remained in the training space, concentrated on his alchemy, and wanted to concoct the rank-3 Bone Mending Pill. However, he didn't rush to concoct it, and he used his alchemy technique to understand more deeply how to concoct it first.

Zhang Fei [5] never left the backyard of Zhang Chen's residence on Earth, and he sealed the area with a soundproof formation because he was still trying to forge a spirit-grade weapon so his activities would not disturb the neighbors.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] swiftly dressed and left the two sleeping women to explore the shops in the northern city. Even so, he continued to monitor the two of them, and he also monitored Ye Hu and the other demi-humans who kept watch at the entrance for them. 'Heh! You guys can wait for us as long as you want, but you will never find us.'

chapters.title: Chapter 595 Buying Herbs
paragraphs: "Big Brother Hu, we have been waiting in this city for four days, but those three people still haven't shown up." One of the demi-humans approached Ye Hu, who was standing on the edge of the city wall.

Ye Hu frowned at that as he was already annoyed because he had not managed to find Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women, but unfortunately, he still did not realize that their targets were already in the city. "Big Brother Xiong wants to recruit the male fox into our group, so you can stop complaining and do your duty, or he will punish you."

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already entered a herb shop and was exploring the area. He discovered some herbs that were not available in the central area, let alone in the Sky Jade Realm. According to Mei and the system's scans, some of the herbs were quite rare and had extraordinary effects.
"Are you interested in these herbs, young man?" An old male demi-human, who resembled an elephant, questioned him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to him. "I am interested in all these herbs, especially the Scarlet Moon Herb, the Yin Lotus Seed, and the Phoenix Dew Herb. Do you have a large quantity of these herbs, Senior?"

"Young man, all these herbs are rare and extremely rare herbs, and some of them only grow once every few decades, so their quantity is not much." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not surprised by the old man's answer. "Even if you search the entire city, you can only find a few of them, and their prices are expensive. Do you want to buy them? I only have about a dozen of each herb, and these are my final stocks."
"What is the total price of all these herbs?"
The old man immediately pulled out a tool to calculate the total price. "One million blue jewels."
'Damn! These herbs are really expensive!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to him. "I'll buy them, and I also want to buy every kind of herb you have, Senior."
"Okay, you can wait here while I prepare them." The old man rushed to his warehouse.
[The price of these herbs is indeed expensive, Master. However, you have Lillea by your side, and you have mimicked her plant manipulation, so the two of you can duplicate them.]

'Haha.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. 'That's why I purposely bought all these herbs, and I will ask Lillea to duplicate them. If possible, I will ask her to create new types of herbs from the combination of these herbs so their effects will be even better.'
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] waited for some time, the old man returned with three different storage rings, and he grouped the herbs according to their grades.
After verifying everything, Zhang Xiaolong [3] promptly paid for the herbs and proceeded to explore other shops, where he purchased various types of herbs that were unavailable in the previous shop.
After his business in town was finished, Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurried back to the inn, and the two women had long since woken up from their sleep. "Shall we return to our residence now?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed softly before replying. "Big Sis Yaolin, the herbs in this city are too expensive, and I don't have many jewels, so I can only buy a few. If you are bored on this island, I can send you and Big Sis Xinyu back first, and I will look for the other herbs myself."
"No!" Shang Yaolin immediately rejected it. "I will be lonely if you are away for too long, and there are many powerful demi-humans on this island, so there's no way I can leave you here alone."

'This woman! She's addicted to having anal sex with me!' Even though he said that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was satisfied because Shang Yaoling would never be able to leave him, so he could use her for his ultimate goal in the future. "What about you, Big Sis Xinyu? Do you want to return to our residence, or do you want to stay on this island with us?"
"We went to this island together, so we have to go home together." Shang Xinyu then asked him. "Do you want to go to the central area again?"

"The central area is the best place to look for herbs, so I want to go there again." Following this, Zhang Xiaolong [3] escorted the two women from the inn before departing the city, and he took them to the central area directly.
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
After the notification appeared, Zhang Fei [4] immediately returned the demon extermination sword to his body again. He then turned to Orith, Ilsath, and Zilvora, who had just killed their opponents.
"Elion, can you take us to another realm?" Zilvora asked as she approached him. "Even if we don't use our demon power, these demon beasts are still weaker than us, so they are not our opponents."

"I agree with Queen Zilvora, Elion." Ilsath spoke to him as well. "I believe you should take us back to the Azure Sky Realm, where the beasts are much stronger than these demon beasts, allowing us to fight as demon cultivators."
"Haha." Orith laughed as she hugged Zhang Fei [4]. "As for me, I will follow all your plans whether we live in this realm or another realm."

"You are really a pervert, and only sex is in your brain." Zhang Fei [4] spoke as he kneaded Orith's breasts before answering the other two female demons. "Since you two want it that way, I will bring you all to one of the cultivation worlds, and you can fight the beasts there. However, those beasts are much stronger than these demon beasts, and since you've never fought them before, you should exercise caution when practicing there."
"Yes." All of them nodded to him.
"Let's go; we must go to the Black Moon City now."
After arriving in front of the city in a few minutes, Zhang Fei [4] led them into it, with Zilvora walking beside him and the two succubi walking behind them.

As they walked into the city, the wolf demons kept staring at them with eagerness to pounce on them, especially the three female demons. However, none of them dared to move due to the pressure of Zhang Fei [4]'s heavenly fox aura, and they also knew Zilvora's identity.

From his map, Zhang Fei [4] found Gu Tong and Chi Yang in residence at the back end of the city, and both of them were with Alder, the wolf king. As for Yin Tong, he had long known that he had left the city and was alone in another area, but he couldn't care less about him.

Instead, Zhang Fei [4]'s attention was more focused on a green dot far behind the residence, and Tasha's name appeared from the dot. 'That woman should be Alder's daughter, especially since her aura is similar to his.'
A while later, they arrived in front of the residence, and they heard Alder's voice from inside. "Come in."

Zilvora immediately led them into the residence, where Alder was sitting leisurely, and the two former humans from the Sky Jade Realm were standing behind him. Gu Tong and Chi Yan naturally recognized Zhang Fei [4], but they did not say anything and waited for the wolf king's reaction.
"I didn't expect you to become a demon cultivator, Zilvora." Alder then looked at Zhang Fei [4]. "You were the one who taught them to cultivate, right? Did you come here for the two men behind me?"

"Didn't you already know everything, Alder? I can feel that you have been monitoring me since I came to this realm five months ago." The wolf king did not refute Zhang Fei [4], but he was surprised that he could detect his senses. "You're right; I came here for Gu Tong and Chi Yang."

"At first, I thought that many of the demons from this realm would die in that realm, but you brought the phoenix princess to this realm to stop Shang Huaqiang and his people, and you even managed to destroy the portal." Alder then questioned Zhang Fei [4] through a voice transmission. 'How can you be a human and a demon at the same time? Moreover, I can sense your beast aura, so I'm sure that you are also a beast, and I have never met a living being with three identities like you.'

'You're not wrong about that, but I can't give you the answer because I don't know how I could have three identities myself, and I became like this after someone resurrected me from the dead.' Zhang Fei [4]'s last sentence shocked Alder because it was impossible for someone to resurrect someone from the dead. 'I don't know that person's true identity, but she did revive me from the dead. At first, I guessed that she lived in the Xianjin Realm, but I found some clues proving that my guess was wrong.'

'Did the phoenix princess tell you about the upper realms?' Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Alder. 'The Xianjin Realm is indeed the most advanced in the upper realms, but the people there don't have the ability to bring the dead back to life, so that woman is definitely not a person from that realm.' "Since you want to meet them, I will leave you guys alone."
After saying that, Alder immediately left his residence. He also asked the three female demons to accompany him, as he knew they were still unaware of Zhang Fei [4]'s human identity.
"What about our realm? Is the situation safe now?" Chi Yang was the first to inquire.

"The Sky Jade Realm is safe now, but those cultivators from the upper realms have not given up on invading it. However, they won't be able to invade the Sky Jade Realm anytime soon, particularly due to the difficulty of creating a portal that connects the lower and middle realms, giving them ample time to prepare." Zhang Fei [4] immediately told Chi Yang. "Anyway, Old Jinshu is taking care of the desolate sect now, and he is assisted by several elders such as Lin Xintong and Chi Zhiqiang."
"Why isn't Lian Xiang the one taking care of our sect?" Chi Yang asked in confusion. "She is our vice sect master, so she should be the next sect master."
Zhang Fei [4] rubbed his nose. "Lian Xiang is part of my family now, and I have brought her to another realm along with many others."

Chi Yang was stunned for a while after hearing that, especially since he and Lian Xiang had known each other for decades. He was very familiar with her character, so he was really surprised to hear that she was already part of Zhang Fei [4]'s family. "Even though she's quite old, she's still young for cultivators like us, so I think it's good if she can move on with her life and forget about her past."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [4] then turned to Gu Tong. "Do you want to meet your wife? If you want to meet Xing Mei, I can bring her over. However, she can't stay here for too long, as the demon aura will affect her.

"I miss Xing Mei, but I am a demon now, and I don't want her to become a demon like me." Gu Tong then took off the storage ring on his finger and handed it to Zhang Fei [4]. "Please give it to her and tell her to forget about me. I know she will be disappointed, but I want her to continue her life without me, and she can take care of our son."

"All right, I will tell her about your message, but I will not be responsible for what happens to her after she hears it." Zhang Fei [4] laughed in his heart as he received the storage ring, especially since Gu Tong still didn't know that Gu Zhan had already been eaten to death by Boitata, and Xing Mei was his prisoner now. "By the way, my brother-in-law and Yan Zhixiu also became demons like you two, and they live with me in Lust City in the north. Do you two want to join them or stay in this city?"
Gu Tong and Chi Yang immediately rejected him. "We are indebted to Alder because he saved us from the other demons, and he taught us to be demon cultivators, so we will stay here."

"If you two have decided like that, then I will not force you guys. Since I still have other matters to attend to, I will take my leave now." Zhang Fei [4] hurriedly left the residence to meet Alder and the three female demons outside. "They wish to stay with you, so I will leave them in your care, and I will take my three women away now."
Alder actually wanted to ask Zhang Fei [4] something else, but he immediately dropped his intention. "All right, you can go now, especially since I still have other things to do."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [4] immediately spoke to the three female demons. "We will return to the tower first to pick up Balena, and I will take the four of you to the other realm afterward."

The three female demons looked delighted by that, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately took them back to the succubi tower. After they picked up Balena, he immediately took them to the northern region of the Sky Jade Realm to train, especially since they were too weak to go to the Nine Stars Realm with their cultivation still in the elementary realm.

Alder himself immediately went to other areas to take care of something, but he kept thinking about something in his mind that was related to his daughter. 'Should I let Tasha go with that kid? If he takes her to the cultivator realms, she can continue her cultivation again. I will first discuss this matter with her, and if she agrees, I will then contact him.'

After he found a suitable location for the three female demons to train, Zhang Fei [4] immediately entered the Yin-Yang Space to meet Xing Mei. He immediately shared his memories of his previous meeting with Gu Tong so she could listen to her husband's words for herself.

After she saw and heard everything, Xing Mei immediately collapsed and cried loudly on the floor. She had lost her son, and her husband had decided not to return to her due to his transformation into a demon. Moreover, she did not have her freedom, especially since Zhang Fei [4] would never free her, making her life truly miserable.
As for Gu Tong's storage ring, Zhang Fei [4] naturally would not hand it over to Xing Mei, and he would use the contents for himself.

Zhang Fei [4] did not bother Xing Mei, allowing her to express her sorrows on her own. He then proceeded to the tube in the middle of the room, which was filled with Yin Qi from the other six female prisoners.
[Are you going to break through now, Master? It's been quite some time since you broke through to the Earth Realm, and your cultivation has long been stable.]
"I only need around 35,000 more Qi to break through, right?"

[Yes, Master. You only need that much Qi, so you don't need to absorb the Yin Qi in this tube, and you only need to complete the other daily quest to break through. Moreover, you might encounter another lightning tribulation, so you won't be able to break through here.]

Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding before checking Zhou Meiling and Qian Ying's condition, especially since both of them were still unconscious. The Zhou Princess's soul was still asleep within her soul space, and the female demon was still struggling to recover from the heavy blow she had suffered after her memories returned.

Zhang Fei [4] immediately exited the Yin-Yang Space and looked for a quiet place in the northern region of the Sky Jade Realm to break through. He sat cross-legged on a hill and looked up at the sky, but he deliberately cultivated very slowly because his real body was undergoing the soul challenge.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 Survival Challenge
paragraphs: In the soul challenge, Zhang Fei and all his close friends continued to use the pressure inside to cultivate their souls, and several hours passed since they started.
'Kid, you must send them back as it's time for you to leave this place; the other participants have completed their challenges.'

Zhang Fei stopped dual soul cultivating with his six wives, and he then asked the others to stop. Despite their disappointment, they had no choice but to rush into the training space as soon as he opened the portal.

Shortly after they disappeared, Zhang Fei was also sent out of the place, and he immediately appeared on the first floor. However, everyone had gathered there, but he could not find the previous few faces, including several members of his group, which meant that they had failed their challenge.

"Why did you take so long in there?" Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao and told her the truth, surprising her. "You're really lucky, you know that? Even though the pressure adjusts to our strength, it remains powerful and beneficial to your soul."

"I was lucky, and my soul power increased quite significantly, but it's still a long way from breaking through to the earthly soul level." Zhang Fei then looked at the people from the other groups. "What's our next challenge? I can't wait to finish everything and go back."

"You don't have to wait to find out, Fei." Xian Xianqin then pointed upwards. "That is the portal to the survival challenge, but our group is down by two because Yu Chongming and Ru Yanyue failed their soul challenge."
Zhang Fei nodded as he looked at the portal. "We will definitely make it through the survival challenge."

The portal immediately sucked all the participants in and sent them to a scorching hot place, causing sweat to drench their bodies quickly, except those with the fire and ice elements. In contrast to the other challenges, they arrived at the same place in one group, but Feng Yao was sent elsewhere.
"How much time do we have to get through this challenge?" Zhang Fei asked them.

Ximen Chuixue explained to him directly. "There are a total of 5 tests in this challenge, and each challenge will last for two hours. After that, we will have a one-hour break to rest before the next test, which is always random, requiring us to prepare for all scenarios."

"I see." Zhang Fei then searched for the other groups' locations on his map. "This place is truly massive, and their location is quite far from ours. However, Zhou Tong seems impatient, and he has already led the rest of his group to look for us."

"He guessed that we are related to Zhou Meiling's disappearance, so he targeted us." Bai Tian'er then pointed at Xian Changyue. "Fortunately, we have Aunt Changyue by our side, so we don't need to worry about them."
Xian Changyue said to them directly. "I'll only handle Zhou Tong, so you guys will have to fight his group members."
"Haha." Yuan Luo laughed and clenched her fists. "We will fight them if they really want to fight, and we will show them that we are not weak."
*Bam... Bam... Bam...*

Xian Xianqin, Xian Xianwu, and Yun Xinyue unexpectedly fell to the ground, shocking them. Their bodies were shivering violently, and several purplish-black spots appeared on their skin. Even their vision quickly became blank, so Zhang Fei and Xian Changyue immediately checked their condition.
"What happened to them?" Yuan Luo asked in a panic.

Zhang Fei and Xian Changyue did not answer her, and they checked the bodies of the three people from their hands to their necks. They found purplish-black sting marks on their necks, which were from Ximen Yueliang's black wasp.
"Are these sting marks like I thought, Zhang Fei?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Xian Changyue. "Something demon-related stung them, but they didn't realize it, and we would never have realized it if their conditions weren't like this."
"Do you think they got stung when we were in the mini demon maze before?"

"I'm sure it happened after that." Zhang Fei dismissed Ye Zhiqiu's guess, as he had not encountered any such demon during his time in the mini demon maze, and he was confident that another demon had used something on them. There were only two groups of demons among them, but Ma Kuangyu controlled Ximen Yan at that time, so he was not the culprit. "The culprit is between Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang."

"Eh?" For a moment, they were surprised to hear that, but they immediately agreed with Zhang Fei. Knowing Ximen Yan's situation, they believed that one of the two demons was the culprit. "Should we look for Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang to save them?"
"No need." Zhang Fei quickly transforms into his half-fox form, shocking his group members.
Yuan Luo wanted to ask Zhang Fei, but Ximen Chuixue stopped her with a shake of his head, especially since the condition of their three friends was critical.
A screen suddenly appeared above them and displayed a test, which required them to find five flags scattered around several areas.

"You guys must move now, and I will join the search after I save them." Once they had spread out, Zhang Fei sat Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue on the ground. He then sat behind them, pressing his palms against the purplish-black sting marks on their necks. He then did the same to Xian Xianwu, using one of his tails.

Zhang Fei channeled his light element into their bodies, searching for the source of their strange conditions. However, it had already spread deep within their bodies, prompting him to act quickly by sealing them all with his light element. He then channeled his fire elements into their bodies to evaporate the source, causing them to grimace and sweat profusely.

The purplish-black spots swiftly disappeared from their skin, and their complexion eventually returned to its original white color. After that, Zhang Fel retracted the two elements and tried to wake them up.
Xian Xianwu was the first to open his eyes, but he felt as though something had jumbled his mind, leaving him perplexed about his circumstances. "What happened to us?"

"Do you recall experiencing a sting?" Xian Xianwu took some time to recollect the incident before telling Zhang Fei that it happened during their battle with the maze's final boss. "If I recall, Ximen Hongwu was helping us at that time, so I'm sure the culprit was Ximen Yueliang. I don't know how she did it, but she probably disguised her actions by taking advantage of the darkness so none of us noticed it. You should rest first, then help others find flags elsewhere."
"I can't rest." Ximen Xianwu stood up, enduring the dizziness. "We only have one hour to find them, and we will fail if we fail the test, so I have to move now."

"Be careful, then." A few moments after Xian Xianwu's departure, the two women opened their eyes, only to find their minds completely disorganized. Zhang Fei immediately helped them up and hugged their waists. "I know you two are still dizzy, but we don't have much time right now, so I'll take you to look for the flags."

As he took them away, Zhang Fei explained to them about their previous situation, causing Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue to become gloomy. Ever since they entered the maze challenge, they have been giving him trouble, and he had to save them time and time again.

"All right, you two don't need to take that to heart, especially since Ximen Yueliang used the darkness to do it." Zhang Fei then looked at his map to locate the flags, found one not far from their location, and hurriedly used his nine cloud steps to bring them there.

After arriving at the location, Zhang Fei immediately released Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue from his embrace. However, they were hesitant to approach the flag, especially since the area was quite suspicious. "Are there usually traps around the flags?"
"Yes." Both women nodded to Zhang Fei. "Sometimes they're surrounded by traps, but sometimes they're not, and sometimes they're guarded by beasts."

Zhang Fei immediately picked up a stone and threw it towards the flag, causing a powerful wall of fire to appear and surround it. Given his possession of the fire element, he swiftly moved to retrieve the flag before making his way back to the two women's side. "Four left."
"How did you find the location so quickly, Fei?" Yun Xinyue curiously asked.
"Secret." Zhang Fei replied with a wink, causing Yun Xinyue to pout her lips. "Princess Yun, if I look closely, you are really cute when you act like a child."
"Humph." Yun Xinyue snorted softly and looked away.

Xian Xianq shook her head at Zhang Fei's behavior. "Can you find the location of the other four flags? If we can find them faster, then we can rest faster, especially since my head still feels heavy."
"Senior Changyue just found one, so we just need to look for the other three." Zhang Fei then hugged them again and took the two women away from the area.

Using the map and his nine cloud steps, Zhang Fei swiftly guided the two women to the second flag's location, only to find it guarded by a quasi-divine-level beast. Even so, it wasn't difficult for them, and they only needed a few seconds to kill it.

Zhang Fei then took them to the location of the third flag, which was hidden in a pit full of lava. Once again, the trap was not an obstacle for them, especially since he had already mastered the law of the fire element.
A few minutes later, they had gotten the fourth flag, so Zhang Fei immediately contacted all his group members to gather at their previous location.
Sometime later, they all gathered at the same place again, but Bai Tian'er and the others continued to stare at Zhang Fei with suspicion; even Xian Changyue was suspicious of him.

"Why are you guys looking at me like that? Aren't you all supposed to be happy that we were able to find this flag quickly?" Zhang Fei then pointed to Xian Xianqin, Yun Xinyue, and Xian Xianwu. "This way, we can rest longer, and they can rest to recover their condition."

Everyone had always believed that he was the best talent in their realm, but his sudden appearance changed everything. Everyone in their realm, including his grandparents and parents, began to speak highly of him, especially after his feat against those heretics.
Zhang Fei [4] was naturally aware of Di Xiaoyao's attitude, particularly when the dot representing his name on the map abruptly turned red, indicating his hostility toward him.

Feng Xiaogang informed them that Feng Jinqiu was Feng Yao's confidant, and he asked them not to approach her because she was completely different from her matriarch.

Feng Jinqiu herself did not spare a glance at them, and her eyes only focused on the sky that continued to brew Zhang Fei [4]'s lightning tribulation. 'No wonder my princess thinks highly of this kid and wants to recruit him to our Phoenix clan. He's only 20 years old, but his cultivation is already quite high. All the cultivators in his generation, including the younger ones of our race, simply cannot compare to him. Unfortunately, he accumulated so much bad karma, and the stench of blood on his body was too strong, making his lightning tribulation no less powerful than those old folks. Will he make it through? Should I help him get through it?'

chapters.title: Chapter 597 2-Star Earth Realm
paragraphs: *Rumble... Rumble...*
As soon as the sky rumbled, Zhang Fei's other clones immediately stopped their activities, especially since all of them would also experience the impact of the breakthrough made by his fourth clone.

Compared to Zhang Fei [4], who remained calm to face his lightning tribulation, the cultivators from the Sky Jade Realm became even more tense as the pressure from the sky grew stronger. Even with their cultivations reaching the ancestor realm, they still struggled to withstand the pressure, with Di Xiaoyao experiencing the most difficulty. As a result, Di Xiong had to use his aura to protect him.

At the foot of the hill, the three female demons stared at Zhang Fei [4] with anxious feelings. They haven't been demon cultivators for very long, and they have never seen a lightning tribulation before. They could feel the power of the lightning as it continued to strike in the sky, which made them worry about him.

Some distance away from them, Feng Jinqiu also looked calm, but her gaze kept shifting between the sky and Zhang Fei [4] as she thought about his chances of passing his lightning tribulation. 'Show me what you've got, kid. If you can't get through this, then my princess's opinion of you is too exaggerated.'

Zhang Fei [4] took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and let his body float into the air. Additionally, he released his four cores and three souls, shocking Feng Jinqiu upon seeing them for the first time.

As for the senior cultivators, they had long known that Zhang Fei [4] had four elements, so they were no longer surprised that he had four cores. However, the appearance of his three souls still shocked them, especially since no one had more than one. Di Xiaoyao, who saw all of that, felt even more jealous of him.

Zhang Fei [4] did not forget to summon Lei Que, the thunderbird, out of his beast space. He promptly positioned himself beneath his master, allowing him to sit on his back. 'I will support your body, Master.'
'Yeah! Come to me now, my tribulation!'
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*
Unlike when he first broke through to the Earth Realm, the heavens showed him no mercy, and several lightning bolts quickly descended from the sky before striking Zhang Fei [4] at the same time.
"Gah!"
*Screee*

Zhang Fei [4] screamed in pain as his body shook violently, and their attacks almost knocked him off his contract beast's back; blood even spurted out of his mouth. Lei Que, who was under him, also felt extreme pain, especially since his lightning tribulation was still too strong for his current state.

Zhang Fei [4] immediately stabilized himself, absorbed the lightning, and channeled it throughout his body to strengthen himself, especially his internal organs. He also channeled the lightning to strengthen his four cores and three souls. Regarding his external wounds, he didn't dwell on them too much, as his regenerative healing factor kicked in immediately, causing all his wounds to heal quickly.
Lei Que immediately followed his master, and he also absorbed the lightning that struck him just now with great excitement.

The senior cultivators, watching the two of them from a distance, trembled violently at the thought of Zhang Fei [4]'s lightning tribulation striking them, but they were also shocked to see that he and his contract beast could withstand such a powerful combination attack from several lightning strikes. Even though they looked like they were in pain, they still looked calm, and they could feel their cultivation starting to rise.

'The heavens are mercilessly trying to kill him. Lightning usually fell one by one, but they attacked him all at once.' Feng Jinqiu muttered as she gazed up at the sky, still brewing Zhang Fei [4]'s second tribulation.
Unfortunately, Feng Jinqiu did not witness all the lightning tribulations that Zhang Fei [4] faced in the Sin Challenge, and the heavens attacked him all at once because he managed to withstand them.

Half an hour later, Zhang Fei [4]'s second lightning tribulation descended and struck them both at once, causing him to vomit another mouthful of blood. Unlike him, Lei Que wasn't too affected by the attacks just now because he was a thunderbird, but he still experienced the pain. Like before, the two of them immediately spread the lightning throughout their bodies, strengthening them further.

The sky above the Sky Jade Realm still had not regained its light, and it became increasingly dark as lightning continued to strike above there, indicating that Zhang Fei [4]'s lightning tribulation still had not ended.
Another half hour passed, and powerful lightning strikes shot down from the sky, electrocuting Zhang Fei [4] and Lei Que for the third time.

Unlike his first breakthrough, Zhang Fei [4] did not lose consciousness after receiving three powerful attacks from the heavens, thanks to his Lightning Body Technique, which had already reached an intermediate level. Moreover, he had also previously faced so many lightning tribulations in the Sin Challenge, which greatly helped him withstand their attacks.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to 2 Star Earth Realm.]
[Congratulations! The host's Lightning Body Technique has been upgraded to an advanced level.]

After the two notifications appeared, the dark sky quickly turned bright. As he smiled with satisfaction, Zhang Fei [4] reinserted his four cores and three souls into his body, and he immediately swallowed a healing pill to speed up the recovery from his injury.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately opened his eyes and watched Lei Que. "You made it through two stages in a row, huh?"

"This is thanks to your lightning tribulation, Master. Being a thunderbird, your lightning tribulation greatly benefits me, and if your lightning tribulation becomes stronger the next time you break through, I will break through even faster."

"My lightning tribulation will become stronger every time I break through, so I will definitely bring you along when I do." Zhang Fei [4] then sent Lei Que back into his beast space, took out a change of clothes, and nonchalantly changed clothes in front of those people.

"You are truly a freak, kid!" Di Xiong was the first to speak. "If I were in your shoes, I'm not sure if I could face three powerful lightning tribulations in a row, and I would be instantly reduced to ashes."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed at that. "Senior Xiong, I have encountered lightning tribulations several times before, and I almost died the first time I encountered it. Fortunately, I have Elmyra, Liu Qingyu, and Ru Xue to help me recover. Moreover, I'm also a body cultivator now, and my master gave me a good body technique, or else I would have died long ago."
"Oh?" Di Xiong was surprised to hear that. "Did you meet your master in your current realm?"
"No." Zhang Fei [4] shook his head. "I met my master in another realm, and she is one of the best body cultivators in her home realm, so I am truly fortunate to have met her."
"I see." Di Xiong nodded in understanding. "In that case, I won't bother you anymore, and I'll bring them back."

Di Xiong immediately led his two clan members back to the central region, with the other two following behind him. However, Di Xiaoyao repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei [4]. Only Feng Jinqiu and the two members of the Chang Clan remained in the northern region after Feng Xiaogang left.

Zhang Fei [4] naturally noticed Di Xiaoyao's glance, but he showed no concern and proceeded to speak to the two members of the Chang Clan. "Chang Wenjie is staying with me in the Nine Stars Realm, so you two don't need to worry about her, and she will be completely safe."

"I don't worry about Wenjie in the slightest." Chang Wuhen replied with a shake of her head. "If she is not safe by your side, then there is no safe place for her in that realm. Are the people in that realm much stronger than this realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] immediately told them about the situation in the Nine Stars Realm. "I can send you two there if you want, but you guys might face pressure when you first arrive."

"What do you think about that, Mother?" Chang Wentian directly asked her mother. "Uncle Zhang and the others are currently in that realm, and our realm is currently calm, so we don't need to worry too much. If we go there, we should be able to break through faster, and we can come back here to protect this realm again in the future."
Chang Wuhen nodded in agreement with her son before answering Zhang Fei [4]. "All right, we want to go to that realm to train, and we will come back here once we are truly strong."

"In that case, you two can go back to your clans first, and you guys can meet me here again once you're ready to leave." Once they left the northern region, Zhang Fei [4] immediately asked Feng Jinqiu. "What about my big sister, Senior? Are you satisfied with her?"

"Yes." Feng Jinqiu nodded to him. "Even though your big sister is still far from being compared to you, she is much better than cultivators at her level, and her understanding is also very high. I have already increased her ice element, and I have also started teaching her every technique of the ice phoenix scripture. However, her path is still too long, and I cannot force her to advance too quickly, as it would be detrimental to her."
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "I entrust my big sister to you, Senior. After she understands everything, I will bring her back to the Nine Stars Realm."
"Yeah." After that, Feng Jinqiu immediately disappeared and returned to the fallen moon cave to monitor Zhang Yue.

Zhang Fei [4] then returned to his human form, which shocked them. "As you can see, I am a human, but I am also a demon. As for why I went to the Netherworld Realm, I've already told you the truth: I went there specifically to increase my demon power. Actually, I still have one other identity, but my third identity is your eternal enemy."
"Another identity?"

Zhang Fei [4] nodded and transformed into his complete fox form, which had become so huge after he evolved to six tails. His current form is no less large than a blue whale, with six long tails dancing behind his hips.

When Zilvora, Ilsath, and Orith saw that, their jaws dropped. They were astonished to discover that Zhang Fei [4] had assumed the form of a fox beast as his third identity, and his physique was too gigantic.

"Are you shocked to see my third identity?" The three female demons nodded to Zhang Fei [4], who immediately returned to his human form. "I can't explain to you how I can have three identities, but my three identities allow me to establish relationships with all races, be they humans, demons, or natural races."

Orith immediately ran to Zhang Fei [4]'s side and hugged his right arm. "I don't care whether you are a human, a demon, or a beast! I will continue to stay by your side, and you must continue to satisfy me."

Ilsath nodded in agreement with them. "I will also continue to stay aside."

After he completed his breakthrough, Zhang Fei immediately led his group members to face the second test, which was to survive several beast hordes.

However, Feng Yao had already left Zhang Fei's group because the tower considered her not a member of their group, so she had to face all the tests alone. Even though her cultivation was suppressed to the quasi-divine realm, the beasts weren't a big deal for her because she was a pure fire phoenix, and her phoenix flames were simply too strong against them.
Due to his heavenly fox bloodline, Zhang Fei's group had no trouble dealing with the beast horde; all he needed to do was suppress them and allow the others to slaughter them.
They all felt a sense of relief after defeating the beast horde five times, as they still had ample time to rest before the third test.
All of them immediately rested in place before Yuan Luo spoke to Zhang Fei. "If only our group had you in the last challenge, we would have passed the first floor long ago."

Yuan Luo's lips twitched, but she did not refute Bai Tian'er. "Back then, I failed the natural challenge because the element that appeared was different from my element, and the weather in that place was terrible at that time, so I decided to give up."
"I'm the same as you." Ye Zhiqiu said with a heavy sigh. "At that time, I encountered the fire element, and due to my weak ice element, I was unable to pass it."
"I failed the beast challenge." Ying Shanhu spoke with a bitter smile. "I always bragged about my speed, but I met some beasts that were much faster than me, and they beat me together."

"Xianqin, Xinyue, and I failed the demon heart challenge, so we didn't have the chance to try the natural or beast challenge." Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue smiled bitterly after Xian Xianwu said that, but they were also relieved that they had successfully passed the challenge on this occasion.
"I chose the wrong technique in the enlightenment challenge, so I failed to understand it." Ximen Chuixue joined in.
"What about you, Senior Sister?" Zhang Fei asked Bai Tian'er.
Instead, Bai Tian'er pointed at Ximen Chuixue. "I'm in the same boat as him; I also failed to understand my chosen technique."
"I see." Zhang Fei then turned to Xian Changyue. "You're the only one among us who has successfully passed all of them, correct?"

"Yes." Xian Changyue then told them. "Actually, I have reached the third floor, but I can't continue because the challenges there are much harder than the first and second floors. However, I can't tell you all about the challenges on the second and third floors, but we will face a few random tests, so all of you can see for yourselves if you make it past the first floor."

Xian Changyue's words caused all of them except Zhang Fei to sigh as they were not sure they could pass the first floor. Even though he is worried about the natural challenge, he is confident that he can pass the first floor.

Zhang Fei then looked at the map to see the movements of Zhou Tong, Ximen Hongwu, and Ximen Yueliang. He found the Zhou Prince already halfway to their location, so he was sure they would face each other soon. The two demons from the Ximen Demon Kingdom were also making their way toward them, but they were still a considerable distance away.
Zhang Fei then whispered to Xian Xianqin. 'Do you want to see Qian Ying, Qin'er?'

Lei Que immediately followed his master, and he also absorbed the lightning that struck him just now with great excitement.

'The heavens are mercilessly trying to kill him.

Unfortunately, Feng Jinqiu did not witness all the lightning tribulations that Zhang Fei [4] faced in the Sin Challenge, and the heavens attacked him all at once because he managed to withstand them.
Half an hour later, Zhang Fei [4]'s second lightning tribulation descended and struck them both at once, causing him to vomit another mouthful of blood.
Unlike him, Lei Que wasn't too affected by the attacks just now because he was a thunderbird, but he still experienced the pain.
Like before, the two of them immediately spread the lightning throughout their bodies, strengthening them further.

The sky above the Sky Jade Realm still had not regained its light, and it became increasingly dark as lightning continued to strike above there, indicating that Zhang Fei [4]'s lightning tribulation still had not ended.
Another half hour passed, and powerful lightning strikes shot down from the sky, electrocuting Zhang Fei [4] and Lei Que for the third time.

Moreover, he had also previously faced so many lightning tribulations in the Sin Challenge, which greatly helped him withstand their attacks.
[Ding]
[Congratulations!
