chapters.title: Chapter 598 Shang Xinyu's Question
paragraphs: As soon as Zhang Fei brought her into the Yin-Yang Space, Xian Xianqin looked over the surrounding area. She was amazed to see the tube filled with Yin Qi, especially since there was no such thing in the Nine Stars Realm. However, Xing Mei's cries and the ten rooms confused her, so she turned to him questioningly.

"As I told you before, I have several female prisoners, and she is one of them." Zhang Fei then took Xian Xianqin to see the rooms one by one, and he explained to her the identities of the six women: Wang Xiaoyi, Chu Youqian, Shen Shixi, Shen Xiwu, Mo Xuanxing, and Gu Jinling. "The woman who is crying is Xing Mei. Her dead son is Ye Lian's ex-fiancé, and I imprisoned her because she betrayed us by leaking many things about us to powerful enemies. Those people possess immense strength, capable of effortlessly destroying our realm.
"Who are they?"

"Those people are not humans; they are mythical beasts, the heavenly fox." Xian Xianqin gazed at Zhang Fei, stunned by the strength of every enemy he faced. "In reality, I am a heavenly fox, just like them, but I am not a part of them. They know of my existence in the Sky Jade Realm because I sent a human heretic to their realm, and their ancestors sent some of them to capture me. Fortunately, I am a demon, and I have the ability to move between realms, so I hid in the Netherworld Realm for quite a long time."
"Will they hunt you down again in the future?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei answered with certainty. "Heavenly foxes are arrogant, and their two ancestors know my other two identities, so they will hunt me down again sooner or later. They are indeed strong, but I am not worried about them, and I only need to hide again if they find me. Once I can match their strength, I will go to their realm to make calculations against them, and I will kill their two ancestors."
"You always have to be careful, okay?"

"I don't want you and the others to be sad, so I will always be careful in my actions." Zhang Fei then led Xian Xianqin to Zhou Meiling's room. "Her cultivation is indeed high, but her Yin Qi is too weak even compared to my six prisoners, so I don't need her. Instead, I will hand her over to you, but I must first do something to ensure that she cannot harm you."
"What are you going to do with her?"

"Release your soul first." Xian Xianqin followed Zhang Fei's wishes by releasing her soul from her body, but she was confused when he pulled Zhou Meiling's sleeping soul out. "I will merge the souls of both of you, binding her life to yours for the rest of her life."
Before Xian Xianqin could refuse, Zhang Fei had already used his soul manipulation ability to duplicate Zhou Meiling's soul, and he immediately fused it with her soul.
After Zhang Fei's action, Xian Xianqin experienced a strange sensation, as she was able to understand all of Zhou Meiling's thoughts, including her feelings.
"Have you noticed?" Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei. "You can put your soul back into your body, and I will wake Zhou Meiling up."
Xian Xianqin followed Zhang Fei's orders and watched him wake up the Zhou Princess, who was still sleeping. After he had enough, he immediately returned Zhou Meiling's soul to her body.

A few minutes later, Zhou Meiling opened her eyes, but her mind was in a state of confusion due to Nalan Yushu's prolonged control over her body. The interior of the room further confused her, especially since it was completely different from the interior of the maze or her kingdom.

"Hey!" Startled, Zhou Meiling immediately turned to the side, but her expression transformed into shock upon seeing Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin. She intended to attack them, but she couldn't use her cultivation. "Are you aware of your current situation? You are my prisoner now, so I have sealed your cultivation."

"You bastard!" Zhou Meiling yelled as she leaped off the bed, but Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin swiftly sidestepped her. Since her head was still a mess, she lost her balance and fell forward, causing her face to hit the floor. "Ouch!"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed, lifted Zhou Meiling with his aura, and then immediately strangled her neck. "Do you think I didn't know that you and your siblings were trying to capture us? Since you are our adversaries, I don't need to be lenient toward you, correct?"

"Bastard!" Zhou Meiling yelled as she repeatedly struck Zhang Fei's hand, but her actions inflicted pain on her due to the strength of his body, particularly after his lightning body technique had been broken through. "You can capture me now, but my parents and big brother will realize that I disappeared because of you, and they will attack the Xian Kingdom!"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled in response, released Zhou Meiling directly, and spoke to Xian Xianqin. "You can try it."
"All right." With a faint smile, Xian Xianqi then looked at Zhou Meiling and gave her several instructions.
Zhou Meiling was filled with panic and shock, unable to resist Xian Xianqin's orders, and she willingly obeyed her, even if it meant kneeling in front of Zhang Fei. "What are you going to do to me?"

"I have fused your soul with Qin'er's soul so that you will obey all her orders without exception, including if she wants you to commit suicide." Zhang Fei's answer shocked Zhou Meiling even more. "Besides, your life is also tied to hers now, and you will die if she dies, so you better think about your actions carefully."

Zhou Meiling's face turned pale after hearing that, especially since she was no different from Xian Xianqin's slave. The difference was that she still had her consciousness and desires, but she still couldn't do anything to refute her order.
"Can she inform her family about this matter, Fei?" Xian Xianqin inquired.

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "If you order her to shut her mouth, she will never tell anyone anything. I have also implanted something into her soul, which will prevent her from disclosing information about me to anyone."
Xian Xianqin nodded in understanding at that. "I want to see Qian Ying now."
"Let's go." Zhang Fei led Xian Xianqin out, leaving behind Zhou Meiling, who looked desperate about her situation.

After all, Zhou Meiling was a princess, but the two of them treated her like a prisoner and slave. She wanted to commit suicide, but her cultivation was sealed, and Zhang Fei had also taken her storage ring. Even if he hadn't taken it, she would still be unable to access it without her cultivation. 'Damn it! Why is my fate so unlucky? If my father hadn't sent me to the tower, I would never have suffered such a miserable fate.'

In Qian Ying's room, Xian Xianqin sat beside her best friend, who had been separated from her for so long. Her eyes started to well up with tears as she recollected the incident in which the demon abducted her best friend, a mistake she attributed to her overconfidence. Moreover, Zhang Fei had already informed her about her best friend's past circumstances, including the demon's implanted Shadow Oblivion Seal, which sealed her true memories.

Zhang Fei sighed softly and stroked Xian Xianqin's head. "I know you feel guilty about Qian Ying, but she's back now, so it's time for you to put aside your guilt. Even though she's a demon now, I can say that it's not that bad, especially since I myself am a demon. Instead, her demon power can enable her to surpass the strength of a human cultivator, particularly when her demon rank reaches a high level."
"What is her current demon rank, Fei?"

"Her demon rank is still at the viscountess rank now, so the road to increasing her demon power is still very long." Zhang Fei then lifted Xian Xianqin to her feet. "I know you still want to accompany her, but we still have tasks outside, so we have to go out now."
"Yeah." Xian Xianqin then ran to Zhou Meiling's room again and gave some orders to her first so that she wouldn't mess up inside the Yin-Yang Space.
Once they returned to their group, Yun Xinyue immediately questioned them. "Where did you guys go just now? I couldn't find you two there before."
"Haha." Zhang Fei immediately teased Yun Xinyue. "Did you miss me that much, Princess Yun?"
"No! I didn't miss you, and I was just worried about you two." Yun Xinyue immediately left them and sat down with the others, but her words and expressions were clearly contradictory.

'Princess Yun is a liar!' Yuan Luo and the others expressed this sentiment in their hearts, especially considering that Yun Xinyue had previously panicked when she couldn't find Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin.

Xian Changyue shook her head at Yun Xinyue's behavior, but she remained silent and questioned Zhang Fei instead. "Where are Zhou Tong, Ximen Hongwu, and Ximen Yueliang now? Are they still far from our location?"

"Zhou Tong is almost here, and we will meet him when the next test appears. We have to look at the situation first because we still don't know the third test, especially since this challenge is much more important, but we will fight him back if he attacks us first." Xian Changyue and the others agreed with Zhang Fei. "Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang are still quite far away, so we don't need to worry about them for now."
As they waited for the next test in the survival challenge, they chose to relax while talking about other things, especially about the remaining three challenges.

After Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian arrived at the northern region of the Sky Jade Realm, Zhang Fei [4] immediately sent them to the Nine Stars Realm. He didn't follow them there, and he stayed in that realm to train the three female demons. He also had to complete one of the two new daily quests, but it wasn't too difficult because Feltia [2] was also hunting demon beasts in the Netherworld Realm while training his subordinates from the Diyu Realm.
When the two arrived at the Nine Stars Realm, people from the Zhang Clan took care of Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian, and Yang Yudie took the two to live in the same building with her family.
As for Zhang Fei [1] and Zhang Fei [5], they continued their training in alchemy and blacksmithing, one in the training space and the other in Zhang Chen's house.
The weather in the wasteland realm was extremely bad, with heavy rain pouring down all over the area and strong pressure from the sky.

The situation forced Shang Xiaoyin and two other women, who were waiting on a small island not far from the western island, to move to another place for shelter. They appeared frustrated, as they had been waiting there for five days, yet neither Zhang Xiaolong [3] nor the two women showed any signs of returning.
As for Shang Wuzi, he had long since returned to their clan's residence. His status was different from that of Shang Xiaoyin and the two women, and he could not be absent from his punishment duties.
"Xiaoyin, we've been here for five days, and we've already wasted a lot of our time, so we should go back now." Shang Jiali sighed helplessly, frustrated by Shang Xiaoyin's stubbornness.

Despite Shang Yifen's irritation with Shang Xiaoyin's behavior, she chose to remain silent, as her family relied heavily on her mother. 'Sigh! Xiaoyin is too obsessed with Yaolin, and she never stops trying to bring her down.'

"All right, let's go back." Shang Yifen and Shang Jiali were surprised by that, but they immediately flew behind Shang Xiaoyin, who had already flown away first. 'Tch! I had no choice but to ask my mother to help me capture that fox kid.'

In the central area, Shang Yaolin was sleeping, leaning against the cave wall, especially since it was raining heavily outside the cave. Furthermore, her boredom stemmed from the fact that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had been preoccupied with herb hunting for the past five days, preventing her from spending much time together.

"Long'er." Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was sorting herbs, turned to Shang Xinyu directly. "I know you are still eager to look for herbs, but you have already bought and picked so many herbs, so I think they are enough for now, right? Moreover, Yaolin is already too bored to continue staying here, so I think we should go back to our residence first, and we will accompany you to this island again another time."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a quick look at Shang Yaolin before nodding in agreement with Shang Xinyu. He then hurriedly stored all the herbs in the system inventory. "You're right, Big Sis. I have collected various kinds of herbs in large quantities, and they are enough for several months."

"What do you think of me, Long'er? I know this will sound strange since you were still a child, and I am a grown woman." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Xinyu directly. "However, I have been contemplating it ever since I first saw you in your adult form, and we have been together for several months now. I've frequently shared a room with Yaolin, and I've witnessed you engaging in intimate activities with her on numerous occasions. I always felt jealous when you two were having fun together, and I yearned to be in her shoes. Unfortunately, you never showed any desire to approach me, which gave me the impression that you didn't find me attractive."

"You're wrong, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then grabbed Shang Xinyu by the shoulders and faced her toward him. "You are beautiful, attractive, and kind. Actually, I'm interested in you, but Shang Xiaoyin keeps bossing you around, and you can't do anything against her because your family is under her mother. Moreover, she obviously hates me and wants to capture me, and she will give you trouble if she finds out you have a relationship with me. That's why I never tried to approach you because your safety is more important, and I don't want anything to happen to you because of me."

Shang Xinyu was well aware of Shang Xiaoyin's character and had frequently heard her express a desire to capture Zhang Xiaolong [3], particularly during their private cultivation sessions. "You're right; if Xiaoyin discovers that I'm in a relationship with you, she will undoubtedly cause me trouble, and it will also cause problems for my family. In fact, she has repeatedly instructed me not to approach you, but I ignored her orders because I was constantly thinking about you."

"That's why you don't have to feel this way anymore, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then rubbed Shang Xinyue's cheek. "I like you, and I want you to be my woman. However, we are both still weak now, and others still control our lives. For the time being, we must focus on increasing our cultivation, and I will take you as my woman after I can defeat all of them, so no one will be able to hurt you or your family."
Shang Xinyu smiled and pressed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hand to her cheek. "Moreover, you are still a child, and I must wait for you to mature first, so I shouldn't be in a rush like Yaolin."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then lifted Shang Xinyu to her feet, approached Shang Yaolin, and carried her. "Big Sis Xinyu, hold my hand, and I will take us back to our residence now."

After Shang Xinyu held his hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] led the two women away from the cave using his nine cloud steps. However, he did not use his maximum speed, and they only arrived at the Shang Clan residence sometime later.

Upon their arrival, Shang Xinyu immediately returned to her private room, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] carried Shang Yaolin back to their room. After he placed her to bed, he immediately began cultivating to complete the daily quest.

sentences.text: As soon as Zhang Fei brought her into the Yin-Yang Space, Xian Xianqin looked over the surrounding area.
She was amazed to see the tube filled with Yin Qi, especially since there was no such thing in the Nine Stars Realm.
However, Xing Mei's cries and the ten rooms confused her, so she turned to him questioningly.

"As I told you before, I have several female prisoners, and she is one of them." Zhang Fei then took Xian Xianqin to see the rooms one by one, and he explained to her the identities of the six women: Wang Xiaoyi, Chu Youqian, Shen Shixi, Shen Xiwu, Mo Xuanxing, and Gu Jinling.
"The woman who is crying is Xing Mei.
Her dead son is Ye Lian's ex-fiancé, and I imprisoned her because she betrayed us by leaking many things about us to powerful enemies.
Those people possess immense strength, capable of effortlessly destroying our realm.
"Who are they?"
"Those people are not humans; they are mythical beasts, the heavenly fox." Xian Xianqin gazed at Zhang Fei, stunned by the strength of every enemy he faced.
"In reality, I am a heavenly fox, just like them, but I am not a part of them.
They know of my existence in the Sky Jade Realm because I sent a human heretic to their realm, and their ancestors sent some of them to capture me.
Fortunately, I am a demon, and I have the ability to move between realms, so I hid in the Netherworld Realm for quite a long time."
"Will they hunt you down again in the future?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei answered with certainty.
"Heavenly foxes are arrogant, and their two ancestors know my other two identities, so they will hunt me down again sooner or later.
They are indeed strong, but I am not worried about them, and I only need to hide again if they find me.
Once I can match their strength, I will go to their realm to make calculations against them, and I will kill their two ancestors."
"You always have to be careful, okay?"
"I don't want you and the others to be sad, so I will always be careful in my actions." Zhang Fei then led Xian Xianqin to Zhou Meiling's room.
"Her cultivation is indeed high, but her Yin Qi is too weak even compared to my six prisoners, so I don't need her.
Instead, I will hand her over to you, but I must first do something to ensure that she cannot harm you."
"What are you going to do with her?"
"Release your soul first." Xian Xianqin followed Zhang Fei's wishes by releasing her soul from her body, but she was confused when he pulled Zhou Meiling's sleeping soul out.
"I will merge the souls of both of you, binding her life to yours for the rest of her life."
Before Xian Xianqin could refuse, Zhang Fei had already used his soul manipulation ability to duplicate Zhou Meiling's soul, and he immediately fused it with her soul.
After Zhang Fei's action, Xian Xianqin experienced a strange sensation, as she was able to understand all of Zhou Meiling's thoughts, including her feelings.
"Have you noticed?" Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei.
"You can put your soul back into your body, and I will wake Zhou Meiling up."
Xian Xianqin followed Zhang Fei's orders and watched him wake up the Zhou Princess, who was still sleeping.
After he had enough, he immediately returned Zhou Meiling's soul to her body.
A few minutes later, Zhou Meiling opened her eyes, but her mind was in a state of confusion due to Nalan Yushu's prolonged control over her body.
The interior of the room further confused her, especially since it was completely different from the interior of the maze or her kingdom.
"Hey!" Startled, Zhou Meiling immediately turned to the side, but her expression transformed into shock upon seeing Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin.
She intended to attack them, but she couldn't use her cultivation.
"Are you aware of your current situation?
You are my prisoner now, so I have sealed your cultivation."
"You bastard!" Zhou Meiling yelled as she leaped off the bed, but Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin swiftly sidestepped her.
Since her head was still a mess, she lost her balance and fell forward, causing her face to hit the floor.
"Ouch!"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed, lifted Zhou Meiling with his aura, and then immediately strangled her neck.
"Do you think I didn't know that you and your siblings were trying to capture us?
Since you are our adversaries, I don't need to be lenient toward you, correct?"

"Bastard!" Zhou Meiling yelled as she repeatedly struck Zhang Fei's hand, but her actions inflicted pain on her due to the strength of his body, particularly after his lightning body technique had been broken through.
"You can capture me now, but my parents and big brother will realize that I disappeared because of you, and they will attack the Xian Kingdom!"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled in response, released Zhou Meiling directly, and spoke to Xian Xianqin.
"You can try it."
"All right." With a faint smile, Xian Xianqi then looked at Zhou Meiling and gave her several instructions.
Zhou Meiling was filled with panic and shock, unable to resist Xian Xianqin's orders, and she willingly obeyed her, even if it meant kneeling in front of Zhang Fei.
"What are you going to do to me?"
"I have fused your soul with Qin'er's soul so that you will obey all her orders without exception, including if she wants you to commit suicide." Zhang Fei's answer shocked Zhou Meiling even more.
"Besides, your life is also tied to hers now, and you will die if she dies, so you better think about your actions carefully."
Zhou Meiling's face turned pale after hearing that, especially since she was no different from Xian Xianqin's slave.
The difference was that she still had her consciousness and desires, but she still couldn't do anything to refute her order.
"Can she inform her family about this matter, Fei?" Xian Xianqin inquired.
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head in response.
"If you order her to shut her mouth, she will never tell anyone anything.
I have also implanted something into her soul, which will prevent her from disclosing information about me to anyone."
Xian Xianqin nodded in understanding at that.
"I want to see Qian Ying now."
"Let's go." Zhang Fei led Xian Xianqin out, leaving behind Zhou Meiling, who looked desperate about her situation.
After all, Zhou Meiling was a princess, but the two of them treated her like a prisoner and slave.
She wanted to commit suicide, but her cultivation was sealed, and Zhang Fei had also taken her storage ring.
Even if he hadn't taken it, she would still be unable to access it without her cultivation. 'Damn it!
Why is my fate so unlucky?
If my father hadn't sent me to the tower, I would never have suffered such a miserable fate.'
In Qian Ying's room, Xian Xianqin sat beside her best friend, who had been separated from her for so long.
Her eyes started to well up with tears as she recollected the incident in which the demon abducted her best friend, a mistake she attributed to her overconfidence.
Moreover, Zhang Fei had already informed her about her best friend's past circumstances, including the demon's implanted Shadow Oblivion Seal, which sealed her true memories.
Zhang Fei sighed softly and stroked Xian Xianqin's head.
"I know you feel guilty about Qian Ying, but she's back now, so it's time for you to put aside your guilt.
Even though she's a demon now, I can say that it's not that bad, especially since I myself am a demon.
Instead, her demon power can enable her to surpass the strength of a human cultivator, particularly when her demon rank reaches a high level."
"What is her current demon rank, Fei?"
"Her demon rank is still at the viscountess rank now, so the road to increasing her demon power is still very long." Zhang Fei then lifted Xian Xianqin to her feet.
"I know you still want to accompany her, but we still have tasks outside, so we have to go out now."
"Yeah." Xian Xianqin then ran to Zhou Meiling's room again and gave some orders to her first so that she wouldn't mess up inside the Yin-Yang Space.
Once they returned to their group, Yun Xinyue immediately questioned them.
"Where did you guys go just now?
I couldn't find you two there before."
"Haha." Zhang Fei immediately teased Yun Xinyue.
"Did you miss me that much, Princess Yun?"
"No!
I didn't miss you, and I was just worried about you two." Yun Xinyue immediately left them and sat down with the others, but her words and expressions were clearly contradictory.

'Princess Yun is a liar!' Yuan Luo and the others expressed this sentiment in their hearts, especially considering that Yun Xinyue had previously panicked when she couldn't find Zhang Fei and Xian Xianqin.
Xian Changyue shook her head at Yun Xinyue's behavior, but she remained silent and questioned Zhang Fei instead.
"Where are Zhou Tong, Ximen Hongwu, and Ximen Yueliang now?
Are they still far from our location?"
"Zhou Tong is almost here, and we will meet him when the next test appears.

We have to look at the situation first because we still don't know the third test, especially since this challenge is much more important, but we will fight him back if he attacks us first." Xian Changyue and the others agreed with Zhang Fei.
"Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang are still quite far away, so we don't need to worry about them for now."

chapters.title: Chapter 599 Test His Strength
paragraphs: Ximen Hongwu and Ximen Yueliang, who were leading the remnants of their subordinates to search for Zhang Fei, were surprised by the appearance of Ximen Yan and several of his subordinates. Moreover, the unusual look in their cousin's eyes convinced them that something was controlling him.
Ximen Yueliang subconsciously took a step back and hid behind her big brother, especially since Ximen Yan's gaze was clearly focused only on her. 'Brother, he seems to be planning to capture me.'
'Yeah.' Ximen Hongwu nodded slightly. "What are you doing here, cousin?"
"Kill their subordinates!" Ximen Yan's subordinates immediately moved as soon as their prince ordered them to attack their enemies. He then moved toward Ximen Hongwu, attacking him with full force.
"Gah!" The blow sent Ximen Hongwu flying far backward.
Ximen Yan didn't directly attack Ximen Hongwu again. Instead, he flew toward Ximen Yueliang, who was trying to escape. "No! Cousin! Let me go!"
"Heh." Ximen Yan snorted and thrust something into Ximen Yueliang's neck, causing her body to go limp in his arms.

Ximen Yueliang was shocked to discover that her body lacked strength and that she was unable to use her demon power or cultivation, particularly since Ximen Yan had sealed both of them. "Brother! Save me!"
"Bastard! Release her!" Ximen Hongwu, who had just stabilized his body, immediately dashed toward his cousin to save his sister.
With a faint smirk, Ximen Yan threw an object toward Ximen Hongwu, which instantly exploded before white powder enveloped him.

"Cough... Cough..." Ximen Hongwu immediately protected his body with qi, but he was a bit too late in doing so, as he had already inhaled a bit of the white powder, causing his movement to slow down significantly. When he arrived, Ximen Yan had already disappeared from his sight, and he had taken Ximen Yueliang with him. "Damn it! What kind of powder is that?"

Ximen Hongwu then assisted his subordinates in eliminating all of Ximen Yan's subordinates, a task that proved to be relatively easy for him. After eliminating them, he ordered his subordinates to spread out in search of his cousin while also rushing to find them in another area. "Fuck! I'll kill that bastard if something bad happens to Yueliang."

Meanwhile, Ximen Yan had already brought the powerless Ximen Yueliang into a cave a little way away from the previous location, and then he chained her body with bloody red chains. "What exactly are you planning to do to me, Cousin?"
"Just shut up and wait for my master to come here." Ximen Yan replied coldly.
Ximen Yueliang appeared perplexed and pondered deeply. 'Master? Since when did he have a master? Isn't his master Uncle Gongfu?'
*Drap... Drap...*

After they had waited for almost two hours, Zhang Fei and the others heard the sound of several swift footsteps running towards them. Simultaneously, a screen appeared above them, causing them to frown as they realized their next test was to eliminate the nearby enemies.
"A test like this has never appeared before in the survival challenge." Bai Tian'er and the others immediately stood up and prepared to face the approaching group of enemies.

'That old man did change the test on purpose.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he lifted Xian Xianqin to her feet, but he had the Xian princess retreat behind them. "Senior Changyue, you don't need to move yet, and I will try to fight with Zhou Tong first."
Xian Changyue briefly raised an eyebrow before posing a question. "Are you sure you can face him? He is different from Zhou Fang, and his cultivation is in the 5-Moon Divine Transcend Realm."

"I won't know the outcome until I fight him, and if I can't defeat him, you can make your move." After Xian Changyue nodded, Zhang Fei immediately took out the demon extermination sword, especially since Mei had detected that Zhou Tong had a demon bloodline in his body. "You guys must focus on getting rid of all his subordinates as soon as possible."
Soon, Zhou Tong and several of his subordinates arrived nearby, and the Zhou Prince glanced at Xian Changyue, the strongest member of Zhang Fei's group, whom even his father dared not underestimate.
"What do you mean by this, Zhou Tong?"

Zhou Tong shivered at Xian Changyue's cold voice, but he responded by pointing at Zhang Fei. "Senior Changyue, I came here specifically for him because I believe he has done something to Zhou Meiling. I hope you don't interfere in our matter."

"Do you have any evidence that Zhang Fei has done something to Zhou Meiling?" Zhou Tong frowned at Xian Changyue's question because he did not have any evidence, and it was just his guess. "He has been with our group since we entered the maze's inner area, and your sister was with you at that time. Moreover, we never met your sister in the inner area, so we know for sure that he didn't do anything to her."

"It's useless for you to talk to him, Senior Changyue." Zhang Fei then pointed his sword at Zhou Tong. "From the start, he was jealous of me because my strength test was equal to his despite my cultivation being far below his, and my other test results were also much better than his. He clearly had no evidence whatsoever and accused me simply because of his jealousy, so we don't need to talk much with irrational people like him. Moreover, the test requires us to defeat our closest opponents, and since they are our closest opponents, we are left with no choice but to engage in combat with them."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately teleported in front of Zhou Tong and kicked him with full force, sending him flying backward.
"Attack them!" Ximen Chuixue immediately led their group members to attack the people from the Zhou Kingdom.
Xian Changyue did not move from her spot, but her gaze was focused on Zhou Tong, who looked shocked as he stood face-to-face with Zhang Fei in the air.

'What the hell is with this guy? How could he move in front of me so quickly?' Just as Zhou Tong was contemplating his next move, Zhang Fei moved in front of him once more and aimed the demon extermination sword at him. However, the Zhou Prince had already shielded his body with his Qi, preventing his attack from reaching him.
Zhou Tong immediately attacked Zhang Fei with his Qi-covered fist, but his punch hit empty air as he had already disappeared.

Zhang Fei reappeared behind Zhou Tong and slashed his sword toward his back, but his Qi protection once again blocked his attack. The Zhou Prince spun around to attack him, but he had already disappeared first, causing his attack to fail again.

'Shit! No wonder he can beat Fang'er! Even I couldn't detect his aura or discern his movements. Zhou Tong immediately spread his senses to look for Zhang Fei, but he was unable to locate his whereabouts. 'Where did this rat actually come from? How could his speed surpass mine? How could he trick my senses?'
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Two dark red Qi swords suddenly shot toward Zhou Tong, but he immediately drew his sword and countered them. Immediately, a dark green Qi sword collided with both of them, causing them to vanish before it shot toward the sky.

"Hmm?" Zhou Tong immediately looked up at the ethereal dark claw that suddenly appeared above him, but he smiled and swung his sword upwards, instantly splitting it in half before disappearing. 'Tch! I don't know how that brat can hide from me, but his weak attacks are useless against me.'

Zhang Fei, who was hiding in the distance, could only sigh as Zhou Tong effortlessly broke all of his attacks. 'The difference in strength between the ten mortal realms and the seven divine realms is indeed too stark! Although I am far superior in speed, all my attacks are useless against this guy, and I can't possibly defeat him with my current strength if my attacks can't break through his qi protection.'

[Master, Xian Changyue is the only member of your group capable of defeating Zhou Tong, so you should allow her to do so instead of wasting your time on him. If you want to do something about him, you can ask her to restrain him for some time.]

Zhang Fei softly sighed in agreement, but he was unable to take action against Zhou Tong due to his strong soul power. He was sure that Xian Changyue wouldn't take any drastic measures against the Zhou Prince, particularly as it could potentially spark a war between the two kingdoms. Moreover, Zhou Fang and Zhou Meiling were already in his hands, so he didn't really need their big brother.
After he spoke to Xian Changyue through voice transmission, Zhang Fei immediately left his hiding place and went to another area.
Zhou Tong, who was busy looking for Zhang Fei, frowned as Xian Changyue flew towards him. "What—"

"You should give up this challenge, or I will force you to do it." Zhou Tong frowned even more at Xian Changyu's threat, but he then looked at his subordinates, who Ximen Chuixue and the others had defeated. "Even if I don't make a move against you, all of them can defeat you with their combined strength, so you must give up and take your subordinates back. As for Zhang Fei, you don't have any evidence of his involvement in Zhou Meiling's disappearance, so he is innocent until you can find the evidence."

Zhou Tong gripped the hilt of his sword tightly as he realized that he would not be able to defeat all of them by himself, whether Xian Changyue was by their side or not. Moreover, he remembered Feng Yao, who had a good relationship with Zhang Fei. 'Tch! I'm sure that bastard kidnapped Meiling, but I can't prove his involvement. Not to mention, that mysterious woman is also by their side, so I should go back and report this matter to my father.' "I give up!"

After he said that, Zhou Tong and all his subordinates were sent out of the challenge, and they were immediately expelled from the tower. When his father's subordinates approached them, they promptly rushed back to their kingdom.

Xian Changyue heaved a sigh of relief as she looked at Xian Xianqin and the others, but she still felt uneasy because Zhou Tong would report everything to her father, necessitating preparation for Zhou Xiaochuan's future plans. 'Where is that kid? Why didn't he appear? Did he go to take care of the two demons?'
Xian Changyue then landed in front of the others, informed them that Zhang Fei was taking care of something, and asked them to rest while waiting for the last two tests of the survival challenge.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had already arrived in front of the cave and entered it directly, and Ximen Yan immediately knelt in front of him, shocking Ximen Yueliang, who was still chained by the bloody red chains. 'What on earth is happening here? Why is my cousin kneeling in front of this brat? Since when did he do something to him?'

"Are you surprised?" Zhang Fei asked as he lifted Ximen Yueliang to her feet with his aura and brought her before him. "At first, I didn't want to deal with you yet, but you have done something to Xian Xianqin, and I hate it the most if someone attacks the people closest to me."
'How... how did he know that?' Ximen Yueliang inwardly muttered as her body trembled, especially since she was in the situation of not being able to fight back against Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei smiled at Ximen Yueliang's frightened expression. "By the way, you're after me too, right? I admit you're quite beautiful, and you're still a virgin. Unfortunately, your yin qi and female essence are too weak for me, making you unworthy of even being my prisoner."

Zhang Fei did not respond to Ximen Yueliang. Instead, he implanted his soul mark into her soul, and he merged her soul with Ximen Yan's soul, causing her expression to turn completely pale with fear.

"This way, you won't be able to say anything about me, and your lives are also tied together. If he dies, then you will also die, and vice versa; he will die if you die." Ximen Hongwu looked upset as soon as they arrived outside the tower, but he felt relieved after seeing that his little sister was fine. "Did you decide to give up the challenge because of our cousin?"

Ximen Yueliang wanted to tell her brother the truth, but Zhang Fei's soul mark hindered her words, so she provided an alternative explanation. "I didn't know what he would do to me, and I hurriedly gave up to avoid anything bad happening to me."
"I see." Ximen Hongwu nodded in understanding. "It's okay; your safety is the most important thing, and we can challenge this tower another time."

Nu Huangjin, who was watching her two children from outside the barrier, also disappeared from that place. However, she was curious about what happened between them and Ximen Yan, so she planned to interrogate them directly.

Zhang Fei had already returned to his group's side and promptly explained Ximen Yan and Ximen Yueliang's situation. Meanwhile, he was able to easily control the lives of the prince and princess of the two kingdoms. 'As long as you are not my enemy, I will certainly never do such a thing to you, but vice versa.' Xian Changyue nodded in understanding and let out a soft sigh, and Zhang Fei directly questioned her. paragraphs: 'Why do you ask that?' Zhang Fei's smile gave Xian Changyue a bad feeling, guessing that he lusted after her. 'I've heard you converse with Bai Tian'er before, and both of your skills are associated with charm and sex, right?'

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei nodded at her. 'That's why I asked you, especially since I know very well the effects and strengths of both of my abilities. No matter how high your cultivation and mental strength are, you are not a soul cultivator, and my charm affects your soul, so it should still be lingering in you. My touch ability has such a powerful effect that it can instantly induce an orgasm in anyone, regardless of gender. However, the effect won't last too long, and it disappears quickly after they orgasm.'

Xian Changyue was embarrassed to hear that, particularly because she experienced an orgasm as soon as Zhang Fei's copy touched her. As for the effect of his enhanced demon charm, it still lingers inside her body, causing her to think about him every day. Even so, she didn't want to admit it, especially since her niece had already fallen for him. 'Did you use your charm ability on Xianqin?'

'I never used it on Qin'er, and she fell for me because of her curiosity.' Zhang Fei then shared another revelation with Xian Changyue. 'Back then, I used it on almost all the women I wanted, but I never did it again. As for now, I only use it on my female enemies or the lovers of my male enemies.'
'How many wives and partners do you actually have?' Xian Changyue curiously asked.

'Hehe.' Zhang Fei chuckled before answering her. 'I have a total of 19 official wives, and their number will continue to increase in the future. Qin'er had already met all of them, and she liked them very much. Each of my clones has a few partners, with the exception of my fifth clone, who is only dual-soul cultivating with my six prisoners. However, those women are not part of my harem, and they will stay with my clones forever.'

Xian Changyue was genuinely shocked by the number of Zhang Fei's official wives, especially since it was simply too numerous. Despite his silence about the exact number of his partners, she was sure that the number of his clones' partners was greater than the number of his official wives. However, her curiosity was piqued about his six prisoners, and his intention to confine them.

'Prisoners?' Zhang Fei directly explained the situation with his six prisoners to Xian Changyue. 'Why don't you imprison Ximen Yueliang? Why did you give Zhou Meiling to Xianqin? Wouldn't they be more useful to you?'

'They are both royal princesses, but they are not worthy of being by my side, even as prisoners.' Zhang Fei then smiled, causing Xian Changyue to shudder. 'Only women like you, Xianqin, and Xinyue are worthy of being by my side.'
'Shameless!' Xian Changyue cursed at him. 'Are Bai Tian'er and the others unattractive to your eyes?'

'Ru Yanyue and Yu Chongming clearly like each other, but they lack the self-confidence to express their feelings, and they just need encouragement to formalize their relationship.' Zhang Fei briefly looked at two women who were cultivating a little distance away. 'Bai Tian'er is a princess; she is quite pretty and sexy. However, she prefers to dominate and take advantage of others, and I have never been attracted to that kind of woman. I have a cold woman by my side, and Ye Zhiqiu is not bad, but I am not interested in her either.'

Xian Changyue nodded in understanding. 'Actually, Bai Tian'er is not that kind of woman, but she changed after Bai Yaowei and his wife fell into Huangfu Shou's control. He removed her family from the royal family, and he expelled them from the Bai Kingdom. He even went so far as to alienate them from their environment, causing their situation to decline. She chose to be who she is today to support her family, and she is willing to use anyone for their benefit.'

'No matter what her reasons are, I will never be interested in her as long as her mindset is still like that.' Zhang Fei then looked up to the sky and told Xian Changyue about the characters of all his wives and partners. 'Now you understand why I'm not interested in them, right?'
'Yeah.' Xian Changyue nodded and asked him. 'Can you take me to meet them?'
'Sure! I'll take you to meet them after we get back.' Zhang Fei then posed a playful question. 'Are you attracted to me now?'
'Humph!' Xian Changyue snorted and moved to sit elsewhere.

Zhang Fei smiled at Xian Changyue's behavior, but he did not bother her. Instead, he sat cross-legged on the ground, trying to understand the other seven sub-techniques of the Nine Demon Secret Scripture.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]

After he finished the daily quest, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes and looked at Shang Yaolin, but she was still fast asleep. He hastily left their room and headed to the mountaintop, as Shang Yingyue was there, and he hadn't engaged in dual soul cultivation with her for a few days. Moreover, the soul emperor, Hun Di, would arrive at the Wasteland Realm in a week, and his soul power had not yet broken through to the earthly soul level, so he wanted to break through to that stage as soon as possible.
"Did you get a lot of herbs there?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded as he sat down in front of Shang Yingyue, immediately releasing his soul from his body. "Actually, I still wanted to look for other herbs there, but Big Sis Yaolin was too bored, so I brought them back. Moreover, your master will arrive in this realm in a few days, so I only have a little time to break through in my soul power."

Even though she knew that Qiao Liangren was lying to Zhang Xiaolong [3] about their master, Shang Yingyue chose not to tell him the truth, especially since she had been waiting for a long time to dual soul cultivate with him. She immediately grabbed both of his hands, interlocking their fingers, and drew out her soul, initiating their dual soul cultivation.
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
After he killed the last beast, Feltia [2] immediately turned to Nauvia, Kyllia, Naeth, and his other subordinates, who were lying exhausted and breathing heavily on the ground.
Not far from them, Fyr, Eve, Ashreth, Leora, Nadea, Angela, Ursula, Virgil, and the Amaris Twins looked excited to find the demon-beast core in the pile of hundreds of beast corpses around them.

After all, the demon beasts in the Netherworld Realm were stronger than Nauvia and Feltia [2]'s other subordinates, who had never trained in the training space. Moreover, he had asked them to fight those beasts without resting for a few days, so they were completely exhausted.

Feltia [2] deliberately brought Yan Zhixiu and Zhang Wuji along to train his subordinates because he didn't want to train them himself, so he asked for their help to train them. After all, they were experienced cultivators and more experienced than him, and they had often fought many stronger opponents in the past, so their experience was useful for their training.
"Fei'er, I think you can let them rest for a few days." Zhang Wuji said this as he walked up to him.

Feltia [2] immediately agreed with Zhang Wuji. "You are right, brother-in-law. I will bring them back to the tower so they can rest comfortably. However, I will take Ursula and the others to another area to search for stronger demon beasts, which will help them become more accustomed to fighting as demon cultivators.
"I'll join you guys." Yan Zhixiu spoke to him.
Zhang Wuji didn't want to rest either. "Me too."

After Feltia [2] sent Nauvia and his other subordinates back to the Elion Tower, he immediately took Zhang Wuji, Yan Zhixiu, and his ten female demon partners to another place, where they would spend several days training and absorbing demon energy.

In the northern region of the Sky Jade Realm, the three female demons were also exhausted after fighting with many cultivation beasts, except for Orith, who had super stamina. Their bodies were covered in several wounds, including Queen Zilvora's.

Zhang Fei [4] immediately moved to their side and gave them Qi recovery pills so they could recover their depleted Qi. "How do you feel after fighting these beasts? They are more or less different from the demon beasts in the Netherworld Realm, right?"

"Yeah." Zilvora was the first to answer him. "Unlike those mindless demon beasts, these beasts are smarter and more cunning, and many of them can read our movements, so it's hard for us to fight them in large numbers."
As Ilsath caught her breath, she asked him a question. "Do you always fight with these beasts?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "I have killed too many cultivation or demon beasts, and these beasts are much weaker than those I have faced in other realms. That's why I brought the three of you here to train, especially since you guys are still amateur demon cultivators. After your cultivation improves and you are more familiar with fighting as demon cultivators, I will bring you to my current realm to train there."
"Hehehe." Orith suddenly laughed and hugged Zhang Fei [4]. "In that case, let's have sex now so our cultivation can improve faster, and we can deal with these beasts more easily."

Zilvora and Ilsath facepalmed at Orith's behavior, especially since she never stopped thinking about sex. Even though they wanted to have sex with Zhang Fei [4] to get stronger, their bodies wouldn't cooperate due to their fatigue.

Zhang Fei [4] just shook his head in response to Orith, but he then took the three female demons away to the abandoned residence of one of the heretic clans. He immediately had sex with the succubus duchess, but the other two chose to rest first.

At Zhang Chen's house, Zhang Fei [5] decided to stop forging because he had already forged a few swords at spirit grade, but their quality was too poor. Moreover, he had not rested for several days, so he wanted to refresh himself first.
*Knock... Knock...*
Someone suddenly knocked on the door of the house, causing Zhang Fei [5] to raise his eyebrows, especially since it was still dawn on Earth.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] was taken aback upon seeing the person with his senses, prompting him to rush out to greet the guest. "Why did you suddenly come here, Brother Xuan?"

"Do you know where Xue'er and Ling'er are, Fei'er? I tried looking for them at their house, but no one opened the door for me." The guest was none other than Xu Xuan, Ru Xue's ex-husband and Xu Ling'er's father.
Zhang Fei [5] always knew that Xu Xuan and Ru Xue's relationship had always been bad, but he never had a bad attitude toward him, which made him still feel guilty about him.

His first clone went straight to Ru Xue and Xu Ling'er to ask if they wanted to see Xu Xuan or not, but they didn't want to see him anymore, especially the little girl. "I'm sorry, Brother Xuan. You don't have to come back to this village to look for them anymore, especially since Big Sis Xue and Ling'er have moved to another city, but she didn't tell me their destination or new address, so I can't help you find them."
"When did they move out of this village?" Xu Xuan asked disappointedly.

"A few days after she decided to divorce you, Big Sis Xue took Ling'er to move out of this village. She wanted to forget her memories with you, and she wanted to find a better future for both of them." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer caused Xu Xuan's expression to become even more disappointed. "Brother Xuan, I didn't mean to interfere in your personal affairs, but you already had a chance with her once, and you wasted it by always treating her rudely. Regarding your daughter, I am familiar with her because she frequently confides in me, and I am aware that she never liked you due to your rude behavior toward her mother. It's been a while since your divorce, so I think you should move on."

"You're right; I was the one who lost my chance with Xue'er. Honestly, I didn't come here to reconcile with her, and I only wanted to visit Ling'er because she is my biological daughter.
